jobs.title: AI Software Engineer II (Credit)
jobs.description: **Who We Are:** NCC is a leader in providing award\-winning software, credit and compliance solutions, and cutting\-edge data to the automotive industry for over 30 years. Our solutions help dealerships streamline their operations, enhance their finance and insurance (F\&I) processes, and drive profitability. We are looking for individuals who thrive in a high\-growth environment. **Overview:** We're seeking an **AI Software Engineer II** to help build the next generation of AI\-powered capabilities. In this role, you'll develop and deliver production\-ready software that integrates large language models (LLMs), machine learning, and cloud\-based AI services into customer\-facing applications. You'll partner closely with Product and Engineering to rapidly prototype, build, and deploy intelligent features, applying strong software engineering fundamentals to deliver scalable, reliable, and maintainable solutions. This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer with 2–4 years of experience who enjoys solving real\-world business problems with modern AI technologies. **What You’ll Do:** * Design, build, and deploy AI\-powered features within our SaaS platform. * Integrate LLMs and cloud AI services into production applications. * Develop scalable backend services, REST APIs, and application integrations. * Build and maintain data pipelines that support AI workflows. * Contribute across the application stack, including backend services and frontend enhancements as needed. * Collaborate with Product Managers, UX Designers, and Software Engineers to deliver customer\-centric solutions. * Rapidly prototype new AI capabilities and iterate on customer feedback. * Write clean, maintainable, well\-tested code that follows software engineering best practices. * Optimize application performance, scalability, and reliability. * Participate in code reviews and contribute to architectural decisions. **What You’ll Have:** **Required:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). * 2–4 years of professional software engineering experience. * Experience developing applications with Python, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or similar object\-oriented languages. * Experience with consuming or integrating LLMs and AI services via APIs. * Experience building RESTful APIs and backend application services. * Working knowledge of cloud platforms, including AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. * Experience with Git and modern software development practices. * Understanding of databases and data modeling (SQL and/or NoSQL). * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Excellent collaboration and communication skills. **Preferred:** * Experience with Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG). * Experience using vector databases and embeddings. * Familiarity with AI orchestration frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex. * Experience building data pipelines and AI workflows. * Experience deploying containerized applications with Docker and Kubernetes. * Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices. * Experience developing customer\-facing SaaS applications. **What Success Looks Like:** Within your first year, you'll contribute production\-ready AI features, collaborate effectively across engineering teams, help accelerate AI adoption across our platform, and continuously improve the quality, scalability, and reliability of our software solutions. **What We Offer:** * Competitive pay * Unrestricted PTO * Comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, and vision insurance. * 401(k) plan with a company match. * Professional development opportunities and continuous training * A supportive, dynamic work environment with opportunities for growth and advancement. We are an equal employment opportunity employer and a drug\-free workplace. **Texting Privacy Policy and Information:** You may receive text messages regarding your application and potentially regarding interview scheduling. No mobile information will be shared with third parties/affiliates for marketing/promotional purposes Message frequency will vary depending on the application process. Msg \& data rates may apply. OPT out at any time by texting "Stop". hSrCUj5RxY

jobs.title: Android Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Overview** As an Android Platform Engineer, you’ll build and maintain Android software that connects applications with devices, operating systems, and networked services. You’ll work across embedded systems, firmware, platform components, and user interfaces, turning technical requirements into reliable, testable solutions. This role calls for hands\-on engineering, clear documentation, and practical collaboration throughout the software development lifecycle. **Duties** * Design, develop, and debug Android platform software, embedded software, firmware, and application development components. * Integrate sensors, microcontrollers, computer hardware, and Internet of Things devices using relevant interfaces and protocols. * Build and maintain RESTful APIs (application programming interfaces), JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) data flows, and TCP/IP (Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol) network connections. * Create unit tests and test automation; investigate defects and support software quality assurance. * Document designs, interfaces, and test results, and collaborate through Agile or Scrum workflows. Your impact: Reliable platform software helps users and development teams connect Android devices and services with fewer integration issues. **Skills** * Essential: Android, Java or Kotlin, Linux, C/C\+\+, embedded systems programming, software design, debugging, software testing, and analysis skills. * Essential: Familiarity with operating systems, OS kernels, real\-time systems, APIs, Git, and computer networking. * Preferred: Python, Bash (Unix shell), scripting, SQL, MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, AWS, Jenkins, Jira, Confluence, UML, and GitHub. * Additional relevant technologies may include FPGA, PCB, Objective\-C, PHP, Perl, JavaScript, C\#,.NET, Visual Basic, VBA, HTML, CSS, XML, Node.js, MATLAB, Simulink, ARM, RTOS, Assembly language, Raspberry Pi, Zigbee, Ethernet, WAN, DHCP, TCP, VoIP, SVN, Eclipse, Visual Studio, and soldering. * Other listed areas include algorithm design, machine learning, quantum engineering, big data, signal processing, logic analyzers, computer operation, engineering troubleshooting, content development, network monitoring, encryption, and microcontroller programming. Pay: From $220,000\.00 per year Experience: * Relevant: 7 years (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Applied Science Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **Why Join Stand****:** At Stand, you’ll help build a new class of global property protection. We use advanced physics and AI to model catastrophic risk at the asset level, then automate underwriting and mitigation before loss occurs. Insurance is simply the current delivery mechanism. The real product is a scalable risk engine, our **Stand World Model**. We stay when traditional insurers exit. We model what others approximate. And we build systems that change outcomes, not just prices. Our **leadership team** has built category\-defining companies (Metromile, Policygenius, WePay, HotelTonight) and brings decades of expertise in underwriting, capital management, and reinsurance. **Background:** The property insurance industry is built to price loss after it happens. It relies on coarse proxies, backward\-looking data, and manual processes, then accepts damage as unavoidable. Stand takes a different approach. We simulate how real\-world catastrophes affect individual properties, translate that into actionable decisions, and automate the business around it. The result is a platform that can underwrite what others can’t and operate with far less friction. **Role Summary:** As an **Applied Science Platform Engineer**, you will build and run the systems that take Stand's physics simulations, digital twins, AI/ML models, and spatial intelligence from research code to reliable production. Your work spans simulation pipelines, AI training and inference infrastructure, geospatial data processing, annotation and QC systems, and CI/CD. You will own pipelines end to end: design, build, deploy, monitor, and fix. Reporting to the Applied Science Platform Lead, you will partner with Physics Simulation Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers (MLEs), and peril subject matter experts (SMEs) to turn their needs into platform capabilities, and to extend the platform to new geographies and types of physics modeling. **Our stack:** A monorepo\-style build system and automated CI/CD; multi\-cloud infrastructure managed as code; containerized services and workflow orchestration across Kubernetes and HPC batch compute; and full metrics and error\-tracking observability. We care more that you’ve run systems like these than which specific tools you’ve used. **What You'll Do:** * **Build and operate production pipelines** for physics simulation, digital\-twin generation, and ML inference, with orchestration, monitoring, and alerting. * **Own reliability**: debug failures across APIs, preprocessing, modeling, and downstream consumers, and drive uptime and throughput improvements. * **Support ML in production:** partner with MLEs to run their data pipelines, GPU training and inference jobs, and model monitoring on the platform. * **Build geospatial pipelines** that merge heterogeneous spatial datasets (imagery, LiDAR, property information, terrain, weather) into reproducible, production\-grade workflows. * **Run simulation workloads at scale**: schedule and optimize solver jobs on cluster compute, and track compute cost and utilization. * **Strengthen CI/CD and infrastructure**: infrastructure\-as\-code, containerization, automated testing, and release processes across simulation, digital\-twin, and ML codebases. * **Extend the platform to new perils and geographies**: adapt data ingestion, digital\-twin generation, and simulation workflows as Stand expands. * **Work directly with SMEs, simulation engineers, and MLEs** to scope requirements and ship tooling they use daily. **Core Skills (Must\-Haves):** * **3\+ years building production\-grade data, simulation, or modeling pipelines** with end\-to\-end automation, monitoring, and alerting. * **Strong software engineering foundation**, with tested, maintainable, shared code. * **DevOps ownership**: cloud infrastructure, infrastructure\-as\-code, containers, CI/CD, observability, and incident response for systems you run. * **Running batch compute at scale:** you've operated long\-running, resource\-heavy jobs as multi\-step workflows, on an HPC scheduler or Kubernetes, and you know how they fail: queueing, preemption, partial reruns, and moving large inputs and outputs. * **Debugging across system boundaries**: matching downstream symptoms to root causes in data, code, or infrastructure. * **Clear, succinct communication** and the judgment to turn a cross\-functional request into the right platform capability. * **Ownership and adaptability** in a fast\-moving environment where priorities and interfaces change. **Nice to Haves:** * ML infrastructure experience: ETL over large heterogeneous datasets, GPU training and inference, evaluation frameworks, model monitoring. * Experience supporting physics\-based workflows in production (CFD, multiphysics, digital twins), with working physical\-simulation intuition. * Geospatial, remote\-sensing, or Earth\-observation data experience. * Breadth across backend, AI pipelines, simulation, and digital twins, even if your background leans one way. * Startup or zero\-to\-one experience. **Benefits:** * Above\-market Health, Dental, and Vision coverage * Weekly lunch stipend * Flexible time off \+ holidays * 401(k) plan * Commuter benefits * PAT \& MAT Leave * Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability * Monthly team gatherings * In\-office perks **AI in the Interview Process** Thoughtful use of AI tools is expected and valued at Stand. Candidates should be prepared to discuss how they use AI, how they evaluate its output, and how it informs their work. Strong communication, sound judgment, and the ability to clearly articulate experience and decision\-making remain core requirements. Some parts of the interview process are designed to assess independent thinking, communication, and problem\-solving. If you plan to use an AI assistant or LLM during any portion of an interview, please discuss it with your interviewer in advance. **Work Authorization** Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. Stand does not sponsor new work visas. We can consider candidates on TN visas, O\-1A visas, or H\-1B transfers with three years or more remaining. **Equal Opportunity Employment** *Stand is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. We believe that diversity enriches the workplace, and we are committed to growing our team with the most talented and passionate people from every community.* *We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals. If you require assistance, please contact us at* *hr@standinsurance.com**.* *Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.* **AI Use in Hiring** *We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us at* *hr@standinsurance.com**.* Compensation Range: $195K \- $225K

jobs.title: COBOL Developer
jobs.description: **IMPORTANT: Candidates will be reviewed within 48 hours of submission.** Senior COBOL / Mainframe Application Developer **Annual Salary:** $120,579–$195,200 **Employment Type:** Full\-time **Work Location:** In person (Woodlawn, MD) Position Overview A government customer is seeking experienced COBOL and mainframe application development professionals to support mission\-critical enterprise systems. This opportunity is available through a federal Direct Hire Authority and is open to all **U.S. citizens**. Selected professionals will contribute to the development, maintenance, performance optimization, and modernization of large\-scale business applications. The role combines established mainframe technologies with modern software development practices, including opportunities to leverage artificial intelligence (AI) and automation to improve development efficiency and application capabilities. Applications may be retained in a candidate pool for consideration as positions become available. Key Responsibilities * Design, develop, enhance, and maintain enterprise applications using COBOL and related mainframe technologies. * Develop and support online transaction\-processing applications using CICS and Temporary Storage Queues (TSQ). * Manage batch\-processing operations, including JCL development, job scheduling, execution monitoring, and troubleshooting. * Optimize DB2 database performance through SQL tuning, efficient data access, and improved processing strategies. * Support enterprise data storage, retrieval, integration, and migration using VSAM, IDMS, and related technologies. * Develop and maintain file\-processing solutions involving sequential, indexed, and relative file structures. * Evaluate application architecture and implement improvements that enhance scalability, reliability, maintainability, and security. * Investigate application defects, resolve production incidents, and improve overall system availability. * Collaborate with business analysts, quality assurance specialists, developers, and other stakeholders to deliver effective technical solutions. * Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including program specifications, system designs, flowcharts, and user guides. * Participate in code reviews, application testing, deployment, and post\-implementation support. * Provide technical guidance, share knowledge, and support development teams according to the assigned grade and level of responsibility. * Evaluate approved AI\-assisted development tools and automation techniques to increase productivity and improve software delivery. * Identify opportunities to incorporate emerging technologies into application enhancement and modernization initiatives while adhering to applicable security standards. Required Qualifications Applicants must meet the specialized experience requirements for the grade at which they are considered. All relevant experience must be clearly documented in the submitted resume. GS\-14 Level Candidates must demonstrate experience equivalent to the GS\-13 level in the following areas: * Developing and maintaining mainframe applications using COBOL, CICS, VSAM, and JCL. * Supporting database management, data integration, or migration activities involving DB2, SQL, and IDMS. * Contributing to legacy application architecture, modernization, or system enhancement projects. * Preparing technical documentation and providing guidance to technical personnel. * Working with stakeholders to support application development and modernization objectives. GS\-15 Level Candidates must demonstrate experience equivalent to the GS\-14 level, including: * Designing, developing, and maintaining complex mainframe applications using COBOL, CICS, VSAM, and JCL. * Managing data integration and migration initiatives involving DB2, SQL, and IDMS. * Leading legacy\-system architecture, modernization, and application improvement efforts. * Providing technical leadership and coordinating development activities across teams and stakeholders. * Developing technical documentation and supporting enterprise\-level modernization initiatives. **Important:** Applicants must explicitly demonstrate the required specialized experience in their resumes. Failure to document the applicable experience may result in disqualification. For additional qualification details, consult the OPM Information Technology Management Series (2210\) qualification standards. Core Competencies Candidates should demonstrate proficiency in the following areas: * **Attention to Detail:** Maintains accuracy, completeness, and consistency when performing technical work. * **Customer Service:** Understands stakeholder needs and provides responsive, effective technical assistance. * **Oral Communication:** Presents technical information clearly and adapts communication to different audiences. * **Problem Solving:** Evaluates complex issues, analyzes relevant information, and develops practical solutions using sound judgment. Applicants must satisfy the applicable federal qualification standards. Qualifying IT experience may include paid or unpaid work and appropriate intensive training, as permitted by those standards. Technical Environment The government customer's enterprise computing environment supports large\-scale, business\-critical applications that require high availability, dependable processing, and strong data integrity. The development environment incorporates modern COBOL capabilities, AI\-assisted coding tools, and contemporary software delivery practices. Developers are encouraged to identify responsible opportunities to use AI and automation to streamline coding, strengthen testing, improve application maintenance, and support modernization. This opportunity is well suited to mainframe professionals interested in applying their technical expertise to complex enterprise systems while contributing to ongoing application improvements. Pay: $120,579\.00 \- $195,200\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Health insurance * Health savings account * Paid time off * Retirement plan Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Coordinator, Soccer Systems
jobs.description: **Overview:** Columbus NWSL is seeking a passionate, entry\-level, full\-stack developer to join the Haslam Sports Group Soccer Systems team. This job will primarily be responsible for translating the existing data infrastructure and backend web platform of Columbus Crew to our Columbus NWSL franchise but also contribute to the front\-end development of the existing platform. Working alongside the current analytics team of Columbus Crew, this is an excellent opportunity to contribute to exciting projects in a professional soccer environment. The team builds with AI\-assisted development tools, and this role will help bring AI\-powered features to the platform. **Responsibilities:** * Manage existing data ELT/ETL pipelines * Manage SQL Server databases for the web platform and Analytics department. + Performance tuning and maintenance * Work closely with the scouting and coaching department to identify new features or improvements to existing processes and platforms. * Build AI\-powered features into the web platform, such as natural\-language search and automated summaries * Support secure access to club data for AI tools through APIs or MCP servers with appropriate access controls * Create and maintain documentation for software design and development processes. * Contribute to the development of test plans and participate in software testing, including reviewing AI\-generated code for correctness, performance, and security * Use AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code) as a standard part of the development workflow, and keep current with the latest technology trends, with a specific focus on the integration of AI **Requirements:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. Requirement can be foregone with relevant work experience/training * Experience managing SQL Server and database performance tuning * Experience with C\#, JavaScript, Python * Experience with front\-end technologies like HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. * Experience building with AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) * Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail. * Excellent communication and teamwork abilities. * Ability to meet with stakeholders and translate needs into problem solving features. **Preferred Qualifications/Our Stack:** * T\-SQL, Microsoft SQL Server, and Python * Visual Studio and C\# Console Apps * Version control systems like Git. * Visual Studio Code and Claude Code * LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI), Model Context Protocol (MCP), and embeddings/vector search * js, nodeJS * Data visualizations in JavaScript. * Azure or other cloud services (AWS, Google, etc...) **Application Process:** Interested candidates should submit a 1 page resume and a cover letter detailing 1 project you have built using AI tools and what you had to fix or verify yourself (max 2 pages / slides) **About Columbus NWSL 2028:** In April 2026, the National Women's Soccer League (NWSL) announced that Columbus will be home to the 18th club in the top global women's soccer league. The team will play home matches at ScottsMiracle\-Gro Field when it officially debuts during the 2028 NWSL season. Columbus NWSL 2028 will train at their own dedicated world\-class performance center. Haslam Sports Group (HSG), in partnership with Nationwide and Dr. Chris and Dr. Pete Edwards, led the effort to bring an elite professional women's soccer club to Ohio. Motivated by sports' unique power to unify and uplift local communities, the collective was inspired by the city's and state's strong passion for soccer and sports and the opportunities created for women, men, boys and girls, based on their combined experience with Major League Soccer's Columbus Crew, within the sports industry and throughout the local community. HSG embraces the positive impact of sports and its unique opportunity to unify communities. Dee and Jimmy Haslam, along with Whitney and JW Johnson, founded Haslam Sports Group in 2020\. Through the Haslam and Johnson families' network of industry experience and relationships, their mission is to create world\-class organizations that achieve sustainable success, provide a best\-in\-class fan experience, and give back to their region. HSG invests in strategic sports and entertainment opportunities, with a current portfolio including ownership of the Cleveland Browns, operating rights to the Columbus Crew and co\-ownership of the Milwaukee Bucks, as well as investments in HSG Ventures, HSG Facilities, the WNBA, and other entities.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About Pocket** ---------------- *At Pocket, we’re building the future of human memory.* Some of the most valuable information in our lives disappears when a conversation ends: an idea, a decision, a detail we wish we could remember. Pocket helps us hold onto it. We’ve built an AI\-powered device that captures real\-world conversations and turns them into searchable transcripts, summaries and next steps. Backed by Accel and Y Combinator (W26\), we’ve already sold 500,000 devices. Our ambition goes beyond recording. We believe the things you learn, discuss and experience can become useful context for the AI tools you already use, and for products that don’t exist yet. **About the Role** ------------------ We’re hiring our first dedicated Data Engineer to own the data foundation behind Pocket’s product, AI systems, growth, and operations. Our data comes from a lot of places: the app database, app stores, Shopify, Amazon, Stripe, ad platforms, product analytics and finance tools. Your job is to make it all land on time, match across sources, and flag issues fast when something goes wrong. This is a hands\-on role, reporting to the Data Lead. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Own ingestion. Build and maintain pipelines from our app database, payment and subscription systems, commerce platforms, ad platforms, product analytics and finance tools into our warehouse. * Own freshness and reliability. Set freshness targets for every source, monitor them, and alert when a load is late, missing or partial. Backfills should be safe and repeatable. * Reconcile sources. Make revenue, orders, subscriptions and refunds tie out across systems that each tell a slightly different story. * Instrument the product. Partner with engineering on event taxonomy, instrumentation standards and validation, so new features ship with metrics and monitoring from day one. * Monitor product and AI quality. Build alerting and anomaly detection for key user journeys, regressions and AI workflows: transcription, summaries, speaker mapping and Ask Pocket. * Build the data models that power funnel, cohort and experiment analysis. * Document it. Keep a living data guide covering what each source is, how fresh it is, who owns it and what depends on it. **What success looks like** --------------------------- * Every source has an owner, a freshness target and an alert, and nothing goes stale for weeks unnoticed. * Dashboard numbers tie out to the source systems, and the business trusts them. * Every major launch ships with instrumentation and monitoring in place. * Backfills and new sources are routine work, not fire drills. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * Have 5\+ years of experience in data engineering or a similar role. * Have built and run production data pipelines, including retries, idempotent loads, backfills and schema changes. * Are strong in SQL and Python and comfortable with analytical databases, ideally ClickHouse, Postgres or similar. * Have pulled data from messy third\-party APIs and know how to handle rate limits, pagination, delayed reports and partial data. * Care about data quality, lineage, naming and clear metric definitions. * Have set up monitoring and alerting for data, not just for services. * Understand product analytics: events, funnels, cohorts, retention and experiments. * Communicate clearly with engineering, finance and leadership, and can turn business questions into concrete metrics. * Like owning things end\-to\-end at startup speed. **Nice\-to\-haves** ------------------- * Hands\-on time with change\-data\-capture or replication tools, and with scheduling and orchestrating data pipelines (e.g., Airflow, Dagster) and transformation tools like dbt. * Familiarity with subscription and commerce data: app stores, RevenueCat, Stripe, Shopify, Amazon. * A background in AI products, LLM evaluation, or speech and transcription quality measurement. * Comfortable defining metrics such as activation, retention, revenue and unit economics. * Some exposure to experiment analysis and A/B testing. * Forecasting work on usage, subscriptions, support volume or infrastructure load. Compensation Range: $160K \- $210K

jobs.title: Distinguished Product Software Engineer (VP level)
jobs.description: **Job Requirements** **Disney Entertainment \& ESPN Technology** Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product \& Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world\-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. **About the Team** Product Engineering is a unified team responsible for the engineering of Disney Entertainment \& ESPN digital and streaming products and platforms. This includes product engineering, media engineering, quality assurance, engineering behind personalization, commerce, lifecycle, and identity. **Job Summary** We’re seeking a Distinguished Engineer to define and deliver state‑of‑the‑art platforms and ML‑driven experiences for ESPN (Sports), ABC News (News), and our cross‑cutting Developer Platform. You’ll be the technical visionary and hands‑on architect who connects models, data, and systems into durable, scalable products that move engagement and retention, while setting technical standards across teams and mentoring senior engineers. You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to translate strategy into measurable consumer and platform outcomes. **Responsibilities** * Guide technical strategy and vision for Sports, News and developer platform, driving innovation and integration across teams. * Drive system stability and reliability by implementing robust monitoring, automated alerting, and proactive jobs.title: Engineer II
jobs.description: **Agency** Dept of Environmental Quality **Division** Energy, Mineral , Land Resources **Job Classification Title** Engineer II (NS) **Position Number** 60032506 **Grade** NC18 **About Us** The primary mission of the North Carolina Department of Environmental Quality (DEQ) is to provide science\-based environmental stewardship for the health and prosperity of all North Carolinians. The North Carolina Department of Environmental Quality (DEQ) is the lead stewardship agency for the protection of North Carolina's environmental resources. The organization, which has offices from the mountains to the coast, administers regulatory programs designed to protect air quality, water quality, and the public's health, and works to advance in all\-of\-the\-above energy strategy that fits North Carolina's needs. DEQ also offers technical assistance to businesses, farmers, local governments, and the public and encourages responsible behavior with respect to the environment through education programs provided at DEQ facilities and through the state's school system. DEQ touches the lives of all North Carolinians in many ways to enhance and ensure our quality of life. **Description of Work** This Engineer II position primarily works in the Erosion and Sediment Control program to perform skilled professional engineering work and reviews, evaluate projects for compliance, and provide technical assistance for the Division of Energy, Mineral, and Land Resources (DEMLR) under both the Express and Standard Review processes. This position will have some secondary duties associated with the other DEMLR programs such as the review of plans for the Post Construction Stormwater, Mine Operation and Reclamation and Dam Safety. Many skills are required including being able to manage multiple priorities, having excellent technical writing and public speaking skills as well as a strong understanding of hydrology, soils, vegetation, hydraulics, and detailed engineering concepts related to all aspects of stormwater collection, treatment and discharge. Other important purposes of this position are to provide technical guidance to Land Quality Environmental Specialists within the regional office, perform inspections, handle citizen inquiries/complaints, document compliance/enforcement actions, and may occasionally present at training programs for DEQ staff, local governments, industry, consulting firms, and developers. Key Responsibilities: * Provides timely and detailed review of permit applications, engineering drawings, specifications, and calculations within the procedural and statutory times for compliance with Federal and State laws, rules, and policies, and good engineering practices. * Prepares a variety of technical documents to communicate the results of the review with all necessary parties. * Performs inspections of sites/facilities regulated under each of DEMLR's four programs: Stormwater, Sedimentation Control, Dam Safety, and Mining. * Advises and provides engineering guidance and written technical/compliance documentation to other staff, clients, and the general public. * Meeting with applicants and their consultants to facilitate project development, design, construction, and ultimately permit approval and site compliance. **Knowledge Skills and Abilities/Management Preferences** **Recruitment Range:** $63,927 \- $75,172 Important: This posting closes at 11:59:59 PM the night BEFORE the End Date above. **Supplemental Information:** **The Division of Energy, Mineral, and Land Resources:** The Division of Energy, Mineral and Land Resources (DEMLR) is comprised of two Sections: Land Quality and Geological Survey. For more information: https://deq.nc.gov/about/divisions/energy\-mineral\-and\-land\-resources The Land Quality Section is responsible for the administration of four regulatory programs: Dam Safety Program as authorized by the Dam Safety of 1967, Mining Program as authorized by the Mining Act of 1971, Sediment Program as authorized by the Sedimentation Pollution Control Act of 1973 and Stormwater Program as authorized by state statutes and the federal Clean Water Act. DEMLR collects permit fees and issues permits for mines, dams, sedimentation control for construction sites, and stormwater permits for various activities and refers enforcement cases to the Attorney General's Office. DEMLR is responsible for scheduling, organizing and transcribing minutes of the North Carolina Mining Commission and the Sedimentation Control Commission as well as reporting to the Environmental Management Commission regarding dam safety and stormwater matters. The N.C. Geological Survey (NCGS) Section’s mission is to provide unbiased and technically accurate applied earth science scientific information to address societal needs. This includes geologic maps, mineral resource and geochemical information, topographic maps and digital products, and earth science education initiatives. The NCGS "...examines, surveys, and maps the geology, mineral resources, and topography of the state" and encourages the wise conservation and use of geologic resources by industry, commerce, agriculture and government agencies for the general welfare of the citizens of North Carolina. The results of the NCGS research are documented in Bulletins, Open File Reports, Information Circulars, Special Publications, and Geologic Map Series. The NCGS along with DEMLR provide staff to the Oil and Gas Commission. **If you have student loans, becoming a state employee includes eligibility for the Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program. Visit** **https://studentaid.gov/** **to learn more.** This position currently qualifies for a hybrid telework option with routine office and remote workdays. The NC Department of Environmental Quality trusts our employees to be self\-motivated and successful in hybrid/remote roles. Telework options are subject to change at the discretion of management. **Minimum Education and Experience** Some state job postings say you can qualify by an “equivalent combination of education and experience.” If that language appears below, then you may qualify through EITHER years of education OR years of directly related experience, OR a combination of both. See the Education and Experience Equivalency Guide for details. Bachelor’s degree in an applicable field of engineering from an appropriately accredited institution and three (3\) years of progressively responsible experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Necessary Special Qualification May require registration as a professional engineer by the North Carolina Board of Examiners for Engineers and Surveyors. **EEO Statement** T he State of North Carolina is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and dedicated to providing employees with a work environment free from all forms of unlawful employment discrimination, harassment, or retaliation. The state provides reasonable accommodation to employees and applicants with disabilities; known limitations related to pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions; and for religious beliefs, observances, and practices. **Recruiter:** Jennifer Baker **Recruiter Email:** hrrecruitment@deq.nc.gov

jobs.title: Founding ML Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **About Parisi Labs** --------------------- Parisi Labs is building foundational world models for physical industry. We are developing models that learn how complex physical systems behave and reuse that understanding across forecasts, scenarios, and operational decisions. Energy is our first proving ground. We combine historical and live data with operational context, bringing together machine learning research, data infrastructure, and software engineering to turn advances in modeling into useful technology for energy operators. We are a small technical team working directly with the founders on our core models, systems, and products. **About the role** ------------------ We are looking for a Founding ML Platform Engineer to design, build, and own the infrastructure that takes our machine learning models from research into reliable production systems. You will establish the core MLOps platform at Parisi Labs, creating the tools and workflows that allow researchers to operationalize models without becoming responsible for the infrastructure around them. This includes model registries, dataset and experiment lineage, retraining workflows, scheduled batch inference, and production monitoring. Our models operate on complex, time\-dependent data, producing forecasts and simulations of physical systems. You will build the infrastructure that makes these workflows reproducible, observable, and dependable as our research and products evolve. This is a hands\-on founding engineering role with significant technical ownership. You will work directly with our CTO, Chief Scientist, and researchers to define the platform architecture, select technologies, and implement the systems the company will build on. **What you'll own** ------------------- * Design and build our end\-to\-end MLOps platform, from model registration and versioning through deployment, inference, and monitoring. * Develop reliable, scalable batch inference infrastructure for recurring forecasts and model\-generated simulations. * Build model registries and lineage systems that track training inputs, dataset versions, model configurations, artifacts, and deployment history. * Create standardized workflows and tools that allow researchers to register models, manage experiments, and move models into production. * Develop automated retraining and deployment pipelines, including dataset preparation, validation, version promotion, and rollback. * Build monitoring and observability for model performance, forecast accuracy, data drift, pipeline health, and production failures. * Help steer the technical and research direction of the company. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * 6\+ years of software engineering experience, including significant hands\-on experience building and operating production ML systems. * A track record of designing and owning ML infrastructure or MLOps platforms, ideally having built systems from the ground up. * Strong Python and backend engineering skills, with experience building reliable data processing and distributed workflow systems. * Experience with ML lifecycle tooling such as MLflow, orchestration frameworks such as Dagster, Airflow, or Prefect, and modern cloud infrastructure. * Deep familiarity with model deployment, batch inference, model versioning, data lineage, and production monitoring. * Comfort working closely with ML researchers and translating experimental workflows into reliable engineering systems. * An entrepreneurial mindset, strong technical ownership, and the ability to operate independently in a fast\-moving environment with limited structure. **Especially compelling backgrounds:** * Experience as a founder, technical co\-founder, or founding engineer at an early\-stage startup. * Experience building an ML platform from zero to production, rather than exclusively maintaining established infrastructure. * Experience as an early technical hire who helped establish engineering architecture, tooling, and practices. * Experience with time\-series forecasting, energy systems, or other data\-intensive scientific applications. **First 90 days** ----------------- * **30 days:** Understand our research workflows, existing model infrastructure, and production forecasting systems. Identify the most important gaps in model lifecycle management, serving, and observability. * **60 days:** Establish foundational model registry and lineage capabilities, and deliver an initial standardized workflow for moving research models into production. * **90 days:** Own a reliable end\-to\-end production ML workflow, including model versioning, scheduled inference, monitoring, and clear operational visibility. **Why join** ------------ You will establish the platform that all of our models run on. Your work will determine how our research becomes reliable, scalable technology used to support real\-world decisions. As an early engineering hire, you will have substantial ownership over our infrastructure, architecture, and engineering practices, working directly with the founders and researchers developing our core technology. **Location and compensation** ----------------------------- **Location:** New York City. This is an in\-person role. **Salary range:** $200,000–$280,000 USD. **Equity**: meaningful early\-company equity.

jobs.title: IT & Security Manager
jobs.description: **The Role** ------------ In a little over a year and a half, Blank Metal has more than doubled in size. The IT, security, and compliance work that comes with that growth has been handled by whoever had time, including the COO. That worked for 12 people. It doesn’t at 50, and it won’t at 100\. Our clients now hand us security addendums before kickoff, expect SOC 2 reports and annual risk questionnaires, write US\-only data processing into their contracts, and audit us as a delegated entity under Medicare rules. Meanwhile our own engineers are running two laptops each, model\-provider API keys are managed by hand, and nobody can tell you where every machine is. You will own all of it: the help queue, the device fleet, the security program, the compliance evidence, and the operational side of the AI stack that runs our business. This is a build role and a player\-coach role. You’ll write the policy and ship the laptop in the same afternoon. The mandate is right\-sized: we scope controls to the obligations we actually have and add more when a contract or an audit finding says to, not because a framework says we might need it someday. Success in the first year looks like a clear device baseline, a passed SOC 2 Type I with Type II underway, security questionnaires answered in days instead of weeks, and a picture of what we spend on models and why. **What You Get To Do** ---------------------- ### ***Run the shop*** * Own the internal help queue end to end. Blank Metal engineers are fast and impatient; you’ll keep them that way by making account setup, access, and troubleshooting a same\-day thing. * Build the device lifecycle we don’t have yet: procurement and vendor relationships, imaging, mobile device management, inventory, loaners, repairs, and retirement. You’ll know where every laptop is and whose it is. * Make onboarding and offboarding a checklist that runs in hours for employees and contractors alike, including the client\-issued machines and accounts that come with each engagement. * Administer the core stack (Google Workspace, 1Password, Slack, Zoom, GitHub) with sane access policies, and be the person who says no to the fourth note\-taking app. * Own the hardware and software budget and get us to a standard kit, with spares on the shelf, without overspending. ### ***Make security something we can prove*** * Take Blank Metal through SOC 2: pick the compliance automation platform, scope the controls to our real obligations, run the audit, and keep the evidence current. * Be the standing answer to client security questionnaires, security addendums, and data protection exhibits, working alongside our outside counsel so what we commit to is what we can actually do. * Write and own the policies that are missing today (access control, data retention and destruction, acceptable use, device, incident response) and make them short enough that people follow them. * Serve as the technical counterpart to our healthcare compliance program, translating Medicare\- and HIPAA\-regulated requirements into controls engineers can live with. * Review the tools we adopt (AI note\-takers, browser extensions, SaaS) against what our client contracts allow, before someone connects them. ### ***Keep the AI stack accountable*** * Own the accounts, API keys, and access to our model providers and cloud environments, with rotation, scoping, and attribution by client and project. * Stand up usage and cost observability for model spend so leadership can see token cost by engagement, tie it to margin, and catch surprises before the invoice does. * Enforce data residency and handling rules for AI workloads, including US\-only processing, no\-training clauses, and environment isolation for client data. * Provision secure, repeatable working environments for engineers and contractors, so a new team member is productive on day one without a security exception. * Contribute to large client engagements that need infrastructure stood up: cloud accounts, model hosting, access patterns, audit logging. You set the pattern; delivery teams carry it. **What Will Help You Succeed** ------------------------------ * 5\+ years running IT and security at a company under 200 people, ideally one that handles regulated data. You’ve been the one who answered the questionnaire and sat with the auditor. * You’ve taken a company through SOC 2 from nothing (HITRUST or a HIPAA program is a plus) and know what auditors actually look at versus what the platform dashboard says. * Hands\-on with a Mac fleet: Google Workspace admin, MDM (Jamf, Kandji, or similar), SSO and identity, password management. You don’t need a ticket to fix a ticket. * Comfortable in at least one major cloud and with the LLM provider ecosystem. You’ve managed API keys and quotas, set up a gateway or proxy, and can read a token bill and explain it to a CFO. * You can read a security addendum and tell a lawyer, in plain English, which clauses we can sign and which we can’t. * A right\-sizer by instinct. You scope controls to real obligations, say when something is over\-built, and sequence investment on evidence rather than fear. * You write clearly. Policies, questionnaire answers, and Slack replies that people actually read and act on. * Patient with the help queue and unbothered by it. Reimaging a laptop is not beneath you, and neither is presenting to leadership. **Why You’ll Love It Here** --------------------------- * Build AI that ships: every project ends in a live deployment, not a slide deck * Craft meets velocity: we obsess over quality while delivering at startup speed * Outcome\-driven model: our work aligns with client success, not billable hours * AI\-native culture: you’ll work with peers who deeply understand modern AI’s potential and limits * Real collaboration: open conversations, shared ownership, and space to bring your voice **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- Compensation: base salary of $155,000 to $190,000, depending on experience. This role is eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, with a guideline of 10% of base salary, based on company and individual performance. Bonuses are not guaranteed. We also offer comprehensive health coverage, 401(k) with match, flexible time off, and support for professional development. This role is based in Minneapolis and works from our office a minimum of three days a week. **About Blank Metal** --------------------- Blank Metal is an AI\-native engineering company that partners with enterprises to deliver production AI fast. We blend strategic insight with hands\-on execution, shipping high\-impact systems that turn AI initiatives into measurable business results. We’re builders, not theorists. Our team of seasoned engineers, designers, and strategists work across industries to create AI applications that actually get used and make a difference. *Blank Metal is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all backgrounds and perspectives. Diversity makes our work better and our team stronger.* blankmetal.ai

Duties may be performed in highly complex and secured environments including prisons, mental health institutions and developmental facilities. May serve as a technical lead for designing and providing training to personnel on highly complex end user services and technologies. * Documents solutions for issue and problem resolution for future knowledge base needs. Responsible for creation of project documentation, end user messaging information and end user training guides. Acts as a technical support subject matter expert for staff and other functional areas of OTS. * Provides feedback to customers concerning advanced technical incidents. Surveys customer technical and business process information gathering and performs analysis to prepare for system implementations or software changes. * Provides end user support through informa atus employee may be required to serve a new probationary period in lieu of promotion. **Career Progressions:** This vacancy participates in a career progression group and may be filled from this recruitment as an IT Statewide Systems Support Engineer 1 or 2\. **Compensation:** The salary range listed on the job posting reflects the pay grade minimum and maximum for the IT Statewide Systems Support Engineer 1 job title. The salary range pay grade minimum and maximum for the other levels of the career progression group can be viewed using the links below: IT Statewide Systems Support Engineer 2 *Louisiana is a “State as a Model Employer” for People with Disabilities.* How To Apply: **No Civil Service test score** is required in order to be considered for this vacancy. Resumes **WILL NOT** be accepted in lieu of completed education and experience sections on your application. Applications may be rejected if incomplete. Applicants are responsible for checking the status of their application to determine where they are in the recruitment process. Further status message information is located under the Information section of the Current Job Opportunities page. Prior to a new hire, a background check, including a criminal record history, will be conducted. Information from the background check will not necessarily preclude employment but will be considered in determining the applicant’s suitability and competence to perform in the position. A criminal history check may be conducted on employees changing positions, including promotions, demotions, details, reassignments, and transfers. Also, prospective employees may be subject to pre\-employment drug testing. jobs.title: Industrial Automation Controls Engineer (Manufacturing)
jobs.description: **Imagine Your First 90 Days** ------------------------------ You arrive on\-site in Hopkinsville, KY, coffee in hand. You sync up with operators, review OEE trends, and jump into a root\-cause session on an intermittent comms fault. By lunch, you’ve pushed a PLC code update through change control and coordinated an OEM call for a weekend FAT. Later this week you’ll be in Clarksville and Nashville (about 30–40% regional travel) to validate a new HMI standard and close out a SAT checklist. This is the rhythm of impact as our Industrial Automation Controls Engineer. ### **What You’ll Own** * Designing, programming, troubleshooting, and optimizing PLC, HMI, SCADA, and plant control systems to keep high\-speed manufacturing safe, reliable, and efficient. * Integrating automation across processing, packaging, and conveying lines, including OEM equipment brought into plant\-wide architectures. * Configuring and supporting VFDs, servo motion, instrumentation, and process control loops. * Driving standardization in platforms, code structures, documentation, and backups with robust change management. * Providing responsive technical support during downtime and production upsets; diagnosing electrical, controls, communication, and automation failures. * Leading root\-cause analysis and implementing durable corrective and preventive actions. * Owning controls scope on capital projects from concept through commissioning; planning budgets and timelines; coordinating with OEMs, SIs, contractors, and internal partners. * Executing and supporting FAT/SAT and full system validation. * Identifying automation and process improvement opportunities in partnership with Integrated Work Systems (IWS) and operational excellence teams. * Maintaining compliance with OSHA, electrical, and industrial automation standards, and championing safe work practices including lockout/tagout. ### **What You Bring** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline. * 5\+ years of controls engineering experience in manufacturing, preferably in high\-speed environments. * Proven PLC programming and troubleshooting capability. * Hands\-on experience with platforms such as Rockwell/Allen‑Bradley, Wonderware, FactoryTalk. * Knowledge of HMIs, SCADA, and industrial networking. * Experience with VFDs, servos, instrumentation, and plant electrical systems. * Ability to read and create electrical schematics and design control panels. * Background supporting automated processing and packaging systems in food, beverage, or CPG manufacturing. * Understanding of batch systems, process automation, MES, OEE, and manufacturing data systems. * Familiarity with OSHA and machine safety standards; strong troubleshooting, communication, and project coordination skills. ### **Where You’ll Work** This role is fully on\-site in Hopkinsville, KY with approximately 30–40% regional travel to Clarksville, TN and Nashville, TN. ### **Compensation** The starting salary is based on but not limited to experience, knowledge, and qualifications in determining compensation decisions. The Salary Range for this position is: $104,900\.00 \- $152,150\.00\. ### **Benefits and Perks** * Flexibility that fits your life, including remote options where appropriate. * Time to recharge: start with 15 days of PTO, 13 paid holidays, 2 floating holidays, and a 37\.5\-hour workweek. * Recognition that counts: annual merit increases and performance bonus opportunities. * Future\-ready: 401(k) match from day one plus Deferred Profit Sharing (13%–17% of base salary as an annual company contribution). * Growth support: student loan repayment assistance, conference attendance, and professional development stipends for certifications. * Comprehensive coverage: medical, dental, and vision for you and your family. * Life’s milestones: paid parental and bonding leave. * Whole\-person well\-being programs. * Give back: paid volunteer days and a culture committed to community impact. ### **About Altria** Altria is a Fortune 500 company with a leading portfolio serving U.S. adult tobacco and nicotine consumers 21\+. Altria is the parent company of Philip Morris USA, John Middleton, U.S. Smokeless Tobacco, Helix Innovations, and NJOY, and holds equity stakes in Anheuser‑Busch InBev and Cronos Group. Learn more at www.altria.com and follow us on LinkedIn. ### **Legal Notices** Work Authorization This position is not eligible for sponsorship. Equal Opportunity **At Altria, we celebrate the power of diverse teams working together to shape our future. Each Altria company is an equal opportunity employer. Join us as we work together to shape a better future for adult tobacco consumers, our employees, and our shareholders.**

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer (Control Systems)
jobs.description: **Benefits:** * Paid time off * 401(k) * Competitive salary * Opportunity for advancement * Stock options plan **About the Role:** Radiant Robotics is looking for a talented Machine Learning Engineer with a focus on Controls Systems to join our innovative development team in San Leandro, CA. This is an exciting opportunity to apply advanced control strategies to magnetic levitation systems, helping to shape the future of intelligent automation and robotics. If you're passionate about building smart, data\-driven physical AI systems with real\-world impact, we want to hear from you. **Responsibilities:** * Design control strategies including PID, model predictive control and learned policies, and recommend which to deploy. * Develop and optimize control algorithms using ML techniques such as reinforcement learning and predictive modeling. * Design, develop, and deploy ML models and apply in areas where they add value, including disturbance modeling, and trajectory optimization. * Build and maintain simulation models of dynamic magnetic forces, moving payloads, and the sensing chain, and validate them against bench measurements * Build and validate simulations of various control strategies by running comparative experiments. * Define performance metrics for the magnetic levitation system, such as positional error and report results against them. * Document models, assumptions, and results for analysis and improvement, and so that other engineers can reproduce and extend the work. * Work with firmware and electronics engineers to move proven strategies from simulation onto the real hardware and tune them in the loop. **Requirements:** * Master's degree or higher in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, robotics, computer science, applied mathematics, or a related field. * Working knowledge of control theory, including PID design and tuning, state\-space methods, and model predictive control (MPC). You can derive a plant model, linearize it, and explain the tradeoffs of each approach. * Applied machine learning experience, with at least one project where a learned model or policy improved a physical or simulated system. * Experience building dynamic simulations of physical systems and checking them against real measurements. * Proficiency in Python, C\+\+, or MATLAB/Simulink for controls and ML development * Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain controller behavior to engineers outside the controls discipline. * Comfort using AI coding tools such as Claude Code or similar for simulations development. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience deploying controllers on embedded targets such as microcontrollers or real\-time Linux, and tuning them with hardware in the loop. * Experience with multi\-physics or finite element modeling of magnetic fields, for example with FEMM or COMSOL. Experience with designing, analyzing, or fabricating systems that generate or manipulate magnetic fields. * **About Us:** Radiant Robotics (formerly US Positronix) is an innovator and leader in magnetic levitation solutions, with a focus on warehousing and logistics applications. Radiant’s mission is to unify all materials handling workflows for warehousing and manufacturing into a single, simple intelligent automation platform. In this role, you will be an integral part of our close\-knit bay area R\&D team striving to introduce novel automation and robotics solutions that will revolutionize the material handling industry.

jobs.title: Manager, Software Engineering - Owner/Investor
jobs.description: AppFolio is more than a company. We’re a community of dreamers, big thinkers, problem solvers, active listeners, and multipliers. At every opportunity, we set the pace while delivering innovation built to carry real estate into the future. One in which every experience feels effortless, yet meaningful. Where customers are empowered to take on any opportunity. We show up as one team, connected by our values to be a force for good. Because together, we have the power to create extraordinary outcomes for our customers, our communities, and ourselves. **Hi, We're AppFolio.** ----------------------- We're innovators, changemakers, and collaborators. We're more than just a software company; we're a cloud\-based powerhouse that creates products to make our customers' lives easier. We are an AI\-first engineering organization, revolutionizing how people do business. We want your ideas, enthusiasm, and passion to help us keep innovating at the speed of the modern market. **Who we are looking for** -------------------------- We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead two teams in our Investor/Owner segment: **Owner Growth** and **Owner Actions**. Together, these teams shape how property owners engage with AppFolio, from how they discover and adopt the experience to the actions they take to manage and improve the performance of their real estate. You'll own the success of both teams: their people, their delivery, and their outcomes. You'll also share ownership of strategy and delivery with your Product partners. The right candidate is a technically credible leader who builds high\-trust, high\-performing teams, keeps a sharp eye on customer value, and helps their teams use the latest AI\-assisted techniques to build software for our large and growing audience of property managers and owners. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role. That doesn't mean writing code. It means staying close to the technical work day to day, weighing in on architecture and quality decisions, and having real skin in the game on how our systems get built. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ * Lead and grow two teams across Owner Growth and Owner Actions, 8–10 experienced engineers in total, all reporting directly to you. You'll own all aspects of people management: hiring, onboarding, goal setting, feedback, performance, and career growth. * Share ownership of strategy and delivery for both teams with Product. Turn Investor/Owner segment plans into team roadmaps and an operating rhythm that delivers results within the year. * Drive execution across both teams: organize work, set clear goals, manage dependencies between the teams, adjust pace to match criticality and risk, and hold the teams accountable for outcomes. * Stay close to the technical work. Take part in architectural discussions, and lead them when needed. Make informed trade\-offs on service boundaries, APIs, and modularization that fit the segment's technical strategy. * Own quality: make sure the systems your teams own are maintainable, tested, secure, performant, observable, and ready to scale with our growth. Balance investment in technical health with net\-new development. * Use engineering and product metrics, including growth and engagement metrics, to measure delivered value, track team health, and drive continuous improvement. * Work with Product, Design, and Machine Learning to bridge the gap between "what's possible" with AI and "what's valuable" for owners. Stay close to customers through calls, feedback, and usage data. * Build a culture of trust, ownership, and psychological safety. Coach engineers with direct feedback, address underperformance quickly, and give emerging leaders stretch opportunities. * Champion AI\-first ways of working. Help your teams evaluate, adopt, and validate AI tooling and new patterns that improve quality and speed up delivery. * Attract top talent: assess candidates rigorously, work closely with Recruiting, and build an inclusive hiring pipeline. **You know you're the right fit if...** --------------------------------------- * You have 7\+ years of experience building and scaling web applications, preferably in SaaS, including 2\+ years directly managing software engineers. Experience leading more than one team is a strong plus. * You've led teams from early ambiguity to a successful launch. Along the way you aligned stakeholders, made tough trade\-offs, and protected long\-term system health. * You're technically credible. You can go deep on system design and code quality, and you stay close enough to the work to make good technical calls with your teams. * You've worked on growth, engagement, or workflow\-heavy product areas and know how to connect engineering work to measurable customer outcomes. * You set clear expectations, give specific and actionable feedback, and handle conflict and underperformance with empathy and accountability. * You delegate to grow others, even when you could do it faster yourself, a understand the business, not just the code. You can explain how your teams' work connects to customer outcomes and company goals. * You've built AI tooling into your own workflow and your teams'. You know how to prompt, iterate, and validate AI\-generated output, and you set the bar for doing it well. * You're pragmatic about technology. You adopt new tools where they add value, stick with proven ones when they get the job done, and push for refactoring and clean architecture where it pays off. * You balance intensity and sustainability. You'll put in the extra hour when needed, but you model healthy work\-life balance for your teams. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in Computer Science or a related technical discipline. * Experience with technologies in our stack, such as Ruby on Rails, Golang, React, AWS, or service\-oriented architectures. **Notes for TA** ---------------- * **Level calibration:** Built from the Manager, Software Engineering column of the EM competency matrix. Two teams with 8–10 direct\-report engineers is still Manager scope; there are no managers reporting into this role. * **To confirm before posting:** location/remote policy, pay band (pay transparency rules apply in CA, CO, NY, WA, and others), EEO statement, and years of experience (7\+ / 2\+ is my proposal; the matrix doesn't specify). * **Candidate screening note:** Some early candidates are targeting manager\-of\-managers roles. Please screen for fit on scope early. **About AppFolio** AppFolio is the technology leader powering the future of the real estate industry. Our innovative platform and trusted partnership enable our customers to connect communities, increase operational efficiency, and grow their business. For more information about AppFolio, visit appfolio.com. **Why AppFolio** **Grow** \| We enable a culture of high performance, where delivering results is recognized by opportunities for growth and compelling total rewards. Our challenging and meaningful work drive the growth of our business, and ourselves. **Learn** \| We partner with you to realize your potential by investing in you from the start. We're cultivating a team of big thinkers through coaching and mentorship with our best\-in\-class leaders, and giving you the time and tools to develop your skills. **Impact** \| We are creating a world where living in, investing in, managing, and supporting communities feels magical and effortless, freeing people to thrive. We do this by innovating with purpose while cultivating a culture of impact. We learn as much from each other as we do our customers and our communities. **Connect** \| We excel at hybrid work by fostering an environment that feels flexible, personal and connected, no matter where we are. We create space to fuel innovation and collaboration, and we come together to celebrate, connect, and succeed. **Paddle as One.** Learn more at appfolio.com/company/careers ***Statement of Equal Opportunity*** At AppFolio, we value diversity in backgrounds and perspectives and depend on it to drive our innovative culture. jobs.title: Physics Simulation Engineer
jobs.description: **Why Join Stand****:** At Stand, you’ll help build a new class of global property protection. We use advanced physics and AI to model catastrophic risk at the asset level, then automate underwriting and mitigation before loss occurs. Insurance is simply the current delivery mechanism. The real product is a scalable risk engine, our **Stand World Model**. We stay when traditional insurers exit. We model what others approximate. And we build systems that change outcomes, not just prices. Our **leadership team** has built category\-defining companies (Metromile, Policygenius, WePay, HotelTonight) and brings decades of expertise in underwriting, capital management, and reinsurance. **Background:** The property insurance industry is built to price loss after it happens. It relies on coarse proxies, backward\-looking data, and manual processes, then accepts damage as unavoidable. Stand takes a different approach. We simulate how real\-world catastrophes affect individual properties, translate that into actionable decisions, and automate the business around it. The result is a platform that can underwrite what others can’t and operate with far less friction. **Role Summary:** As a **Physics Simulation Engineer** on the Applied Science team, you will build, extend, and continuously improve the physics solvers, pre\-, and post\-processing behind Stand's risk analytics for wildfire, wind, flood, and future perils. You will work directly in solver code, not just run it: adding physics, cutting runtime, and proving accuracy against experimental and field data. You will become a subject matter expert in a variety of different disciplines, and you’ll have endless opportunities to jump into testing, research review, and productization efforts. Reporting to the Physics Simulation Team Lead, you will work daily with peril SMEs, Machine Learning Engineers, and Platform Engineers so that simulations connect across scales, accurately feed probabilistic risk models, and supply the data behind AI\-accelerated surrogates. **What You'll Do:** * **Develop and extend core solvers**: modify CFD, FEA, and coupled multiphysics codes to capture physical regimes such as wave\-action, combustion, radiation, fire\-structure interaction, wind loading, and debris impact. * **Tune and validate models**: build automated validation suites and benchmarks that quantify solver error against experimental and field data. * **Improve solver performance**: improve parallel performance through load balancing, discretization and resolution strategy, and GPU acceleration, holding accuracy within agreed tolerances. * **Stand up simulation workflows for new perils**: gather requirements, evaluate open\-source and commercial solvers, and build the pre\-processing and solver pipeline. * **Build coupled multiphysics workflows**: connect fluid and structural solvers for fluid\-structure interaction, and link property\-scale solvers to larger\-scale peril models. * **Turn simulations into probabilistic risk inputs**: design simulation campaigns and apply reduced\-order, surrogate, and uncertainty quantification methods. * **Learn, document, and teach**, within and across teams. We work openly and collaboratively believing we are most effective when we develop understanding of each other’s work areas. * **Support ML surrogate development**: generate training data, define physical constraints and acceptance tests, and make sure surrogates slot into the simulation pipeline. * **Run on HPC efficiently**: work with Platform Engineers on compute workflows, throughput, and processing cost. * **Communicate tradeoffs plainly**: explain accuracy, runtime, and cost choices to ML, product, underwriting, and leadership. **Core Skills (Must\-Haves):** * **MS or PhD** in mechanical or aerospace engineering, applied math, physics, or a related field, with 3\+ years of hands\-on simulation development. * **Direct experience modifying solvers**, not only running them, in Fortran, C\+\+, or similar, with Python for scripting and tooling. * **Numerical rigor**: strong intuition for robust handling of geometry, discretization, convergence, stability, and solver error modes. * **Depth in CFD plus working fluency in structural or FEA modeling**, and comfort moving between heat transfer, fluid flow, structural, and multiphysics coupling. * **Strong intuition for high quality** ***automation***,to set up robust simulation pipelines, track and reduce failures, improve quality, and throughput, while minimizing human\-in\-the\-loop hours. * **Validation track record**: simulations verified with experimental or field data with quantified error. * **HPC experience**: parallel workflows with MPI or OpenMP on HPC clusters. * **Ownership and speed**: you prototype, test, document, and refine quickly under ambiguity and take responsibility for solver correctness end to end. * **Tools and lessons from your current industry**,that you’re excited to apply somewhere new. Our team is from a mix of audio, simulation vendor, automotive, aerospace, and academic backgrounds. **Nice to Haves:** * Hands\-on fluid\-structure interaction experience or other coupled multiphysics development. * Experience with simulation tools such as Fluent, Siemens star\-CCM, LS\-Dyna, Ansys workbench, Abaqus, code\_aster, OpenFOAM, SU2, CalculiX, Elmer. * Experience with multi\-objective optimization, through custom code, open\-source, or commercial codes such as Pymoo, HEEDS, Mode\-frontier, Isight, Optimus, Hyperstudy, or Optislang. * GPU\-accelerated solver work. * Reduced\-order modeling, surrogate modeling, or uncertainty quantification. * Experience building hybrid physics and ML models, or working closely with machine learning engineers on surrogates. * Simulation applied to natural hazards or risk: wildfire, wind, flood, or others. * Startup or zero\-to\-one experience. **Benefits:** * Above\-market Health, Dental, and Vision coverage * Weekly lunch stipend * Flexible time off \+ holidays * 401(k) plan * Commuter benefits * PAT \& MAT Leave * Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability * Monthly team gatherings * In\-office perks **AI in the Interview Process** Thoughtful use of AI tools is expected and valued at Stand. Candidates should be prepared to discuss how they use AI, how they evaluate its output, and how it informs their work. Strong communication, sound judgment, and the ability to clearly articulate experience and decision\-making remain core requirements. Some parts of the interview process are designed to assess independent thinking, communication, and problem\-solving. If you plan to use an AI assistant or LLM during any portion of an interview, please discuss it with your interviewer in advance. **Work Authorization** Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. Stand does not sponsor new work visas. We can consider candidates on TN visas, O\-1A visas, or H\-1B transfers with three years or more remaining. **Equal Opportunity Employment** *Stand is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. We believe that diversity enriches the workplace, and we are committed to growing our team with the most talented and passionate people from every community.* *We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals. If you require assistance, please contact us at* *hr@standinsurance.com**.* *Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.* **AI Use in Hiring** *We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us at* *hr@standinsurance.com**.* Compensation Range: $195K \- $225K

jobs.description: **Job Requirements** **Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product \& Technology** Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product \& Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally.
