The Rights \& Accounting fleet oversees products and optimizes workflows that enable TWDC to monetize content including content rights and avails management, content sales and content protection, content accounting, and talent payments. **Job Summary:** As a Product Software Engineer II, you will play a meaningful role working across Rights Management supply chain applications, building and supporting capabilities, and taking ownership of the technical design and implementation of medium\-sized projects and features. This position might be a great fit if you: * Are a curious and efficient engineer who wants to help shape the direction of development and collaborate closely with some of the brightest minds in our organization. * Thrive in an agile, collaborative environment where teamwork and innovation are valued. In this role, you will focus on the systems that govern and track the rights \& availability of TWDC media for use in 1st party products such as Disney\+ and 3rd party digital media sales. You will collaborate closely with multiple internal and external teams to enable robust data integration capabilities. **Responsibilities:** * Maintain a deep understanding of our core systems and how they interact with upstream and downstream dependencies. Contribute and review code, and work with engineers to ensure product and design specifications are met. * Responsible for fundamental platform performance, scalability, and resiliency. Influence and contribute to department technical strategy and planning. Research, learn, and evangelize widespread adoption of new technologies and architecture patterns * Lead cross\-functional troubleshooting of complex issues as needed. Any other duties needed to help achieve Business Objectives **Minimum Qualifications:** 3\+ years of professional experience in a software engineering role. Proficient in Java and JVM languages, with hands\-on experience in Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Integration, and other Spring frameworks. Solid experience across the full software development lifecycle, including continuous integration, unit and integration testing, functional testing, code reviews, and documentation. Experience designing, building, and integrating APIs. Practical experience with AWS services such as S3, RDS, messaging, VPC, Cloudformation/Terraform, and related infrastructure. Design and build modern, performant, responsive user interfaces using React and related technologies. Strong understanding of data integration concepts and workflows. Experience with event\-driven architecture (EDA) and publish/subscribe messaging patterns (e.g., Kafka, SNS). Experience in monitoring and maintaining application health and performance. Skilled in applying object\-oriented and functional programming principles to solve real\-world software engineering problems. Excellent communication and collaboration skills in a team environment. Effective time management, with the ability to break down complex problems into manageable tasks. Familiarity and experience with Agile methodologies. Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Software, Electrical or Electronics Engineering, or comparable field of study, and/or equivalent work experience. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Previous work experience in media distribution. * Comfort and experience using AI\-assisted coding tools such as GitHub Co\-pilot, Amazon Q Developer or Claude Code. * Experience collaborating with teams located across the globe. * Strong curiosity about how Disney delivers the Magic and a desire to be a part of it **Disclaimer** PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Glendale, CA is $119,200\.00 to $159,800\.00 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long\-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. This position is with Disney Entertainment \& Sports LLC, which is part of a business we call Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product \& Technology. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Disney champions a business environment where ideas and decisions from all people help us grow, innovate, create the best stories and be relevant in a constantly evolving world. jobs.title: Research Engineer, Post-Training
jobs.description: ### **About Actively AI** Actively AI is defining a new category: Intelligence\-Led Revenue. Revenue organizations have always been bottlenecked on human capacity. Reps triage which accounts get attention. Context disappears at every handoff. On any given day, the vast majority of accounts have exactly zero people thinking about them. Actively addresses this at the structural level. Our platform deploys Per\-Account AgentsTM across our customers’ TAM, working 24/7 to research, identify opportunities, and advance next steps without being asked. Leading enterprises including Ramp, Ironclad, and Samsara are already making this shift. Our co\-founders are former Stanford AI researchers, and the team comes from Harvard, CMU, Berkeley, Brex, Scale AI, and Google. We've raised $68M from TCV, First Harmonic, Bain Capital Ventures, First Round Capital, and more. ### **About the Role:** We're looking for research engineers to help accelerate post\-training models specific to the GTM and sales domain. Our product which is used by thousands of sales reps and leaders daily across the entire lifecycle of prospecting, deal execution, expansion, and retention, and there is substantial insane demand for higher quality intelligence across these tasks. This role involves working directly with our founders to help us fine\-tune intelligence and push the Pareto Frontier in our domain. **What You'll Accomplish** -------------------------- * **Post\-Training Recipe Development:** Iterate on the full stack of datasets, training stages, and hyperparameters that determine model behavior. Measure how choices compound across evals and production performance, not just isolated benchmarks. * **Evaluation Design and Integrity:** Build evals that actually capture what matters. The loop never ends: define, optimize, realize the gaps, and rebuild. You'll be responsible for making numbers go up and making sure the numbers mean something. * **Deep Understanding:** When training produces results that don't make sense, you dig until you understand why. The goal isn't just to fix it; it's to carry that understanding forward to the next problem. This requires rapidly understanding domain context. * **Alignment and Agent Behavior:** Apply and advance techniques like RLHF, RLAIF, and constitutional approaches to shape how agents reason, act, and collaborate with humans in long\-horizon tasks. * **Scaling and Exploration:** Measure how performance scales with data and compute, and develop new methodologies when existing ones hit ceilings. We expect both rigor and invention. **We are looking for evidence of:** ----------------------------------- * A track record of advancing ML systems through post\-training, alignment, or related methods: RLHF, RLAIF, preference modeling, reward learning, or equivalent * Strong fundamentals in probability, statistics, and ML theory. The ability to look at experimental data and distinguish real effects from noise and bugs * Evidence of original contributions or working on similar problems in industry (preferably in startup environments). At least 3 years of full\-time experience. * Unique ability to understand the end user tasks, domain, and build user empathy and intuition around judging what good, great, and bad looks like. ### **Why Join** At Actively, you write playbooks rather than follow them. You own outcomes, not just tasks, and see directly how your work changes what customers can do — across a product and go\-to\-market motion that is scaling fast. The team is high\-caliber and low\-ego: people who work from first principles, move with urgency, and care deeply about building something that drives real value. If that's the kind of challenge you're looking for, Actively is the right place. ### **Benefits** * Competitive Early\-Stage Equity * + Health, Dental, Vision Coverage * Unlimited PTO \+ Recharge Days * ️ Catered Lunch on Tuesday \& Friday, Dinners every day! * Fully Stocked Kitchen * Cutting\-Edge Tech \& Tools * Annual Off\-sites \& Monthly Events * Commuter Benefits * Cozy Office in NYC

jobs.title: Research Engineer, Voice AI [NYC or SF]
jobs.description: **About Concurrence** ===================== Concurrence (formerly Amigo) is building the platform healthcare organizations use to build their own clinical AI agents. Our mission is to make excellent care accessible to every patient, not rationed by the limits of clinician time. Underneath our platform is the Health World Model, which unifies a health system’s data into a living, event\-level record of every patient’s care. On top of it, agents handle work across the patient journey, from intake and scheduling to medication management and clinical decision support. Our agents have supported more than 10 million patient encounters and are on track to grow tenfold this year. We run natively on Databricks, integrate with every major EHR, and are backed by Madrona, General Catalyst, and Optum Ventures. We’re about 35 people, working in person in New York and San Francisco. **About this role** =================== As a Research Engineer, Voice AI at Concurrence, you'll build and tune speech models for patient conversations and ambient clinical audio. You'll own models from data and training through evaluation and production, working with runtime engineers on streaming inference, latency and turn\-taking. The work includes full\-duplex speech\-to\-speech models that listen and speak at the same time, handle interruptions and preserve clinical details. **What you'll do** ================== * Train and fine\-tune speech and audio models for patient calls and clinical encounters * Own data preparation, training experiments and evaluation code * Improve streaming inference, turn\-taking and interruption handling, balancing model quality, latency and cost * Define clinical failure cases with clinicians, product and evaluation engineers, and measure the errors that matter to patients * Evaluate changes on held\-out examples, investigate regressions and carry improvements into production * Use evidence from real conversations to choose the next experiment and shape our modeling approach **What we're looking for** ========================== * You've personally trained or fine\-tuned speech or audio models on large audio datasets as a substantial part of your work * You've shipped a model into a real\-time product, with concrete results on streaming inference, latency, turn\-taking or overlapping speech * You've taken an ambiguous problem, defined a useful metric and led the work through to a model running in production * You write the training and evaluation code yourself and can explain the choices behind an experiment * You use coding agents in your work and independently verify their output * You're low ego, direct, and hold yourself to a high bar * You can work on site in New York City or San Francisco **Nice to have** ================ * Experience building or tuning a full\-duplex speech\-to\-speech model, our strongest preference * Neural audio codecs or audio language models * Telephone audio, overlapping speech or multi\-speaker audio * Model adaptation for a particular customer, domain or regulated environment **Benefits (available to Full\-Time Employees)** ================================================ **Health \& Wellness** ---------------------- * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance * Daily catered lunch and dinner * Mental health support and wellness coaching * Flexible wellness stipend for fitness, therapy, or personal growth **Growth \& Development** ------------------------- * Annual learning budget for courses, books, or conferences * Conference attendance budget for professional development * Annual team offsite * Academic collaboration opportunities * Unlimited PTO **Our Core Values** =================== * **Patients Win, We Win** If patients aren't getting better care, we haven't earned the right to scale. Every internal decision gets pressure\-tested: does this make patients' lives better? If we can't draw the line, we question why we're doing it. * **High Standards, High Care** We hold a high bar for the team because patients are counting on us to get this right. But high standards only work with genuine investment in each other. You can take risks, admit mistakes, and challenge ideas. Not despite our standards, but because of them. * **Thoughtful Urgency** We move fast by default, but speed without judgment is recklessness. The discipline is knowing which decisions are reversible vs. not. In healthcare AI, the companies that win will be fast everywhere they can be and careful everywhere they must be. We build the muscle to do both. * **Intensely Measured** We instrument patient outcomes, provider ROI, system performance, and clinical accuracy. But data without action is surveillance. Every metric should have an owner, a threshold, and a response plan. If we're measuring something but never acting on it, we stop measuring it. **Who Builds With Us** ====================== * **Low ego:** Politics and territory don't interest you. The best ideas win, regardless of who has them. * **Direct:** You say the hard thing, challenge ideas openly, and commit fully once decided. * **High agency:** You thrive on trust rather than instruction. When you see something is broken, you fix it. You don’t file tickets and wait for someone else. * **Bar of excellence:** You hold yourself to a bar most people wouldn't, and you want teammates who do the same. * **Skeptical:** You push back on rules that don’t make sense and question assumptions that haven’t earned their place. Compensation Range: $220K \- $300K

jobs.description: **Sales Engineer \- Thread Rolling Solutions Team** **Preferred Base Location: Houston, Texas area** **Job Type: Remote, Full\-Time** **Travel: Up to 50%** **Salary** will be competitive and based on experience, qualifications, and demonstrated expertise. **About Brinkman Products** Brinkman Products, Inc. is an industrial manufacturing company encompassing two specialized divisions: **Davenport Machine** and **CJWinter**. Together, we manufacture proprietary product lines including Davenport multi\-spindle screw machines, thread rolling attachments, thread rolls, and precision tooling solutions serving manufacturers worldwide. **Position Overview** We are seeking a motivated and technically proficient **Sales Engineer** to develop and grow the **CJWinter Thread Rolling Solutions business** throughout Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, and Louisiana, with a strong focus on manufacturers serving the Oil \& Gas industry. The preferred candidate will be based in the Houston, Texas area. This position combines technical sales, business development, customer support, and market development. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working directly with manufacturers, understanding their production challenges, and developing practical thread rolling and tooling solutions. **What You Will Do** The Sales Engineer will be responsible for developing new business while growing relationships with existing customers throughout the assigned territory. **Key Responsibilities** * Identify, develop, negotiate, and close new sales opportunities for CJWinter thread rolling products and solutions. * Develop new customers and expand business with existing accounts throughout the territory. * Visit manufacturers and work directly with engineering, manufacturing, purchasing, and management personnel to identify opportunities. * Evaluate customer applications and recommend thread rolling attachments, thread rolls, tooling, and process solutions. * Develop a strong understanding of customer machining and manufacturing processes to identify areas where CJWinter products can improve productivity, quality, and tool life. * Provide technical sales support, product demonstrations, training, and customer consultations. * Develop relationships with key customers, distributors, industry partners, and other market contacts. * Identify competitive activity, market trends, and opportunities for new products and market expansion. * Work closely with CJWinter sales, applications engineering, manufacturing, and product development teams to support customer projects. * Provide customer and market feedback to help guide product\-development initiatives. * Support regional trade shows, industry associations, technical events, and other sales and marketing activities. * Maintain an active sales pipeline and follow up on quotations, leads, projects, and new\-business opportunities. * Travel throughout the territory as required to develop and support customers, with travel of up to **50%**. * Research new markets and recommend targeted marketing strategies for specific products, industries, and regions. * Generate and submit sales activity, pipeline, and market reports to management as needed. * Provide onsite product training and assist with application troubleshooting when required. **What We Are Looking For** **Education \& Experience** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical field preferred. * Technical sales experience within machining, metalworking, tooling, industrial manufacturing, or a related industry. * Strong mechanical aptitude and the ability to understand manufacturing applications. * Experience working directly with manufacturing customers and developing new business. * Knowledge of threading, thread rolling, cold rolling, burnishing, machining, tooling, and related cold\-forming or metal\-forming processes is highly desirable. **Professional Skills** * Strong sales and business\-development skills. * Excellent communication and presentation abilities. * Ability to understand customer manufacturing challenges and communicate technical solutions clearly. * Self\-motivated and comfortable developing a territory and pursuing new customers. * Strong organizational, follow\-up, and project\-management skills. * Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with internal sales, engineering, and manufacturing teams. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office. * Willingness to travel up to 50%. * Strong time\-management skills with the discipline to establish and achieve sales goals. * Working knowledge of manual and CNC lathes, CNC programming, and precision measurement using micrometers is preferred. * Familiarity with drill pipe threads, including API\-style applications, is highly desirable. * Comfort using LinkedIn and other professional social media platforms to support prospecting and market development. * Experience serving the Oil \& Gas industry is preferred. **Why Join CJWinter?** **Technical Sales** Work directly with manufacturers to solve real production challenges with engineered thread rolling solutions. **Territory Development** Take an active role in expanding CJWinter's presence throughout **Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, and Louisiana**. **Customer Impact** Help customers improve manufacturing productivity, quality, tool life, and overall process performance. **Product \& Market Development** Work with sales, engineering, manufacturing, and product development to identify new applications and opportunities. **Career Growth** Develop specialized expertise in thread rolling technology while building a significant industrial sales territory. **Compensation \& Benefits** * Car allowance * Company\-paid fuel for business travel * Performance\-based incentives * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) retirement plan with company matching * Life, Short\-Term Disability, and Long\-Term Disability insurance * Generous paid time off program plus 10 paid holidays annually * Professional development and ongoing technical training * Career\-development opportunities **Join Our Team** If you have a strong technical background, enjoy developing new business, and want to work directly with manufacturers to solve challenging production applications, we encourage you to apply. Join **CJWinter** and help expand our Thread Rolling Solutions business throughout Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, and Louisiana. Please submit your resume for consideration. We appreciate your interest in our company! *EOE, including disability/vets*.

jobs.title: Senior Agentic AI Engineer
jobs.description: **YOUR ROLE** We are seeking a Senior Agentic AI Engineer to architect, build, and operate intelligent AI agents that execute complex, end\-to\-end business workflows. This role goes beyond building conversational interfaces: you will develop reliable agentic systems that can reason over business context, plan and perform actions, collaborate with other agents, integrate with enterprise platforms, and involve people when judgment or approval is needed. You will combine strong software engineering fundamentals with deep hands\-on experience in LLM\-based systems, agent orchestration, tool integration, and production operations. You will own technical outcomes from architecture and prototyping through deployment, evaluation, and continuous improvement, while helping establish engineering standards and mentoring other engineers. **WHAT YOU'LL** **DO** * Design and implement robust single\-agent and multi\-agent systems using patterns such as supervisor, planner, specialist agents, and delegated task execution. * Build agent workflows that support planning, tool use, state transitions, retries, checkpoints, resumability, and human\-in\-the\-loop approvals. * Define clear boundaries between probabilistic agent reasoning and deterministic business rules, validations, and transaction execution. * Develop reusable agent capabilities, tools, prompts, workflow components, and orchestration patterns that can be adopted across products. * Manage agent context, memory, conversation state, task state, and long\-running workflow lifecycle. * Integrate and evaluate foundation models from providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and AWS Bedrock. * Engineer prompts, structured outputs, function/tool calling, context assembly, and model\-routing strategies. * Build retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) systems using embeddings, semantic search, metadata filtering, and vector databases. * Improve quality and reliability through grounding, validation, confidence\-aware workflows, fallback strategies, and hallucination mitigation. * Optimize model selection, latency, throughput, token consumption, and inference cost without compromising business outcomes. * Integrate agents with enterprise APIs, microservices, data platforms, and business applications. * Build and consume Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and tools using secure, well\-defined contracts. * Implement agent\-to\-agent (A2A) communication and interoperability patterns, including task lifecycle, status, input, and result handling. * Design capability discovery, delegation, and invocation patterns for internal and external agents. * Create resilient integration patterns for asynchronous operations, streaming, event delivery, and external system failures. * Build scalable, fault\-tolerant agent services using asynchronous and event\-driven architectures. * Implement durable workflow execution, persistence, checkpointing, idempotency, retries, timeouts, and recovery from partial failures. * Establish observability across agent decisions, tool calls, traces, latency, token usage, costs, and business outcomes. * Develop automated testing and evaluation strategies for agent behavior, tool correctness, regression detection, and end\-to\-end workflows. * Implement enterprise security controls including authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, secrets management, auditability, and policy enforcement. * Deploy and operate services using cloud\-native infrastructure, CI/CD, containers, and appropriate runtime platforms. * Lead technical design discussions and make pragmatic architecture decisions that balance speed, quality, scalability, and maintainability. * Partner with product, platform, security, and domain teams to translate business problems into agentic solutions with measurable outcomes. * Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing. * Evaluate emerging agent frameworks, protocols, models, and tools; recommend adoption based on evidence rather than novelty. * Drive prototypes and proofs of concept into production\-ready capabilities, including documentation and operational readiness. * Other duties and responsibilities as assigned. **YOUR LOCATION** This is a fully remote role, with the exception of onboarding and optional in\-office events. **SKILLS \& QUALIFICATIONS** * Typically 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with substantial backend or distributed\-systems development experience. * Demonstrated hands\-on experience building and deploying LLM\-powered applications or AI agents in production or production\-like environments. * Strong Python skills and experience designing maintainable services, APIs, and software components. * Practical experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent technologies. * Strong understanding of LLM capabilities and limitations, including prompting, tool calling, structured generation, context management, and model evaluation. * Experience designing REST APIs, integrating microservices, and working with asynchronous or event\-driven systems. * Experience with RAG architectures, embeddings, semantic retrieval, and vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, or pgvector. * Experience deploying cloud\-based applications and using Docker, CI/CD, and infrastructure automation; Kubernetes experience is valuable. * Understanding of production concerns including reliability, observability, performance, cost management, testing, and secure software development. * Ability to independently own a technical problem, communicate trade\-offs, and deliver a working solution across the development lifecycle. * Experience designing multi\-agent systems with supervisor, planner, worker, or specialist\-agent patterns (preferred) * Hands\-on experience implementing MCP servers, MCP clients, and tool integrations (preferred) * Experience with A2A or other agent interoperability protocols and distributed task lifecycle management (preferred) * Experience with AWS Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore, or comparable managed model and agent runtime platforms (preferred) * Experience with agent memory, long\-running workflows, state persistence, and human\-in\-the\-loop interaction patterns (preferred) * Familiarity with agent tracing and evaluation tools such as LangSmith, as well as operational platforms such as Datadog or CloudWatch (preferred) * Knowledge of enterprise identity and security patterns, including OAuth 2\.0, JWT, RBAC, and multi\-tenant authorization (preferred) * Experience in insurance, financial services, healthcare, or another domain with complex workflows and compliance requirements (preferred) **Physical Requirements** * Must be able to sit/stand/walk for prolonged periods of time (up to 8 hours per day), at a desk working on a computer. * Must be able to use standard office equipment for extended periods of time, including but not limited to, a mouse, keyboard, phone and video conferencing. * Must be able to travel to the Bold Penguin office in Dublin, Ohio for New Hire Onboarding \& Orientation (2 days, 2 nights); travel costs are covered by Bold Penguin. * Must be able to travel occasionally (up to 10%) for corporate events and team planning sessions. Bold Penguin is the premier digital broker for commercial insurance. Their technology expands top\-of\-funnel demand and increases yield for enterprise partners. Through digital distribution, wholesale capabilities, and AI\-driven insights, they transform the lifecycle of both simple and complex risks, from prospecting to placement. **Benefits** We offer competitive compensation and progressive benefits that include: * Medical, Dental, and Vision * Flexible PTO Policy * 401(k) with a company match * Employee Assistance Program * Parental Leave * Disability and Life Benefits **Stay connected to the Glacier.** We have great SLACK channels for work and play. We also like to video conference and hold all\-hands "Waddles" regularly. **Penguin bling.** Like swag themed after a certain Antarctic bird? Just. You. Wait. Bold Penguin believes in inclusion. That’s why we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer that considers all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. To learn more about our results\-focused culture and employee\-focused perks, read more on our **careers page**.

jobs.title: Senior Android Automation Engineer (Device Fleet Management) - Contract
jobs.description: **About the project** We're an agency building our own platform to manage a fleet of physical Android phones. We have a small working prototype and need an experienced engineer to turn it into a reliable production system. The platform will let our team remotely view and control phones, install apps, organize phones into groups, schedule workflows, and review results in a web dashboard. This is a hands\-on role covering Android device integration, backend infrastructure, and a practical operator interface. **Pay:** Discussed on call, based on experience and agreed scope. Contract, with potential for ongoing work. **What you'll build** *Android device management* * Connect and provision physical Android phones * Remote screen viewing and input control * App installs, updates, and device health monitoring * Organize devices by location, group, and rack position * Recover cleanly from network drops, restarts, and app crashes * Identify supported phone models, Android versions, and any root requirements *Workflow execution* * A framework for assigning and scheduling tasks across devices * Approved app workflows built with Android automation tools * Task status, completion evidence, errors, and retries * No duplicate runs and no overlapping tasks on the same device * Screenshots and logs for troubleshooting Early workflow discovery includes Google Maps search and navigation interactions for authorized testing. Please explain any technical limits and platform requirements you see. Location simulation, attribution to Google Business Profile reporting, and ranking effects are not established capabilities or expected deliverables. *Backend and dashboard* * Secure APIs, device registration, authentication, and access controls * Device inventory, grouping, task queues, and scheduling * Online status, task progress, and per\-device results * Real\-time commands and screen streaming * Monitoring, audit logs, and alerts **Required experience** * Automating or remotely managing **physical** Android devices (not emulator\-only) * Strong ADB, Android permissions, provisioning, and troubleshooting skills * Kotlin or Java, plus Android app or service development * Appium, UI Automator, or similar Android automation tools * Backend development in a production language * APIs, databases, async workers, and task queues * Real\-time communication, reconnect logic, and unreliable networks * Deploying, documenting, and maintaining systems on client\-owned infrastructure * Clear communication about tradeoffs, constraints, and estimates **Nice to have** * Device labs, mobile test infrastructure, or multi\-device platforms * scrcpy, GADS, or similar remote device tools * Android screen capture, video encoding, low\-latency streaming * WebSockets, WebRTC, or WebTransport * PostgreSQL, Docker, Linux, cloud deployment * React, Vue, or similar dashboards * USB hubs, powered racks, thermal management, fleet reliability * Secure handling of device credentials and app data We're open to adapting existing tools where licenses and capabilities fit. Tell us what you'd reuse and what needs custom work. **First paid milestone: 3–5 device prototype** Using hardware you recommend and we approve, the prototype should show: * Device registration and accurate online/offline status * Browser\-based remote screen viewing and control * Device grouping and bulk install of a test APK * An agreed, repeatable test workflow * Per\-device logs with success, failure, and evidence * Recovery after a device disconnects and reconnects, with no duplicate task runs * Deployment docs and a code walkthrough We'll agree on acceptance criteria, dates, and payment milestones before work starts. More work depends on the prototype's results. **Ownership and delivery** * Custom code committed regularly to our repository * Infrastructure and service accounts under our control * The agreement covers ownership of custom work and rights to any pre\-existing components * All third\-party dependencies, licenses, and recurring fees disclosed * Setup instructions, architecture docs, and an operational handoff * Any subcontractors disclosed before they start **How to apply** Apply here with: * Examples of Android automation, remote\-control, or device\-management systems you've built * Your specific part in each one * A short outline of your proposed architecture * Recommended hardware for the prototype * Your availability, timeline, and hourly rate or milestone estimate * Any ongoing software or hosting costs you expect Demos, repos, or private walkthroughs help a lot. Please separate physical\-device work from emulator\-only work. Application Question(s): * Have you built remote screen viewing/control for physical Android phones (scrcpy, WebRTC, or similar)? Describe it briefly and share a repo, demo, or portfolio link. Experience: * physical Android device automation: 3 years (Preferred) Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Automation Test Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Overview** We are seeking an experienced Senior Automation Test Engineer with a minimum of 7 years of professional experience to lead the design, development, and execution of automated testing strategies for our complex, distributed enterprise systems, APIs, and data pipelines. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring high quality, reliability, and performance across post\-trade processing, message\-driven microservices, ETL workloads, and front\-end user interfaces. The ideal candidate possesses deep hands\-on expertise in building scalable test frameworks, validating end\-to\-end data flows, and embedding automated test solutions directly into CI/CD pipelines. **Key Responsibilities** · **Test Framework Design \& Development:** Architect, build, and maintain robust, scalable automated test frameworks and test suites for functional, integration, API, regression, and performance testing. · **API \& Microservices Validation:** Execute comprehensive testing of REST APIs, WebSocket services, and messaging\-based integrations in event\-driven, microservices\-based architectures. · **Data Movement \& ETL Testing:** Validate data movement, complex transformations, reconciliations, and end\-to\-end workflows across distributed applications, data warehouses, and reporting solutions. · **Database \& SQL Verification:** Utilize strong SQL queries to inspect, validate, and verify transactional data across relational databases (PostgreSQL, SQL Server). · **CI/CD \& DevOps Integration:** Integrate automated test execution into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing, rapid release cycles, and DevOps best practices. · **Performance \& Observability:** Conduct performance, load, and reliability testing, leveraging monitoring tools to identify system bottlenecks and ensure high availability. · **Defect Lifecycle \& Collaboration:** Manage defects, test runs, and coverage tracking in tools like PractiTest or Jira/Xray, collaborating closely with developers, business analysts, and DevOps teams. · **Troubleshooting \& Root Cause Analysis:** Analyze test failures, troubleshoot complex issues across applications, services, integrations, and data pipelines, and drive sustainable root\-cause resolution. **Required Qualifications \& Skills** · **Professional Experience:** Minimum of 7 years of professional experience testing distributed software systems, APIs, data pipelines, and enterprise applications. · **Automation Frameworks \& Tools:** Proficiency with modern testing tools and frameworks such as Cucumber, Selenium, Playwright, Power Automate, Rest Assured, Postman, or equivalent technologies. · **Programming Languages:** Strong programming skills in TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, and/or Python with proven ability to build automated test solutions. · **Architecture \& API Testing:** Hands\-on experience testing microservices\-based architectures, event\-driven systems, REST APIs, WebSocket services, and messaging integrations. · **Data \& ETL Validation:** Experience validating data movement, transformations, reconciliations, and end\-to\-end workflows; hands\-on experience testing ETL/data integration workloads, data warehouses, and reporting tools. · **Relational Databases \& SQL:** Strong SQL skills with hands\-on experience validating data in relational databases such as PostgreSQL and SQL Server. · **Messaging \& Event Streaming:** Experience working with message queues and streaming platforms such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, IBM MQ, or similar technologies. · **Front\-End Automation \& Web UI:** Exposure to modern front\-end technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Angular) and UI test automation. · **SDLC \& DevOps Integration:** Proficiency in SDLC, DevOps (CI/CD), and Agile methodologies, with demonstrable experience embedding automated testing into CI/CD pipelines. · **Test Management Tools:** Experience with test management and defect tracking platforms such as PractiTest, Jira, Xray, Zephyr, or similar tools. · **Performance \& Reliability Testing:** Familiarity with performance, load, and stress testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, k6, or equivalent solutions. · **Monitoring \& Observability:** Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, and Splunk. · **Problem Solving \& Troubleshooting:** Excellent problem\-solving skills and proven ability to troubleshoot complex issues across multi\-tier applications, integrations, and data pipelines. **Preferred \& Desirable Qualifications** · **Financial Domain Knowledge:** Understanding of trade lifecycle workflows and post\-trade processes across asset classes including equities, bonds, options, and futures is highly desirable. · **Containerization \& Cloud Expertise:** Working knowledge of containerization and cloud platforms (Docker, Kubernetes); AWS experience and strong Kubernetes expertise are major pluses. Pay: $50\.35 \- $60\.64 per hour Work Location: Hybrid remote in Charlotte, NC 28216

platforms, and ensuring rigorous data quality, lineage, and compliance across downstream reporting, risk, finance, and settlement platforms. **Key Responsibilities** · **Pipeline Design \& Engineering:** Design, develop, and maintain high\-throughput batch and streaming data pipelines (ETL/ELT workflows) utilizing Python, SQL, Spark, and streaming platforms. · **Post\-Trade \& Financial Data Management:** Process and integrate post\-trade data flows including trade allocations, confirmations, settlement, risk management, finance, and regulatory reporting. · **Data Modeling \& Grafana. **Preferred \& Bonus Qualifications** · **Time\-Series \& Market Data:** Understanding of time\-series data management and financial market data is a strong plus. · **AI / GenAI \& ML jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer / Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Location:** Chicago, IL / Hybrid or Remote **Employment Type:** Full\-Time **Compensation:** Competitive, based on experience About the Opportunity We are developing an ambitious technology platform designed to revolutionize how freight transportation is priced, analyzed, and traded across global markets. Our vision is to create a sophisticated digital marketplace that brings stock\-market\-style transparency, price discovery, and trading functionality to the global freight industry. The platform will aggregate freight pricing information across transportation modes, geographic regions, and trade lanes, enabling users to monitor market movements, evaluate pricing opportunities, and potentially execute freight\-related transactions through a centralized marketplace. We are seeking a highly skilled and entrepreneurial **Senior Full Stack Developer / Lead Software Engineer** to help architect, develop, and launch this platform from the ground up. This is an opportunity to play a foundational role in building a potentially transformative technology product at the intersection of global logistics, financial markets, and software engineering. Key Responsibilities 1\. Full Stack Platform Development Architect, build, and maintain a scalable, cloud\-based web application. * Develop responsive, high\-performance user interfaces with modern JavaScript frameworks. * Build secure backend infrastructure supporting user accounts, pricing data, transactions, and market analytics. * Design and manage databases capable of handling substantial volumes of historical and real\-time freight pricing information. * Develop a modular software architecture supporting rapid expansion into additional freight markets and transportation modes. * 2\. Real\-Time Freight Pricing \& Market Data Design systems to collect, normalize, process, and display freight pricing information from multiple sources. * Integrate third\-party APIs, transportation management systems, and logistics data providers. * Develop real\-time pricing dashboards featuring interactive charts, historical trends, and market comparisons. * Create pricing engines capable of processing transportation rates across global trade lanes. * Establish data structures supporting truckload, intermodal, ocean freight, air freight, and additional transportation markets. * Implement efficient data streaming and updating mechanisms to maintain timely market information. * 3\. Trading \& Marketplace Functionality Develop marketplace functionality allowing participants to submit, evaluate, and respond to freight pricing bids and offers. * Design order\-management workflows inspired by electronic financial marketplaces. * Build transaction tracking, trade history, and audit logging capabilities. * Develop tools for visualizing market depth, bid/ask spreads, historical pricing, and trading activity. * Support the future implementation of automated matching and transaction execution systems, subject to product requirements and applicable regulatory review. * 4\. Technical Architecture \& Infrastructure Design a secure, reliable, and scalable cloud infrastructure. * Develop RESTful APIs and real\-time data communication services. * Implement authentication, authorization, encryption, and role\-based access controls. * Optimize application performance, database queries, and system responsiveness. * Establish automated testing, continuous integration, deployment pipelines, and monitoring. * Design infrastructure capable of supporting international users and growing transaction volumes. * 5\. Product Development \& Technical Leadership Work directly with the founders to translate business concepts into technical specifications. * Recommend appropriate technologies, frameworks, and development approaches. * Establish the technical roadmap and prioritize minimum viable product (MVP) features. * Independently solve complex engineering problems and recommend scalable solutions. * Document system architecture, code, APIs, and development processes. * Help recruit and guide additional engineering talent as the business expands. * Take ownership of technical execution from initial prototype through commercial launch. * Required Qualifications 5\+ years of professional software development experience, preferably with full stack application development. * * Strong experience with modern frontend frameworks such as **React, Next.js, or Angular**. * Proficiency in backend technologies such as **Node.js, TypeScript, Python, or equivalent frameworks**. Strong understanding of relational and nonrelational databases, including PostgreSQL, Redis, and related technologies. * Experience designing and integrating APIs and external data services. * Familiarity with real\-time communication technologies such as WebSockets and event\-driven architectures. * Experience deploying and managing applications using AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. * Knowledge of application security, authentication, and data protection best practices. * Demonstrated ability to design systems from the ground up and work independently. * Strong analytical, architectural, and problem\-solving capabilities. * Experience working in agile development environments or early\-stage technology ventures. * Preferred Qualifications Experience developing financial trading platforms, electronic marketplaces, brokerage systems, or market data applications. * Familiarity with exchange\-style order books, matching engines, bid/ask systems, or transactional marketplaces. * Experience with financial market data APIs, streaming infrastructure, or high\-volume data processing. * Knowledge of logistics, freight brokerage, international shipping, supply chain technology, or transportation management systems. * Experience building data visualization platforms featuring interactive charts and pricing analytics. * Familiarity with quantitative modeling, pricing algorithms, or machine learning. * Experience with distributed systems, event streaming, or message brokers such as Kafka. * Previous experience as a technical lead, founding engineer, or startup software architect. * Initial Project Objectives The successful candidate will be responsible for leading development of an initial MVP incorporating: * **Global Freight Market Dashboard:** A centralized interface displaying transportation pricing across selected international markets and freight corridors. * **Market Pricing Engine:** Infrastructure for collecting, processing, and presenting freight rates and historical pricing trends. * **Interactive Market Charts:** Financial\-market\-style visualizations featuring price movements, historical comparisons, and trading activity where available. * **User Accounts \& Permissions:** Secure user registration, authentication, account management, and user access controls. * **Bidding \& Offering System:** Functionality allowing approved participants to post, view, and respond to freight pricing bids and offers. * **API \& Data Integration Framework:** Scalable infrastructure for integrating transportation providers, logistics systems, and external pricing sources. * **Expandable Trading Architecture:** A technical foundation capable of supporting additional exchange\-style trading functionality as the product matures. Ideal Candidate We are looking for a developer who thinks like a technical founder rather than someone who simply completes assigned programming tasks. The ideal candidate is comfortable with ambiguity, can transform an ambitious concept into a functioning product, and understands the importance of building scalable systems with sound technical foundations. A strong background in financial technology, electronic trading platforms, B2B marketplaces, or logistics technology would be especially valuable. The right individual will have the opportunity to shape the underlying technology and technical direction of an innovative global freight marketplace. Why Join Us? Help build a new technology platform from its earliest stages. * Work at the intersection of global logistics, market data, and financial technology. * Take ownership of architecture, engineering, and product development. * Collaborate directly with experienced transportation industry professionals. * Help establish a technical foundation for a potentially global platform. * Opportunity to grow into a senior technical leadership position as the company expands. * **To Apply** Please submit your resume, relevant project portfolio or GitHub profile, and examples of sophisticated web applications, marketplaces, financial technology platforms, or data\-intensive software systems you have helped design or develop.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote \- US **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Engineering **Compensation** ---------------- * $180K – $200K • Offers Equity The base salary will be determined by the level and scope of the role, along with the candidate’s experience, skills, credentials, education, and performance in the interviews. We view equity as long\-term ownership, giving team members the opportunity to participate directly in the company’s future growth and success. **About Quilter** ================= At Quilter, we are helping electrical engineers save time and accomplish more by automating the tedious and time\-consuming task of designing printed circuit boards (PCBs). Our small team is composed of experts in electrical engineering, electromagnetic simulation, ML/AI, and high\-performance computing (HPC). We are inventing and leveraging novel techniques to solve the decades\-old problem of automating circuit board design where today hundreds of billions of dollars are spent. We have raised $25 million in Series B funding from some of the very best and are charging full\-speed toward our goal. No matter where we come from, we're united by a common vision for the future and a core set of values we think will get us there: * Curiosity * Conviction * Rigor We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join Quilter’s Application Team and help us build the software platform behind the future of circuit board design. We are a team of generalists who pride ourselves on solving new challenges and always learning. You’ll work across the stack to create helpful and friendly user interfaces as well as the services backing them. integrity: schema design, safe migrations on live data, reliable queues and webhooks, and idempotent business logic. * Build integrations with messaging, video, identity, e\-commerce and pharmacy partners. * Own CI/CD, monitoring, releases and incident response. * Grow automated test coverage on the flows that matter most, and lead code and design reviews. **What you bring** ------------------ * 6\+ years building and running production back\-end systems, including time as a senior or lead engineer. * Strong skills in Node, TypeScript and modern web frameworks. * Deep experience with relational data modeling, transactional integrity, queues and async jobs, and API design. * A track record of owning reliability for a live product: monitoring, on\-call and incident response. * Product engineering mindset: you're not a ticket\-taker, you think critically about the customer experience and can talk through tradeoffs. * Experience with sensitive data such as health or financial data, and the controls it needs. * Working knowledge of a major cloud platform (we run on AWS). * Testing as a habit, and clear written communication with distributed teams. **Nice to have** React Router, and Tailwind CSS. * **Back end:** Node.js on AWS Lambda with the Serverless Framework, MySQL on RDS through Prisma, and S3, SQS and SNS. * **API:** JSON\-RPC, validated with Zod and Actions, across dev, staging and production. * **Testing:** Jest and React Testing Library. **Why join** ------------ * Own critical systems end to end, with direct impact on patient care and company $195,000\. jobs.description: **New York, NY · Full\-time · Hybrid (in office 3 days a week) · $150,000 \- $275,000 \+ equity** **We’re deploying advanced agents into the real world to solve some of the biggest pain points in healthcare, and bringing the JOY back to healthcare by fixing the financial chaos behind it.** Every year, healthcare practices fail to collect an estimated $125 billion in earned revenue. The money disappears into fragmented financial data, manual workflows, and opaque payer systems that don’t talk to one another. Often, these costs are passed on to patients through higher bills or rising health costs, and for many practices the losses are fatal. Joyful Health builds AI agents that take on insurers so providers get paid for the care they deliver. We didn’t start with a product. We spent ten months working as fractional CFOs for a dozen practices, doing the work alongside providers before we wrote the technology that automates it. We just announced our $22M Series A, led by CRV, with world\-class investors including the founders of MongoDB and KAYAK. Now we’re doubling our engineering team. **This role is full\-time. We’re looking for someone NYC\-based who is open to coming into the office 3 days a week.** **ABOUT THE ROLE** ------------------ We’re looking for a talented and ambitious Software Engineer with 4\+ years of backend experience to build the internal engines and systems that let us scale. Every new customer adds claims, people, and operational complexity to the business behind our agents. These systems will handle hundreds of thousands of claims and automate complex operational processes, so they need to work at scale. You’ll find the bottlenecks across the company and build reliable, auditable, self\-healing systems around them. You’ll partner with eng, ops, RCM and finance teams to find the work that eats the most hours, then design a system that replaces it. You’ll ship in small steps, measure the impact, and move to the next bottleneck. As a software engineer, you’ll have an outsized impact on the company’s trajectory, working on a critical problem that’s central to our success. This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to work on something extremely challenging and make a huge difference. You should be comfortable (and excited!) about working in a fast\-paced, early\-stage startup environment where you'll be able to wear many hats and take on new challenges as they arise. **WHAT YOU’LL DO** ------------------ Here are some examples of what you’ll build: * **Automatic claim routing.** An allocation engine that assigns work dynamically as volume, priorities, and capacity change. * **Claims forecasting engine.** Models that predict incoming volume and workload, so we plan ahead of demand. * **Staffing rebalancing.** Systems that match specialist and BPO capacity to demand across accounts. * **Customized invoicing systems.** Billing that adapts to each customer’s terms and reconciles automatically. * **Quality and monitoring systems.** Checks that catch process failures before they reach a customer. * **Access and credential automation.** Secure, auditable provisioning for the portals and systems our team works in. * **Internal metrics.** Reporting that updates itself and ties back to source data. * **Privacy and Security.** Because this work touches sensitive data, you’ll design for security and HIPAA compliance from the start. **WE’D LOVE TO HEAR FROM YOU IF…** ---------------------------------- * **You’re passionate about Joyful Health’s mission.** You want to solve real, pressing problems for providers and put them in control of their businesses. You naturally empathize with users and enjoy building with their needs in mind. * **You have 4\+ years of experience in backend engineering,** with a focus on building data pipelines, integrations, and the infrastructure that supports them. * **You have strong technical execution.** You view coding as a craft, not just a task, and you care about building a product that works at scale, with the user at the forefront. You bring: + Proficiency in Python and database systems, with familiarity in performance and optimization for scale + Experience in distributed systems coordination and AI pipelines + Familiarity with big data technologies and comfort working with massive datasets + Experience with CI/CD workflows such as GitHub Actions + Experience building reliable, observable production systems * **You have a radical sense of ownership.** You have the ability and desire to own technical roadmaps and refine ambiguous problems. * **You have a low ego and a growth mindset,** and you’re excited to shape our engineering team and culture as an early team member, leading by example and growing your impact as the product and team scale. * We care more about your drive, hustle, and passion than a college degree from a shiny institution or experience at name\-brand companies. **Bonus points** * You have experience working with healthcare data or solving interoperability challenges. * You’ve built internal platforms or developer tooling used by other engineers. * You’ve been a founder or an early engineer at a startup. **WORKING AT JOYFUL** --------------------- **Meaningful impact.** You’ll work on one of the most hair\-on\-fire problems providers face, so they can focus on caring for patients. **Autonomy and ownership.** As an early team member, you’ll shape the company from the ground up. **Growth and learning.** You’ll get direct access to experienced founders and advisors, plus stipends for professional development courses and books. **Competitive compensation and equity.** $150K \- $275K base, plus strong equity in Joyful Health. **Be your best self.** Comprehensive healthcare benefits, unlimited PTO (with a minimum of 10 days off a year), flexibility, and regular team off\-sites and events. Please apply even if you don’t meet 100% of the criteria. Nobody checks every box every time, and we’d love to talk with you about how you see yourself growing into this role. We’re also very open to candidates with non\-traditional experience. Joyful Health is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Ataraxis AI** ===================== Ataraxis is a clinical AI research lab working at the intersection of multi\-modal AI and precision medicine. Our goal is to make disease predictable. To accomplish this, we develop new AI methods that predict patient outcomes and treatment response, and build clinical tools to assist physicians in selecting the most optimal treatments for their patients. Our AI research lab discovers and develops methods to recognize patterns and predict outcomes across complex, multi\-modal clinical data. This spans our causality (Ataraxis Tau), foundation model (Falcon and Kestrel for digital pathology), and survival analysis research. Our first clinical products, such as Ataraxis Breast for breast cancer, already help patients get the most appropriate treatment across the best academic institutions and community clinics worldwide. At Ataraxis, you will have a unique opportunity to shape not only the future of our company, but also the future of healthcare. You will join an exceptional team at the forefront of clinical AI research and deployment. Our advisors include AI pioneers such as our founding advisor, Yann LeCun, and distinguished oncologists from top cancer research institutions, all united by the mission to redefine precision medicine. Ataraxis has raised over $24 million in funding, including a $20 million Series A led by top venture capital funds such as Thiel Capital/Founders Fund (OpenAI, SpaceX, Palantir), Obvious Ventures (AMI Labs, Inceptive, Radical Numerics, Recursion), and AIX Ventures (Hugging Face, Perplexity). We are an company with a flat organizational structure, where every team member is empowered to actively contribute. Leadership roles are earned by those who demonstrate initiative and consistently deliver exceptional results. Strong work ethic and the ability to prioritize ruthlessly are essential. **Responsibilities** ==================== This is a high\-ownership generalist role. You'll work across 3 services spanning TypeScript/React, Python backends, and ML/CV inference, all running on Google Cloud and Modal. Comfort moving between product code and ML infrastructure is essential. * **Physician web portal:** Next.js / React app where clinicians place orders, view slides, and read reports. * **Order service:** the system of record such as orders, patients, clinical data, insurance billing claims, report (PDF) generation, and a web of third\-party integrations. * **Slide tiles service:** generates and serves DeepZoom pyramids from gigapixel pathology slides. **Who You Are** =============== * **Product\-obsessed builder:** You're never satisfied with "good enough"—you relentlessly spot opportunities to improve the product and move fast to ship them, knowing that done and iterating beats perfect and waiting. * **AI\-native**: You're comfortable using latest AI tools (e.g., Cursor/Windsurf) to quickly build, refine, and document your code. * **Sense of style**: You appreciate polished, professional UIs, enjoy collaborating closely with designers, and understand that great UX is integral to great products. * **Creative thinker**: You thrive in environments requiring innovation and aren't limited by past experience. * **Self\-directed leader:** You take ownership, set your own agenda, and move with urgency. You don't need a roadmap handed to you. You identify what matters and rally others around it. * **Effective collaborator:** You keep teammates informed, surface blockers early, and turn around feedback rapidly, making it easy for those around you to do their best work. * **Strong external communicator:** You can represent the product and company confidently to customers, partners, and the outside world—translating technical work into clear, compelling narratives. **Qualifications** ================== * Frontend + Strong TypeScript and React (we run React 19 /Next.js 15, App Router) + Tailwind CSS, component\-driven UI, and modern testing with Jest\+ React Testing Library and Playwright for E2E + Bonus: data viz (Recharts), rich\-text (Tiptap), or medical image viewers (OpenSeaDragon) * Backend + Strong Python, with production experience in Flask (or similar) and SQLAlchemy/PostgreSQL + Database schema migrations (Alembic / Flask\-Migrate) + Designing and consuming REST APIs; integrating third\-party services + Async/background job processing (Google Cloud Tasks) * Cloud \& DevOps + Hands\-on Google Cloud Platform: Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage (GCS), Cloud Run, Cloud Tasks + Docker and CI/CD with GitHub Actions; tag\-based semantic\-versioned releases + Comfort with Vercel (portal) and serverless GPU deploys (Modal) * Testing \& quality + A genuine testing discipline—pytest, Jest, and Playwright are first\-class here, and our work feeds a regulated requirements\-traceability process Compensation Range: $100K \- $180K

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Voice Evaluation [NYC or SF]
jobs.description: **About Concurrence** ===================== Concurrence (formerly Amigo) is building the platform healthcare organizations use to build their own clinical AI agents. Our mission is to make excellent care accessible to every patient, not rationed by the limits of clinician time. Underneath our platform is the Health World Model, which unifies a health system’s data into a living, event\-level record of every patient’s care. On top of it, agents handle work across the patient journey, from intake and scheduling to medication management and clinical decision support. Our agents have supported more than 10 million patient encounters and are on track to grow tenfold this year. We run natively on Databricks, integrate with every major EHR, and are backed by Madrona, General Catalyst, and Optum Ventures. We’re about 35 people, working in person in New York and San Francisco. **About this role** =================== As a Software Engineer, Voice Evaluation at Concurrence, you'll build the system that determines whether a voice agent is ready for patients. You'll own realistic audio tests, scoring and the release gate, with authority to block releases that fail it. The tests need to catch failures that a clean transcript can miss, from mishandled interruptions to missed clinical information or a failure to hand off to a person. **What you'll do** ================== * Build simulated callers and call\-replay tests that exercise the production voice path with real audio * Test phone trees, hold queues, interruptions, conflicting clinical information and appropriate escalation * Build scoring systems and calibrate automated judges against human assessments * Measure clinical failure rates and uncertainty, and test whether simulation results predict behavior on real calls * Define release criteria with model, runtime, product and clinical colleagues, own the gate and block changes that fail those criteria * Turn production failures into regression tests, verify fixes and monitor behavior after release * Maintain held\-out evaluation sets so models are tested on examples they did not train against **What we're looking for** ========================== * You've personally built and owned evaluation or simulation for production agents at scale. Voice and audio experience is a strong preference * You've built agent simulations or replay systems, implemented scoring and caught a concrete failure before release * Your evaluation results determined what shipped, and you led that work * You can explain what a score captures, what it misses and how you checked it against real behavior * You write reliable software that runs at volume and follow failures through to a verified fix * You use coding agents in your work and independently verify their output * You're low ego, direct, and can hold the line on release criteria with evidence * You can work on site in New York City or San Francisco **Nice to have** ================ * Experience calibrating automated judges against human labels * Load testing and concurrent calls using audio * Speech or audio machine learning * Experience in healthcare or another regulated environment **Benefits (available to Full\-Time Employees)** ================================================ **Health \& Wellness** ---------------------- * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance * Daily catered lunch and dinner * Mental health support and wellness coaching * Flexible wellness stipend for fitness, therapy, or personal growth **Growth \& Development** ------------------------- * Annual learning budget for courses, books, or conferences * Conference attendance budget for professional development * Annual team offsite * Academic collaboration opportunities * Unlimited PTO **Our Core Values** =================== * **Patients Win, We Win** If patients aren't getting better care, we haven't earned the right to scale. Every internal decision gets pressure\-tested: does this make patients' lives better? If we can't draw the line, we question why we're doing it. * **High Standards, High Care** We hold a high bar for the team because patients are counting on us to get this right. But high standards only work with genuine investment in each other. You can take risks, admit mistakes, and challenge ideas. Not despite our standards, but because of them. * **Thoughtful Urgency** We move fast by default, but speed without judgment is recklessness. The discipline is knowing which decisions are reversible vs. not. In healthcare AI, the companies that win will be fast everywhere they can be and careful everywhere they must be. We build the muscle to do both. * **Intensely Measured** We instrument patient outcomes, provider ROI, system performance, and clinical accuracy. But data without action is surveillance. Every metric should have an owner, a threshold, and a response plan. If we're measuring something but never acting on it, we stop measuring it. **Who Builds With Us** ====================== * **Low ego:** Politics and territory don't interest you. The best ideas win, regardless of who has them. * **Direct:** You say the hard thing, challenge ideas openly, and commit fully once decided. * **High agency:** You thrive on trust rather than instruction. When you see something is broken, you fix it. You don’t file tickets and wait for someone else. * **Bar of excellence:** You hold yourself to a bar most people wouldn't, and you want teammates who do the same. * **Skeptical:** You push back on rules that don’t make sense and question assumptions that haven’t earned their place. Compensation Range: $220K \- $300K

jobs.description: Farmer’s Fridge makes fruits and vegetables accessible and approachable for everyone. We offer a variety of fresh, healthy, ready\-to\-eat meals and snacks through our fresh food vending machines, wholesale partners, and our office pantry solution — providing chef\-curated meals to customers within seconds. Today, we operate a network of Fridges and partner with clients nationwide in high\-foot\-traffic areas, such as airports, hospitals, universities, and large office buildings — where there is limited accessibility to fresh, healthy, grab\-n\-go options. We care deeply about what we’re creating and aspire to make sure our customers feel that through every touchpoint. This shows up in many ways across the business. We are committed to prioritizing food safety, we are passionate about product quality, we value our employees, we champion the best idea no matter where it comes from, and we’re committed to making an overall positive impact as we scale. **About this Role:** As a **Senior Front End Engineer (SE III)**, you’ll raise the team’s ability to deliver high\-quality software by contributing to development, improving our practices, and mentoring others. Our engineers take pride in crafting great software, but even more pride in product ownership: taking ideas from concept to release and beyond. You’d be joining the front end team that builds the applications that power the business, including the driver restocking app, the touchscreen interface on our Smart Fridges, the Farmer’s Fridge mobile app for reserving orders, and internal tools. Our near\-term focus is the tools that support our Supply Chain and Operations teams, so you’ll work closely with those teams here in Chicago. You’ll also help shape how we use AI day to day. We’re actively building our standards for LLM\-assisted development, and we expect our engineers to be fluent with these tools. **In a typical week, the Senior Front End Engineer will...** * Own projects end\-to\-end, from technical design through implementation, testing and deployment * Work directly with Supply Chain, Operations and other business stakeholders to understand pain points and build solutions that fix the root of the issue * Partner with Product to stay aligned on business goals * Build POCs quickly to prove out ideas and resolve uncertainty * Lead technical design for the projects you own and contribute to architecture discussions across the team * Work across greenfield and legacy systems, modernizing where it makes sense and raising the testing floor on the systems you touch * Perform timely PR reviews and mentor other engineers * Explore what’s newly possible with AI tooling and contribute to our standards for using it * Improve our engineering practices to accelerate the pace of delivery * Have creative liberty to operate and push the boundary * Help out the menu development team by tasting new recipes **In a Senior Front End Engineer, we're looking for someone who…** * Has 7\+ years of software engineering experience and a clear understanding of software best practices * Has strong experience with Flutter, React, or a similar framework * Has native app experience (a plus) * Is comfortable working in the back end when needed (full stack and AWS experience a plus) * Has side projects they’re passionate about (a plus) * Takes a deliberate, thoughtful approach to LLM\-assisted development and stays current as the tooling changes * Solves difficult problems, takes full ownership, and adapts to changing requirements * Is comfortable in both legacy codebases and greenfield projects, with a passion for raising standards * Makes the engineers around them better through mentorship and code review * Communicates technical challenges and solutions clearly, with a focus on outcomes * Is comfortable digging into data to inform decisions, flag issues, and measure whether what we built worked * Brings curiosity, attention to detail, a sense of urgency, and a desire to keep learning * Wants to build technology that directly impacts the company’s path to profitability and sets us up for long\-term success * Is based in the Chicago area and able to work from our office 3 days a week * Has a passion for making healthy food accessible to all The base salary range for this role is **$145,000 \- $155,000**. The base pay offered will be determined by factors such as experience, skills, training, certifications, education, and any applicable minimum wage requirements. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for company performance\-based bonuses and equity. We provide a **comprehensive benefits package**, including: * **Medical, dental, and vision insurance** (multiple plans available) * **401(k)** with immediate **employer match vesting** * **Paid time off (including vacation, sick leave, and holidays)** * **Paid sabbatical after 5 years of service** * **Employee discounts** * **Employee Assistance Program (EAP)** **Benefits at Farmer's Fridge:** ***In This Together \-*** We stay connected, whether in person or virtually. We encourage business transparency through monthly town hall meetings and weekly financial updates. We set out to make the best product on the market, and we believe we’ve done it. We value your input in the new menu creation process. From regular tasting panels, where employees provide new menu feedback. ***Happier Workdays \-*** Each day at work should fill you with joy. We're a fun and passionate group, and we don't take ourselves too seriously. Bring your unique self to work, dress comfortably, and always feel free to share your thoughts and opinions. We encourage curiosity; there's no hierarchy here when we're all swapping ideas. ***Never run on empty \-*** Daily Farmer's Fridge meal and office snacks are just some of the offerings to make sure you aren't distracted by a growling stomach. Recharge with our paid sabbatical program after five years of service. ***Innovate \& Elevate \-*** We're all teachers and learners. You'll grow and help grow the company through cross\-functional collaboration, open access to leadership, and regular business updates. You have a direct impact on the company’s bottom line. You can also impact your bottom line by participating in our 401(k) plan that includes a company match with immediate vesting. **Farmer’s Fridge Diversity Statement:** ***"Don’t meet every single requirement? At Farmer’s Fridge, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.”*** Farmer’s Fridge is an equal\-opportunity employer. jobs.title: Staff Agentic AI Engineer
jobs.description: **YOUR ROLE** We are seeking a Staff Agentic AI Engineer to lead our agentic AI engineering team: setting technical direction, driving delivery, and turning fast\-moving model and orchestration capabilities into secure, reusable, observable production systems. You will be the team's technical lead. You will own the architecture of our agent platform, define how the team builds and operates agents, and make sure the work ships reliably within enterprise controls. You will stay hands\-on in the most critical architectural and engineering work while guiding Senior engineers, shaping the roadmap with engineering and product leadership, and partnering with data, security, and operations to deliver measurable business outcomes. **WHAT YOU'LL** **DO** * **Team technical leadership:** Act as the technical lead for the agentic AI engineering team. Set the technical roadmap with engineering and product leadership, break large initiatives into well\-scoped work, assign clear ownership, and hold the team accountable for quality and delivery. * **Architecture and platform strategy:** Define the target architecture, technical principles, and evolution plan for the agent platform. Make clear build\-versus\-integrate decisions and guide migration from prototypes to supported services. * **Multi\-agent systems:** Design orchestration patterns for single\- and multi\-agent workflows, including delegation, planning, state, handoffs, tool use, human review, retries, and bounded autonomy.
