jobs.description: ***Every day, we work together for what matters – bold, swift, and equitable climate action.*** **ABOUT THE ROLE** At 3Degrees, a Certified B Corporation driving climate action, our proprietary, mission\-critical platform is the system of record for our transaction data and the core of our business. It brings teams across the company together around a single source of truth and powers high\-stakes, high\-value workflows where accuracy, auditability, and speed all matter. We are now reimagining that platform from the ground up, with AI at its core. Think intelligent document understanding that turns inbound emails and contracts into structured records, rules engines that validate every detail and explain their reasoning, agentic assistants that plan work in plain language or by voice, and open integrations that let the AI tools we choose work directly with our data. Through it all, one principle holds: the AI drafts, and a person approves. An early prototype has already shipped hundreds of improvements in a single month, and now we are building the team that will take it to production and beyond. How we build matters as much as what we build. Across 3Degrees, our engineering teams put AI agents to work throughout the development lifecycle: drafting code and tests, preparing pull requests for review, and even writing the release notes that tell users what is new, often several times a week. Engineers stay firmly in the loop as architects, reviewers, and decision\-makers, and they are always looking for the next way to work smarter. You will join a growing community of product engineers across the company who share ideas openly and raise the bar for one another. As Senior Engineer, Full Stack \& AI, you will be a core builder on a small, senior team, reporting to the Senior Director of Engineering and working closely with our Lead Engineer and the business teams who use the platform every day. You will own meaningful \& complex enough slices of the system end to end, from data models and services to polished user interfaces and AI\-powered features, and ship them at a pace that only an AI\-first workflow makes possible. This role is for builders who love modern tools, feel a genuine thrill with each new leap in AI, move fast with discipline, and want their work to matter. For this role, we prefer candidates to join us in a voluntary, flexible hybrid work style in our San Francisco Bay Area office. We may also consider candidates who are able to join us at one of our office hubs in New York, NY, or Portland, ME.* *For exceptional remote candidates, we strongly prefer those located in states where we are currently eligible to hire: CA, OR, NY, WA, ME, TX, CO, MI, FL, MA, MN, VA, DC, GA, UT, and IL. Hiring in a new state would involve evaluating the implications of establishing a new hiring presence there. 3Degrees does not provide relocation assistance or work authorization sponsorship for this position; pre\-existing right\-to\-work status in the U.S. is required.* **WHAT YOU’LL DO** As Senior Engineer, you will design, build, and ship major parts of our next\-generation internal platform, using AI throughout your own workflow and building AI into the product itself. Your responsibilities will include: Full\-Stack Platform Engineering * Design, build, and operate features end to end, including data models, APIs, services, integrations, and user interfaces * Own vertical slices of the platform, from a business user’s first request through production, and ship them on a fast, steady cadence * Build clean, intuitive interfaces for complex workflows, with strong product judgment even when a designer is not available, including one\-click exports that ease the move from spreadsheets * Integrate with partner systems, such as ERP/CRM systems, accounting, identity, and external data providers, through secure, well\-tested interfaces AI Product Engineering * Build AI features that read inbound documents and emails, extract structured data, and draft records and outbound communications for human review * Contribute to the platform’s intelligent assistant, including natural language and voice interactions, retrieval over the system of record, and connections to AI tools through open standards such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP) * Implement evaluations, guardrails, and observability so AI features stay accurate, explainable, and safe, with a person always approving the final action Rules, Controls \& Data Quality * Encode complex busi r, proactive communicator who builds trust with engineers and business users alike, and enjoys learning a new domain * Genuine curiosity about AI: you keep up with new releases of tools like Claude, try them early, and get excited about what they make possible * A learning mindset: you seek out feedback, give it generously in code review, and love picking up new tools and techniques * Comfortable moving fast inside an established company, adapting as requirements evolve, while keeping standards for quality high * Curiosity about climate, energy, or environmental markets, and a desire for your work to support real climate impact Education * Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience **HOW WE DEFINE SUCCESS** This role is about taking meaningful parts of our next\-generation platform from idea to production at AI\-first speed, while meeting the standards for accuracy, control, and reliability that our business teams depend on. Within 30 days * Build a working understanding of the business workflows the platform supports, the current prototype, and the codebase * Establish strong partnerships with the Lead Engineer, the engineering team, and the business users you build for * Ship your first end\-to\-end feature or improvement to production Within 90 days * Own the design and delivery of one or more significant features that business users rely on. * Deliver at least one AI\-powered capability with clear evaluations, guardrails, and human approval built in * Demonstrate measurable impact, such as time saved, errors avoided, or adoption, through telemetry and user feedback * Contribute to the migration and parallel\-run plan for moving workflows from the legacy platform * Contribute at least one improvement to how the team builds or ships, such as a new agent, workflow, or tool Within 6 months * Help bring the platform into production for a first set of workflows, with results that match or exceed existing tools * Own a major area of the production platform, including its quality, monitoring, and ongoing improvement * Respond quickly to feedback from business users after launch, shipping fixes and improvements within days Within 1 year * Help expand the platform to additional workflows and teams as the legacy system is retired. * Consistently ship high\-quality improvements at a pace that sets the bar for modern, AI\-first engineering at 3Degrees * Be a go\-to engineer for a major area of the platform, trusted by both the engineering team and business users * Be an active voice in the broader product engineering community at 3Degrees, sharing ideas and techniques that elevate how we all work **Benefits** COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS * Compensation: The starting base salary for this position is $160,000\.00 \- $180,000\.00 in the US. jobs.description: Actionstep is a pioneer in cloud\-based Legal Practice Management software (SaaS). Headquartered in Denver, with a growing global team across the UK, US, Australia and New Zealand, we empower thousands of law firms worldwide to run more profitable and efficient practices. We are fast\-growing, innovative, and deeply focused on the success of our partners and customers. Partners are our growth engine: they source about half of our pipeline and implement 95%\+ of new ARR. The Director, Partner Lifecycle Automation \& Tools leads the agentification of Actionstep’s partner engine. You will drive adoption across Actionstep teams and our partners, and prove the value in hours removed, time to go\-live, failure to launch avoided and EBITDA delivered. **Who You Are** * **A process redesigner first:** you start from the outcome and redesign the workflow, rather than automating today’s steps. * **Hands\-on with AI:** you have built and shipped LLM\-based agents, skills or automations yourself, and know where they fail. * **Value\-obsessed:** you set baselines before you build and report impact in dollars and hours. * **A translator:** equally credible with partner consultants, PMs, engineers and the CFO. * **A change leader:** you know adoption is the hard part, and you design for it. * **Pragmatic about risk:** you design human\-in\-the\-loop controls, data privacy and accuracy checks in from day one. **What you will do** **Strategy and roadmap** * Own the Partners \& Services automation roadmap across the partner lifecycle and the six plays, sequenced in waves by value and data readiness (Wave 1 from November: Project Health, Decision Tracker, Deal Readiness pilot). * Maintain the agent portfolio with the COE KPI fields for each initiative: impact type, annual run rate, FY impact, go\-live date and first\-dollar date. * Prioritise with David, the AI CoE and business owners; retire initiatives that don’t prove value. **Process redesign and delivery** * For each play, redesign the process with the business owner, defining what the agent does and what people decide. * Act as product owner for each agent: requirements, acceptance criteria, testing with real projects, release and iteration. * Build light agents, Claude skills and automations directly; feed this capability into the AI CoE (Nick), which keeps the shared platform and heavier agent builds, and work with Product, which owns API/MCP. * Unblock high\-value enablers, e.g. handing LA data loads to certified partners (de\-encryption release, tools and training: \~3 FTE, $250k\+ per year). **Data and tool foundations** * Join up the partner data chain (Salesforce, Asana, PlanHat, Zendesk, Academy) so projects carry ARR, readiness score, partner and status end to end. * Own the partner\-facing tool stack: Academy and certification tracking, partner scorecards, the Enablement Assistant and the partner portal experience. * Set standards for data quality, access, privacy and human review of agent outputs. **Adoption and value** * Drive adoption across Actionstep teams and partners: training, playbooks, champions and usage tracking. * Report agent impact monthly to David and the AI CoE, and feed the Phase 1 and Phase 2 scorecards. * Build a small, high\-performing team of 3 FTEs (data migration, configuration, automation) and an AI\-first way of working across Partners \& Services. **Requirements** **What you Bring** * 8\+ years across business process automation, professional services operations, revenue/partner operations or product management in B2B SaaS, with 3\+ years leading a team. * Proven delivery of AI agents or LLM\-based automation into production business workflows, with measured outcomes. * Strong process design and change management skills (e.g. Lean, Six Sigma or service design). * Working knowledge of Salesforce, Asana, PlanHat, Zendesk or similar, and of APIs and integration tools. * Ability to build business cases and track benefits with Finance. * Clear, confident communicator with executives, engineers and partners. **Advantages (strongly preferred)** * Hands\-on experience with Claude, agent frameworks, MCP or similar tooling. * Experience in partner or channel ecosystems, implementation services, or LegalTech. * Experience with data migration or system configuration tooling. **Benefits** We have a fantastic and inspirational working environment! * Robust medical, dental, vision offerings * 401K with company match * Flexible working and PTO * Take your birthday off * Frequent team building events * Fantastic training and development opportunities * 170\-185k Salary

jobs.description: **About the Job** ----------------- At Allia Health, the umbrella organization for Southend Pharmacy, Brello Health, and Woven, we don’t just follow industry trends—we redefine them. Our mission is to commoditize anti\-aging solutions, making them affordable and accessible to the average consumer—not just the wealthy. This role focuses on building, maintaining, and improving data pipelines and data models that enable analytics, reporting, and AI initiatives. Working closely with Senior Data Engineers, AI, and Product teams, the Data Engineer will help ensure data is reliable, well\-structured, and accessible across the organization. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Assist in designing, building, and maintaining ETL/ELT data pipelines * Support data ingestion from internal and external data sources * Help maintain and improve data warehouse structures and data models * Ensure data quality through validation, testing, and monitoring processes * Support analytics and BI use cases by preparing clean, well\-documented datasets * Collaborate with senior engineers and stakeholders to understand data requirements * Contribute to documentation and continuous improvement of the data platform * Follow software engineering best practices including version control, testing, and CI/CD **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Ideal Degree(s): BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Data Science, or a related field * 4\+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a related role (or equivalent hands\-on experience) * Strong SQL skills * Experience with at least one programming language (Python preferred) * Basic understanding of ETL/ELT processes and data modeling concepts * Familiarity with cloud data platforms (Google BigQuery preferred; AWS/Azure acceptable) * Ability to work collaboratively in cross\-functional teams * Strong attention to detail and interest in data quality **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Exposure to data orchestration or transformation tools (e.g., dbt, Airflow) * Experience with BI or analytics tools (Looker preferred) * Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform and modern data stacks * Interest in analytics, AI, or machine learning use cases **Equal Opportunity Employer Statement** ---------------------------------------- Allia Health Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.description: **Ally and Your Career** Ally Financial only succeeds when its people do \- and that’s more than some cliché people put on job postings. We love this stuff! We see our people as, well, people \- with interests, families, friends, dreams, and causes that are all important to them. Our focus is on the health and safety of our teammates as well as work\-life balance and diversity and inclusion. From generous benefits to a variety of employee resource groups, we strive to build paths that encourage employees to stretch themselves professionally. We want to help you grow, develop, and learn new things. You’re constantly evolving, so shouldn’t your opportunities be, too? **Work Schedule** **:** Ally designates roles as (1\) fully on\-site, (2\) hybrid, or (3\) fully remote. Hybrid roles are generally expected to be in the office a certain number of days per week as indicated by your manager. Your hiring manager will discuss this role's specific work requirements with you during the hiring process. All work requirements are subject to change at any time based on leader discretion and/or business need. **The Opportunity** As a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) within Ally's Production Engineering/Operations organization, you will be responsible for maintaining the health of our applications in production. This includes designing technology approaches that modernize our application stack and enabling our Agile teams to deliver with quality and speed. The ideal candidate is passionate about technology, especially the benefits and opportunities that cloud infrastructure brings to an enterprise. In this role, you will provide in\-depth technical expertise on decisions related to running complex software systems at scale. You will partner with our Enterprise Architecture and Infrastructure teams to enable flexible application patterns driven by business use cases. Most importantly, you will be an integral part of Ally's technology strategy, partnering closely with our Application Product teams to translate business requirements into scalable, flexible, and secure cloud solutions. **The Work Itself** **The Work Itself:** * Provide technical guidance across development, delivery, production support, and application modernization. * Partner with product operational support. * Establish and manage SLIs/SLOs, observability, monitoring, and service health to improve application reliability. * Strengthen resiliency, fault tolerance, disaster recovery, and release readiness, including resiliency and chaos testing. * Support incident response and post\-mortems, translating findings into engineering improvements that reduce recurring issues and recovery time. * Conduct capacity planning and resource optimization to support performance and growth. * Communicate technical recommendations to senior leadership and cross\-functional stakeholders. **The Qualifications We’re Looking For** ---------------------------------------- * 3\+ years of software development experience * Experience with monitoring, alerting, performance analysis, and reliability, including SLI/SLO/SLA development. * Strong knowledge of Linux, networking, distributed systems, microservices, and cybersecurity best practices. * Hands\-on development experience with Java/J2EE, JavaScript, Spring/Spring Boot, React, REST APIs, Python, Shell scripting, PL/SQL, Oracle, and Windows/Linux. * AWS/cloud experience or certification, including services such as Fargate, Lambda, Aurora, DynamoDB, ALB/NLB, and Auto Scaling. * DevOps and automation experience with Terraform, Jenkins, GitLab, CI/CD pipelines, and Ansible. * Experience with observability tools such as Dynatrace, CloudWatch, Prometheus, and Grafana. * Experience working across Agile, Scrum, Kanban, and Waterfall environments. **Minimum Qualifications** * 3\+ years of relevant experience * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Math, Engineering, or related field of study or equivalent **How We'll Have Your Back** Ally's compensation program offers market\-competitive base pay and pay\-for\-performance incentives (bonuses) based on achieving personal and company goals. generation (RAG), agentic workflows, machine learning, computer vision, and recommendation technologies. * Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and business stakeholders to identify jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Trainium Systems
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Have you ever wondered what it takes to build the software systems that turn a rack of AI accelerators from inert silicon into a system a customer can run workloads on? Do you want deep ownership of a service that every one of those systems depends on to boot, run, and stay healthy? \*\*Who are we?\*\* Annapurna Labs is the part of Amazon that designs the custom silicon behind the cloud, including Trainium for AI training, Graviton CPUs, and the AWS Nitro system. Nearly every server in AWS runs hardware we designed. We're a new team inside Annapurna Trainium Systems taking Trainium beyond AWS, so customers can run it in their own data centers. \*\*What do we do?\*\* We build the software that runs on Trainium servers in customers' own data centers. We also build the software customers use to install, provision, operate, update, and monitor those servers. We give the people who run this hardware a complete way to stand it up, watch its health, deliver new software to it, and diagnose it, all through open, standard interfaces. We own that software from design through the running system. \*\*Why it's high\-impact?\*\* The hardware is just silicon until our software makes it provisionable, observable, and serviceable. Every system runs through what we build. The service you own is on the path for all of them, and the people who run this hardware depend on it every day. \*\*What's the challenge?\*\* There are many ambiguous and difficult challenges in our fast\-moving space. Our services require deep system and software expertise. You need to have the ability to work within a fast moving and startup\-like environment in a large company. You will identify solutions, trying ideas, given space to fail and iterate to produce products that your customers love. \*\*What you will do?\*\* You own a large component of the software that manages servers, racks, and clusters from outside. That might be a provisioning plugin, a telemetry exporter, or the service that delivers software updates. It might also be a test suite every release passes, or the tool that walks a customer through a repair. Some of it works against the server's interfaces, and some of it never touches hardware. You design it with direction from your lead and run it in production. \*\*Who would succeed in this role?\*\* An engineer who builds and operates a service in production and takes a large component from design to running code with some direction. You read logs and reason across process and system boundaries, you ship in small verifiable steps, and you start to mentor the engineers around you. Key job responsibilities * Own the design and implementation of a large component or service in the management plane, in provisioning, monitoring, telemetry, software delivery, or diagnostics. * Make the application\-level trade\-offs on your component, and seek direction on the calls that reach beyond it. * Automate and simplify the team's development, test, and operations work, and mentor peers as you grow. * work backward from customer requirements and deliver solutions that are simple. A day in the life You design and build the provisioning and management surface over standard interfaces like Redfish, and the boot flow operator tools drive. You build the offline software\-update service and prove the signed bundle applies and recovers cleanly. You design each system against the interfaces the platform exposes and turn architecture decisions into APIs and tools a customer runs without you in the loop. About the team Our team builds the software suite for provisioning, monitoring, software delivery, and the diagnostics of Trainium systems, and we build all of it on open, standard interfaces. jobs.title: Chief Engineer, Intelligence Systems
jobs.description: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years. ### **ABOUT THE TEAM** Anduril is seeking a Chief Engineer to lead the design, development, and technical integration for a product line of critical network capabilities. This role is not just about leading; it's about re\-envisioning the technical future of secure, resilient, and high\-bandwidth communication for all of Anduril and the DoW's autonomous platforms and integrated defense solutions. A successful candidate will not only have a strong technical background, but must also possess a vision for leadership that embraces Anduril's mission to disrupt the defense technology ecosystem across technical and programmatic domains. As Chief Engineer, you will be responsible for the end\-to\-end technical success and architectural coherence of complex, multi\-disciplinary network systems. You will operate at the intersection of complex engineering challenges in embedded systems, networking protocols, mechanical integration, and strategic program execution. You will work directly with our most senior technical leaders, program managers, and customers to define, build, and deliver cutting\-edge networking capabilities that impact national security. #### **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * **Technical Vision \& Architecture:** Own and define the comprehensive technical architecture, design principles, and engineering roadmap for complex, distributed network systems. Ensure technical consistency, scalability, performance, and cyber\-resilience across all technical domains (embedded software, UI/UX design, network protocols, hardware integration, ruggedized mechanical designs). * **System Integrity \& Risk Management:** Serve as a technical arbiter, ensuring the integrity, reliability, security, and survivability of our network systems in contested and high security environments. Proactively identify and mitigate technical risks related to performance, security, and physical robustness. * **Engineering Leadership \& Mentorship:** Provide decisive technical leadership and guidance to large, multi\-disciplinary engineering teams (Mechanical, Electrical, Software, System, Test, Manufacturing) to deliver high quality products that can be manufactured at scale. Foster a culture of technical excellence, rigorous design, rapid iteration, and continuous improvement, ensuring seamless collaboration across disciplines. * **Strategic Technical Guidance:** Translate strategic objectives and customer needs into actionable technical requirements and solutions. Drive trade studies, technology selections, and critical design decisions related to network topology, protocol selection, embedded hardware integration, power management, thermal management, and software\-defined networking. * **Stakeholder Engagement:** Act as the primary technical interface with internal stakeholders (Product, Program Management, Executive Leadership) and external stakeholders (customers, partners, regulatory bodies), clearly articulating complex technical concepts, challenges, and solutions for network capabilities. * **Rapid Prototyping, Fielding, and Scaled Production:** Drive aggressive timelines for design, development, integration, and testing of network systems, supporting rapid prototyping, fielding, and scaled production of operational capabilities for defense applications. #### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** * 10\+ years of progressive experience in leading system design and development from initial concept through test and delivery to customers. * Experience with data analysis, rapid prototyping, and early\-stage customer deployment * Cross\-disciplinary systems integration experience, particularly bridging the gap between hardware and software for robust network performance in demanding environments. * Proven ability to define, architect, and lead the development of highly complex, integrated systems from concept through deployment and sustainment. * Exceptional leadership skills with a track record of building, mentoring, and inspiring high\-performing multi\-disciplinary technical teams in fast\-paced, challenging environments. * Demonstrated experience in strategic technical planning, roadmapping, and managing technical debt while delivering on aggressive schedules for networking products. * Strong problem\-solving acumen, with the ability to b ckground in cybersecurity for network infrastructure and resilience against near\-peer nation state cyber risks. * Experience with network modeling, simulation, and analysis tools for predicting performance in diverse environments. * Demonstrated ability to drive technical decisions involving significant financial and programmatic impact for network system development. * Familiarity with military communication standards and requirements (e.g., Joint All\-Domain Command and Control (JADC2\) concepts). The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top\-tier benefits for full\-time employees, including: ### **Benefits** At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.* ### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams** Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links. * **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts. ### **Data Privacy** To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant\-privacy\-notice/. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. jobs.title: Founding Exchange Engineer – Crypto / Fintech
jobs.description: **About the Opportunity** ------------------------- A $1B unicorn is building a new US\-regulated exchange from the ground up, creating an opportunity to shape the next generation of financial market infrastructure. We are looking for a Founding Exchange Engineer to join this 0\-to\-1 initiative, combining the ownership and execution speed of an early\-stage startup with the resources and backing of an established company. You'll collaborate with a world\-class team of engineers and industry leaders with backgrounds at Robinhood, Coinbase, Google, and other leading technology companies. **About the Role** ------------------ As a Founding Exchange Engineer, you will architect, build, and scale the core infrastructure powering a 24/7 regulated derivatives exchange. You will take ownership of critical systems spanning trade execution, matching engines, perpetual futures infrastructure, and clearinghouse integrations – taking the platform from initial architecture to live production. This is a highly technical, hands\-on role with significant architectural ownership and the opportunity to grow into a technical leadership position as the business scales. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * **Trade Execution \& Matching Systems:** Design, develop, and optimize low\-latency, high\-throughput trade execution engines and order\-routing infrastructure for reliable 24/7 market operations. * **Perpetual Futures Infrastructure:** Build core derivatives infrastructure, including funding rate engines, mark\-price calculations, margin systems, and liquidation pipelines. * **Clearinghouse \& Post\-Trade Integrations:** Develop mission\-critical integrations with Designated Contract Markets (DCMs), Designated Contract Organizations (DCOs), Futures Commission Merchants (FCMs), and post\-trade settlement systems. * **System Reliability \& Resilience:** Implement fault tolerance, deterministic replay, simulation testing, monitoring, and observability to meet production and regulatory requirements. * **Foundational Engineering:** Establish engineering standards, system architecture, clean interfaces, and development practices while balancing speed, scalability, and correctness. * **Production Operations:** Participate in on\-call rotations and support mission\-critical infrastructure to maintain continuous uptime and resolve production incidents. **Requirements** ---------------- * Previous experience building or scaling a regulated exchange (DCM), clearinghouse (DCO), or institutional crypto derivatives platform. * Senior\-to\-Staff\-level engineering experience (EP3\+) at a leading technology company, fintech, crypto exchange, or quantitative trading firm. * Strong hands\-on experience developing low\-latency, highly available backend systems and distributed infrastructure. * Experience with trade execution systems, matching engines, clearinghouses, or derivatives infrastructure. * Strong knowledge of concurrency, deterministic state machines, fault tolerance, and high\-throughput data pipelines. * Proficiency in at least one systems programming language, such as Rust, C\+\+, Go, or Java. * Solid understanding of perpetual futures, order book mechanics, margining, clearing, or settlement workflows. * Strong ownership mentality and ability to build foundational systems in ambiguous, fast\-paced environments. * Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate with engineering, quantitative research, product, risk, and regulatory teams. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience with FIX protocols, binary trading protocols, or ultra\-low\-latency networking. * Experience operating mission\-critical, 24/7 financial infrastructure. * Familiarity with strict audit, compliance, and regulatory requirements in financial markets. **Why Join?** ------------- * **Founding Engineer Opportunity:** Shape the architecture and infrastructure of a new exchange from day one. * **Unicorn Backing:** Build with the resources and support of an established $1B company. * **World\-Class Team:** Work alongside experienced professionals from Robinhood, Coinbase, Google, and other leading firms. * **Technical Ownership:** Make critical architectural decisions and influence the future direction of the platform. * **Career Growth:** Opportunity to develop into a technical leadership role as the exchange and engineering organization expand. Interested in building next\-generation exchange infrastructure? We'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Applied AI Architect, Beneficial Deployments (Non-Profits)
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About Beneficial Deployments** -------------------------------- Beneficial Deployments ensures AI reaches and benefits the communities that need it most. We partner with nonprofits, foundations, and mission\-driven organizations to deploy Claude in education, global health, economic mobility, and life sciences — focusing on raising the floor for those who need it most. **About the Role** ------------------ We're looking for an Applied AI Architect to join Beneficial Deployments, focused on helping nonprofits and foundations get real value from Claude. You'll be the technical lead for a portfolio of partners, working alongside our Account Executives from first conversation through deployment. You'll help partners find where Claude makes a real difference to their mission and their operations, design solutions that fit their budgets, data and teams, and turn early pilots into lasting adoption. What works for one partner becomes something the whole sector can use. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Serve as the primary technical advisor to a portfolio of nonprofit partners from discovery through deployment, turning their priorities into scoped use cases with clear measures of success. * Partner with Account Executives on account plans, discovery and technical evaluation. * Design and demo solutions with Claude, the API and Claude Code across program delivery, fundraising, operations and data analysis. * Guide partners through security review, data governance and procurement. * Run workshops and trainings that build AI fluency across partner teams. * Build reusable assets (reference designs, connectors, prompt and eval templates) so one partner's work helps the next. * Spot patterns across partners, bring field insight back to Product and Research, and help partners measure what changed. * Travel to partner sites for workshops, technical deep dives and relationship building. **You Might Be a Good Fit If You Have** --------------------------------------- * 3\+ years in customer\-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, sales engineering, forward\-deployed engineering or technical consulting. * A track record of getting lean, skeptical or slow\-moving teams to adopt technology and keep using it, including working through how they buy and govern it. * Hands\-on experience building with LLM APIs: you have built and evaluated working prototypes or agents, and can guide a partner's own engineers on architecture and evals. You don't need to write production code. * Clear written and spoken communication across a broad audience. The ability to explain technical tradeoffs to program leads, operations staff and executives. * Patience with long buying cycles, a knack for knowing how to make them go smoothly, and real care for public benefit. * A track record of agency and autonomy: you spot what needs doing before anyone asks, agree that it matters, drive it to a finished result and know when to pull others in. * Comfort operating in ambiguity: you bring clarity to fuzzy problems, wear multiple hats and do whatever it takes to further the mission. * Bonus if you've worked in a sales team, or with or at nonprofits, foundations or other mission\-driven organizations. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $240,000 \- $315,000 USD **Logistics** ------------- **Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **For roles performing work in California:** We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Datacenter Server Lifecycle
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the role** ------------------ Anthropic is investing $50 billion in American computing infrastructure, including datacenters custom\-built for our workloads, and this role sits at the heart of that effort. As a Staff Engineer on the Datacenter Server Lifecycle team, you will own the end\-to\-end operational journey of every machine in our datacenters – from initial provisioning and deployment, steady\-state operation, maintenance, and repair. This is greenfield work: you will help define the services, tooling, standards and processes that govern how we operate critical hardware at scale, powering frontier model development and serving. You will have the opportunity to define AI\-native workflows for datacenter operations and to help drive innovations on efficiency, performance, and reliability. A distinguishing aspect of this role is its deep intersection with security. The machines in our datacenter handle some of the most sensitive workloads in AI – training frontier models and serving millions of users interacting with Claude. Ensuring that every machine in the fleet is trusted, attested, and operating with a verified chain of integrity from the hardware up is a core part of the job, not an afterthought. You will partner closely with our Infrastructure Security team to define and enforce trusted compute standards across the lifecycle, from secure provisioning through end\-of\-life handling. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ * Build automation to support datacenter fleets at scale. * Define and own the end\-to\-end system lifecycle strategy – from provisioning and deployment through operation, maintenance, refresh, and decommissioning – and maintain automation and operational procedures for common lifecycle events (e.g., hardware failures, firmware upgrades, fleet rotations). * Partner closely with Infrastructure Security to design and enforce trusted compute standards across the server lifecycle. * Work closely with our Networking team to ensure end\-to\-end connectivity across all sites. * Build and maintain tooling to track machine health, configuration, and operational status across the full datacenter fleet. **Minimum qualifications** -------------------------- * Hands\-on experience with server hardware, including rack deployment, cabling, troubleshooting, and understanding failure modes at scale. * End\-to\-end understanding of hardware lifecycle management: asset tracking, provisioning workflows, maintenance scheduling, and decommissioning practices. * Proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Rust, Go, or Java). * Working knowledge of modern cloud infrastructure, including Kubernetes and large scale cloud providers (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP). * Ability to communicate clearly and build consensus with a wide range of stakeholders. * Comfort navigating ambiguity and making progress on complex, cross\-functional problems. * Willingness to travel occasionally to datacenter sites across North America. **Preferred qualifications** ---------------------------- * 8\+ years of experience in datacenter infrastructure management, or a closely related discipline. * Hands\-on experience with GPU or AI accelerator hardware (e.g., NVIDIA A100/H100, Google TPUs, or AWS Trainium) and an understanding of their operational demands. * Familiarity with modern provisioning and OS tooling such as LinuxBoot and NixOS * Experience building or contributing to datacenter automation or fleet management platforms. * Experience building and deploying server operating system distributions across large server jobs.title: Software Engineer II - Compute
jobs.description: **Who we are** Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self\-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly. The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone. At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn. **What we are looking for** Aurora hires talented people with diverse backgrounds who are ready to help build a transportation ecosystem that will make our roads safer, get crucial goods where they need to go, and make mobility more efficient and accessible for all. The journey to developing our cutting\-edge self\-driving truck Driver software requires a massive and continuous computational effort. Every day, Aurora's engineers initiate and manage millions of compute tasks, systematically processing and analyzing petabytes of critical data. This colossal computational workload spans various essential domains, including raw and derived data processing pipelines, large\-scale simulations to test and validate the software in countless scenarios, and the intensive machine learning training jobs that are the core of our autonomous system's intelligence. At the heart of orchestrating this monumental computing infrastructure is the **Compute team**. This team is dedicated to building and maintaining the foundational technology that solves the fundamental challenges of resource scheduling, task isolation, and distributed state consistency across our massive batch compute fleet. At our scale, traditional off\-the\-shelf orchestrators break. The Compute team builds the custom engine \- **BatchAPI** \- that manages the lifecycle of millions of tasks \- built on top of K8s primitives but implements our own custom scheduler. We deal with the 'unsolved' problems of distributed computing: maximizing hardware utilization while ensuring that a failure in one node doesn't cascade across the entire cluster. This engine is engineered to handle massive scale, ensuring reliability, efficiency, and rapid turnaround for our engineers. Furthermore, the Compute team empowers engineers across the company to run detailed, end\-to\-end simulation and integration tests (at scale) between “virtual vehicles” and backend services. They develop and maintain the **AV to Offboard (AV2O)** system. This framework provides a powerful, flexible interface that allows engineers to programmatically define, construct, deploy, monitor, and manage complex integration and simulation tests. The framework abstracts away the complexities of traditional “hardware\-in\-the\-loop” testing, enabling engineers to rapidly iterate on difficult integration efforts, thus accelerating the entire development cycle for the Aurora Driver. **In this role you will** * Design, implement, and maintain core components of the high\-performance, large\-scale distributed batch compute engine (BatchAPI). operational excellence for critical workflows. * Collaborate closely with infrastructure and product engineering teams (e.g., Autonomy, Data, Simulation, Machine Learning) to gather requirements, compute and data services (e.g., AWS EKS, S3, RDS). **Desirable qualifications** * Experience working with computational workloads specific to the autonomous vehicle, robotics, or large\-scale machine feedback, managing expectations, and effectively prioritizing development based on user needs. * Web UI development experience (Typescript, React) For roles based in Louisville, CO: The salary range jobs.description: **Sr. Staff, Firmware Engineer** Location: San Jose, CA (on\-site, occasional international travel) Ayar Labs, the global leader in optical I/O chiplets, is harnessing silicon photonics to revolutionize the scaling of AI compute hardware. Ayar Labs is shattering AI data bottlenecks by moving data at the speed of light. As pioneers of co\-packaged optics (CPO), we are using light instead of electricity to move data faster, further, and with a fraction of the energy needed to fuel the explosive growth of AI models. Backed by industry giants like NVIDIA, AMD and Intel and manufactured in partnership with the world’s leading semiconductor ecosystem, Ayar Labs’ co\-packaged optics solution is key to unleashing next\-generation AI scale\-up architectures. Ayar Labs builds co\-packaged optics for datacenter interconnect. Our customers deploy it in AI infrastructure at scale, where a single firmware defect can take down systems that many workloads depend on. This role owns the verification practice that keeps those defects out of the field. Every firmware release will ship with evidence of what has been tested, so customers can deploy it with confidence. This is a senior individual contributor role. You will set the technical direction for firmware verification and lead the engineers across a geographically dispersed team, including contract staff, who write tests against it. **Essential Functions** * Own the verification strategy and test plan, including what results are required before a release ships * Define and automate the release gate, with authority to block a release * Own hardware\-in\-the\-loop regression and the unit and integration test harness * Root\-cause escaped defects and close the coverage gaps they expose * Write specifications and review test code for engineers in other time zones, working mostly asynchronously **Minimum Requirements** * Embedded firmware background that includes owning the verification strategy and test infrastructure for at least one shipping product * Strong C, C\+\+ and Python * Experience building hardware\-in\-the\-loop rigs and a firmware CI and regression system * Board\-level debug with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers and datasheets * Technical leadership across teams or sites, and clear technical writing **Preferred Qualifications** * Optical module firmware and management standards; platform management and BMC firmware; silicon photonics; manufacturing test; secure boot; Zephyr, FreeRTOS or bare\-metal firmware. Photonics experience is not required. Salary Range: $197,000 to $229,000 NOTE TO RECRUITERS: Principals only. We are not accepting resumes from recruiters for this position. jobs.title: QA Automation Engineer

validating data across relational databases. * Working knowledge of containers and Kubernetes, and of a major cloud platform (GCP preferred). * A clear, collaborative communication style and comfort We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. jobs.title: Systems Administrator - I.T.
jobs.description: **PURPOSE** The Systems Administrator supports the administration, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the organization’s infrastructure and systems environment. This role handles day\-to\-day operation of core infrastructure services, including servers, virtualization platforms, networking, and remote site systems, to ensure reliability, performance, and alignment with organizational standards. The Systems Administrator also supports operational initiatives and project execution, works independently with general guidance, and collaborates closely with internal IT teams to carry out infrastructure and system changes. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES** ***The following duties are typical for this job. These are not to be construed as exclusive or all inclusive. Other duties may be required and assigned.*** * Administer and maintain on\-premises infrastructure, including servers, virtualization platforms, storage, backup, and core services. * Support networking infrastructure, including switches, firewalls, and remote connectivity. * Support infrastructure and systems at remote sites, including equipment setup, troubleshooting, and coordination with carriers and vendors, and ensure alignment with corporate standards. * Support infrastructure lifecycle activities, including system upgrades, patching, and hardware replacement, with minimal disruption and in line with established change\-management practices. * Monitor systems proactively and provide hands\-on support for infrastructure issues and escalations, including troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis. * Perform routine backup, restore, and recovery tasks, and help test disaster recovery procedures. * Manage user accounts, access, and permissions, and maintain security controls and configurations in line with established policies, assisting with vulnerability remediation. * Assist systems engineers with the planning and execution of infrastructure projects by carrying out configuration, deployment, and testing tasks and coordinating technical tasks, timelines, and dependencies. * Support systems engineers with operational and administrative tasks, such as preparing change requests, scheduling maintenance windows, and managing engineering\-related tickets and requests. * Contribute to developing, documenting, and refining service processes, standard operating procedures, and system workflows, such as change management and access provisioning. * Create and maintain accurate documentation, including system configurations, network diagrams, standards, and configuration records. * Identify opportunities for automation, efficiency, and operational improvement, using scripting and other tooling. * Assist with implementation and support of cloud and hybrid infrastructure initiatives. * Collaborate with internal IT teams to align infrastructure work with organizational priorities and standards. **MINIMUM EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE REQUIRED TO PERFORM ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS** * \[3]\+ years of experience administering on\-premises systems and networks in an enterprise environment * Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft server and directory platforms * Working knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPN) and firewalls * Experience with server virtualization and backup technologies * Experience scripting or automating administrative tasks * Experience supporting multi\-site or remote environments is a plus * Familiarity with cloud platforms is a plus **Certifications, Licenses, Registrations** * At least one relevant industry certification, or willingness to earn one within the first year **MENTAL AND PHYSICAL COMPETENCIES REQUIRED TO PERFORM ESSENTAL FUNCTIONS** * Strong customer service and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy, attention to detail and follow\-through. * Demonstrated reliability, professionalism and a consistent record of strong work performance * Genuine interest in technology and a proactive approach to learning and adopting new tools and solutions. **ENVIRONMENTAL ADAPTABILITY** * Ability to regularly lift and carry up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or more heavier equipment, with assistance. * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer * Must be able to lift 10 pounds occasionally * May have occasional visits to a job site which would require periods of standing, walking and/or climbing stairs **EQUIPMENT/TOOLS** * Server, virtualization, storage, and backup platforms * Network and security infrastructure (firewalls, switches, wireless, VPN, WAN connectivity) * Microsoft platforms and cloud services * Monitoring and automation tooling ***Baker******Group*****is an Equal Opportunity Employer. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, Baker Group will consider reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and encourage prospective employees and incumbents to discuss potential accommodations with the Employer.**

jobs.title: Technology Services Engineer
jobs.description: Are you ready to join a growing team that puts a premium on productivity and has an award\-winning culture centered around transforming talented employees into effective business leaders? Then BHG Financial is the place for you. In 2001, we started with an idea, an opportunity, and $25,000\. Back then, our focus was strictly on serving those in the medical industry. With healthcare in our heritage, we soon expanded to serve high\-earning professionals in many other industries, providing all with leading\-edge financial solutions, including our extensive network of community banks. Today, BHG Financial has firmly established its legacy as a leader in the financial services space. Founded on the philosophy of a better way to borrow, we are dedicated to helping accomplished professionals, small businesses, and institutions build upon their success through innovative financial solutions, a hassle\-free process, and personalized concierge service. Our relentless commitment to the success of our customers is part of what has made BHG Financial thrive. We take a 360\-degree view of our customers to tailor the best solutions for their financial aspirations. Today's professionals have multiple sources of income, not just their paycheck. Therefore, it is essential to factor those in when making responsible lending decisions. Our continued focus on data, analytics, and proprietary modeling has enabled faster funding for our customers. From business to personal loans to relationships with community banks, the country’s top professionals and business owners rely on us for our exceptional financial solutions and concierge service to continue their success and legacy. **Who You Are** You are a customer\-focused technical professional who supports BHG employees while expertly managing a variety of technologies. You demonstrate proficiency in ticketing systems and software solutions, handling Microsoft, Apple, and Android devices with ease. Your responsibilities extend to overseeing Azure Virtual Desktop environments, ensuring a secure and efficient virtual desktop experience. Additionally, you manage facility access systems, broadcast systems, telephony, IVR, and call center operations to maintain seamless communication and security. Your role requires a strong technical background, exceptional problem\-solving skills, and a dedication to providing top\-notch customer service. The ideal candidate excels in multitasking across diverse technologies and consistently strives to exceed customer expectations. ### **What You’ll Do** * Endpoint Management + Device Management: Manage and support Microsoft and Apple endpoint devices to ensure smooth operation and user productivity. + Security Implementation: Implement and maintain robust endpoint security measures to protect devices from threats and vulnerabilities. + Issue Resolution: Troubleshoot and resolve hardware and software issues on endpoint devices efficiently. + Onboarding and Offboarding Support: Assist with onboarding and offboarding by providing or retrieving equipment, software, and security credentials. + Service Desk Support: Analyze, diagnose, test, and resolve end\-user service desk issues to maintain high levels of user satisfaction. + Asset Management: Perform asset and inventory audits; receive new assets from vendors and add them to the configuration management database (CMDB); reassign assets among active employees, separated employees, and warehouse inventory; and coordinate equipment decommissioning and CMDB updates with an IT Asset Disposition (ITAD) provider, such as Human\-I\-T.Mobile Device Management + Device Configuration and Deployment: Configure, deploy, and manage Android and Apple mobile devices to ensure they meet company standards. + Security and Compliance: Ensure mobile device security and compliance with company policies and industry standards. + Issue Support: Provide comprehensive support for mobile device\-related issues, ensuring minimal disruption to users.Audio\-Visual Systems + Technology Support: Support audio\-visual equipment in conference rooms to ensure seamless operation. + Issue Resolution: Troubleshoot and resolve audio\-visual issues promptly to reduce downtime. + Team Collaboration: Collaborate with the audio\-visual team to ensure smooth and uninterrupted operations.Customer Service + Technical Support: Provide exceptional technical support to end users, addressing and resolving technical inquiries and issues promptly, while adhering to SLAs. + Documentation: Maintain accurate documentation of support activities and solutions for future reference. + Service Delivery: Ensure exceptional customer service by responding to inquiries and requests via telephone, the internal ticketing system, and other communication channels. + Knowledge Sharing: Contribute to developing, facilitating, and updating FAQ documents, knowledge articles, and user guides. + Incident Management: Keep users informed of incident and service request statuse tion Communication: Ability to clearly convey technical information to both internal and external customers. * Smartphone and Tablet Proficiency: A strong understanding of Android and iOS smartphones and tablets. * Process Improvement: An innovative mindset and willingness to suggest ideas for process improvement and efficiency. * After\-Hours Support Availability: Ability to participate in a rotating on\-call schedule shared among team members to support critical business systems and services. Willingness and ability to respond to incidents and support requests outside normal business hours, including occasional evening, weekend, and holiday work. * Active Directory Knowledge: Understanding of Active Directory and experience with Microsoft Outlook/Exchange environments. * Networking Concepts: Basic knowledge of networking concepts is advantageous. * Other Duties: Perform all other duties required by the supervisor. * Travel requirement: All roles require travel during the first 6 months of employment to attend the BHG Oars in Experience. After the initial 6 months, ongoing travel is expected at approximately \~5% annually for periodic team on\-sites, team meetings, and cross\-functional collaboration. **Life at BHG Financial** At BHG Financial, we work hard and aren’t afraid to take risks. Since the beginning, our core values of PMA (positive mental attitude), team player, and loyalty have been the driving force behind every interaction we have between each other and our customers. We have a healthy respect for the daily grind, yet we value work/life balance. We believe that all employees should have the opportunity to lead and that good ideas can come from anyone. From the top down, our leaders are actively involved not only in strategic oversight and running the business, but also in the well\-being and growth of all employees. We consider people our \#1 asset, and help employees realize their full potential, set and exceed their goals, and explore new opportunities for personal and professional development. **Why You Should Join BHG Financial** We strive to offer amenities, opportunities, events, and programming that support the interests of our teams, while furthering the culture that makes us Great Place to Work® certified. Some of the benefits you can expect when you join BHG Financial include: * Medical/Rx/Dental/Vision coverage for employees and their eligible family members * Competitive PTO and vacation policies * 1 Friday off each month for Wellness Weekends * Company 401(k) plan with employer contributions after one year * Company\-sponsored training and certification opportunities * Quarterly award ceremonies where top achievers are celebrated and receive additional bonuses * Ongoing volunteer opportunities to give back to the community through our BHG Cares program If you’re ready for a career where you can exercise your passions, be surrounded by co\-workers who are relentlessly committed to service, and have a team\-player mindset, apply today! BHG Financial is committed to equal treatment and opportunity in all aspects of recruitment, selection, and employment without regard to gender, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, disability, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other category protected under the law. BHG Financial is an equal opportunity employer; committed to a community of inclusion, and an environment free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: **DevOps Engineer – GitGuardian Secret Remediation** **Client:** Wells Fargo **Locations:** Iselin, NJ \| Charlotte, NC \| Chandler, AZ \| Irving, TX **Work Model:** Hybrid **Employment Type:** 12\+ Month Contract **Pay Rate:** $45–$50/hour on W\-2 \| $60/hour on 1099 **Visa Eligibility:** U.S. Citizens, H\-1B, H\-4 EAD **Role Overview** We are seeking experienced DevOps engineers to support the enterprise\-wide rollout of GitGuardian across Wells Fargo. In this role, you will partner directly with application development teams to triage, remediate, and prevent hardcoded secrets—including API keys, credentials, tokens, and certificates—across source code repositories and CI/CD pipelines. This is a hands\-on, developer\-facing position requiring both deep Git expertise and strong collaboration skills. **Core Responsibilities** * **Triage \& Validation:** Analyze historical and real\-time secret alerts in GitGuardian, distinguish true positives from false positives, and assess blast radius and severity. * **Developer Collaboration:** Partner closely with application teams to communicate security risks, guide remediation efforts, and ensure fixes do not disrupt application functionality. * **Secret Remediation \& Rotation:** Assist teams in revoking exposed credentials, rotating secrets, and migrating hardcoded values into approved secret management solutions (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault). * **Git History Cleanup:** Safely rewrite Git commit history using tools such as git\-filter\-repo or BFG Repo\-Cleaner when required, coordinating branch synchronization with developers throughout the process. * **Preventative Controls:** Help engineering teams implement pre\-commit hooks (ggshield) and CI/CD pipeline checks to block future secret leaks before code is merged. * **Tracking \& Reporting:** Maintain accurate remediation metrics, track SLA compliance per application team, and escalate high\-risk exposures to AppSec leadership. **Required Skills \& Qualifications** * **Git Mastery:** Deep understanding of Git internals, branching strategies, and history\-rewriting tools (git\-filter\-repo, BFG). * **Secret Management:** Hands\-on experience integrating enterprise secret managers (AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, GCP Secret Manager, or HashiCorp Vault) into application code. * **Software Development Background:** Ability to read and understand multiple programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, JavaScript/Node.js, Go, C\#) to locate how secrets are used in code and configuration files. * **CI/CD \& DevOps:** Familiarity with CI/CD platforms (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps) and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes). * **Communication \& Stakeholder Management:** Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work empathetically and effectively with fast\-moving development teams. **Preferred Qualifications** * Direct experience administering or triaging alerts within GitGuardian (or similar secret scanning tools such as TruffleHog or GitHub Secret Scanning). * Background in Application Security (AppSec), DevSecOps, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE). * Experience working in regulated enterprise environments with strict SLA and compliance tracking. **Key Requirements at a Glance (5 Must\-Haves for DevOps – GitGuardian)** * Git expertise, including history rewriting (git\-filter\-repo, BFG) * Secret manager integration (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, or GCP Secret Manager) * Multi\-language code literacy (Python, Java, JavaScript/Node.js, Go, C\#) * CI/CD and DevOps tooling experience (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps; Docker/Kubernetes) * Strong developer\-facing communication and stakeholder management skills Pay: $45\.00 \- $50\.00 per hour Application Question(s): * What is your work authorization? * Are you comfortable to work on W2 or 1099? Work Location: Hybrid remote in Irving, TX 75015

As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting\-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide. Recognized as a top destination for innovators and champions of inclusion, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what \#LifeAtBNY is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary. **Job Summary** BNY is seeking a Senior Java Full Stack Developer – Equities Trading Platform to join the Execution Services Platform team, supporting the development and modernization of mission\-critical trading systems across the Equities business. This role focuses on building scalable, high\-performance applications that power order management, execution, pricing, and risk platforms in a front\-office trading environment. This position is based in New York, NY and requires 4\+ days onsite per week. The role will play a key part in transforming legacy systems into modern, cloud\-based microservices architectures while leveraging AI\-enabled development tools to drive efficiency and innovation. **Key Responsibilities** * **Full Stack Application Development:** Design, develop, and implement high\-performance applications across front\-end and back\-end layers to support trading and operational workflows. * **Trading Systems Engineering:** Build and enhance trading channels and messaging systems interfacing with exchanges and external venues using industry\-standard protocols. * **Microservices \& Modernization:** Contribute to re\-architecting legacy systems into scalable microservices\-based solutions within cloud environments. * **Messaging \& Integration:** Develop core components using Java and messaging technologies such as Kafka and MQ to support real\-time data processing and trading flows. * **Front Office Platform Support:** Deliver enhancements and provide second\-level production support for mission\-critical front office trading systems. * **Data Processing \& Performance Optimization:** Handle high\-volume trading data, ensuring low latency, scalability, and system reliability. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with product, operations, and engineering teams to gather requirements and deliver solutions aligned with business objectives. * **Testing \& Quality Assurance:** Coordinate system integration testing and ensure high\-quality code through best practices and code reviews. * **AI\-Enabled Development:** Leverage AI\-assisted coding tools (e.g., Windsurf, Copilot) to improve development efficiency and accelerate delivery. * **Mentorship \& Leadership:** Mentor junior developers and contribute to best practices across the engineering team. **Qualifications** * 10\+ years of software development experience, with strong focus on full stack engineering * Strong expertise in Java, SQL, and Git * Experience with Spring, Spring Boot, and related frameworks * Experience with messaging technologies such as Kafka, MQ, and FIX protocols * Strong understanding of distributed systems, data modeling, and high\-performance application design * Experience working in cloud environments and DevOps practices * Familiarity with Linux and Windows environments * Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills * Experience supporting production systems in high\-pressure environments * Strong communication and collaboration skills * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field (advanced degree preferred) * Experience within financial services, particularly Equities trading environments * Familiarity with AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Copilot, Windsurf, Cursor) **Preferred Experience** * Knowledge of order management systems (OMS) and smart order routing (SOR) * Understanding of equity trading lifecycle and market structure * Experience building front office trading or execution platforms * Experience with Angular or modern front\-end frameworks * Familiarity with Python for scripting or data processing * Exposure to regulatory reporting and compliance considerations in trading systems * Experience with application profiling, debugging, and performance tuning **Why Join Us** This role offers the opportunity to be part of a high\-impact transformation initiative within the Equities trading space. You will help modernize legacy platforms into cutting\-edge, cloud\-based systems while working with advanced technologies, including AI\-assisted development tools. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to the evolution of front\-office trading systems in a fast\-paced, innovation\-driven environment. At BNY, our culture speaks for itself, check out the latest BNY news at: BNY Newsroom BNY LinkedIn Here’s a few of our recent awards: America’s Most Innovative Companies, Fortune, 2025 World’s Most Admired Companies, Fortune 2025 “Most Just Companies”, Just Capital and CNBC, 2025 **Pay Rate Range** Min Pay Rate$112 Max Pay Rate$140 CurrencyUSD Unithourly USD112140HOUR Additional Notes *Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis.* *This posting is for a contract assignment with Tundra Technical Solutions to provide services to Bank of New York (BNY).
