jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer III, AI Products
jobs.description: **Overview** ============ Baker Tilly is a leading advisory, tax and assurance firm, providing clients with a genuine coast\-to\-coast and global advantage in major regions of the U.S. and in many of the world’s leading financial centers – New York, London, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago and Boston. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP (Baker Tilly) provide professional services through an alternative practice structure in accordance with the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct and applicable laws, regulations and professional standards. Baker Tilly US, LLP is a licensed independent CPA firm that provides attest services to its clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities provide tax and business advisory services to their clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities are not licensed CPA firms. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP, trading as Baker Tilly, are independent members of Baker Tilly International, a worldwide network of independent accounting and business advisory firms in 141 territories, with 43,000 professionals and a combined worldwide revenue of $5\.2 billion. Visit bakertilly.com or join the conversation on LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram. Please discuss the work location status with your Baker Tilly talent acquisition professional to understand the requirements for an opportunity you are exploring. *Baker Tilly is an equal* *opportunity/affirmative* *action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable federal, state or local law.* *Any unsolicited resumes submitted through our website or to Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, employee e\-mail accounts are considered property of Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, and are not subject to payment of agency fees. In order to be an authorized recruitment agency ("search firm") for Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by Baker Tilly's Talent Attraction team, to submit candidates for review via our applicant tracking system.* **Job Description:** ==================== **What we're building** ======================= We're building AI agents that do real work for Baker Tilly's tax, assurance, and advisory teams. They read client files, find risks and opportunities, draft financial statement disclosures, and show their sources, and a practitioner always makes the final call. The data is some of the most sensitive in the business, so we build security in from the start. Baker Tilly is the sixth\-largest accounting and advisory firm in the U.S., with more than 11,000 people, and the firm is investing seriously in AI. We're a small team at the start of that work, and the engineers who join now will help decide what we build and how. As a Full Stack Engineer, you'll build the screens practitioners use and the services behind them. You'll take well\-scoped features from frontend to production and learn from experienced engineers as you go. **What you'll work with** ========================= * Years of client engagement history, tax returns, and financial records, at the scale of a major firm. * Tax, audit, and advisory practitioners who help define what good looks like and review what the agents produce. * Real users inside the firm who give direct feedback on what you build. * We work in partnership with frontier labs. * A mix of building and buying. You'll help decide which is which, and everything we ship meets the same standards for security, tracing, and testing. * Our stack: Python, TypeScript and React, Databricks, graph and vector databases, MCP, OpenTelemetry, and Braintrust, on Azure. **What you'll do** ================== * Build features for our AI agents end to end: the screens practitioners use, the services behind them, and the data they read. * Build the tools our experts use to review agent output and flag what's wrong. * Work directly with practitioners to understand how they do their jobs, then turn that into software. * Connect to firm systems and data through APIs, with the right access controls. * Write tested, readable code. Review other people's code, and have yours reviewed. * Watch what you ship: tests, tracing, user feedback, and fixing what breaks. * Use AI coding tools extensively to build and ship, and check their work. We ship through a code factory more and more, and you'll help us get there. **Who you are** =============== * You're a hands\-on technologist who has built things people actually use, ideally end to end, from the first conversation with users through production and after. * You're naturally curious, a strong problem solver, and a clear communicator. * You can take an objective, form an opinion, and move things forward on your own, even when the path is unclear. **What you bring** ================== * 5 years of experience preferred building and shipping production software, on both frontend and backend. * You use AI coding tools extensively, and you have opinions about what works. * TypeScript or JavaScript with a modern frontend framework, plus a backend language like Python, Node, Go, or Java. * Comfort with APIs, relational databases, and common authentication patterns. * Solid habits: debugging, automated tests, version control, secure coding. * You ask who should see the data before you ask how to show it. * Bachelor's Degree required **Nice to have** ================ * React, Python, PostgreSQL, Azure, Databricks, containers, or CI/CD tooling. * Some exposure to LLM apps, retrieval, agents, or evals. No AI background needed. * Experience with enterprise systems, specialist business users, or regulated data. **In a year** ============= * You've shipped features practitioners use every week. * You've improved a real workflow, and you can show it with feedback or numbers. * You're taking on bigger pieces, and the team is better for having you. *The pay rate range for this job position are listed below. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of relevant factors including but not limited to applicant’s skills, prior experience, qualifications, degrees, professional certifications, work arrangements and geographic location. Baker Tilly offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package to eligible employee*s. *The national pay rate range is $205,000–$250,000* *In California: pay rate range is $205,000–$250,000* \#LI\-AC1

security across hybrid, multi\-cloud and on\-premises estates, including network segmentation, secrets management and zero\-trust patterns. * Assess and explain AI security risks in integration jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Build Systems (Bazel)
jobs.description: At Boston Dynamics, our mission is to deliver the world’s most capable robots. Behind every robot is a lot of software, and on the **Central Software (CSW)** team, we build the “software factory” that gets it from a developer’s laptop to robots, desktops, and the cloud. We’re looking for a **Senior Software Engineer** to take the next big leap in how fast and reliably many hundreds of engineers can build and test. Our monorepo spans C\+\+, Python, Go, Rust, TypeScript, and Java/Kotlin, and targets embedded hardware, simulation, machine learning, and cloud services. That means build and test problems you won’t find at a typical web company: cross\-compiling for robot hardware, large binary artifacts, and testing that has to bridge simulation and real machines. **You’ll make an impact by:** * Owning the rollout of remote build execution across our monorepo, from proof of concept to production use by every developer. * Teaming up with CSW leadership and peers to turn priorities into well\-scoped, well\-executed, and well\-coordinated work. * Improving build and test performance by profiling builds, raising cache hit rates, and eliminating non\-determinism. * Root\-causing and fixing build breaks, flaky tests, and speed regressions. * Modernizing our build, from migrating to current Bazel rulesets to using the dependency graph to generate SBOMs. * Seeing everything through, from implementation and testing to deployment, documentation, and ongoing operations. * Becoming one of the go\-to Bazel experts on the team, staying current with the Bazel ecosystem and sharing what you learn through docs, code review, and helping teammates. jobs.title: Software Engineer - AI Team (NYC-based)
jobs.description: **Who we are** Bowery Valuation is one of the leading startups in the emerging world of real estate tech and the only company of its kind in the commercial real estate appraisal space. We are also the first\-ever venture capital\-backed commercial appraisal firm, having raised over $80MM. Powered by big data, advanced technology, and extensive expertise, Bowery is redefining the entire commercial appraisal space. Inside Bowery, we’re a people\-forward company dedicated to providing a productive and inspiring working culture. We are a collection of hard\-working and enthusiastic types focused on building great teams to support great work. We balance our dedication to success with a commitment to gratitude, kindness, and a team\-first attitude. **About the Role** ------------------ Bowery is in a new phase: rethinking the whole appraisal process with AI at the core. We’re hiring a Software Engineer to join our AI\-first engineering team, reporting to our Head of Technology. As the first truly tech\-enabled appraisal firm \- having raised over $80mm backed by Goldman Sachs, Capital One, and numerous venture funds \- Bowery has a strong foundation to build on: a proprietary appraisal\-writing platform, high\-quality data, and a team of 100\+ appraisers across 17 offices from more than 1,000 clients. We’ve grown over 30% year\-over\-year and are fully profitable. Few industries are better suited for AI than appraisal. The work is structured, repetitive, and data\-driven, and it pulls from fragmented sources. We want to use AI to turbocharge appraisers, who can spend their time on judgment, comparables, and compliance instead of data entry. The result will be a better product for our clients and a transformation in the industry. This is a senior engineering role, not a prompt\-writing role. We want someone with a strong software engineering foundation who also uses AI tools like Claude Code and Codex to get far more done than they could alone. You’ll make product decisions, own systems end to end, and hold a high bar for how they’re built. Bowery is a post\-Series B company with clear product\-market fit and material scale, but with a small engineering team. You get the security and data of a late\-stage startup with the impact of a very early one. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Design, build, and ship features end to end across our appraisal platform and AI\-powered workflows, from data extraction and analysis to narrative generation * Work directly with appraisers and Ops to understand the problem, decide what to build, and make the product calls to get it shipped * Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, or similar) every day, and help shape how the team uses them well, including knowing where not to trust them * Build LLM\-backed features with evaluation, testing, and monitoring in place so quality is measured, not guessed at * Own infrastructure and deployments on AWS, including CI/CD with GitHub Actions, infrastructure as code with Terraform, and containerized services with Docker * Keep the bar high on system design, code review, testing, and observability as we move faster **Experience and Skills** ------------------------- * 4\+ years building and shipping production software, ideally including time at an early\-stage or fast\-moving company * Strong fundamentals in system design, data modeling, APIs, and testing * Fluent in TypeScript and Node.js; React experience is a plus * AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, or similar) are a real part of how you work today, and you have opinions on how to use them without giving up quality * Experience building with LLMs: prompt design, RAG, structured outputs, and evals * Experience with AWS preferred, along with GitHub Actions, Terraform, and Docker **Why You’d Be a Good Fit** --------------------------- * **You want ownership.** You’d rather figure out what should be built than wait for a fully specced ticket, and you’re comfortable making and defending product decisions. * **You think critically.** You use AI to multiply your output, and you review its work the way you’d review a teammate’s. You know when something is good enough to ship and when it isn’t. * **You care how things are built.** Speed matters, but so do clean interfaces, tests, and systems that the next engineer can understand. * **You enjoy having direct access to end users.** Our core users (appraisers and Ops teams) are all in\-house, so you’d be iterating with a tight feedback loop. Many of them work 3x/week from our office in Cooper Square. * **You value a remote\-first eng culture.** Our engineers prioritize async communication and make space for deep focus time to help us ship faster. **Why You Might Not Be a Good Fit** ----------------------------------- * **You want well\-defined tickets and a narrow scope.** This role means wearing many hats and working through ambiguity with the business. * **You’d rather not use AI tools in your work.** They’re central to how our team operates and how we expect to scale. * **You’d ship code you don’t understand.** AI\-generated code still needs to meet our engineering standards, and you own what you merge. **Bowery’s Tech Stack** ----------------------- * **Languages:** TypeScript, JavaScript * **Frontend:** React * **Backend:** Node.js (NestJS framework) * **Database:** MongoDB, Postgres * **Infrastructure:** AWS, Docker, Terraform, GitHub Actions **Bowery Leadership** --------------------- * John Meadows, Chief Executive Officer; LinkedIn * Madeline Pinkner, Head of Technology; LinkedIn * Eliot Jenkins, President and Chief Operating Officer; LinkedIn * Steve Schaller, Chief Revenue Officer; LinkedIn **The pay range for this role is:** 180,000 \- 200,000 USD per year(New York)

jobs.title: Engineer - Embedded
jobs.description: ### **Description** Brivo SmartHome connects apartments and rental homes to the cloud. Our gateways are Linux\-based devices installed at each property. They control Z\-Wave door locks, thermostats, leak sensors and switches, and report to our cloud platform over MQTT. As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will help design, develop, test, debug and release the software that runs on thousands of these gateways in the field. Our next\-generation gateway software is written in TypeScript on Node.js and runs on a custom embedded Linux image built with Yocto. You'll write application code on the device, and you'll learn the whole path: from a Yocto build, to a firmware update shipped to the fleet, to diagnosing problems on real gateways at real properties. You'll work with our cloud/backend engineers on the device\-to\-cloud messaging layer, with hardware and QA on validation, and with support teams when devices in the field need investigation. A senior engineer will mentor you and review your work closely.### **What You'll Do** * Spend most of your time writing clean, maintainable, well\-tested TypeScript/Node.js code for the gateway software * Support the full lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, release, over\-the\-air updates and support in the field * Work on device integrations, such as Z\-Wave locks, thermostats and sensors, and on the MQTT messaging that links gateways to the cloud * Help build and maintain our embedded Linux image (Yocto/BitBake), including packaging the Node.js application and its dependencies for ARM hardware * Investigate field issues using device logs (systemd/journald), remote diagnostics and fleet data, and turn what you find into fixes * Write Bash and Python tools for builds, testing, provisioning and diagnostics * Join code reviews, sprint planning and backlog grooming on an Agile team ### **About You** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field * 0–2 years of software experience. Internships, co\-ops, capstone projects and serious personal projects all count. * Working knowledge of TypeScript or JavaScript, including asynchronous programming (Promises, async/await, event\-driven design) * Comfortable on the Linux command line, with some Bash scripting * Basic knowledge of data structures, algorithms and networking fundamentals (TCP/IP) * Familiar with Git * Clear written and spoken communication, and an eagerness to learn * Interest in hardware, IoT and how software behaves on real devices ### **Why work for Brivo?** Why Your Work Matters Innovation drives our vibe, but purpose drives our mission. You will work on essential systems that protect the health, safety, and welfare of people and property worldwide. At Brivo, your voice is heard, your talent is respected, and your contributions have a global impact. * *The Brivo Experience:* We thrive on in\-person collaboration and a "one\-team" atmosphere. We embrace our international presence, leveraging diverse ideas and backgrounds to improve our culture and our products. To keep our global teams connected and inspired, we provide a premium onsite experience featuring communal meals, recurring social events, and fully stocked workspaces—ensuring you have everything you need to stay focused while building the future of security. * *Total Rewards:* We support our people with competitive medical, vision, and dental plans (including company\-offset premiums), a 401k with company match, and an unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO) policy that empowers you to take the time you need to maintain a healthy work\-life balance. Individual compensation packages are based on job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, training, and market conditions. In addition, Brivonians enjoy a robust benefits and perks package tailored to their work location.### **About Brivo** Brivo and Eagle Eye Networks have come together to create a category\-defining, cloud\-first platform at the intersection of AI and the physical world. Our mission is simple and ambitious: to make physical spaces safer, smarter, and more autonomous—from single\-site businesses to global enterprises. jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: Join the team turning internet intelligence into real\-world security outcomes. Built on the world’s most comprehensive and accurate map of the Internet, the Censys Platform delivers real\-time visibility and actionable intelligence needed to accelerate triage, investigate threats, hunt adversaries, and manage Internet exposure. We're trusted by half of the Fortune 500 and government agencies all around the world, and looking for people as passionate about the problems we're solving as we are. At Censys, we're on a mission to provide best in class internet visibility and intelligence to the global security community. Our platform helps security teams uncover hidden threats, gain actionable insights, and build proactive defense strategies. Trusted by organizations worldwide, Censys cuts through the noise to surface the most critical risks, enabling teams to respond faster, and stay ahead of attackers. We're constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible to help our customers see and secure the internet more clearly than ever before. **Location:** This position is remote within the United States or Canada **Role Summary** ---------------- Censys is seeking a **Senior Site Reliability Engineer** to join our Infrastructure and Operations Platform team. Our engineers ship Go services from a single monorepo onto Kubernetes in Google Cloud, and the speed and safety of the path from commit to production sets the pace for the whole company. We're looking for an engineer who can support that path end to end, treat our development teams as internal customers, and build the self\-service platform that lets them create, deploy, and run their services with confidence. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Own the developer path to production, from monorepo build tooling and CI in GitHub Actions through GitOps deployments with ArgoCD, Helm, and Crossplane, and drive it toward true continuous deployment * Design and build self\-service platform capabilities, including service templates, a service catalog, repository tooling, and documentation, so development teams can stand up and operate new services without filing a ticket * Make observability a default rather than an afterthought, standardizing how our services capture the four golden signals (latency, traffic, errors, and saturation) with Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry * Build, secure, and maintain the container images and tooling that run our applications on Kubernetes and GCP managed services such as Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub, and Memorystore * Shift security left by building dependency scanning, static analysis, and image scanning into CI, working with our Security Operations team to keep it fast and actionable for developers * Lead troubleshooting of complex production issues alongside development teams, and participate in our shared on\-call rotation, where SRE owns infrastructure and primary site uptime and development teams own their services end to end * Mentor engineers on the SRE team and across development teams on Kubernetes, CI/CD, and reliability practices, and contribute to the golden\-path standards and shared libraries they build on **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * A positive attitude biased towards action and iterative problem solving, learning as we grow every step of the way * 5\+ years of experience in site reliability, platform, or infrastructure engineering * Hands\-on experience deploying, operating, and debugging applications on Kubernetes, including Helm\-based deployments and building and securing container images * Experience running workloads on public cloud managed services (GCP preferred), such as managed databases, messaging, and caching * Fluency with infrastructure\-as\-code and GitOps workflows (Terraform, Crossplane, ArgoCD, or similar) * Experience with CI/CD in a monorepo, trunk\-based development model (GitHub Actions or similar), and a strong desire to get to continuous deployment * Practical experience instrumenting and monitoring services with Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar * Experience building automation and internal tooling in a language like Go or Python, not just writing configuration * Strong communication and empathy for developers. You seek out feedback from the teams you support, and explaining a BCDR tradeoff to product management should be as comfortable as walking an engineer through a failed deploy **What Sets You Apart** ----------------------- * Experience supporting a gRPC microservice architecture, including a service mesh such as Istio for observability, multi\-cluster routing, and traffic management * Comfort working in application code to introduce golden paths, shared libraries, and better test and integration environments. Most of our services are written in Go, with some Python and Scala. * Working knowledge of infrastructure networking (load balancers, ingress, DNS, and VPC design). We operate globally distributed data centers alongside our cloud infrastructure * A h hat others accept as permanent, such as manual release steps, environment setup, or flaky pipelines * Strong interest in harnessing AI and LLM tools as a force multiplier for platform work, from incident analysis to developer tooling and documentation *For* *high cost of living areas* *(San Francisco Bay, New York City, and Seattle), the expected salary range for this position is $174,000 USD \- $206,000 USD, plus bonus eligibility and equity.* *For all other locations, the expected salary range for this position is $151,000 USD \- $191,000 USD, plus bonus eligibility and equity.* Job level and actual compensation will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process (including skills and prior relevant experience, potential impact, and scope of role), market demands, and specific work location. The listed range is a guideline, and the range for this role may be modified. For roles that are available to be filled remotely, the pay range is localized according to employee work location by a factor of between 83% and 100% of range. Please discuss your specific work location with your recruiter for more information. Censys offers a competitive benefits package to employees, including equity, health, dental \& vision coverage, retirement with company contribution, parental leave, mental health \& wellness benefits, flexible PTO, and a professional development stipend. Censys also offers sales incentive pay for most sales roles and an annual bonus plan for eligible non\-sales roles. Censys’s compensation and benefits are subject to change and may be modified in the future. *Please see our* *careers page* *for more details.* We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to apply for a role, participate in the interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. If you require accommodation, please reach out to your recruiter. These modifications enable an individual with a disability to have an equal opportunity not only to get a job, but successfully perform their job tasks to the same extent as people without disabilities. To ensure the integrity of our hiring process and facilitate a more personal connection, we require all candidates to keep their cameras on during video interviews. Additionally, if hired, we would love to bring you to our HQ in Ann Arbor for in\-person onboarding. By applying for this job, the candidate acknowledges and agrees that any personal data contained in their application or supporting materials will be processed in accordance with our Censys Privacy Policy. *Our roots are in Ann Arbor, Michigan and our innovation is fueled by the team’s global perspectives. For this role, we are open to remote employees across the continental US. We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Censys is an* *equal opportunity employer**.* \#LI\-DNI #### **Identity Verification** As part of our hiring process, all candidates who receive an offer of employment will be asked to complete an identity verification through CLEAR. **California Privacy Rights Notice** Pursuant to the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), we are providing you with notice that we collect personal information from job applicants for business purposes, including evaluating your candidacy for employment, conducting interviews, and, if applicable, completing the hiring process. jobs.title: Controls Engineer
jobs.description: **City Brewing Company – Who We Are** City Brewing \& Beverage is a leading U.S. co\-manufacturer for top beverage brands. With more than 25 years of experience and state\-of\-the\-art high scale and high volume facilities, we have the ability to produce a diverse portfolio of alcoholic and non\-alcoholic beverages. We foster a collaborative, growth\-focused workplace where employees are empowered to learn, lead, and make an impact while helping shape the future of the beverage industry. **Job Summary** Controls Engineers are key to ensuring the success and efficiency of our highspeed equipment throughout our production and warehousing spaces. This individual will work in a variety of areas of the manufacturing facility developing PLC and HMI code for automated Brewing/Batching equipment while also troubleshooting industrial controls and electrical systems. They will also provide mentorship and coaching to our Electricians and ensure Operations leaders are informed of any challenges or opportunities of improvement on the floor. The job will primarily be in Brewing/Batching but will also support other departments throughout the plant as needed. **Duties and Responsibilities*** Design and program all aspects of PLC/HMI software for packaging equipment * Test and debug control systems * Create, update, and modify machine, part or facilities schematics using a CAD program * Both AC and DC Drive experience with various drive platforms * Write and modify, extensive PLC’s and HMI’s programs for the following: + Rockwell Automation'Allen Bradley + Modicon + Troubleshoot or establish control networks. + EtherNet / IP + DeviceNet + DH\-485 + Modbus + Modbus Plus + ProLeit * Troubleshoots systems including but not limited to: electrical, instrumentation and controls * Electrical schematic design and drafting using AutoCAD Electrical * Troubleshoots process control systems in particular packaging line control systems * Performs all duties within GMP standards * Performs all functions as required within the CMMS * Train, mentor and coach trainees and front line automation techs * Perform additional duties as assigned * Responsible for department compliance with GMP, HACCP and FSMA guidelines **Minimum Qualifications*** Degree in Electrical Engineering, or 5\+ years’ experience in PLC controls engineering in lieu of degree * Allen Bradley PLC and motion controls experience * Skilled in RS Logix 500 and Studio * ProLeit experience * Prior experience in root cause analysis and continuous improvement * System process controls and line balancing experience * Advanced knowledge of electrical systems, control power and drives, sanitary control principals, operation and trouble shooting * Experience in food/beverage processing * Excellent communication, planning, and prioritization * Strong leadership and team skills **Benefits/Compensation** City Brewery provides a competitive salary and benefit package that includes: Health, Dental, Vision, Life, and Long Term Disability Insurance; Section 125; 401(k) and a paid 30\-minute meal period. jobs.title: Founding AI Engineer, Agents

jobs.title: Founding Harness Engineer

jobs.title: Founding ML Engineer

jobs.title: Founding Software Engineer

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Description** We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Software Engineer to lead the design, development, deployment, and ongoing management of software applications. This role requires a strong combination of technical expertise, independent problem\-solving, project ownership, and the ability to leverage modern AI\-assisted development tools, including Claude and Claude Code, to accelerate software delivery. The ideal candidate is a self\-directed engineer who can take high\-level business requirements, translate them into actionable technical specifications, manage development tasks, and deliver reliable, scalable, and maintainable applications. This individual should be comfortable owning the full software development lifecycle, from initial requirements gathering and solution architecture through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support. We are particularly interested in candidates who embrace AI\-assisted software engineering practices and understand how to effectively incorporate AI\-generated code into professional development workflows while maintaining high standards for quality, security, and maintainability. A successful candidate will be able to take ownership of a software initiative with minimal oversight, working directly with stakeholders to understand business needs and translating those needs into a well\-defined technical solution. They will effectively manage their own development backlog, leverage AI\-assisted coding tools to improve productivity, and consistently deliver high\-quality applications that are secure, reliable, and maintainable. Beyond writing code, this individual will demonstrate strong technical judgment, proactive communication, and accountability for the full lifecycle of the applications they develop. They will balance development speed with engineering discipline, ensuring that AI\-assisted development contributes to measurable improvements in delivery efficiency without compromising software quality. We are looking for an engineer who is equally comfortable designing solutions, writing code, managing development activities, and owning applications in production. The ideal candidate combines the technical depth of a senior engineer with the independence and delivery mindset of a technical lead. They are enthusiastic about the evolving role of AI in software engineering, have practical experience using tools such as Claude to accelerate development, and understand that effective software delivery requires more than generating code. It requires thoughtful architecture, disciplined validation, strong communication, and end\-to\-end ownership of the solution.### **Key Responsibilities** * Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to gather, clarify, and document functional and nonfunctional requirements. * Translate business objectives into technical specifications, application designs, and actionable development tasks. * Identify technical dependencies, potential risks, and opportunities to simplify or improve proposed solutions. * Design scalable, secure, and maintainable application architectures aligned with business requirements. * Provide technical recommendations and communicate architectural decisions and trade\-offs to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. * Design, develop, test, and maintain applications, APIs, integrations, and supporting services. * Leverage Claude, Claude Code, and other AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, debugging, refactoring, documentation, and test generation. * Apply effective prompt engineering and context management techniques to guide AI\-assisted development. * Review, validate, and refine AI\-generated code to ensure functional correctness, security, performance, and adherence to engineering standards. * Develop reusable software components and establish consistent development patterns. * Implement automated unit, integration, and end\-to\-end testing to support reliable application delivery. * Maintain clean, well\-structured, and documented code using established software engineering principles. * Independently manage development activities from initial requirements through successful delivery. * Break complex initiatives into manageable tasks with clearly defined deliverables, dependencies, and acceptance criteria. * Estimate development effort, establish realistic timelines, and communicate progress against milestones. * Use project management tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar platforms to organize and track development work. * Proactively identify blockers, manage competing priorities, and communicate risks or changes to project timelines. * Coordinate technical activities with other engineers, stakeholders, and external partners as needed. * Own the deployment, configuration, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance of software applications. * Develop and manage CI/CD pipelines to support consistent and reliable software releases. * Implement appropriate logging, monitoring, exception handling, and alerting capabilities. * Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement sustainable resolutions. * Manage application updates, enhancements, technical debt, and performance optimization. * Apply secure development practices, including authentication, authorization, secrets management, and data protection. * Maintain technical documentation covering application architecture, deployment procedures, configurations, and operational support. * Establish and promote software development best practices, including code reviews, automated testing, version control, and secure coding standards. * Evaluate emerging development technologies and recommend tools or frameworks that improve engineering efficiency. * Champion responsible adoption of AI\-assisted development while ensuring appropriate human oversight and validation. * Provide technical guidance and mentorship to other engineers. * Take accountability for the quality, reliability, and maintainability of delivered solutions ### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise** * 2\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of production applications. * Strong proficiency in one or more modern programming languages such as Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, C\#, or Java. * Demonstrated experience designing, building, deploying, and maintaining full\-stack or backend applications. * Experience translating ambiguous business requirements into clearly defined technical solutions and implementation plans. * Hands\-on experience using Claude, Claude Code, or comparable AI\-assisted coding tools in software development workflows. * Strong understanding of REST APIs, system integrations, relational databases, and application architecture. * Experience with Git\-based source control, branching strategies, pull requests, and code review practices. * Experience deploying and supporting applications in cloud environments such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, and application monitoring. * Ability to independently organize development work, estimate effort, manage priorities, and deliver against agreed timelines. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving capabilities. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders. * Experience developing applications using Microsoft Azure, including Azure Functions, App Service, Azure SQL, and related services. * Experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React, Next.js, or Angular. * Experience with Docker, containerized applications, and infrastructure as code. * Experience integrating applications with large language models through APIs, including Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, or Azure AI Foundry. * Familiarity with AI agents, tool calling, workflow orchestration, and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG). * Experience using Azure DevOps or similar platforms for development planning, source control, and deployment management. * Experience working in a consulting, professional services, or client\-facing software development environment. * Understanding of application security, access controls, data governance, and responsible AI development practices. ### **Benefits** * Training and development for career growth * PTO leave * 401(k) match * Healthcare * Paid family leave ### **About Calligo** Calligo transforms data into businesses’ most lucrative asset. We combine great minds in data science, privacy, security and engineering with leading machine learning, data analytics and cloud platforms to support the operational, customer\-centric and revenue\-generation aspirations of some of the world's most ambitious and progressive organizations.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II
jobs.description: **Discover your potential. Build your legacy.** **Go the distance with Capital Group** At Capital Group, we go the distance — for our people, our clients, and each other. As a global, privately held firm with more than 95 years of history, we believe meaningful careers, like meaningful investing, are built over the long term. That’s why we invest in our associates with the same conviction we bring to our clients — through career growth, purpose\-driven work, whole\-person wellness, and rewards that recognize your contributions. Here, you’ll find the opportunity, global scale and support to unlock your potential and build a career that lasts. As a Software Engineer, you partner with business partners, product managers, and other engineers to turn business problems into reliable production software, with a particular focus on AI\-enabled solutions that improve our investment process and business outcomes. You contribute across the software development lifecycle, from understanding the problem and designing the solution through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support. This is a hands\-on software engineering role. We are looking for an engineer with strong foundations in software design, testing, APIs, data, cloud infrastructure, security, and operational excellence who can apply those principles to modern AI systems. You will work on problems that combine traditional software engineering with emerging AI capabilities such as retrieval, large language models, and agentic workflows. You will contribute to how AI\-enabled software is built and operated reliably and responsibly across the firm. **You will:** * Partner with business partners and product managers to understand workflows, clarify requirements, and translate business problems into practical technical solutions. * Design, build, test, deploy, and operate high\-quality production software, applying engineering principles around maintainability, reliability, performance, security, and scalability. * Build AI\-enabled applications using capabilities such as retrieval, embeddings, context and prompt engineering, tool use, and agentic workflows, integrating them with enterprise data and systems. * Apply testing and evaluation practices to AI systems, defining acceptance criteria, building automated evaluations, and measuring quality, latency, failure modes, and hallucination risk. * Own the software you build through production, using logging, monitoring, observability, and debugging practices to identify issues and continuously improve reliability and performance. * Build security, privacy, and responsible\-AI controls into solutions, including authentication and authorization, secrets management, data protection, auditability, and appropriate guardrails. * Contribute to technical design and architectural decisions, evaluating trade\-offs and working with other engineers to choose simple, maintainable solutions. * Contribute reusable components, patterns, documentation, and engineering practices that improve consistency and help others understand, operate, and extend the systems you build. **Required qualifications:** * Professional software engineering experience, with proficiency in Python, Java, C\#, or another modern programming language. * Strong software engineering fundamentals, including APIs, data structures, system design, data stores, testing, source control, CI/CD, debugging, and production operations. * Experience designing, building, testing, and deploying production software, with an understanding of maintainability, reliability, performance, and security. * Experience working with APIs, databases, cloud services, and enterprise data, including structured or unstructured data. * Strong problem\-solving and communication skills, with the ability to work through ambiguity, explain technical decisions, collaborate effectively, and incorporate feedback. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. **Preferred qualifications:** * Experience in financial services or another regulated enterprise environment. * Experience with public cloud and modern data or AI platforms, such as AWS, Azure AI, or Databricks. * Experience with modern AI application technologies, such as vector or hybrid search, tool calling, agents, AI orchestration, or protocols such as MCP. * Experience with AI/ML operational practices, including evaluation, monitoring, observability, model or prompt versioning, and CI/CD. * Experience developing across multiple parts of the application stack, including backend services, APIs, data integrations, cloud infrastructure, or user\-facing applications. * Hands\-on experience building AI or LLM\-powered applications, with practical understanding of patterns such as context and prompt engineering, retrieval, embeddings, tool use, agents, or evaluation. **What you bring:** * You operate with urgency, ownership, humility, and strong collaboration. * You hold high standards for code quality, testing, clarity, and reliability, and you apply engineering judgment to know which standard matters where. * You treat intent and verification as the hard part: you care less about how much code gets written and more about whether it solves the problem, holds up under evaluation, and can be owned safely in production. * You can say no constructively by pushing back on scope, proposing better alternatives, and protecting quality and team capacity when it counts. * You stay current as the tooling and model landscape shifts, and you help the people around you do the same. **What you’ll get** When you go the distance for our clients, we go the distance for you. jobs.description: **About Cencora** ----------------- Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today! **Job Details** =============== **Position Summary:** --------------------- The **Senior Engineer \- eCommerce** is responsible for designing, developing, enhancing, and supporting scalable digital commerce applications and services. This role is a senior individual contributor position that combines strong hands\-on engineering with ownership of complex technical solutions supporting high\-volume eCommerce operations. The Senior Engineer plays a key role in building modern eCommerce capabilities across **Java\-based microservices, cloud\-native services, React\-based headless storefronts, event\-driven integrations, and ERP\-connected transaction flows**. This individual partners with architects, tech leads, product managers, QA, DevOps, and business stakeholders to deliver secure, resilient, and high\-performing solutions that support critical customer journeys and business operations. **Key Responsibilities:** ------------------------- ### **Software Design and Development** * Design, develop, test, deploy, and support scalable eCommerce applications and services. * Build and enhance **Java\-based microservices** that support core commerce capabilities such as product discovery, cart, checkout, pricing, promotions, order orchestration, and customer account functionality. * Develop and support **React\-based headless front\-end components** and integrations that deliver modern, responsive, and user\-friendly digital experiences. * Contribute to the design and implementation of reusable services, APIs, and shared components across the eCommerce ecosystem. * Translate business and technical requirements into maintainable, well\-structured software solutions. ### **Microservices, Cloud, and Distributed Systems** * Build and maintain cloud\-native applications using modern microservices architecture patterns. * Develop services that are resilient, observable, secure, and optimized for scale and performance. * Apply best practices for service decomposition, API design, asynchronous processing, and distributed transaction handling. * Support deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management of services in cloud environments. * Contribute to improving platform scalability and reliability for **high\-volume transaction processing**. ### **Headless Commerce and Front\-End Enablement** * Support development and integration of **headless commerce** solutions using **React** and API\-first design patterns. * Build and enhance front\-end experiences that interact seamlessly with commerce APIs, customer data, search, pricing, inventory, and checkout services. * Partner with UX and product teams to implement responsive, accessible, and high\-performing customer experiences. * Optimize front\-end and back\-end interactions for speed, usability, and conversion\-related performance. ### platforms to enable order flow, fulfillment, inventory synchronization, pricing, and financial reconciliation. * Ensure reliability and data consistency across synchronous and asynchronous system interactions. * Troubleshoot complex integration issues spanning APIs, events, and enterprise systems. ### **Performance, Quality, and Reliability** * Engineer solutions to support **high\-throughput, high\-availability, and high\-volume** eCommerce environments. * Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across services, APIs, integrations, and front\-end interactions. * Write and maintain unit, integration, and automated regression tests. * Participate in code reviews and contribute to high standards for code quality, security, observability, and maintainability. * Support production readiness, defect resolution, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement activities. ### **Team Collaboration and Technical Leadership** * Work closely with tech leads and architects to implement platform and solution designs aligned with enterprise standards. * Provide guidance and technical support to other engineers on design patterns, implementation approaches, and troubleshooting. * building **microservices\-based applications**. * Experience developing applications in **cloud environments** such as **Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud**. * Experience with **React** and modern front\-end development for API\-driven or headless applications. * Experience with **RESTful APIs**, service integrations, and distributed systems. * Experience with **event\-driven architecture**, messaging systems, or asynchronous processing patterns. * Experience integrating with **ERP systems** or complex enterprise back\-end platforms. * Experience supporting **high\-volume, high\-availability** applications with a focus on scalability and performance. * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, source control, automated testing, and Agile development practices. * Strong understanding of secure coding, troubleshooting, observability, and production support. * Strong communication, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills. **Preferred Qualifications:** jobs.title: Senior Advanced AI Gameplay Designer
jobs.description: Senior Advanced AI Gameplay Designer Would you like to work on some of the greatest franchises in gaming history? What about working on our new original IP? Certain Affinity is a game development studio in Texas, based out of Austin, and we have a growing presence in Toronto, Canada. Our culture reflects the values and the vibrant nature of the cities we call home. This includes a commitment to evolution, diversity, excellence, and work\-life balance. We are also excited to be a recipient of the Canadian Studio of the Year award. We're best known for co\-developing numerous AAA FPS games, though now we are creating compelling new games of our own. We're always on the lookout for amazing talent to join our team. As an AI Gameplay Designer at Certain Affinity, you’ll own the design and implementation of enemy gameplay and encounter design for AAA action titles. You’ll prototype enemy archetypes, script their behaviors and combat abilities, and tune how they work together in encounters. You’ll work with the Lead Designer and Game Director to set goals for enemy combat and partner with engineering, animation, and level design to take enemies from first playable through ship. Responsibilities* Work with design leadership to define enemy combat goals and own the design and implementation of assigned enemy archetypes and encounters from prototype through polish. * Design, document, script, and tune enemy behaviors and combat abilities in partnership with engineering, animation, and level design. * Maintain and extend existing AI gameplay systems. Debug enemy behavior in\-editor and work with engineering to resolve underlying issues. * Build and tune encounters around enemy composition, placement, and pacing. Make enemy roles and attacks readable so players can recognize threats and respond under pressure. * Run focused playtests of enemies and encounters, diagnose what’s driving player frustration or confusion, and iterate based on player and QA feedback. Requirements* 6 or more years of professional experience in gameplay design, technical design, or gameplay scripting. * Experience with scripting or programming languages (C\+\+, LUA, Python, etc.) as well as visual scripting languages (Blueprint, etc.) * Hands\-on experience designing and implementing enemy behaviors, combat abilities, or encounters on at least one shipped game. * Experience working in Unreal 5\. * Experience implementing and debugging AI for human and non\-human enemy archetypes using tools such as behavior trees, action planners, finite state machines (FSMs), or Unreal’s Environment Query System (EQS). * Experience building, debugging, and tuning gameplay in a game editor such as Unreal Editor. * Ability to dissect and understand core gameplay and mechanics and then implement and improve them. * Ability to manage your own work, meet deadlines, and communicate tradeoffs early as priorities change. Extra Credit* Experience taking enemy gameplay or encounters from prototype through ship on a AAA title. * Player character or 3C (character, camera \& controls) design experience. * Extensive experience playing shooters and action games such as Call of Duty, Halo, Left 4 Dead, or Warframe. * Experience in level design and construction. * Degree from an accredited four\-year college or university in a related field. Certain Affinity or its partners or affiliates run background checks on candidates or employees with written authorization from the candidates or employees. These may be done to offer employment or determine eligibility to work on a specific project. Multiple searches may be required. Certain Affinity is authorized to do business in many, but not all, of the states in the US and the Canadian provinces. If you are not located in or able to work from a state where Certain Affinity is registered, you may not be eligible for employment as a fully remote employee. Please speak with your recruiter to learn more about where we are registered. a0FHDALoI8

jobs.description: Chamberlain Group (CG) is a global leader in intelligent access and Blackstone portfolio company. Our flagship brands, LiftMaster® and Chamberlain® , are found in 51\+ million homes, and 14 million\+ people rely on the myQ® app daily. **Job Summary** The Principal Software Engineer, Residential is the senior technical authority for the myQ Residential experience and the realtime communication between our apps, our cloud, and the connected devices in customers’ homes. This role owns the architecture of the mobile client and the client\-to\-server protocols behind device control, live state, notifications, and event delivery, and makes sure they feel instant and stay reliable across a large and varied IoT device ecosystem. The role also leads the most complex system design problems in the Residential Business Unit, including the Residential\-specific services that complement Chamberlain’s shared platform services. The Principal sets multi\-year technical direction, makes the calls that cross team boundaries, and raises the engineering bar for Senior and Staff engineers. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Own the architecture of the Residential mobile applications and shared client frameworks for device control, real\-time device status, notifications, and other customer\-facing features. Decide state management, networking, caching, and offline behavior on iOS, Android, or cross\-platform stacks. (\~20%) * Design and evolve the real\-time client\-to\-server communication model end to end: connection management, device state synchronization, command delivery, event ordering, retry, and reconnection under poor network conditions. Partner with Cloud, Platform, and Firmware teams so a tap in the app reliably becomes a device action in the home. (\~20%) * Lead the most complex system design challenges for the Residential Business Unit, including Residential\-specific services that complement platform services. Define service boundaries and integration patterns with the shared Platform and resolve cross\-team ambiguity with documented architectural decisions. (\~15%) * Define and communicate the multi\-year technical vision and roadmap for Residential mobile and services. Partner with Product, Design, Quality Engineering, Security, Platform, Firmware, and Data teams to translate strategy into architecture, scope and sequence cross\-team work, and report direction and progress to Engineering and Product leadership. (\~10%) * Lead design and architecture reviews. Establish standards, reference architectures, and reusable components that Residential teams adopt, and record decisions. (\~10%) * Drive performance, reliability, and observability across the client and the real\-time path. Define and instrument measures such as command latency, crash\-free rate, and connection success, and lead root cause analysis for high\-severity incidents and systemic regressions. (\~10%) * Mentor and coach Senior and Staff engineers through design feedback, reviews, and communities of practice, and participate in hiring. (\~5%) * Apply and champion AI\-assisted development practices across the Residential teams and evaluate emerging capabilities through hands\-on prototyping. (\~5%) * Comply with the security requirements set by the Information Security team and the ISO 27001 Security Roles, Responsibilities, and Authorities Document in the ISMS Document Library. * Comply with health and safety guidelines and keep Chamberlain Group information confidential. * Maintain professional and technical knowledge and contribute to team results and projects as needed. **Minimum Qualifications** **Education/Certifications** * Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * An advanced degree in a directly applicable area of study may substitute for up to two (2\) years of job\-related experience. **Experience** * 12\+ years of software engineering experience, with demonstrated progression to a Staff, Principal, or equivalent technical leadership role. * 5\+ years building and shipping production mobile applications (iOS, Android, or cross\-platform) used by consumers at scale. * Experience designing real\-time client\-to\-server systems, such as persistent connections, publish/subscribe or messaging protocols, push delivery, and state synchronization. * Experience designing and operating distributed systems and cloud services that serve large numbers of clients or connected devices. * Experience setting technical direction and making architectural decisions across multiple teams. * Experience creating technical documentation such as architecture diagrams, sequence diagrams, and API specifications, and setting documentation standards for others. **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** * Expert understanding of mobile architecture patterns, API design, and client performance optimization. * Strong grasp of reliability engineering for distributed systems, including failure modes, latency, consistency tradeoffs, and observability. * Ability to provide clear technical direction to multiple development teams across locations and to tailor communication to engineers, product leaders, and executives. * Ability to estimate work, support project plan creation, and report progress to functional management. **Other** * Ability to travel up to 10% of the time domestically and internationally. **Preferred Qualifications** **Education/Certifications** * Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. **Experience** * Experience with IoT, smart home, camera, or access control products, including device communication over BLE, Wi\-Fi, and cloud\-based control. * Production experience with both iOS and Android, or with a cross\-platform framework at scale. * Experience with video streaming, camera SDKs, or low\-latency media delivery. * Experience with messaging technologies such as MQTT, WebSockets, or equivalent, and with cloud platforms (AWS or Azure). * Experience designing SDKs, shared libraries, or frameworks used by multiple teams. * Experience working in a regulated or security\-sensitive domain, and with ISO 27001 practices. **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** * Experience applying AI\-assisted development tooling across a software organization. \#LI\-LN1 The pay range for this position is $159,490\.00 \- $267,742\.00; base pay offered may vary depending on a number of factors including, but not limited to, the position offered, location, education, training, and/or experience. jobs.description: **The application window is expected to close on:** 12/20/2026\. **NOTE:** Job posting may be removed earlier if the position is filled or if a sufficient number of applications are received. * This role is an onsite position located in Milpitas, CA. Though the team may offer hybrid days, the selected finalist will be expected to work onsite. The Common Hardware Group (CHG) creates innovative hardware platforms central to the AI era, powering Cisco’s core Switching, Routing, and Wireless products for organizations globally. Our innovations in silicon, optics, and hardware platforms—like Silicon One—are shaping the technology industry. We're a global team of creative experts, bringing our unique backgrounds and bold ideas to push boundaries and help each other grow. Because full product development—from design to qualification to production—is within our team, we’re able to think differently, experiment more, and work quickly. Join us to power the future of the digital world. Your Impact As a Diagnostics Development Manager, you will lead and mentor a talented hardware diagnostics team in a fast\-paced environment, fostering collaboration and helping engineers grow their technical and cross\-functional skills. In this role, you will drive the development of component\- and system\-level diagnostics using embedded software and firmware for Cisco Hyperscale, Core, and Edge routing products. Working across advanced technologies in system, board, FPGA, and ASIC designs, you will translate engineering and manufacturing requirements into clear design objectives. Additionally, you will oversee the creation and execution of detailed test plans, develop automated tools to validate diagnostics software, and support both engineering verification and manufacturing test processes. Partnering closely with hardware design, software development, and manufacturing teams, you will plan, schedule, and manage complex projects across global teams—shaping industry and technology trends to deliver high\-quality products and ensure a long\-term competitive advantage. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. jobs.title: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Offensive Security Analyst
jobs.description: **Discover your future at Citi** -------------------------------- Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact. **Job Overview** ---------------- **Why Citi** Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. As a bank with a brain and a soul, Citi creates economic value that is systemically responsible and in our clients’ best interests. As a financial institution that touches every region of the world and every sector that shapes your daily life, our Enterprise Operations \& Technology teams are charged with a mission that rivals any large tech company. Our technology solutions are the foundations of everything we do from keeping the bank safe, managing global resources, and providing the technical tools our workers need to be successful to designing our digital architecture and ensuring our platforms provide a first\-class customer experience. We reimagine client and partner experiences to deliver excellence through secure, reliable, and efficient services. Our commitment to diversity includes a workforce that represents the clients we serve from all walks of life, backgrounds, and origins. We foster an environment where the best people want to work. We value and demand respect for others, promote individuals based on merit, and ensure opportunities for personal development are widely available to all. Ideal candidates are innovators with well\-rounded backgrounds who bring their authentic selves to work and complement our culture of delivering results with pride. If you are a problem solver who seeks passion in your work, come join us. We’ll enable growth and progress together. **Why This Team** The Chief Information Security Office (CISO) is home to deeply talented colleagues that work to ensure the safety of Citi's clients', our revenue, our employees and our proprietary data. We manage information security as one end\-to end program – one with a clear mandate and accountability. Our mission is a program that is fully anchored to modern control and architectural frameworks, is fully aligned with the enterprise architecture of the firm and is deeply integrated into the businesses and functions. **About the Role** Citi's Offensive Security and Vulnerability Management (OSVM) team is hiring practitioners who can run security assessments against AI systems and use AI\-powered tools to make security testing faster and more effective. The AI Offensive Security Analyst is an operational role on a team that runs penetration tests, vulnerability assessments, and Red Team adversarial evaluations across Citi's application portfolio. The AI dimension is twofold: you'll test AI systems as a target, and you'll use AI tools as part of how you work. We're looking for someone to help build the tools from scratch and who knows how to get the most out of them, knows their limits, and can operate in an environment where the right approach isn't always obvious yet. **What Makes This Different** The problems we're solving don't have playbooks yet. * **AI\-driven vulnerability management.** When frontier models can generate thousands of findings in a weekend, the bottleneck shifts from discovery to triage, verification, and remediation. We're building the pipeline that makes this sustainable. * **Security architecture for the AI era.** Defining how a global bank deploys, monitors, and governs agentic AI — from standards and evaluation frameworks to production runtime monitoring. * **AI at scale, not in a lab.** Citi has deployed AI tools to 180,000\+ employees, equipped 30,000 developers with AI coding assistants, and is rolling out agentic AI capabilities firm wide. Securing that footprint and the platforms that underpin them is the job. * **Securing AI agents that can behave like insider threats.** Frontier models can harvest credentials, escape sandboxes, and adapt when they detect monitoring. We're designing the containment architectures and runtime controls to operate them safely at enterprise scale. * **Real security engineering.** This isn't a cyber seat where you'll spend your time in administration . You will be expected to understand the code, the architecture, the threats, and find solutions. You'll have the mandate and the backing to build something meaningful. * **Cyber Security Operations** — Detection, triage, and response for a world where adversaries use AI to find and exploit vulnerabilities faster than traditional detection can keep up. Behavioral * **Real and urgent.** Not an innovation lab. The threats are active, the work ships into production, and it protects one of the world's largest financial institutions. * **Technical teams.** These are engineering\-led functions. Small teams, high autonomy, minimal governance overhead. We build tools, ship code, and measure ourselves by what we deliver — not slide decks. * **Strong mandate.** Executive sponsorship to move fast. You'll have the backing and resources to act on what you find. * **Unique scope.** Very few organizations operate at this intersection at this scale. The solutions you build will influence how the industry responds. **Education** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. * Master’s degree preferred *The role sits within Citi's Offensive Security and Vulnerability Management (OSVM) organization, a team whose mission is to safeguard Citi's clients, partners, and business sectors by integrating an attacker's mindset across the technology lifecycle.* *We have multiple openings across various experience levels, from senior to principal, offering a dynamic environment for growth and impact. Location and compensation packages may be flexible and will be commensurate with experience and qualifications.* *This job description provides a high\-level review of the types of work performed. Other job\-related duties may be assigned as required.* **\#LI\-MC5** \- **Job Family Group:** --------------------- Technology \- **Job Family:** --------------- Information Security \- **Time Type:** -------------- Full time \- **Primary Location:** --------------------- Tampa Florida United States \- **Primary Location Full Time Salary Range:** -------------------------------------------- $87,280\.00 \- $212,160\.00 In addition to salary, Citi’s offerings may also include, for eligible employees, discretionary and formulaic incentive and retention awards. Citi offers competitive employee benefits, including: medical, dental \& vision coverage; 401(k); life, accident, and disability insurance; and wellness programs. Citi also offers paid time off packages, including planned time off (vacation), unplanned time off (sick leave), and paid holidays. For additional information regarding Citi employee benefits, please visit citibenefits.com. Available offerings may vary by jurisdiction, job level, and date of hire. \- **Most Relevant Skills** ------------------------ Please see the requirements listed above. \- **Other Relevant Skills** ------------------------- Agentic Design, AI Penetration Testing, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Cybersecurity, Large Language Models (LLMs), MITRE ATT\&CK Framework, OWASP Top 10, Penetration Testing. \- **Anticipated Posting Close Date:** ----------------------------------- Dec 31, 2026 \- **Automated Processing and AI** ------------------------------- We use automated processing, including artificial intelligence, for our legitimate business interests (or our reasonable and appropriate business purposes) to identify and align the candidate's skills and abilities with a specific job opening. Additionally, if you so choose, or consent, we can match your skills and abilities to other suitable roles at Citi. Importantly, all our hiring processes and decisions, including determining your suitability for a role, are conducted, checked, and decided by individuals. Our automated processing and AI do not involve relying on automatic or autonomous decision\-making. Please refer to any Jurisdictional Considerations, with specific provisions for your country (where relevant) for further details.
