jobs.title: Senior Staff GIS Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** With a workforce of over 25,000 people, and opportunities in more than 1,000 different job categories, the City of Philadelphia is the fifth largest city in the United States and one of the largest employers in Southeastern Pennsylvania. As an employer, the City of Philadelphia operates through the guiding principles of service, integrity, respect, accountability, collaboration, diversity and inclusion. Through these principles, we strive to effectively deliver services, to resolve the challenges facing our city, and to make Philadelphia a place where all our residents have the opportunity to reach their potential. The Office of Innovation \& Technology (OIT) is the central IT agency for the City of Philadelphia headed by the Chief Information Officer (CIO). OIT oversees all major information and communications technology initiatives for the City of Philadelphia \- increasing the effectiveness of the information technology infrastructure, where the services provided are advanced, optimized, and responsive to the needs of the City of Philadelphia’s businesses, residents, and visitors. OIT responsibilities include: identifying the most effective approach for implementing new information technology directions throughout city government; improving the value of the city’s technology assets and the return on the city’s technology investments; ensuring data security continuity; planning for continuing operations in the event of disruption of information technology or communications services; and supporting accountable, efficient and effective government across every city department, board, commission and agency. **Job Description** The Philadelphia Water Department (PWD) serves the greater Philadelphia region by providing integrated water, wastewater, and stormwater services. This position supports GIS operations and analytics of PWD, and reports to the GIS Manager. The Staff GIS Software Engineer is responsible for leading the design and development of internal GIS applications that support the design, operation, and maintenance of Philadelphia's drinking water, wastewater, and green stormwater infrastructure. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can own systems end\-to\-end, from architecture and data modeling through frontend implementation, deployment, and long\-term maintenance. You'll work at the intersection of GIS, software engineering, and database design, building tools that engineering and operations staff depend on every day. The bulk of the role is greenfield development of modern applications that replace aging systems, with the rest spent keeping existing tools reliable, automating GIS editing workflows, and investing in the development practices that make all of it sustainable. A core part of new application work is partnering directly with the many civil, environmental, mechanical, and electrical engineers across PWD to understand their work processes and design tools that fit what their needs. You'll work alongside a team of several GIS professionals and editors who maintain the datasets your applications display. **Essential Functions** * Developing new applications and API’s on modern tech stacks to replace legacy ones. Primarily with C\#, ASP.NET Core, and SQL Server for backend, and JavaScript/TypeScript, React and the Esri ArcGIS Maps SDK for frontend. * Design and maintain a document management system for over 340,000 georeferenced engineering drawings. * Maintaining legacy Visual Basic and ASP.NET Framework applications. * ArcGIS Pro Add\-in/extension development using C\# and the ArcGIS Pro .NET SDK to automate common workflows for GIS editors. * Implementing modern DevOps; CI/CD pipelines and other best practices to support application development, testing, and long\-term maintenance. * Direct collaboration with civil, environmental, mechanical, and electrical engineers, city planners, and field operations staff to gather requirements, validate designs, and iterate on tools that fit their needs. * Python GIS data processing and alerting scripts. * Directs the work of a junior level software engineer **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field. **Competencies, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** * Significant professional experience building and shipping production software, with strong full\-stack range across C\#/.NET on the backend and React \+ TypeScript on the frontend. * Demonstrated ability to design and build polished, maintainable frontend applications — component architecture, state management, type safety, and an eye for UX. * Experience with web mapping development using the Esri JavaScript API (or comparable mapping libraries) and a solid grasp of how spatial data flows from server to browser. * Deep familiarity with SQL Server, including schema design, performance tuning, and permissions. * Strong working knowledge of the Esri ArcGIS ecosystem and the data systems built around it. * Hands\-on experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and the practices around them — automated builds, deployments, environment promotion, and release management. * Comfort working directly with non\-developer subject matter experts (engineers, GIS editors, operations staff) to elicit requirements and shape the design of new applications. * Willingness to maintain and incrementally improve legacy systems — including older Visual Basic and ASP.NET Framework codebases — while charting a path toward replacing them. * A track record of making pragmatic architectural decisions and avoiding unnecessary complexity. * Strong communication skills, especially around documenting decisions and explaining tradeoffs to non\-developers. **Preferred Skills:** * ArcGIS Enterprise 10\.6 and later * Experience with ArcGIS Pro SDK development. * SQL Server * Windows Server, IIS 10 * Experience as a user of of ArcMap and ArcGIS Pro * Python experience, particularly for GIS data processing and ETL work. Background in utility, municipal, civil engineering, or infrastructure data systems. * **Additional Information** **Salary cannot exceed $110,000** **We’re interested in hiring the best possible candidate for the role. We recognize that experience, education, and qualifications can be attained in a variety of ways and that many skillsets are transferable. If you feel you’re a good fit, please don’t hesitate to apply.** **Please include:** * Resume * A cover letter **Please note: Applications will not be considered without a cover letter.** Did you know? * We are a Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program qualified employer : 25% tuition discount program for City employees (and sometimes spouses and dependents as well) in partnership with area colleges and universities * We offer Comprehensive health coverage for employees and their eligible dependents * Our wellness program offers eligibility into the discounted medical plan * Employees receive paid vacation, sick leave, and holidays * Generous retirement savings options are available **\*The successful candidate must be a city of Philadelphia resident within six months of hire** Effective May 22, 2023, vaccinations are **no longer required** for new employees that work in non\-medical, non\-emergency or patient facing positions with the City of Philadelphia. As a result, only employees in positions providing services that are patient\-facing medical care (ex: Nurses, doctors, emergency medical personnel), must be fully vaccinated. jobs.title: Software Technical Support Engineer II
jobs.description: **Position Overview** We are seeking a technically strong and customer\-focused Software Technical Support Engineer II to support Concepts NREC’s Agile suite of turbomachinery design and analysis software. The role combines practical turbomachinery engineering knowledge with software troubleshooting, customer engagement, technical communication, and product quality activities. The successful candidate will help customers apply the software effectively, investigate technical issues, communicate workable solutions, and provide structured feedback to our product development teams. This is a full\-time remote position based in India, reporting to the General Manager of CNIPL. The role involves regular interaction with customers and colleagues across global time zones and may require travel of up to 10%. **Key Responsibilities** **Customer and Software Technical Support** * Provide technical support for Concepts NREC’s Agile suite of turbomachinery design and analysis applications. * Respond to customer questions, investigate software errors and unexpected results, and guide users toward effective solutions. * Reproduce reported issues using representative models and workflows; collect relevant input files, settings, logs, and diagnostic information. * Troubleshoot application workflows involving geometry, mesh preparation, boundary conditions, solver settings, convergence, and post\-processing, as applicable to the product. * Manage support cases from initial assessment through resolution, documenting findings, workarounds, and follow\-up actions in the support tracking system. * Escalate complex or suspected software defects to the appropriate product development team with clear reproduction steps and supporting evidence. * Conduct remote customer meetings, screen\-sharing sessions, and technical discussions to resolve application\-related challenges. **Concepts NREC Application Support** * Develop working knowledge of Concepts NREC applications and their end\-to\-end turbomachinery workflows, including tools such as AxCent, Compal, Pumpal, Rital as relevant to assigned responsibilities. * Support users working across preliminary (1D/mean\-line) design, through\-flow analysis, and detailed 3D turbomachinery design and analysis workflows. * Assist customers with application of the software to axial, radial, and mixed\-flow turbomachinery, including compressors, turbines, and pumps. * Help users understand software inputs, modeling assumptions, design parameters, performance maps, and engineering outputs. * Where relevant, assist with interfaces and workflows involving third\-party CAE tools such as ANSYS CFX, ANSYS Fluent, Siemens tools, NUMECA, and OpenFOAM. **Customer Enablement and Technical Content** * Participate in software demonstrations, technical presentations, and pre\-sales or customer engagement activities. * Deliver customer training, workshops, and software demonstrations covering engineering concepts as well as practical application workflows. * Create and maintain clear technical resources, including user guides, tutorials, FAQs, knowledge\-base articles, presentations, case studies, and application notes. * Develop example models and demonstration cases that explain software capabilities, recommended workflows, and engineering best practices. * Translate recurring customer questions and support findings into reusable technical documentation and learning material. **Product Quality and Development Support** * Develop and maintain a structured library of representative turbomachinery design and analysis cases for product verification and regression testing. * Test beta, maintenance, and production releases; verify bug fixes and evaluate new or enhanced software functionality. * Check that application workflows produce consistent and technically reasonable results, documenting deviations and test outcomes. * Collect, organize, and communicate customer feedback, feature requests, and recurring usability issues to product management and development teams. * Assist with internal and customer software licensing requests and related technical coordination. * Monitor relevant industry developments and competing turbomachinery software capabilities to help identify customer needs and opportunities for improvement. Requirements * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related discipline. * A strong foundation in fluid mechanics, thermodynamics, turbomachinery, and engineering analysis. * Practical experience in CFD and/or FEA, with the ability to interpret simulation setup, results, and common sources of error. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, including the ability to investigate technical issues systematically. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to explain complex engineering and software topics clearly. * A customer\-oriented approach, strong ownership of assigned cases, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment. **Preferred Skills and Experience** * Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, preferably with a specialization in turbomachinery, CFD, or a related field. * Typically 2–4 years of relevant industrial experience in turbomachinery design, CFD, FEA, or engineering software support. * Hands\-on experience with Concepts NREC software applications, particularly AxCent, Compal, Pumpal, Rital. * Experience with turbomachinery design workflows from preliminary 1D/mean\-line design to detailed 3D design and analysis. * Experience designing or analyzing axial, radial, and mixed\-flow turbomachines, such as compressors, turbines, and pumps. * Working knowledge of commercial or open\-source CFD tools such as ANSYS CFX, ANSYS Fluent, Siemens software, NUMECA, or OpenFOAM. * Familiarity with CFD pre\-processing, mesh quality, boundary\-condition definition, solver setup, convergence assessment, and post\-processing. * Experience preparing technical content for engineering software users, including tutorials, training material, and application examples. * Knowledge of design optimization, scripting, or programming (for example Python, MATLAB, or similar tools). * Experience handling customer support cases, delivering technical training, or conducting software demonstrations. **What Success Looks Like in This Role** * Customers receive timely, technically sound, and clearly communicated support. * Reported issues are reproduced, documented, and routed efficiently, with useful feedback provided to development teams. * Training sessions and technical resources help customers use Concepts NREC applications confidently and effectively. * Regression and release testing is consistent, repeatable, and supported by well\-documented engineering test cases.

Together, we’re shaping how our brands create, publish, and connect with audiences worldwide, combining craft, technology, and collaboration to deliver quality at scale. **About Our Engineering Team** Our engineering team builds and evolves Verso, the shared front\-end platform powering more than 70 Condé Nast brand sites worldwide. We specialize in modern React architectures, performance\-optimized experiences, multi\-brand configuration systems, and flexible storytelling tools that enable teams to move fast while maintaining exceptional quality. We value craft. We value clarity. We value performance. We value governance. We believe that exceptional digital experiences require engineering, product and design working in lockstep. **About the role** Our brands are our USP. The expression of our iconic brands – from Vogue to the New Yorker – within their digital experiences is of utmost importance in our mission to create the best places to consume and interact with our brands. We’re hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build and evolve Verso, our shared publishing platform. Your work will focus primarily on React and TypeScript interfaces, with ownership extending into the Node.js runtime, data fetching, and service integrations that power them. You’ll take changes from technical discovery through delivery and production support. You’ll turn editorial and design needs into accessible, performant interfaces used across multiple brands and markets. This includes building shared components, supporting distinctive brand experiences through configuration, and improving the architecture that connects content to the page. You’ll collaborate closely with our Product Design Lead, editorial partners, and platform engineers to bridge design intent with production\-quality code. **Key Responsibilities \& Areas of Impact:** * Build and evolve the publishing platform + Build polished, high quality UI elements as React components with a strong focus on layout, typography and interactive fidelity. + Explain technical decisions and trade\-offs to Design, Product, and Editorial partners. Agree on delivery milestones, communicate progress, and raise risks early. + Utilize modern React and Typescript features. Familiarity with React 18\+, TypeScript, hooks, suspense, SSR concepts, and emerging RSC patterns are expected. + Write semantic, maintainable code with clear component and service boundaries. Use peer reviews to explain trade\-offs, incorporate feedback, and improve the solution.. Your s. Contribute to responsible AI practices, including appropriate handling of confidential data, copyright\-sensitive content, bias, attribution, human review, and brand/editorial integrity. + * Contribute to our Multi\-Tenant Application + Build shared components and configuration\-driven capabilities that support distinctive brand experiences across markets. + Make deliberate trade\-offs between reuse and brand\-specific needs, keeping exceptions explicit, testable, and maintainable. + Participate in design reviews, architectural discussions, and platform strategy. Set high standards for code quality, component architecture, performance best practices, and design fidelity + **What We’re Looking For (Experience \& Skills)** * 6\+ years of experience developing high\-quality production experiences using React and TypeScript. * Experience designing and consuming GraphQL APIs, including schemas, fragments, resolvers, schema evolution, and typed clients. * Experience building and maintaining Node.js applications or backend services, including API integrations and error handling. * Experience writing automated tests and diagnosing accessibility, rendering, and performance issues in production web applications. * Deep understanding of modern React (hooks, suspense, SSR/Hydration concepts). * Experience using logs, metrics, traces, and production evidence to diagnose root causes * Strong understanding of accessibility, usability, and inclusive design principles. * Curious mindset with a desire to learn, iterate, and push the platform forward. * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools such as coding assistants, chat\-based technical copilots, or AI\-supported documentation/search workflows. * Ability to prompt, critique, test, and refine AI\-generated outputs rather than accepting them unreviewed. * Awareness of responsible AI considerations, including privacy, security, intellectual property, accessibility, bias, and editorial trust. Curiosity about AI\-enabled product experiences and how they can support publishing, storytelling, personalization, discovery, or internal tooling. * **Nice to have** * Experience integrating AI\-powered features into web applications, such as streaming responses, prompt\-driven interfaces, semantic search, recommendations, summarization, or editorial assistance tools. * Familiarity with LLM APIs, embeddings, RAG patterns, evaluation workflows, or AI observability. Experience designing user interfaces for AI\-assisted workflows with clear feedback, confidence cues, human\-in\-the\-loop review, and graceful failure states. * You’ll thrive in this role if: * You enjoy following a problem across system boundaries, can balance immediate delivery with the health of a shared platform, and are comfortable owning a change from technical discovery through production operation. * Raise risks early, seek feedback, and help teammates make progress. Improve existing systems incrementally and choose carefully when a larger change is justified. * A note: research indicates that women and individuals from marginalised groups tend to apply only when they meet all of the criteria. You can update your resume or upload a cover letter at any time by accessing your candidate profile. ***Condé Nast is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, familial status and other legally protected characteristics.***

jobs.description: Houston, TX, US, 77019 About ContourGlobal **ContourGlobal** is a KKR\-backed next\-generation Independent Power Producer (IPP) operating across the United States, Latin America, Europe and Africa. Lead scoping and study results meetings, negotiate interconnection agreement terms, facility scopes, cost estimates, and milestones, and pursue technical and commercial solutions to reduce interconnection cost and schedule. * **Grid Analysis:** Manage consultants performing power flow, contingency, short\-circuit, deliverability screening, and headroom analyses to validate study results, evaluate alternatives, and support POI selection and project sizing. jobs.title: PTI - Research Associate - Mass Spectrometry
jobs.description: **Parallel Squared Technology Institute** (PTI) is a non\-profit research institute aiming to catalyze a leap in protein analysis technology and use it to explore new biological frontiers. PTI supports open research and educational opportunities supporting rapid career development for scientists, engineers, and mathematicians. **Why?** Protein dysfunctions directly cause many diseases, such as Alzheimer’s disease. Yet, proteins remain understudied because of technological hurdles. **How?** To resolve these limitations, PTI will develop mass tags enabling a new framework for multiplexed protein analysis by mass spectrometry towards achieving 100\-fold increase in throughput. Scientists at and collaborating with the institute will use these gains to directly investigate disease mechanisms and resolve problems that have proven intractable for decades. Our proof of principle technology and strategies are outlined at: parallelsq.org. PTI’s new approach requires synergy between a diverse team of chemists, machine learning engineers, biologists and mass spectrometrists. Alzheimer’s disease and aging will be among the first focuses of this technology\-driven research organization. **New career opportunities** Members of PTI will be supported with industry\-level resources to lead research projects and disseminate their discoveries and innovations to the broader biomedical community through frequent publications, presentations, and submissions to public data portals. **Summary of Position** We are looking for a Research Associate who is interested in mass spectrometry. This person will be working on maintaining MS instruments for running multitudes of samples for a variety of projects in addition to other responsibilities. **In order to be seriously considered for this position, we require a cover letter as part of the candidate's application.** ### **Responsibilities** * You will learn how to set up, operate and maintain mass spectrometers from multiple major vendors. * Protein and peptide sample preparation. * Analyze experimental data and interpret results for internal and public presentation. * Preparation of lab reagents and media. ### **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Biochemistry, or related field. Advanced degrees could be considered for a Senior RA position. * Basic proficiency with analytical chemistry assays or biochemistry techniques. * Demonstrated enthusiasm \& interest in analytical chemistry. * High level of initiative and flexibility, excellent communication and teamwork skills. * Attention to detail. * Good time management. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Familiarity with analytical techniques, mass spectrometry preferred. * Familiarity with liquid chromatography. * Sample preparation and purification methods. ### **Who Will Love This Job** * You are passionate about science and technology and are eager to work in a team environment. * You love learning new techniques, new technologies, and new concepts. * You want an environment that will support your future plans as a scientist or engineer. * You are committed to open science ideas and want to see your work disseminated broadly. ### **We Offer** * An opportunity to change the world and work with some of the smartest and the most talented experts from different fields. * Excellent medical, dental, and vision insurance with many $0 premium options for you and your family with several national and regional providers. Most employees have more than 20 plan options to choose from. * Company\-paid group life, AD\&D, long\- and short\-term disability insurance * 15 days PTO \+ 10 sick days per year * 18 company holidays \+ your birthday off * $5,000 per year educational reimbursement * Up to 16 weeks paid parental leave * Industry competitive salary We aim to help fill a structural gap in today's R\&D system. jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer- LSP
jobs.description: **Why p44LSP.ai?** At project44, we believe in better — and p44LSP.ai is what better looks like for the logistics service provider market. For years, project44 focused on global shippers as our core customer. That focus worked. Our Shipper business is a category leader growing 20% year\-over\-year. That strength is what makes the next chapter possible. Shippers and LSPs are fundamentally different businesses. Shippers buy logistics software to support their core operations. Logistics Service Providers — freight forwarders, brokers, and 3PLs — sell logistics as their product. Their software is their competitive edge. They buy fast, build on APIs and agents, and reward teams that ship in weeks, not quarters. This is why we created p44LSP.ai: a dedicated, AI\-native division built to serve the LSP market with the focus, speed, and resources it deserves. It's the scope and ownership of an AI startup, backed by the infrastructure of a $124M business — 259K carriers, billions of shipment outcomes, agents in production, and direct access to project44's data graph, carrier network, and enterprise relationships. This is a small, hand\-picked team operating across Chicago, San Francisco, Bangalore, and the EU. Flat org. Forward\-deployed engineering. AI coding tools across the workflow. Agents as the product surface. Customers who pilot in weeks and tell you what they think directly. The LSP market is moving fast. AI agent startups are growing 300%\+ year\-over\-year, and seven of eight sell to LSPs. We have the data position, the platform, the customers, and now the team. We're hiring the engineers who will build it with us. **AI at project44** We expect every project44 team member, regardless of role or function, to actively leverage AI in their day\-to\-day work. Whether you're building product, serving customers, managing people, or running operations, AI is a tool you're expected to use with intent, curiosity, and judgment. We don't expect everyone to be a data scientist. We do expect everyone to be an intelligent user of AI: able to identify where it adds value, direct it effectively, evaluate outputs critically, and govern it responsibly. We invest in our team's AI fluency because we believe it's a competitive advantage for every person at project44, not just our engineers If you’re driven to solve meaningful problems, leverage AI to scale rapidly, drive impact daily, and be part of a high\-performance team – we should talk. **The Role** Most engineers build for customers. FDEs build with them. You'll be embedded directly with high\-value LSP accounts — owning integration architecture, customizing agent workflows, and serving as the ground truth between how LSPs actually operate and how our product team thinks they do. Your job is to transform logistics from a reactive service into a programmable network — replacing manual workflows with autonomous agent\-to\-agent coordination. What you learn in the field shapes the roadmap. You ship in weeks, not quarters. **What You'll Work On** * Own end\-to\-end integration for dedicated LSP accounts — configure bi\-directional webhooks and event\-driven pipelines so AI agents can read, act, and write data into customer TMS, WMS, and ERP systems instantly * Unify disparate customer data into a single actionable signal — driving dynamic interoperability across core business systems * Customize interfaces and agent logic to fit existing LSP workflows across freight procurement, load tendering, and exception handling — reducing time\-to\-value and making adoption feel natural * Feed the right context to agents and debug decisions when they go wrong — tracing failures back to the specific data point, prompt, or tool use that caused them * Build event\-driven pipelines (Kafka/PubSub) that carry agent intent at the scale of millions of logistics events per day * Serve as the ground truth — we can't build a world\-class product in a silo. Your field observations directly inform what gets on the roadmap and when **What We're Looking For** **Qualifications** * 5\+ years in software engineering, solutions engineering, or technical implementation in a customer\-facing role * Mastery of API\-first design and bi\-directional webhook configuration * Experience with event\-driven architecture and stream processing (Kafka, PubSub, or similar) * Hands\-on integration experience with TMS, WMS, or ERP systems * Strong debugging skills across distributed, agent\-driven workflows * Deep domain knowledge in logistics — freight procurement, load tendering, carrier management, and exception handling. LSP customers don't trust engineers who don't understand their world. You need to speak their language to earn the right to change how they work. **Nice to Have** * Experience with agentic AI systems — context feeding, prompt engineering, tool invocation, stateful agents * Prior experience in a forward\-deployed or field engineering role * Containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) **How You Work** * You take ownership of outcomes, not just deliverables * You bring back what you see in the field and use it to make the product better * You move fast, iterate in the open, and don't wait for perfect conditions * You can translate technical complexity to both engineers and LSP operators without losing either audience **Work Authorization:** Candidates must be authorised to work in the US without current or future employer\-sponsored visa support. **In\-office Commitment:**Our office is where ideas spark, connections thrive, and innovation comes alive. We are looking for candidates who are enthusiastic and committed to joining our team on\-site, in our beautiful headquarters **3 days a week**. Together, we’re building something extraordinary—learn, grow, and thrive in our fast\-paced, transformative environment. **Diversity \& Inclusion** At project44, we're designing the future of how the world moves. As we work to deliver a truly world\-class product, we're intentionally building teams that reflect the unique communities we serve. We're focused on creating a company where all team members can bring their authentic selves to work every day. project44 is an equal opportunity employer. If you share our values and passion for the future of logistics, we'd love to review your application. Even if you don't meet 100% of the requirements, please consider applying — studies show you can still be a strong candidate at 50%. For any accommodation needed during the hiring process, please email recruiting@project44\.com.

jobs.title: Next Level Experience Designer
jobs.description: ### **Overview** Most websites and software make people think too much. Where do I click? What does this mean? How do I sign up? Our software works. That doesn’t mean it makes sense. Too many clicks, confusing workflows, and designs that make sense to the person who built them and no one else. We’re looking for someone who can take websites and software that technically do their jobs and make them dramatically better: clearer, simpler, faster, and easier for real people to use. From fixing frustrating workflows to turning curious website visitors into customers, you'll make every interaction feel more intuitive. You won’t spend your days debating button colors or making pretty pages just because they look cool. You’ll spend your days asking why there are twelve buttons in the first place, whether the message makes sense, and whether someone can figure out what to do next without a map. ### **Wage** $200,000 / year ### **Benefits** * 100% employer\-paid medical, dental \& visionFull coverage for employees — nothing comes out of your paycheck. Plus an annual review with a raise option. * Time off that grows with you22 days PTO \+ 4 holidays to start. After 3 years it bumps to 29 days, and after 5 years you move to flexible time off — not accrued, not capped. Take time off when you want. * Parental leave \& 401(k) matchPaid parental leave, plus up to 6% company 401(k) matching with no vesting period — it’s yours from day one. * Quarterly allowanceSpend it on whatever makes work better: a comfier remote setup, continuing\-education classes, a plant for your desk, coffee for a coworker, a massage for yourself… really, whatever. * No dumb perks (and a trail mix bar)No weekend dog\-walking gimmicks that look cool but cost nothing because nobody uses them. We spend on benefits you’ll actually use — an open\-concept office, friendly coworkers, a creative environment, and yeah… a trail mix bar. ### **Responsibilities** * Turn complicated software into experiences that feel obvious by finding unnecessary steps, confusing workflows, and friction everyone else has learned to tolerate. * Challenge assumptions about how our software should work, influencing what we build, how it works, and whether it should exist at all. * Raise the quality of our software through better thinking, not decoration, and push ideas beyond “good enough.” * Design websites and landing pages that are simple, clear, and useful. * Make it ridiculously easy for people to understand what we do and sign up. * Question confusing layouts, unnecessary steps, and design that exists just to look clever. ### **Requirements** * Learn our software, understand the problem, and take ownership of making it better. * Turn complicated workflows and information into experiences that feel simple and obvious without leaving out what matters. * Question anything that makes people stop, think, or give up during sign\-up. * Work directly with engineers, challenge ideas, and stay open to having your own ideas challenged. * Challenge designs and ideas, including your own, when they are not working. * Explain your thinking clearly and take feedback without getting weird about it. * Use feedback, testing, and failure to improve the work. Be willing to try, learn, adjust, and keep pushing until the experience is genuinely better. * Care more about whether the website works for real people than whether other designers think it looks cool. * We care more about what you can actually do than the size or name of the company you've worked for. You should be able to demonstrate your hands\-on design skills, walk us through your work, and explain the decisions behind it. ### **Next Level Experience Designer** Portland, OR If you’ve ever tried to cancel a subscription, find a buried setting, or sign up for something and thought, “Who designed this?” you’ll probably fit in here. You know simple things shouldn’t be so complicated. We want someone who spots those frustrations, calls out bad design, and makes things work the way people actually expect. Here, you get to turn those “there has to be a better way” moments into something better.

This is a Sr. Software Development Engineer (SDE) role in the CTIO team that delivers the cutting edge innovation for our sensor (lightweight agent) for Linux, Windows, and Mac OS platforms. Many features are also built in a way that they will have shared components across Linux, Windows, and MacOS. The team operates under the Agile development principles and ships frequently. complex model performance metrics, failure modes, and risk assessments into clear, actionable insights for R\&D leadership and engineering stakeholders. * **Drive Continuous Improvement:** Stay current with emerging LLM evaluation frameworks and industry best practices to continuously modernize our AI quality engineering processes. ### **Qualifications** * **Education:** Master’s degree in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Data Science, Computational Linguistics, or an equivalent technical discipline. * **Deep LLM Expertise:** Strong theoretical and practical understanding of Large Language Models, prompt engineering, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), agentic workflows, and common LLM failure modes. * **Test Automation Experience:** Proven ability to write clean, maintainable code (e.g., Python) to automate software testing, build evaluation pipelines, and integrate automated checks into CI/CD workflows. * **Exceptional Communication Skills:** Demonstrated ability to collaborate across diverse technical teams, clearly document test strategies, and present findings to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications** * Prior hands\-on experience in software quality engineering (QE/SDET), AI/ML model validation, or automated testing in a production R\&D environment. * Familiarity with modern LLM evaluation frameworks and tooling (e.g., DeepEval, RAGAS, LangSmith, PyTest, or custom benchmarking suites). * Academic or professional background in mechanical engineering, physics, CAD/CAE, or scientific simulation software. We are committed to fair employment practices and will evaluate all candidates based on their qualifications, regardless of past arrest or conviction history. **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- Dassault Systèmes offers an excellent salary with potential for bonus, commensurate with experience. Leveraging your deep experience in facility management and data center operations, you will lead process improvement initiatives, oversee technical implementation, and ensure that our critical systems consistently perform at the highest standards for our customers. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Lead Process Improvement: Develop, implement, and drive best practices, policies, and procedures to optimize facility operations and service delivery. * Technical Documentation: Draft and review Methods of Procedure (MOPs) and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure clarity, compliance, and effectiveness. * Project Implementation: Oversee and ensure timely, successful deployment of customer solutions, including preparation and allocation of space, power, and network resources. * Technical Presentations: Prepare and deliver technical presentations and status updates on facility systems to internal and external stakeholders. * Facilities Management: Oversee the technical and operational aspects of critical facility infrastructure, including power, HVAC, UPS, generators, and mechanical systems, ensuring optimal performance and swift response to incidents. * Reporting and Metrics: Produce and maintain monthly reports, operational metrics, and compliance documentation. * Customer Integration: Provide advanced technical support during customer integration to ensure seamless implementation of data center solutions. * Problem Resolution: Respond rapidly to and resolve facility issues to maintain 100% uptime and reliability. * Leadership: Supervise and mentor facility operations staff; jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: **The Opportunity:** -------------------- Data privacy has become one of the most strategic challenges facing modern enterprises — sitting at the intersection of AI governance, data operations, and customer trust. As companies adopt AI at scale, they need new ways to automate privacy and manage risk without slowing innovation. DataGrail has launched the first agentic privacy platform, and we're entering a pivotal phase of growth as we scale toward the next stage of the business. As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll be the technical lead for our Consent product, which shapes how people experience privacy on our customers' websites and apps. Reporting to the VP of engineering, you'll own Consent's architecture across a Ruby on Rails, React, and AWS stack and ship consent experiences that are fast, reliable, and easy for customers to deploy, and you'll help shape how our engineering team continues to advance adoption of AI tooling. Claude Code is part of how we work every day, and you'll set the workflows, standards, and guardrails that help the whole team move faster without lowering the bar on quality or security. In a year, you'll be able to point to products you helped launch and to an engineering practice you helped define. This is a chance to show what AI\-native engineering looks like at a company where getting trust and privacy right is the product. **What You'll Do:** ------------------- * Serve as technical advisor and architect for the Consent platform, setting the long\-term vision and reviewing significant design decisions across runtime, ingestion, analytics, web and mobile SDKs, supply\-chain controls, and regulatory frameworks like Google CMP and IAB TCF. * Set the architectural bar for how DataGrail exposes its platform to AI agents, from external tools like Claude, Codex, and Cursor to our own internal agents, owning authentication and authorization, agent\-facing tool patterns, safety annotations, observability, and rollback paths. * Drive solutions to complex, ambiguous problems that span multiple teams, establishing patterns and frameworks others can build on. * Build with Claude Code every day and set the standard for how the team plans, writes, tests, and reviews code with AI. * Establish shared AI engineering workflows, including project context files, reusable skills and commands, MCP integrations, and guardrails for security and sensitive data. * Mentor engineers through code reviews, design reviews, and pairing, helping them get more out of AI tools while keeping quality high. * Partner with your VP of Engineering and Product Manager to scope milestone\-based plans and lead delivery of new features. * Partner with Staff Engineers across teams to shape our engineering principles and technical direction. * Provide hands\-on guidance on the highest\-leverage problems and lead resolution of high\-severity issues as part of the on\-call rotation. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * Deep full stack experience building and operating production systems with Ruby on Rails, React with TypeScript, and Postgres or similar databases, including performant JavaScript that runs in the browser. * Hands\-on experience running services on AWS, with a strong grasp of scalability, reliability, and observability. * A track record of driving architecture for complex, cross\-team problems and seeing them through to delivery. * Daily, hands\-on experience shipping production code with Claude Code or a comparable agentic coding tool, and concrete examples of how it changed the way you work. * Experience building custom Claude Code skills, subagents, hooks, or MCP servers, or running AI agents in CI/CD. * Strong judgment about AI\-generated code, including how to give agents the right context, verify their output, and catch the correctness and security issues they introduce. * Experience raising the bar for a team through mentorship, technical standards, or tooling others adopted. * Clear written and verbal communication in a remote environment, including flagging cross\-team risks early and driving issues to resolution. ### **Bonus Points** * Familiarity with consent management, cookies and tracking technologies, or privacy regulations such as GDPR, CCPA, and CPRA. * Experience building LLM\-powered product features. * Familiarity with GitHub Actions and Terraform. * Experience with Python or similar languages. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- ### **Within 90 Days You'll:** * Ship your first Consent features end\-to\-end with Claude Code while learning our product, customers, architecture, and deployment process. * Bring cross\-domain universal consent to general availability. * Build cross\-device universal consent so every platform stays in sync and is treated as a first\-class experience. ### **Within 180 Days You'll:** * Lead the design and delivery of universal consent for TV and connected devices. * Reduce friction in how customers onboard and deploy Consent. * Build tooling and education that help engineers, Customer Success, and Solutions Architects self\-serve on Consent. * Help lead resolution of high\-severity issues as part of the on\-call rotation. ### **Within 365 Days You'll:** * Play a lead technical role in launching major new Consent capabilities. * Help grow AI tooling and adoption across the engineering team. * Mentor engineers and serve as the go\-to technical expert for Consent. Please note that the base compensation range below is a guideline and the final compensation will be based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, and competencies. Our compensation ranges apply to all US\-based job postings regardless of state. All full\-time regular employees are eligible for equity, health, dental \& vision insurance plans, remote\-first working environment, 401k savings plan, parental leave, wellness benefits, flexible time off, paid holidays, and a work from home stipend. Benefits are subject to change. Compensation Range $205,000 \- $240,000 USD **About Us:** ------------- DataGrail is the Agentic Data Privacy Platform. We help the world’s leading brands such as HubSpot, FanDuel, Dexcom, Major League Soccer, and Okta automate privacy and control risk with secure, human\-governed AI that scales. Powered by Vera, the complete privacy AI agent, and underpinned by an unrivaled 2,500\+ integrations and no\-compromise security architecture, DataGrail is built to solve complex privacy challenges that others can't. DataGrail is rated 4\.8/5 stars on G2 and is a two\-time recognized privacy leader by IDC. *DataGrail provides equal opportunities for everyone that works for us and everyone that applies to join our team, without regard to sex or gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, pregnancy, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, any service, past, present, or future, in the uniformed services of the United States (military or veteran status), or any other consideration protected by federal, state, or local law. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.*

jobs.title: Salesforce Agentforce for Life Sciences - Forward Deployed Engineer- Products and Platforms
jobs.description: **THE TEAM** The Innovation \& Delivery Transformation (I\&DT) team is building the future of Deloitte's business through new AI\-native platforms and products. The team is responsible for identifying, nurturing, scaling, and winning in new markets through new capabilities. Rather than relying on what the firm has historically done, I\&DT looks ahead and invests in areas where growth is expected three, five, and ten years into the future. This role is aligned to the Converge for Life Sciences portfolio, Deloitte's AI\-enabled platform portfolio for the modern life sciences enterprise. Converge by Deloitte combines proprietary data assets, advanced analytics, and AI\-driven decision intelligence to help pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical product organizations accelerate the pace of discovery, development, and commercialization, while improving compliance and operational visibility across the enterprise. This role is 100% dedicated to FastForward offering which is built on Salesforce Agentforce for Life Sciences and accelerates the enablement of commercial field operations for life science organizations. Recruiting for this role ends on 01/14/2027\. **WORK YOU'LL DO** We're seeking a Product Forward Deployed Engineer (pFDE) to own the full FastForward client lifecycle, from pre\-sales through implementation and into long\-term managed services. This is an experienced individual\-contributor role for someone who operates end to end: leading demo\-driven discovery, delivering implementations as the client's primary point of contact, and owning the post\-go\-live relationship. Day to day, the pFDE will have the following key responsibilities: **PRE\-SALES DISCOVERY \& SOLUTION SHAPING** * Lead demo\-driven discovery with prospective clients by managing FastForward demo environments, aligning capabilities to each prospect's commercial context. * Partner with the engagement lead on pursuit execution: sequencing milestones, handling technical objections, and contributing inputs to proposals and RFPs. **IMPLEMENTATION \& DEPLOYMENT** * Serve as the client's primary delivery lead through implementation, coordinating workstreams, managing client communication, and driving toward a clean go\-live. * Work with technical team to define the implementation design * Manage project scope, timeline, and risk, surfacing and resolving issues before they affect go\-live dates or the client relationship. * Brief the development team on what to build; review and sign off on their deliverables before work reaches the client. **PRODUCT FEEDBACK \& TEAM CONTRIBUTION** * Build reusable delivery assets \- implementation playbooks, demo scripts, and reference configurations that accelerate future engagements. * Contribute to the product group's shared knowledge base \- documenting implementation learnings, patterns, and approaches that scale across engagements. * Bridge field experience and the product organization \- translating client needs and market observations into structured insights, and contributing to go\-to\-market and solution positioning materials. **QUALIFICATIONS** **Required** * Bachelor's degree in Business, Life Sciences, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience * 4\+ years of consulting and/or life science industry experience with demonstrated client\-facing ownership across the full delivery lifecycle. * Experience with Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud, Health Cloud, Veeva CRM, or IQVIA OCE in a pharma commercial context. * Hands\-on technical experience configuring or building on Salesforce (administrator\-level configuration, flows, validation rules, and other declarative/point\-and\-click tools), sufficient to build and run product demonstrations without engineering support. * Experience presenting to technical and non\-technical audiences * Ability to travel 20\-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future. **Preferred** * Experience in life sciences or healthcare commercial technology environments (e.g., CRM, field engagement, patient services, or market access). * Experience with Salesforce Agentforce or comparable AI\-agent / GenAI capabilities embedded in enterprise applications. * Experience in post\-go\-live client success or managed services, including account cadences, adoption management, and feature backlog prioritization. * Familiarity with data loading, integration patterns, and CRM data models common to life sciences commercial operations, as well as CLI\-based deployment or configuration\-as\-code approaches. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $105,400\-$207,800\. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.description: **Why Digacore?** ================= We’re a fast\-paced, people\-first MSP with: * Real career growth * Autonomy to own projects and make decisions * A collaborative culture (we back each other up, no egos) * Paid certs, hybrid flexibility, and a leadership team that gets IT * Recognition as one of New Jersey’s Top Workplaces for 2026 **About the Role** Are you the engineer everyone calls when nobody else can fix it? This is a hands\-on Service role. Most of your time will be spent resolving live escalations and critical incidents, with opportunities for proactive improvements, mentoring, and occasional project support. Success means staying composed under pressure, knowing what to tackle first, pivoting quickly as priorities change, and communicating clearly to client stakeholders and Digacore leadership throughout. **What You’ll Do** * Own complex Level 3 escalations and escalations received from Service pods end to end: perform advanced troubleshooting, isolate root causes, coordinate necessary resources, implement sustainable fixes, and confirm resolution rather than passing issues along. * Lead critical, high\-visibility incidents, including full\-site outages, network disruptions, security\-related escalations, executive/VIP issues, and recurring failures, with calm judgment and urgency. * Continuously prioritize competing incidents by business impact, severity, affected users, and client commitments; switch context quickly without losing ownership, follow\-through, or documentation. * Provide timely, proactive updates to client contacts and ownership, account managers, Service leadership, and Digacore executives; clearly explain impact, actions taken, blockers, next steps, and realistic ETAs when available. * Troubleshoot complex networking issues across Layer 2/3, routing, switching, VLANs, VPNs, wireless, ISP connectivity, IP conflicts, and loops; use CLI and packet analysis as appropriate, including SonicWall/Fortinet and UniFi/Meraki/Aruba environments. * Diagnose Microsoft 365, Exchange Online mail flow, Entra ID, conditional access, Intune/Autopilot, endpoint management, and Azure infrastructure issues. * Resolve Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS/DHCP, virtualization (VMware/Hyper\-V), and Azure Virtual Desktop performance, profile, and availability issues. * Use ConnectWise Manage and RMM to track active work, maintain accurate ticket notes, and ensure important follow\-ups are not missed; maintain clear, reusable documentation in IT Glue. * Mentor L1/L2 and other service technicians through live troubleshooting, escalation coaching, and knowledge sharing; proactively help others solve issues before they become major escalations. * Identify patterns in repeat incidents, monitoring gaps, aging infrastructure, and systemic risks; partner with Proactive Support, Security, and account teams to prevent future disruptions. * Collaborate with Projects and other departments on complex cross\-team incidents, technical assessments, or occasional implementation support without losing primary Service responsibilities. **What You Bring** * 8\+ years in an MSP or high\-volume IT support environment, including substantial hands\-on experience resolving complex Level 3 issues and escalations from service teams rather than primarily project delivery or presales. * Broad technical depth and strong diagnostic skills across networks, Microsoft 365/Entra ID, Windows Server/AD, Azure, virtualization, endpoints, and security\-related issues; ability to work through unfamiliar technologies methodically. * Strong Layer 2/3 networking fundamentals, CLI troubleshooting, switching, firewalls, routing, VLANs, DNS/DHCP, VPNs, and wireless; experience with SonicWall or Fortinet and UniFi, Meraki, or Aruba. * Experience with Exchange Online, Microsoft 365, conditional access, Intune/Endpoint Manager, and Windows Server; practical experience with VMware or Hyper\-V. * Excellent prioritization and multitasking in a fast\-paced environment; ability to pivot between urgent situations, handle stress, and remain effective when executives and clients are watching closely. * Independent technical judgment, persistence, and full ownership of outcomes when no higher internal escalation resource is available. * Clear, timely communication to technical teams, nontechnical client ownership, and internal leadership—including during uncertainty or extended incidents. * Strong ticket hygiene, documentation, and collaboration; experience with ConnectWise Manage/RMM or comparable PSA/RMM tools. * Proactive mindset and willingness to mentor junior engineers, share knowledge, and strengthen the broader Service organization. **Nice to Have** * Azure Virtual Desktop, Nerdio, and FSLogix experience; PowerShell scripting and automation. * CCNA/CCNP, AZ\-104/AZ\-305, or relevant security certifications; Wireshark and packet\-capture analysis. * Healthcare/HIPAA environment experience; server/workstation hardening, cloud security, and infrastructure assessments. * Ability to prepare technical scopes or Statements of Work (SOWs), review designs, and advise on solutions when requested—not a core requirement. **Benefits:** ============= * Nationwide medical insurance. * Dental insurance. * Life insurance gifted to all employees. * Long\-term disability insurance gifted to all employees. * FSA and HSA options. * Generous paid time off. * Mental health days * $500 sign on bonus * Paid certification assistance **We are an Equal Opportunity Employer!** Compensation Range: $95K \- $110K

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Engineer
jobs.description: **Summary of Position:** Digital Check Corp. is the world's leading manufacturer of check scanners and a technology company that provides world\-class solutions in check processing, microfilm reading/conversion, and cash handling automation software. As the Cybersecurity Engineer, you will serve as the hands\-on technical security resource for the enterprise, owning the design, implementation, automation, and continuous improvement of security controls across identity, endpoint, cloud, network, and Microsoft 365 environments. administrative activity, insider\-risk events, and data\-loss scenarios. * Develop and maintain KQL queries, analytic rules, workbooks, automation, and PowerShell tooling to improve detection, triage, investigation, and response. * Own vulnerability\-management workflows from identification and risk prioritization through remediation validation and management reporting. * Perform threat hunting using endpoint, identity, network, cloud, and application telemetry; identify detection gaps and engineer new controls to close them. * Lead or coordinate penetration testing, red\-team exercises, and remediation of identified weaknesses. **Identity, Endpoint, Cloud, and Network Security*** Engineer and maintain Conditional Access, MFA, privileged access, least\-privilege, and identity\-governance controls using Microsoft Entra ID and Privileged Identity Management (PIM). * Engineer endpoint security baselines and protection policies using Microsoft Defender and Microsoft Intune, and validate control effectiveness across managed endpoints. * Review and improve network segmentation, firewall policies, secure remote access, SSO, and authentication architecture. * Assess cloud and SaaS security configurations and work with system owners to remediate misconfigurations and control gaps. * Design secure technical patterns and provide security architecture review for new infrastructure, applications, integrations, and significant technology changes. **Incident Response and Security Assurance*** Act as a technical lead during security incidents, coordinating evidence collection, containment, eradication, recovery, root\-cause analysis, and post\-incident improvements. * Build and maintain incident\-response playbooks for compromised accounts, password spraying, malicious administrative activity, malware, data exfiltration, and lost or stolen devices. * Preserve investigation evidence and maintain clear incident documentation suitable for leadership, auditors, Legal, and external security partners. * Partner with IT and engineering teams on remediation activities and verify that corrective actions are completed and effective. **Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC)*** Serve as a technical control owner and subject\-matter expert for SOC 2 Type 2 and related security assurance activities. * Gather and validate control evidence, identify control deficiencies, and implement technical remediation rather than limiting the role to audit coordination. * Perform security reviews of vendors and technology partners, assess technical risk, document findings, and track remediation or compensating controls. * Complete vendor security questionnaires and perform risk\-based due diligence for new and existing third\-party vendors and technology partners; document findings and track remediation or compensating controls. * Complete security questionnaires and evidence requests supporting prospective and ongoing customer due diligence, coordinating accurate and consistent responses with Legal, Sales, Product, IT, and other control owners. * Create and maintain security standards, procedures, architecture guidance, metrics, and operational dashboards for leadership. * Review, update, and maintain information security policies, standards, procedures, architecture guidance, and supporting documentation so they remain aligned with business practices, contractual commitments, and applicable control frameworks. * Advance data\-protection controls, including Microsoft Purview DLP and safeguards governing enterprise use of AI tools and sensitive information. * Serve as an active member of th ing, and recommend improvements based on campaign and incident trends. * Translate security risk into clear technical and business terms for leadership and recommend prioritized, practical remediation plans. * Continuously evaluate the effectiveness of security controls using measurable outcomes, testing, and operational metrics. * Identify opportunities to automate repetitive security operations and reduce dependence on manual monitoring and review. **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required:****Required Skills \& Experience*** 5\+ years of progressive cybersecurity experience, with substantial hands\-on responsibility for security engineering, incident response, security operations, or cloud/identity security. * Demonstrated experience administering and engineering controls in Microsoft security environments, including Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Entra ID/Conditional Access, Microsoft Purview DLP, and Microsoft Intune. * Advanced working knowledge of identity security, MFA, SSO, privileged access, least privilege, Zero Trust, endpoint protection, and common attack techniques. * Strong KQL and PowerShell skills with experience using automation to improve security operations and control reliability. * Hands\-on experience investigating security events across endpoint, identity, network, cloud, and SaaS data sources and leading incidents through remediation. * Experience with vulnerability management, penetration\-test findings, remediation validation, network segmentation, firewall policy, and secure configuration practices. * Working knowledge of security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CIS Controls, and ISO 27001\. * Experience completing vendor or customer security questionnaires, collecting evidence, documenting control narratives, and coordinating responses across multiple stakeholders. * Experience maintaining security policies, standards, procedures, and governance documentation, including periodic review and approval practices. * Experience administering phishing simulations or security awareness training platforms and using results to improve program effectiveness. * Ability to independently prioritize work, document decisions, own technical outcomes, and communicate effectively with technical teams, leadership, auditors, Legal, and vendors. **Preferred Qualifications:*** Relevant \-level certifications such as CISSP, Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC\-100\), Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC\-200\), GIAC certifications, or comparable credentials. * Experience securing technology environments that handle financial, payment\-related, customer\-confidential, or proprietary information. * Experience supporting SOC 2 audits and translating audit/control requirements into implemented technical safeguards. * Experience with Secure SDLC, application security, cloud security, or DevSecOps practices is a plus. **Personal Skills and Competencies:*** Strong ownership mentality and ability to move security issues from discovery to verified resolution without requiring continual direction. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risk and recommended actions to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Calm, disciplined judgment during incidents and investigations, with appropriate handling of sensitive and confidential information. * Ability to balance security rigor with practical business and operational requirements. **Customer Base:*** Financial organizations and retailers The above is not intended to be an all\-inclusive list of the duties and responsibilities of the job described, nor is it intended to be an exhaustive list of the skills and abilities required to do the job. Rather, it is intended only to describe the general nature of the job. Employees may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed.

jobs.title: Transmission Engineer - Underground
jobs.description: **Job Title:** ============== Transmission Engineer \- Underground**Location:** ============= Charlotte, NC**Job Summary and Description:** ================================ The Transmission Engineer – Underground is classified as a Technical Leader. The Transmission Engineer\- Underground will provide subject matter expertise and technical leadership for EPRI research focused on extruded and laminar dielectric cables and accessories across the full asset lifecycle, including design, operation, maintenance, aging, diagnostics, reliability, and end\-of\-life considerations. The Transmission Engineer \- Underground is intended for an experienced underground transmission professional who can independently lead technical work, shape research direction, engage member utilities and industry partners, and translate complex technical findings into actionable guidance for the electric power industry. **The Ideal Transmission Engineer – Underground will be/have:** * An experienced underground transmission professional with practical knowledge of cable systems and the ability to connect field challenges with research\-based solutions. * Comfortable serving as a technical lead rather than an entry\-level contributor, with the ability to work independently and guide others. * Credibility with utility members and industry stakeholders, with strong judgment, collaboration skills, and a service\-oriented approach to research delivery. * Ability to translate complex technical details into concise reports, presentations, recommendations, and guidance that can inform real\-world utility decisions. * Be curious, collaborative, and proactive in identifying emerging research needs and advancing EPRI’s leadership in underground transmission systems. **As the Transmission Engineer – Underground you will:** * Lead and contribute to applied research projects addressing underground transmission cable systems, accessories, ratings, installation practices, condition assessment, aging mechanisms, and reliability performance. * Provide technical direction to project teams, contractors, and collaborating researchers to ensure research activities are technically sound, aligned with member needs, and delivered with high\-quality outputs. * Develop and review technical reports, research summaries, presentations, specifications, guidance documents, and member\-facing deliverables related to underground transmission assets. * Analyze technical data, field experience, inspection results, testing outcomes, and forensic findings to identify practical insights and recommendations for utilities. * Engage directly with EPRI members, utilities, manufacturers, laboratories, and other industry stakeholders to identify research needs, communicate results, and support adoption of research outcomes. * Serve as a recognized technical resource within EPRI for underground transmission topics and support knowledge transfer to internal staff, early\-career engineers, and external stakeholders. * Support project planning, scoping, proposal development, budget inputs, milestone tracking, and technical quality review for underground transmission research activities. * Monitor industry developments, standards, emerging technologies, and utility practices relevant to underground transmission cable systems and incorporate findings into EPRI research strategy. **Education, Experience \& Technical Knowledge:** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related technical field required; master’s degree or Ph.D. preferred. * 7\-10\+ years of relevant experience in power transmission, with demonstrated experience in underground transmission cable systems strongly preferred. * Strong technical understanding of underground transmission cable design, installation, operation, maintenance, diagnostics, condition assessment, aging, failure analysis, and/or end\-of\-life planning. * Experience working with utilities, manufacturers, laboratories, consultants, or research organizations on underground transmission or related high\-voltage infrastructure topics. * Ability to analyze technical information, interpret data, synthesize industry practices, and develop clear written recommendations. * Strong communication skills, including the ability to present technical information to technical and non\-technical audiences, facilitate member discussions, and represent EPRI in industry forums. * Experience leading or managing technical projects, coordinating cross\-functional contributors, and delivering research outputs against defined objectives and timelines preferred. **Additional Information** This Transmission Engineer \- Underground offers the opportunity to influence industry research and technical guidance for underground transmission systems used by utilities, manufacturers, and grid stakeholders worldwide. The role is well suited for an experienced technical professional who can bring underground transmission expertise, research leadership, and member\-facing credibility to EPRI’s applied research portfolio. **About the Program:** EPRI’s Underground Transmission Program assists utilities in resolving complex challenges related to the design, construction, installation, operation, inspection, maintenance, and lifecycle management of underground transmission systems. Cross\-cutting research addresses topics such as design calculations, cable ratings, construction and installation methods, inspection technologies, forensic analyses, and technical guidance for utility stakeholders. The salary range for this position is $120,000 USD to $127,500 USD annually. This salary range is an estimate, and the actual salary may vary based on various factors, including without limitation applicant's education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on applicant's geographic location. This role is eligible to participate in EPRI’s annual incentive program. The amount of incentive varies and is subject to the terms and conditions of the plan. This role is eligible to participate in EPRI’s standard employee benefit programs, which currently include the following: medical, dental, vision, 401k, STD/LTD and paid family leave, life and accident insurance, paid time off (flexible vacation, sick leave, and holiday pay). EPRI participates in E\-Verify, an online system operated jointly by the Department of Homeland Security and the Social Security Administration (SSA). EPRI uses the system to check the work status of new hires by comparing information from the employee's I\-9 form against SSA and Department of Homeland Security databases. jobs.description: Interested in joining a growing company where you will work with talented colleagues, enhance a supportive and energetic culture, and be part of the climate solution? At Energy Solutions, we focus on the big impacts. And we believe that market\-based programs can be a powerful force to deliver large\-scale energy, carbon, and water\-use savings. Since 1995, we've harnessed that power to offer proven, performance\-based solutions for our utility, government, and institutional customers. Energy Solutions is seeking a **Software Engineer II** to join our team and help build software that makes an impact. In this role, you'll develop full\-stack features, integrations, and application enhancements that support reliable, scalable, and secure solutions. You'll collaborate with engineering, product, QA, project, and business partners to turn requirements into high\-quality functionality, solve technical challenges, and keep projects moving forward. This is a great opportunity for a developer who enjoys taking ownership, solving problems, and growing alongside an experienced engineering team. **This is a hybrid work opportunity. ES has offices in Oakland, CA; Orange, CA; New York, NY; Portland, OR; Chicago, IL; and Boston, MA.** **Responsibilities include but are not limited to:** * Deliver defined software features, environment * Experience delivering assigned software functionality and working across requirements, design, coding, testing, deployment, and maintenance activities * Experience collaborating with and business stakeholders * Ability to prioritize multiple assignments and deliver work within established quality, schedule, security, and documentation expectations * Ability to handle confidential or sensitive business data in accordance with established security, privacy, and access requirements **The salary range for this role is $100,000 \- $115,000/annually with a target compensation of $100,000 \- $109,250 based on experience and qualifications.** Compensation is commensurate with experience and includes a generous retirement package. Energy Solutions provides an excellent benefits package including medical, dental and vision insurance, other pre\-tax contribution plans and an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). **AI Use** At Energy Solutions we believe in the importance of authentic interactions and equitable opportunities. Employees who reside within 40 miles of an office (except New York) will be assigned to that location, though in\-office attendance requirements may vary by team.
