jobs.title: Sr. 3D C++ Software Engineer
jobs.description: United States of America, California, Pomona R5026291 United States of America Engineering **Job description** **About the Team:** The software team is part of the Global Manufacturing Engineering (GME). Alongside GME's Hardware Controls, Manufacturing Process, and Automated Quality Control teams, we build the geometrical compiler behind Spark™ Clear Aligners: the math\-heavy software stack that turns digital treatment intent into physical parts at production scale. Our systems decide how geometry gets transformed, nested, validated, and translated into instructions that run across a global factory footprint producing more than 100,000 unique parts per day. This is not generic application development. Our code drives scanners, printers, mills, and other fab equipment. Physical reality is the unit test. When the math is wrong, parts are wrong. **Job Summary:** We are hiring a Sr. 3D C\+\+ Software Engineer who is genuinely strong in applied math, understands the physics behind manufactured parts and processes, and can turn that reasoning into production\-grade C\+\+. You will work on the core algorithms and services that bridge CAD to CAM: geometry processing, numerical optimization, physical constraint modeling, and the software interfaces that let those models run reliably in production. You should be comfortable moving from formulating a problem from first principles to shipping the implementation without handholding. If deriving a normal from three points on a triangle, reasoning about numerical stability, or solving a nonlinear equation numerically feels outside your daily toolkit, this is likely not the right role. At this production volume, a solver running at 99\.9% reliability still generates roughly 100 support escalations per day. Correctness isn't a quality bar — it's a throughput constraint. This is a full\-time and on\-site five days/week engineering role in Pomona, CA. Rapid development here depends on being next to the hardware and the people using it. You will work directly with R\&D equipment such as scanners, 3D printers, CNC systems, and metrology tools, shortening the loop between idea, code, experiment, measurement, and revision from weeks to days. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** * Build the mathematical core: Formulate, design, and implement algorithms for 3D geometry processing, numerical optimization, spatial reasoning, and CAD/CAM translation in a production manufacturing environment. * Model physical constraints in software: Turn real\-world process behavior, machine limits, material effects, and measurement data into robust computational models that survive contact with actual hardware. * Write expert\-level C\+\+: Develop high\-performance, maintainable C\+\+20 systems for compute\-heavy workloads where correctness, numerical robustness, and runtime behavior all matter. * Prototype with purpose: Use Python, NumPy, SciPy, and related tools when they speed up discovery, then harden the right ideas into production services. * Run tight hardware\-software loops: Work side by side with R\&D and Operations to test algorithms on equipment, inspect outputs, understand failure modes, and iterate quickly based on measured results. * Ship math in real systems: Package algorithms behind gRPC and Protobuf interfaces, operate within Bazel\- and Conan\-based builds, and make sound choices about how compute\-heavy services run in Docker and AWS Kubernetes environments. * Any duties or tasks assigned by Manager. **Examples of the Work:** * Detect geometry with no downward path to the build plate and automatically generate support structures that prevent mid\-print failure — without adding unnecessary material or obstructing neighboring parts. * Given a hollow 3D\-printed part with non\-uniform structural loading, compute the wall thickness profile it actually needs — then implement the custom offset surface that produces it. * Register a 3D scan of a printed mold against its digital blueprint, segment the surface into regions by structural importance, and produce a localized devtaion map that flags quality failures at production scale. * Given a 5\-axis CNC toolpath, find the velocity profile that keeps every drive within its speed and acceleration limits without unnecessarily slowing the overall cut. **Job requirements** **Basic Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of professional software development experience, including substantial work in large modern C\+\+ codebases. * Deep fluency in 3D geometry, linear algebra, numerical methods, and optimization. You should be able to reason from first principles. * Experience in the physics that sit underneath geometric or manufacturing problems, with the judgment to translate continuous models into stable discrete implementations. * Demonstrated ability to formulate and implement mathematically demanding algorithms in production\-quality C\+\+ wit ies (Envista) will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate. Envista will consider unsolicited referrals and/or resumes submitted by vendors such as search firms, staffing agencies, professional recruiters, fee\-based referral services and recruiting agencies (Agency) to have been referred by the Agency free of charge and Envista will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt such unsolicited resumes. An Agency must obtain advance written approval from Envista's internal Talent Acquisition or Human Resources team to submit resumes, and then only in conjunction with a valid fully\-executed contract approved by the Global Talent Acquisition leader and in response to a specific job opening. Envista will not pay a fee to any Agency that does not have such agreement and written approval in place. Depending on location, our life and disability programs offer valuable financial security and added peace of mind during unexpected life events. **Paid Time Off** We know that time away from work is essential for rest, balance, and personal priorities. jobs.title: AI Velocity Head of Engineering
jobs.description: **About this opportunity:** --------------------------- Ericsson is seeking an experienced AI Velocity Head of Engineering to help shape how Ericsson Americas works, delivers and competes in an AI\-enabled future. Our AI Velocity vision is clear: combine trusted data, shared platforms and human expertise to simplify operations, accelerate innovation and create intelligent offerings. We are seeking an experienced AI Velocity Head of Engineering to turn that ambition into coordinated execution and measurable business value across sales, delivery and common functions. Based in Plano, Texas, this senior leader reports to the Head of Commercial Management \& AI Velocity, a member of the Americas Leadership Team. You will lead a team of AI engineers responsible for transformation projects in the AI Velocity Program and a prioritized set of AI uses cases across Americas. You will establish the criteria for business focused prioritization based upon the best return on investment and advancement of the organization. This is an exciting opportunity to drive measurable impact for the Americas with value adding AI agents and assets for both cost efficiency and new areas to monetize. Your leadership will come through expertise, trusted relationships and influence across organizational boundaries. **What You Will Do** -------------------- * **Lead a team of high impact engineers**. This role would include leading a team of high performing AI engineers who would be developing new AI capabilities based upon prioritized projects. Spend majority of their time leading squads technically, building reference implementations and shared components that others build upon. * **Develop** agents, write code when applicable and can credibly review team’s work with credibility. * **Continuously prioritize AI development based upon current criteria and impact to the business**. The leader would establish the key criteria to establish prioritization of AI development to ensure measurable business impact is achieved. These criteria would be assessed and updated as needed. * **Deliver impact through agents and future AI capabilities**. Today, the team would focus on business impacting agents. As AI evolves, the engineers would learn the next AI paradigm to develop new AI assets such as multi\-agent Swarm or self evolving AI. Work with business and technology leaders to assess new opportunities and recommend which initiatives to advance, scale, reshape or stop based on value, feasibility and strategic fit. * **Design Authority**. This role would also ensure consistency across our AI agents and capabilities. Communicate standardized AI best practices. Reuse and promote high use agents on respective platforms * **Make business value measurable**. Partner with AI Velocity Program Director and business owners to establish baselines, success measures and benefits tracking, validating outcomes such as productivity, cost efficiency, delivery quality, and customer impact for overall Return on Investment. * Enable **secure, responsible, and compliant AI usage**. * Maintain the **highest level of AI competency** amongst the engineering team, to shape upskilling and anticipate the technical competencies needed to develop present and future AI assets **The Skills You Bring** ------------------------ * A demonstrated track record of delivering high impact business results. * Experience taking AI initiatives from business case through implementation and value realization, with a practical understanding of what enables successful adoption at scale. * Strong Leadership experience with direct reports or cross functional teams. * Critical thinking and gap resolution * Commercial and financial judgment to evaluate AI project proposals and business cases. * Executive presence and concise communication, with the ability to turn complex information into clear recommendations and lead discussions that result in decisions and action. * Proven ability to mobilize teams and influence senior stakeholders without direct reporting authority, including navigating competing priorities and holding owners accountable for commitments. * Platform and architecture depth: Working knowledge of enterprise AI and data platforms, including AWS, Azure, Snowflake, etc. with the ability to evaluate architecture options, integration, security, scalability and cost * Ability to write code in Python and the current agent and orchestration frameworks; comfortable in enterprise cloud environments. * The curiosity to challenge established ways of working, the judgment to navigate ambiguity and the persistence to turn ambitious goals into sustained results. **Education Requirements** -------------------------- * Bachelors of Science or Masters of Science in Mathematics, Computer Science, AI. Data Scientists considered **Notice:** ----------- Ericsson Inc. does not sponsor U.S work authorizations for this job position including U.S. immigration filings for initial and/or change of employer paperwork for H\-1's, H\-1B1's, E\-3's, O\-1's, and TN's. Ericsson also does not hire F\-1's working on CPT or EAD for this position. **Why join Ericsson?** At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next. **What happens once you apply?** Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like. Ericsson uses a merit\-based hiring approach that values people with different experiences, perspectives and skillsets. We truly believe this approach drives innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer, learn more. If you need assistance or to request an accommodation due to a disability, please contact Ericsson at hr.direct.americas@ericsson.com. **DISCLAIMER:** The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees in this position. They are not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required for this position, and you may be required to perform additional job tasks as assigned. **Primary country and city:** United States (US) \|\| Plano (Country/ City) **Job details:** Data Scientist

jobs.title: Healthcare Software Developer
jobs.description: Job Description Eventium is seeking a skilled and motivated Healthcare Software Developer to support the development, integration, and improvement of healthcare technology solutions. The ideal candidate will have experience in software engineering, healthcare applications, database development, and clinical information systems. In this role, you will contribute to software solutions that support clinical decision\-making, patient education, healthcare data management, and standardized care planning. Redesign the app tomorrow and the service does not change. The second is a personalization flywheel. It is a closed loop where ideas are generated, pre\-tested, run as live experiments, and analyzed, and each result feeds the next round. Today most good ideas never get tested because experiment capacity is scarce and analysis is slow. You will own the products that change that. Working closely with the Director of Data Product, you will drive requirements, prioritization, and delivery across customer understanding, ranking, serving, and experimentation. You will partner daily with data science, ML Platform, ML engineering, product analytics, and product managers in every business unit to turn a fast\-moving, cross\-functional program into shipped, measurable results. This is a high\-visibility role tied directly to our "One App, One Customer" data strategy, our 2027 OKRs, and customer engagement, retention, and revenue. In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs. THE GAME PLAN Everyone on our team has a part to play * Own the backlog and delivery for one personalization product area, such as experimentation tooling or ranking inputs, and deliver it in small, shippable releases. * Work with the Director of Data Product and senior PMs to shape the personalization roadmap, recommending priorities and trade\-offs based on customer data and experiment results. * Translate broader program goals into clear problem statements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineering and data science can plan against. * Partner with data science and ML engineering on recommendation and ranking approaches, asking questions about accuracy, latency, and cost, and turning their input into product requirements. * Work with product analytics and the experimentation platform team to define hypotheses, success and guardrail metrics, and test readouts for your area, and share what you learn with the team. * Support responsible gaming, privacy, and compliance requirements in your area by working with Legal, Compliance, and Responsible Gaming, and escalate open questions early. * Give status updates to your pod and key stakeholders, flagging risks and blockers early so issues are resolved before they affect delivery. * Escalate cross\-team conflicts and decisions outside your remit to the Director, and bring a recommendation with each escalation. * Seek and act on feedback from your manager, peers, and partners, and share knowledge with other PMs in the Product Management community. * Contribute to other Data Product initiatives as priorities evolve, keeping focus on a small number of priorities rather than parallel work. THE STATS What we're looking for in our next teammate * 3\+ years of experience as a Product Manager or Product Owner on personalization, recommendation, search, ranking, experimentation, or other data or ML\-powered products, with a record of shipping and measuring results. * Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Business, or related) or equivalent industry experience. A Master's degree is a plus. * Working knowledge of how recommender and ranking systems work (collaborative filtering, learning\-to\-rank, embeddings, or similar), enough to engage credibly with data scientists and ML engineers on accuracy, latency, and cost. * Exposure to personalization across varied content types (commerce, media, gaming, social feeds, payments), including cold\-start and cross\-sell, is a strong plus. * Hands\-on experimentation experience. You have designed and run A/B tests, chosen primary and guardrail metrics, and read results carefully. You know common traps such as peeking, underpowered tests, and novelty effects. * Hands\-on use of AI tools in your product and experimentation work, such as using LLMs to draft hypotheses, design tests, or speed up analysis. * Working understanding of how LLM\-based agents are built and evaluated (tools, prompts, guardrails, and evals). Experience taking an agent into production is a plus. * Product\-led mindset: comfortable questioning engineering\-led plans, using frameworks like DACI for decision clarity,  and model performance data. * Knowledge of sports, gaming, or entertainment, and/or experience in a heavily regulated industry with privacy and responsible\-use constraints, is a plus. Familiarity with Databricks, Kafka, Amplitude, Snowplow, or Xtremepush is also a plus. * Don't check all the boxes? That's okay! We encourage you to still apply if you feel like you possess an adjacent skill set and are interested in learning more about this position. **ABOUT FANDUEL** FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. FanDuel Group consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including: America's \#1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; the industry's unquestioned leader in horse racing and advance\-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product. In addition, FanDuel Group operates FanDuel TV, its broadly distributed linear cable television network and FanDuel TV\+, its leading direct\-to\-consumer OTT platform. FanDuel Group has a presence across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico. The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company's affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia. FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world's largest sports betting and gaming operator with a portfolio of globally recognized brands and traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FLUT). **PLAYER BENEFITS** We treat our team right We offer amazing benefits above and beyond the basics. We have an array of health plans to choose from (some as low as $0 per paycheck) that include programs for fertility and family planning, mental health support, and fitness benefits. We offer generous paid time off (PTO \& sick leave), annual bonus and long\-term incentive opportunities (based on performance), 401k with up to a 5% match, commuter benefits, pet insurance, and more \- check out all our benefits here: **FanDuel Total Rewards**. \*Benefits differ across location, role, and level. FanDuel is an equal opportunities employer and we believe, as one of our principles states, "We are One Team!". As such, we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by state, local or federal law. We believe FanDuel is strongest and best able to compete if all employees feel valued, respected, and included. FanDuel is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please email Benefits@fanduel.com. ***The applicable salary range for this position is $116,000 \- $145,000 USD, which is dependent on a variety of factors including relevant experience, location, business needs and market demand. This role may offer the following benefits: medical, vision, and dental insurance; life insurance; disability insurance; a 401(k) matching program; among other employee benefits. This role may also be eligible for short\-term or long\-term incentive compensation, including, but not limited to, cash bonuses and stock program participation. This role includes paid personal time off and 14 paid company holidays. jobs.title: Copy of Strategic Solutions Engineer - CNC - Northeast
jobs.description: **About MISUMI Americas** MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world\-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas. ### **Impact In This Role** Misumi Americas is seeking a Strategic Solutions Engineer \- CNC to join our solution engineering team focused on strategic, high\-complexity, production\-level customer programs. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, manufacturing, customer advisory, and commercial execution, supporting customers as they scale from prototype into production. The ideal candidate brings deep experience in CNC machining, casting, CAD, (SolidWorks), GD\&T, and DFM skills,strong technical communication skills, and the ability to guide customers through DFM/DFA, production readiness, operational/program support, cost optimization, and mechanical assembly considerations. This role is mainly customer\-facing and requires comfort operating in ambiguous, high\-stakes environments. ### **What You'll Be Doing** **Customer \& Program/Production Support** * Serve as a trusted technical advisor/guide for strategic customers with complex CNC manufacturing needs. * Lead technical scoping discussions, translating customer requirements into manufacturable, scalable solutions. * Some level of support for customers through prototype production transitions, anticipating manufacturing risks early. **Manufacturing \& DFM Expertise** * Perform detailed DFM/DFA reviews for CNC\-machined components. * Evaluate part geometry, tolerances, GD\&T, material selection, and finish requirements for manufacturability and cost. * Provide cost optimization recommendations based on process selection, feature simplification, and volume scaling. * Support efforts with manufacturing\-informed input on feasibility, risk, and lead time. **Assembly \& System\-Level Understanding/Support** * Evaluate and guide on mechanical assemblies, including: * + Part\-to\-part fit, stack\-ups, and tolerance interactions + Fastener selection, joint design, and access for assembly + Assembly sequencing and installation considerations * Help customers identify risks related to assembly, serviceability, and field installation. * Provide feedback that improves downstream assembly efficiency and reduces rework. **Technical Execution** * Review and interpret engineering drawings with strong command of GD\&T. * Perform CAD work, including: * + Design updates for manufacturability + Parametric 3D Modeling \& Visualization + Detailed Documentation \& Drafting with GD\&T + Optimizing CAD — CNC to Casting and 3DP to IM + Reverse engineering * Collaborate cross\-functionally with Sales, Operations, Quality, and LoB teams. **Quality \& Compliance Awareness** * Apply working knowledge of ISO 9001 and AS9100D requirements in customer discussions and internal workflows. * Identify quality risks early and ensure proper requirements definition ("quality in, quality out"). ### **Desired Traits** * 6\+ years of relevant experience in manufacturing roles such as CNC (candidates with deeper experience are strongly encouraged to apply). * Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering or related field, or equivalent demonstrated hands\-on experience. * Strong expertise in CNC machining processes (milling, turning, multi\-axis) and Casting, . * Must have DFM, cost optimization, and manufacturing trade\-off fluency. * Hands\-on experience in production\-scale manufacturing programs. * Proven ability to interpret and apply engineering drawings and GD\&T. * Solid understanding of mechanical assemblies and installation considerations. * Experience supporting customer\-facing technical discussions. * Familiarity with ISO 9001 and AS9100D compliance environments. * Willingness and ability to travel 30–40%. * Proficiency with Google Workspace and/or Microsoft Office. * Strong verbal, written, and digital communication skills. * SolidWorks CAD proficiency. * Willingness to perform hands\-on CAD work and reverse engineering as needed. * Willingness to support the Marketing team with technical publications, seminars, university lectures, and other related activities as needed. ### **Nice\-to\-Have Qualifications** * Experience with Casting, Molding (IM) and/or Additive Manufacturing (3DP). * Prior experience working with external suppliers or contract manufacturers. * Leverage AI tools (e.g., Claude and other AI assistants) to accelerate DFM analysis, documentation, customer\-facing content creation, and day\-to\-day engineering workflows. * Experience integrating AI/LLM tools into engineering or customer\-facing workflows. ### **Physical Demands** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. * Standard Office \& Remote Work: Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer for remote customer consultations. * Onsite Environments: Must be able to walk and stand on manufacturing floors and trade show environments for extended periods. Must be able to safely navigate industrial areas around heavy machinery and wear required PPE (safety glasses, safety shoes, hearing protection). * Lifting \& Handling: Ability to occasionally lift, move, and position mechanical parts, prototypes, or trade show materials weighing up to 30 lbs. ### **Perks and Benefits** * Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401K plan * Parental leave programs * Paid volunteer days * And much, much more! **Salary Range: $125,000 to $142,000 per year, based upon experience** **Interested in learning more? We look forward to hearing from you soon.** We're actively seeking teammates who: * Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company. * Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team. * Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth. * Have an 'always learning' mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins. * Help us continue to build a world\-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

Our ideal candidate will have built systems with technologies like Entity Framework, SQL Server, and Azure Functions, and be comfortable taking on a project on their own or as part of a team. ##### **Responsibilities \& Duties:** * Design, Develop, and maintain solutions for FSX’s clients * Participate in all steps of the Agile process including Sprint Planning, Sprint Review, Sprint Retrospective, and Daily Scrum * Thoroughly test through both automated and manual means all code to prove its effectiveness * Collaborate and help team members by sharing knowledge and combining brainpower to solve problems * Look for ways to improve processes and functionality to further deliver increased value to FSX’s clients * Mentor and manage other Software Engineers ##### **Job Requirements:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience * 5\+ years of experience in a prior software engineering role including interactions with nontechnical stakeholders ##### **Skills, Knowledge \& Abilities:** Nice to have: * Messaging experience with technologies like Azure Service Bus, ActiveMQ, Amazon SQS, or similar * Experience in Agile/Scrum methodologies is a plus * C\#, .NET Framework and/or .NET Core, ASP.NET Web API * SQL Server Experience; can also be any RDBMS: Oracle, DB2, MySQL, Postgres * Demonstrated experience working on applications with multiple services/aspects working together, consuming and/or producing data to specification * Experience with Git and GitFlow branching. * Deep knowledge of software development lifecycle best practices, including source control, testing, security, maintainability, code reuse, etc. * Drive to understand the vision of a project and work closely with team members to see it through to completion * Ability to communicate with non\-technical stakeholders

jobs.title: Design Engineer - Embedded Hardware, Software & AI (Robotics, Energy, IoT)
jobs.description: **The interesting problem right now is connecting AI to the physical world.** Not chatbots. Agents with their hands on real things: a power supply and a debug probe on the bench, a board under test, a radio mesh across a solar field, a fleet of devices reporting to the cloud. We already work this way. Our agents drive our lab benches, flash and test boards, read a live site's history from the cloud, and help operate field sites through their gateways, with an engineer reviewing every move. We use this on real client work in alternative energy, robotics, lighting, utilities and municipal services, and we are just getting started. If this is the thing you have wanted to work on, read the rest. **Who we are** Firia is a small engineering team in Madison doing commercial product development for clients nationwide. We design the hardware, write the firmware, build the cloud, and ship it. We also make our own products: the CodeBot robot, the CodeAIR drone, the CodeX handheld and the CodeSpace platform, used by students in classrooms across the country. **What the job is** You will move across the whole stack: * **Hardware.** Schematics, PCB layout, power, RF, bring\-up and debug. Hands on the bench. * **Firmware.** C, MicroPython, wireless mesh stacks, over\-the\-air updates. Code that survives in the field. * **Software and cloud.** Python services, web dashboards, device management, internal tools. * **AI systems.** MCP servers, skills and tools that put agents to work on the bench, in the design flow and in the field. * **Clients.** You sit in the room with them, executives included, and own the technical story. **Who we are looking for** * **Hardware fluency.** EE or Computer Engineering preferred. A CS degree works if you have real hands\-on hardware experience: you read schematics, you own a scope, you were building things before anyone paid you to. We have grown CS grads into strong embedded developers and circuit designers. We cannot grow someone who is not already curious about hardware. * **Real software ability.** Comfortable from a datasheet up to a cloud service. * **AI as a tool you already use.** You know what an MCP server is, you have written skills or tools for an agent, and you have a working sense of where AI multiplies your impact. If you have wired an agent into something physical, lead with that. * **You build things, think for yourself, and say so.** If the president is about to make a bad call, say so, with evidence. * **Organized, a clear communicator, with taste.** Writing and client meetings are core technical skills here. You can tell good design from bad in a circuit, a UI or a codebase. * **Confident and humble at once.** We hire across experience levels. A recent graduate with a portfolio of things they actually built is more interesting to us than fifteen years of maintaining someone else's program. **The honest part** The pace is fast and the expectations are high. You will be closer to customers and consequences than almost anywhere else in this market. If you want real ownership early and to look back in two years at shipped products with your fingerprints on them, this may be a good fit. **Benefits** * Medical and dental (Blue Cross Blue Shield), with Firia paying half the premium. * 401(k) with a 4% company contribution, and profit sharing. * Three weeks of vacation and eight paid holidays. **Logistics** On\-site in Madison, Alabama. Hands\-on hardware and a collaborative team, so this is in person, not hybrid or remote. **To apply** Send a resume and **tell us about something you built**: a robot, a board, a tool, an agent you taught to do something useful, a weird automation that only makes sense to you. A paragraph and a link or a photo is plenty. We're far more likely to consider your application if you provide this! If the Indeed platform doesn't provide an easy way to submit something, just email us using our info@ Firia address \- we'll get it. Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Health insurance * Paid time off Work Location: In person

Everything we do is centered around our* ***community****,* ***customer service****, our* ***stability****, and being* ***trustworthy****. These values support our mission and vision, shape our culture, and provide a foundation for the future.* Offering a dynamic benefit package that includes but is not limited to: * Four Medical Plan Offerings to choose from * Employer HSA Contributions (Coverage/Plan exclusions) * Employer Provided Life Insurance Policy * Annual Health Incentive * Annual Wellness Reimbursement * Tuition Reimbursement program * Generous Match 401k Retirement Plan * Paid Sick Leave * Paid Vacation Leave * 11 Paid Holidays Based on the Federal Reserve Calendar If you are ready to take on a challenging and rewarding role; we invite you to apply for this exciting opportunity. **JOB PURPOSE:** Designs, develops, automates and maintains internally built applications, integrations and unattended automation that advance the Bank’s operations. Operates as an individual contributor on the Development and Automation team, delivering innovative and creative solutions through a secure, governed development life cycle while protecting the long\-term stability of the Bank’s systems, data and customer trust. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:** * Provide **Reliability** by developing, testing and maintaining applications and automation that protect the performance, integrity and availability of the Bank’s systems and data; * Assure proper **Responsiveness** to business needs by delivering solutions through an Agile/Scrum process of sprints, feature branches and pull requests, prioritizing and adjusting work to meet business objectives; * Develop, script and maintain interactive applications, API endpoints and scheduled tasks on the Bank’s development platforms, primarily using PowerShell; * Design and support unattended automation, scripts and integrations that reduce manual effort and improve operational efficiency; * Follow the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Automation procedures, including risk classification, data classification, secure coding, code review, testing and change management; * Participate in development projects to deliver **Tangibles**, including but not limited to building, configuring and deploying applications, endpoints, containers and related automation; * Implement authentication and role\-based access through Active Directory, manage secrets securely, and apply secure coding practices aligned to the Bank’s standards; * Log all project work, change management tasks and support interactions in the ticketing system and provide **Assurance** that changes and resolutions are completed timely and in accordance with established procedures; * Support production issues, including approved emergency corrections (hotfixes) to production, ensuring such changes are documented in the ticketing system and reconciled to source control; * Create, update and maintain documentation of applications, automation and the application inventory/risk register; * Collaborate with the Technology Officer, business owners and other IT staff, providing **Empathy** by listening to and understanding business needs and translating them into practical, well\-supported solutions; * Adhere to IT department strategies, processes, policies and procedures; * Demonstrate accuracy, thoroughness, quality and orderliness in performing work assignments; * Provide the best service to our customers with innovative and creative solutions. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES:** The essential functions listed above are representative of the core responsibilities of this position and are not intended to be an exhaustive list. As business needs, technologies and priorities evolve, this role is expected to perform additional related duties, tasks and responsibilities reasonably necessary to accomplish the objectives of the position and to support the Development and Automation team and the Bank’s overall goals, whether or not such duties are specifically described herein. All such duties are considered essential to the role. **JOB REQUIREMENTS:** * Minimum 3–5 years of related software development or automation experience with a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field; or 5–10 years of related software development or automation experience in lieu of a degree; * Extensive, hands\-on experience developing and scripting in PowerShell; * Working knowledge of Git\-based source control, including branching and pull\-request workflows; * Familiarity with REST APIs, relational and document databases, and containerization ; * Familiarity with Active Directory authentication, SSO, OAUTH, JWT, role\-based access, and secure coding and testing practices; * Must have an aptitude for troubleshooting, analyzing, and diagnosing problems; * Strong oral and written communication skills and decision\-making ability; * Ability to handle changing priorities and make valuable contributions to team objectives; * Ability to work non\-business hours and on\-call hours as needed, including for emergency production support; * Must interact professionally with other employees, customers and suppliers; * Extended hours sitting and performing computer tasks may be required; * Must be able to complete complex projects with minimum to no supervision. * First Federal Bank is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants and employees receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. * Employees confirm they are able to perform the essential functions of this position to continue employment with First Federal Bank. * This job description may not be all\-inclusive; accurate and complete. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ At Ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. Together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. Make your move. * Job Type: Full time * Work Type: Hybrid We made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families. You'll see your work on the road every day, helping people move freely and pursue their dreams. At Ford, you can build more than vehicles. Come build what matters. **Enterprise Technology** plays a critical role in shaping the future of manufacturing and mobility. By leveraging data, advanced analytics, AI, and modern engineering practices, we partner with Manufacturing teams to turn complex operational challenges into scalable solutions that improve **quality, efficiency, safety, cost, employee experience, and customer value**. Join us and apply your **AI/ML expertise and analytical skills** to help shape the next generation of intelligent vehicles. **In this position...** We are seeking a highly skilled **DIA Machine Learning Engineer** to design, develop, deploy, and scale AI/ML and advanced analytics products for manufacturing. In this role, you will combine deep technical expertise in **machine learning, MLOps, cloud technologies, and data science** with strong business acumen to translate complex manufacturing challenges into **scalable, production\-ready solutions that deliver measurable business value**. Based in Dearborn, MI, this is a hybrid position with a requirement to be onsite four or more days per week. Relocation assistance may be available for qualified candidates. **What you’ll do …** * Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain scalable machine learning, deep learning, Generative AI, optimization, statistical, and advanced analytics solutions for complex manufacturing challenges. * Build and productionize end\-to\-end AI/ML products, including data preparation, feature engineering, model development, validation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. * Develop reusable ML frameworks, MLOps pipelines, APIs, and engineering patterns that enable reliable, scalable, and maintainable AI/ML solutions. * Develop and deploy scalable AI and machine learning solutions on GCP using services such as Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, and related data and AI services. * Establish and monitor model performance, data quality, system reliability, and business\-value metrics to ensure deployed solutions deliver sustained impact. * Proactively identify and mitigate production risks, including model and data drift, data availability, scalability, security, explainability, performance degradation, and operational support requirements. * Explore and implement agentic AI patterns such as planning, tool and function calling, memory, reflection, human\-in\-the\-loop approvals, and multi\-step workflow execution. **Business Engagement \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration** * Partner directly with Manufacturing teams to understand business processes, identify opportunities, define problem statements, technical independence. **What** **You’ll** **Do** ### **Partner with the Business** * Develop an understanding of your assigned business area’s workflows, systems, data, priorities, and operational problems and requirements into appropriately scoped technical tasks. * Build relationships with business users and learn how technical solutions support their day\-to\-day work. * Support the implementation and adoption of new AI capabilities. * Help measure outcomes such as adoption, time saved, quality improvements, reduced manual effort, and other business impact. ### **Build and Support AI Solutions** * Design, build, test, and deploy AI agents, copilots, automations, and supporting services with guidance from experienced team members. * Develop agentic workflows that connect tool calling, structured outputs, retrieval\-augmented generation, grounding, and multi\-step workflows. * Build retrieval solutions using structured and unstructured data, embeddings, vector search, and enterprise knowledge sources. * Develop tests and evaluations to measure AI behavior, accuracy, reliability, and task completion. * Monitor deployed solutions for reliability, quality, usage, and cost. * Apply established security, access\-control, responsible AI, human\-oversight, and governance practices. * Help evaluate when conventional software, automation, data solutions, or process improvements may be more appropriate than an AI\-based solution. * Write clear, maintainable code and documentation while contributing to reusable engineering components and patterns. **What** **We’re** **Looking For** * At least one year of software engineering, data engineering, AI engineering, or comparable applied development experience. * Relevant experience may come from professional work, internships, apprenticeships, open\-source contributions, or substantial project work. * Experience building software, automations, integrations, or AI\-enabled applications. ### **Technical Skills** * Proficiency in Python and working knowledge of SQL. * Familiarity with Databricks or a comparable modern data platform. * Familiarity with a major public cloud platform. Azure experience is preferred. * Experience using AI\-assisted development environments such as Cursor or Claude Code. * Understanding of LLM application patterns, including prompting, tool calling, retrieval\-augmented generation, structured outputs, and agentic workflows. * Familiarity with Model Context Protocol and emerging agent\-interoperability approaches. * Experience working with REST APIs. * Familiarity with Git, testing, code review, and modern software development practices. ### **Business and Collaboration Skills** * Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non\-technical partners. * Strong problem\-solving skills and curiosity about how business processes work. * Ability to translate reasonably well\-defined business problems into technical tasks with guidance. * Openness to feedback and a commitment to learning from experienced team members. * Motivation to develop increasing technical independence. * A practical, outcome\-focused approach to technology and problem\-solving. **Nice to Haves** * Experience with Azure AI Foundry. * Experience with LangGraph, LangChain, or similar frameworks. * Experience with vector search, embeddings, enterprise search, or RAG. * Exposure to AI evaluation, tracing, or monitoring. * Exposure to CI/CD practices and production deployment. * Familiarity with AI security, governance, responsible AI, and human\-in\-the\-loop patterns. * Experience working in healthcare or another regulated industry. **Life at FMH** We’re building more than a company. We’re building a team of ambitious, curious people who are passionate about solving meaningful problems, growing their careers, and genuinely enjoying the journey together. Based in Pittsburgh’s Strip District, FMH draws inspiration from the city we call home. Our value of Grit isn’t just a word on a wall. It’s a mindset inspired by the city around us: **showing up, rolling up our sleeves, and finding a way forward no matter the challenge.** As FMH continues to grow, so do the opportunities for our people to leave their mark. Guided by our core values of **Integrity, Adaptability, Grit, and Collaboration**, we foster an environment where trust is earned, new ideas are welcomed, challenges are embraced, and success is shared. You will be surrounded by people who care deeply about the work they do and the people they do it with. **Together, we’re building something special, and we’re just getting started.** **Benefits** * Unlimited PTO * 100% employer\-paid individual medical, dental, and vision premiums * Employer HSA contribution * Paid parental leave * 401(k) match * Transportation and parking benefits * Flexible, collaborative work environment *Benefit eligibility is based on employment status.* **Build What’s Next With Us** Healthcare is evolving \- **and so are we.** If you’re excited by meaningful challenges, collaborative teammates, and the opportunity to help build a growing healthcare technology company, we’d love to hear from you. **Equal Opportunity Employer** Free Market Health is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace makes us better teammates and problem solvers and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. jobs.title: Senior AI/ML Engineer, Human Physiology Modeling
jobs.description: We create a place where people can grow, be their best, be safe, and feel welcome, valued and included. We offer a competitive salary, an annual bonus based on company performance, healthcare and wellbeing programs, pension plan membership, and shares and savings programme. We embrace modern work practices; our Performance with Choice programme offers a remote or hybrid working model, empowering you to find the optimal balance between remote and in\-office work. Discover more about our company\-wide benefits and life at GSK on our webpage *Life at GSK \| GSK* Find out more about GSK and R\&D: Our approach to R\&D **Senior AI/ML Engineer, Human Physiology Modeling** GSK is building a computational capability that models human physiology as an interconnected, multiscale system. We are hiring the founding member of a new team. You will set the technical direction, build the first models and help define the team's practices. You will also connect models across scales, from molecular and cellular to tissue, organ and whole\-body level and turn that scope into a prioritized modeling roadmap, choosing the right method for each question. You will work with key stakeholders across GSK. The goal is models that inform real decisions, such as target hypotheses, mechanism of action, safety, biomarkers and patient stratification. This is a hands\-on role. You will write, review and ship production\-quality scientific software, as well as set the scientific direction. **This is a hybrid role in the United States in San Francisco, CA or Cambridge, MA. You will be expected to work on\-site regularly and collaborate with colleagues across sites and regions in the United States.** **This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following*****:*** * Define and own the modeling strategy and phased roadmap across the team's organ systems. Recommend sequencing based on scientific tractability, data availability and portfolio relevance. * Build, calibrate and validate multiscale models of physiological function, regulation and disease. * Define how models of different organ systems and scales interface and compose. * Integrate heterogeneous data into models: human genetics and genomics, single\-cell and spatial omics, imaging, clinical and EHR data, and published physiology knowledge. * Establish standards for uncertainty quantification, sensitivity analysis, parameter identifiability and model validation. * Write reproducible, tested, version\-controlled and containerized code that runs on GSK cloud and HPC infrastructure, in partnership with platform engineering. * Work with experimental colleagues to design studies that test or constrain model predictions. * Communicate results and their limits clearly to scientists and senior leaders. * Help hire, onboard and mentor future team members. Evangelize and enforce code\-review, documentation and modeling standards set by the group. * Track the external literature and open\-source ecosystem, and contribute or publish where appropriate. **Basic Qualifications:** **We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:** * A minimum of a BS, MS, or PhD in computational or systems biology, biomedical engineering, physics, applied mathematics, computer science or a related field. * A minimum of 4 years of experience with a PhD, a minimum of 5 years of experience with an MS and a minimum of 8 years of experience with a BS. All experience must involve building and applying quantitative models of biological or physiological systems, in academia or industry. For candidates without an advanced degree, a track record of published work, shipped models or open\-source contributions can substitute for some of the required years. * A minimum of 2 years of experience modeling the physical and biological processes that recur across organ systems. These include fluid flow and transport, mass exchange across barriers and membranes, tissue mechanics, hormonal and neural regulation, and cell population dynamics. * A minimum of 4 years of experience with Advanced Python Programming. jobs.title: Senior Data Center & AI Fabric Network Engineer - RDT Hosting and Infrastructure (HI)
jobs.description: ### **The Position** The Senior AI \& Data Center Network Engineer is a technical expert responsible for architecting and implementing resilient, ultra\-high\-performance Data Center and AI/ML network infrastructures. develop and maintain Arista AVD, NVIDIA Air (for digital twin validation), Ansible, and CI/CD pipelines to ensure scalable, repeatable deployments across multi\-vendor environments. * Technical Problem Solving \& Congestion Management: Collaborate with cross\-functional AI, compute, and storage teams to diagnose and resolve complex network incidents, fine\-tuning lossless Ethernet parameters (RoCEv2, PFC, ECN) and performing root\-cause analysis in high\-stakes environments. * Reliability \& Observability: Define and maintain Service Level Objectives (SLOs) through advanced telemetry, streaming analytics, and tools like NVIDIA NetQ to proactively monitor microbursts, tail latency, and fabric performance, maximizing "five\-nines" availability. * Strategic Influence: Translate technical roadmaps into business value for stakeholders and steer vendor product evaluations (including next\-generation high\-radix switches and optics) to align with long\-term organizational AI and cloud strategy. **Who You Are** --------------- * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a business field, or equivalent experience. And 5\-8 years of work experience. required * Multi\-Vendor Fabric Mastery: Deep expertise in Arista EOS and NVIDIA Cumulus Linux, with hands\-on experience designing and operating NVIDIA Spectrum switches alongside traditional EVPN\-VXLAN Spine\-Leaf architectures and complex BGP control planes. * AI/ML Networking Expertise: Solid understanding of high\-performance computing (HPC) and AI cluster networking requirements, including RoCEv2 (RDMA over Converged Ethernet), congestion control mechanisms (ECN, PFC, DCQCN), and high\-speed optical interconnects (400G/800G). * Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Proficient in automating multi\-vendor network deployments using Arista AVD, Ansible, Linux networking tools (Netplan, ifupdown2\), and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub/GitLab). * Migration \& Cutover Leadership: Experienced in leading high\-stakes brownfield\-to\-greenfield migrations, with a focus on hitless cutovers, robust rollback planning, and zero\-downtime execution. * Advanced Troubleshooting: Expert\-level troubleshooting skills across underlay/overlay networks and Linux\-based network operating systems. You exercise sound judgment and remain decisive in high\-pressure, complex technical scenarios. * Communication \& Mindset: A proactive learner who thrives in rapidly evolving AI infrastructure landscapes and translates complex system concepts into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in a technical field preferred; CCNP (Enterprise or Service Provider), NVIDIA Networking certifications, or equivalent deep industry experience is highly desirable. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.description: **The Role:** Generate Biomedicines is seeking a principal engineer to lead the evolution of our scientific data and analytical tools. Experimental data is central to how we design, evaluate, and improve protein therapeutics. Making that data accessible, interpretable, and trustworthy is essential to connecting laboratory experimentation with computational design and scientific decision\-making. In this role, you will set the technical direction and deliver systems that connect agents with experimental data, reproducible processing, quality\-controlled results, and analysis across experiments. You will help scientists move beyond traditional workflows toward an integrated agentic experience where they can ask questions, explore evidence, and make informed decisions. You will build on Generate's agent platform, connecting agents with internal tools, data, and scientific workflows. Working closely with experimental scientists, Data Science, laboratory systems engineers, and the platform team, you will translate scientific needs into a clear roadmap and powerful software. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role with responsibility for architecture, implementation, and adoption. **Location:** This role is based in Somerville, MA, with an expectation of working onsite at least three days per week. **Here's how you will contribute:** * **Define and deliver the scientific data and analytics roadmap.** Understand how scientists work today, identify the highest\-value opportunities, and turn a broad vision into focused capabilities that improve experimental analysis and decision\-making. * **Connect the experimental data lifecycle.** Design data models, interfaces, and workflows that link raw instrument outputs to samples, experimental conditions, processing methods, QC decisions, and published results. Partner with laboratory systems engineers to establish reliable handoffs from data capture into processing and analysis. * **Build reproducible processing and trustworthy results.** Work closely with Data Science and assay experts to define and implement mathematical methods, statistical analyses, normalization, and QC rules. Support versioned processing, traceable results, and controlled recomputation as methods evolve. * **Create** **agentic** **analytical experiences.** Build agent\-accessible tools and applications that help scientists retrieve data, inspect processing, visualize results, compare experiments, and explore hypotheses. Combine agent flexibility with validated computational methods and appropriate scientific review. * **Enable meaningful analysis across experiments.** Address differences in assay versions, units, experimental conditions, controls, and sample identity so scientists and computational teams can make defensible comparisons and reuse data. * **Lead through implementation and collaboration.** Make architectural decisions, build systems, guide engineering contributors, and resolve difficult integration problems. Partner with scientists and program teams to establish requirements, evaluate outputs, and drive adoption. * **Own measurable outcomes.** Assess success through reliable processing, scientific validity, time saved, and sustained use. Establish practical monitoring and feedback mechanisms, and improve workflows based on real scientific work. **The Ideal Candidate will have:** * A bachelor's or advanced degree in computer science, engineering, bioinformatics, a quantitative scientific discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * Substantial experience designing and delivering scientific software or data systems, with demonstrated technical leadership across architecture, implementation, and deployment. * Strong hands\-on agentic programming skills, including Python, and experience building data\-processing pipelines, APIs, and analytical applications. * Experience developing or integrating AI agents, with sound judgment about their appropriate use, evaluation, and interaction with deterministic processing. * Experience modeling experimental data, including metadata, provenance, versioning, and data quality. Ability to balance consistent structures with the diversity of scientific workflows. * Strong grounding in mathematics, statistics, and experimental analysis to collaborate deeply with data scientists and assay experts and translate their methods into reliable software. * A track record of turning ambiguous scientific needs into a clear technical direction, prioritized deliverables, and software that people use. * Strong collaborative skills and the ability to communicate effectively with experimental scientists, data scientists, software engineers, and scientific leaders. \#LI\-HM1 **About Generate Biomedicines** We are a clinical\-stage generative biology company pioneering the AI revolution in drug design and development. We are advancing a new approach to drug creation—one grounded in the ability to design proteins with defined biological intent. By integrating machine learning with large\-scale experimentation, this approach aims to reduce the uncertainty, time, and cost associated with developing protein\-based medicines. Founded in 2018, we are advancing a growing pipeline of clinical and preclinical programs across multiple disease areas and protein modalities. By unifying computational design and clinical development within a single operating model, we translate this approach into clinical\-stage programs and are leading a shift from traditional drug discovery toward systematic drug generation. At Generate:Biomedicines, we collaborate across disciplines in new ways to invent and innovate. We bring diverse perspectives to a shared goal of delivering better medicines to patients in need, faster, guided by our values and leadership behaviors. Generate:Biomedicines is **committed to equal employment opportunity** regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. ***Recruitment \& Staffing Agencies****: Generate:Biomedicines does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Generate:Biomedicines or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by the Company's internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Generate:Biomedicines and the Company will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.*

jobs.description: How You’ll Contribute: The Senior Software Test Engineer I is a hands\-on member of the Software Test Engineering team responsible for testing and verification and validation (V\&V) of Software in a Medical Device (SiMD), Software as a Medical Device (SaMD), connected systems, and GxP\-relevant software tools. jobs.title: Senior Product Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Group 1001** is a consumer\-centric, technology\-driven family of insurance companies on a mission to deliver outstanding value and operational performance by combining financial strength and stability with deep insurance expertise and a can\-do culture. Group1001’s culture emphasizes the importance of collaboration, communication, core business focus, risk management, and striving for outcomes. This goal extends to how we hire and onboard our most valuable assets – our employees. **Why This Role Matters:** As a Product Software Engineer at Group 1001, you own the distance between what our AI\-assisted development capabilities can do and what teams actually get out of them. Our agentic ecosystem includes both the platform that engineering teams build on, and the managed development environments with integrated AI coding assistants that let engineers and business technologists alike build and deploy applications in a fast, safe, and consistent way. This is a forward\-deployed role where your customers are colleagues. You will frequently engage with application teams, platform and infrastructure teams, and business technologists adopting the agentic platforms we are consistently evolving. If and when you help these partners write code to better leverage these platforms, you then generalize and upstream the capability into our platform/ecosystem. You remain accountable to the platform product rather than becoming staff augmentation for whichever team asks loudest. Adoption of our work and our offerings is always earned. Overselling costs more here than it would with an external customer; our internal relationship has no end date. Your customers can read your code and your backlog, and they will have opinions about both; this is a feature, not a bug. The ideal candidate is a strong software engineer who would rather spend a week finding out why a team abandoned a tool than a week adding a feature nobody asked for. This is a senior individual\-contributor role with product ownership. **How You'll Contribute:** * Deeply engage with teams to learn how they actually work, not how some guide says they work, then build something real that will truly work for them. The deliverable is their workflow running, not a recommendation that it could. *Fix it locally, then upstream the pattern.* * Enable teams with local fixes to get people going; but leaving a local fix in place is an anti\-pattern. * Generalize bespoke fixes and features, then land them in our platform; delete the bespoke version. If something cannot be generalized, say so and articulate why. * *Translate between three audiences who describe the same problem differently* \- application engineers, central platform teams, and business technologists. Each has a vocabulary, a set of constraints, and a threshold for what counts as "working," and they rarely match. * *Build the golden paths and the reference implementations.* Most adoption failures are not capability gaps; they are the absence of a worked example close enough to someone's real problem to start from. * *Carry actionable signal back to the roadmap.* Anecdotes from one frustrated team vs. a pattern across six teams are different inputs and deserve different responses. Know which one you are holding and actioning on. * *Earn trust.* Show up consistently, learn the domain, fix something small early, and be direct about what the tooling can and cannot do. * *Say no to work that belongs somewhere else.* Some of what you are handed is a backlog item, another team's responsibility, or a problem the platform should not solve. Routing it correctly is more useful than absorbing it. * *Write the documentation you wished existed when you got there.* What released, what is coming, how to use it, and what it will not do for you. **What We’re Looking For:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 7\+ years building and shipping production software, including end\-to\-end ownership of something real; design, delivery, operation, and the respective consequences. * Proficiency in one or more modern programming languages (e.g. Python, Golang, JavaScript/TypeScript) at production quality. You will be writing code other teams depend on, not prototypes they rewrite. * Hands\-on experience building and/or working with agentic LLM applications and supporting infrastructure: tool\-calling, MCP or comparable integration patterns, context engineering, evaluation design, and working with non\-deterministic behavior in systems that need to be dependable. * CI/CD and infrastructure\-as\-code fluency: pipeline design, containers, Terraform or equivalent. jobs.title: Senior AI Enablement Engineer, GTM
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- IT **Compensation** ---------------- * $153K – $210\.5K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus *Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in our equity plan and benefits program. Benefits include, but not limited to: Comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits (401k match up to 4%), and flexible PTO.* **Why Harvey** ============== At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise\-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come. This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product\-market fit and world\-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched. Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you. At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started. **Role Overview** ================= We're seeking a Senior AI Enablement Engineer to be the dedicated technical partner for Harvey's go\-to\-market organization — Sales, Customer Success, SDR, Legal Engineering, Partnerships, and Revenue Operations. GTM has been Harvey's most enthusiastic adopter of AI: teams have built dozens of skills, plugins, and agents on their own. That energy is an asset, but it has outrun the structure around it. Your job is to turn that energy into a focused set of workflows that GTM teams trust and use every day. This is a hands\-on technical IC role inside BizTech (Business Technology), partnering closely with GTM leaders, GTM Systems, and RevOps. You'll spend your time sitting with sellers, SDRs, and CSMs to understand how they actually work; consolidating and hardening the workflows worth keeping and retiring the ones that aren't; building the connector and MCP integrations those workflows depend on; and giving GTM a fast, clear answer when they want to try something new. The ideal candidate is a senior IC engineer who understands how a revenue team runs — pipeline, deal cycles, quota, account planning, renewals — well enough to earn credibility with a quota\-carrying rep, and who sees making Harvey's GTM team more effective with AI as the actual job. **What You'll Do** ================== * **Bring order to and extend GTM's AI footprint.** Audit the skills, plugins, and agents GTM teams have built; measure what's actually used; consolidate duplicates into well\-maintained versions; retire what isn't earning its place; ship new AI\-powered workflows. * **Be the AI tooling partner of choice for GTM teams.** Embed with Sales, CS, SDR, Legal Engineering, and Partnerships to understand their workflows from the inside — prospecting, call prep, follow\-up, account planning, pricing, renewals — and steer them toward solutions that fit how they work rather than building for its own sake. * **Own the intake for new AI features and experiments.** GTM regularly asks to try new capabilities as they ship. Partner with fellow AI Enablement Engineers to build a lightweight path for requesting, piloting, and evaluating them — success criteria up front, a timebox, and a clear adopt / wait / pass call at the end — so experimentation stays fast without leaving another trail of abandoned tools. * **Own technical governance of GTM skills and plugins.** Define publishing standards, ownership, review, and deprecation rules for the GTM side of the plugin and skill marketplace, and stand up usage and spend monitoring so adoption, cost, and staleness stay visible as adoption scales. * **Own the MCP and connector roadmap for GTM systems.** Harden and extend the integrations GTM workflows depend on — Salesforce, Gong meeting notes and call recording, Gmail and Calendar, Slack, Omni, and internal knowledge sources — with sensible read/write scoping and guardrails around anything that reaches customers or prospects. * **Build reference patterns GTM can extend.** Ship well\-structured templates and examples so GTM builders can create good workflows themselves, within guardrails, without you becoming the bottleneck for every new idea. * **Run AI vendor reviews for GTM tools.** AI sales tools pitch GTM leaders constantly. Partner with Privacy, Security, and Legal to evaluate them against a reusable framework and give a clear build / buy / pilot / pass recommendation. **What You Have** ================= * 5\+ years of software, integration, or GTM engineering experience, with at least 2 years building integrations or automation on top of GTM systems (CRM, sales engagement, conversation intelligence, CPQ, analytics). * A real understanding of how GTM teams work — the sales cycle, pipeline management, account planning, renewals and expansion — ideally from having worked inside or alongside a revenue org. You can talk to a rep about their week, not just their data. * Hands\-on experience with API integration patterns, OAuth and identity, webhook architectures, and the kind of glue work that makes enterprise systems actually talk to each other reliably. * Practical experience with LLM\-based applications and AI tooling — prompt design, agent workflows, retrieval, evaluation, or production integration of model APIs. You don't need to have trained a model; you do need to have shipped something real that depends on one. * Working knowledge of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or comparable agent\-tool integration patterns. If you haven't shipped MCP yet, you've at minimum read the spec and built something against it. * A product mindset about internal tools. You measure adoption, talk to your users, and are as comfortable deprecating something as shipping it. * Strong communication and stakeholder\-management instincts with GTM leaders and individual contributors — you can redirect a VP's feature request toward a better solution and keep the relationship, and be the most pragmatic person in an engineering review the same afternoon. * Strong DevOps and operational fundamentals — CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code, secrets management, and observability. You treat the integrations and AI tools you ship as production systems: version\-controlled, monitored, and safe to change without breaking the teams that depend on them. * Demonstrated experience applying data governance and security best practices, including to customer data and to agents that take external\-facing actions. * Comfort evaluating third\-party vendors — asking the right questions about data access and flows, reading DPAs, and translating findings into clear go/no\-go recommendations for the business. * Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-growth, and global environment with significant ambiguity. **Bonus Points:** * Background as a GTM Engineer, RevOps or Sales Ops engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Forward Deployed Engineer — ideally combined with internal tooling work. * Experience at a company where sales and CS teams adopted AI tooling at scale, and first\-hand lessons about what stuck and what didn't. * Hands\-on work with Salesforce (including custom development), sales engagement platforms, CPQ, or conversation intelligence tools, including their APIs or AI\-adjacent extensions. * Familiarity with enterprise iPaaS platforms. * Experience leading change management or enablement for a sales organization. **Compensation** ================ $153,000 \- $210,500 USD ### **Depending on your location, an Applicant Privacy Notice may apply to you. You can find all of our Applicant Privacy Notices** **here****.** \#LI\-RB1 *Harvey is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.* We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made by emailing accommodations@harvey.ai
