jobs.title: Helpdesk Analyst
jobs.description: **About Halter** ---------------- At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time\-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out\-think, out\-work and out\-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world \- this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard. We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures. To find out more, visit our LinkedIn \& Instagram. **About the role** ------------------ Our US team is growing quickly, in the office and out in the field, and it needs IT support in its own time zone. This role takes ownership of frontline IT support for Halter in the United States: the first person our US team turns to when they need help, and the person who makes sure new starters land on day one with everything they need. You'll be the face of IT for our US team. You'll resolve the bulk of incoming requests yourself, run our device and account lifecycle end to end, and escalate the genuinely complex problems to our Senior Systems Engineers in Auckland, who focus on the systems, automation and infrastructure that scale Halter. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Own frontline IT support for our US team. Requests start with Chandler, our AI service desk agent in Slack, which resolves what it can on the spot. Anything Chandler can't resolve is raised as a request in AtomicWork, our service desk platform, where you triage, resolve or escalate it and own it through to resolution. * Run the device lifecycle end to end: procure, enroll in our device management platform, configure, ship and track laptops, phones and peripherals, and keep our asset inventory accurate. * Get kit to remote and field staff across the US ahead of their start date, including laptops, mobile phones and Starlink, and arrange equipment returns when people leave. * Execute new\-starter onboarding and offboarding: provisioning and deprovisioning accounts through our identity\-driven workflows, and making sure every new hire is set up and productive on day one. * Handle account support: password and multi\-factor authentication resets, group and access changes, and password\-manager recovery, all within our access policies. * Support our US office: meeting rooms and audio\-visual equipment, Wi\-Fi and network access, and the general office environment. * Keep our knowledge base current and write clear self\-service guides, so Chandler and our people can resolve repeat questions without raising a request. * Spot the patterns: surface recurring or manual requests so we can automate them out of existence. * Work closely with the Auckland\-based Workplace IT team across time zones, with clear handovers so nothing is dropped overnight. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * At least 1 year in an IT support, helpdesk or desktop\-support role. * Hands\-on with a cloud\-first environment: Google Workspace, Slack, an identity provider (Okta or similar) and a device management platform. * Comfortable with device setup and enrollment, and with basic networking troubleshooting. * Strong customer\-service instincts: clear, calm and friendly, with a genuine drive to help people. * Well organized and reliable, able to juggle a busy queue without dropping the ball. * Self\-directed. Your manager and teammates are in New Zealand, so you're comfortable making sound calls on your own and knowing when to escalate. * Curious and automation\-minded: you'd rather fix the root cause than solve the same request twice. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience with Okta, AtomicWork or a similar service desk platform, and a knowledge base such as Notion. * Experience working alongside an AI service desk agent, or improving what one can resolve. * Exposure to joiner, mover and leaver automation and structured onboarding. * Experience supporting remote or field\-based staff. * Scripting or a willingness to learn. **Why This Role** ----------------- You'll join a small, capable Workplace IT team building a modern IT function from the ground up in a fast\-scaling environment. As our Workplace IT presence in the United States, you'll get real ownership from day one, a front\-row seat to how we automate and scale, and a clear path to grow into systems engineering as you develop. ake time off when you need it—no accrual required, available from day one * **Employee Assistance Program (EAP) \& paid wellness leave:** Access confidential support through JustWorks plus 3 paid wellness days per year * **Comprehensive health benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting the first day of the month after you join (with most premiums covered, including 100% of employee\-only health premiums on select plans) * **Personal growth fund:** $750 USD per year to support learning, development, or personal growth goals * **Parental leave:** 16 weeks paid leave for birthing parents and 8 weeks paid leave for non\-birthing parents * **401(k):** 100% match on the first 3% contributed, plus 50% match on the next 2% (up to a 4% employer match), with immediate vesting * **Onboarding travel to New Zealand:** Fly to NZ for onboarding at Halter HQ in Auckland—meet the team, visit a test farm, and immerse yourself in all things Halter **Our Office First Approach** ----------------------------- Humans are wired for connection. Being office first is a core pillar of our culture because in\-person connections drive your growth, learning, impact, and relationships. Strong relationships make it easier to disagree, give feedback, and do meaningful work together. We're office first, not office only. Working from the office is our default, but we flex when needed. We have a high\-trust culture where everyone is trusted to do what's best for Halter. Our office vibe is special, the high energy and spectacular people make work enjoyable. Your growth and impact are unlimited here, coming from solving problems, innovating, and constantly learning from each other. **Join our team** ================= Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under\-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit! If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch! Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn \& Instagram. **Why our team loves working at Halter:** ========================================= * **Work that genuinely matters.** Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations. * **Spectacular people solving hard problems.** Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems. * **You'll grow here.** Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our personal growth fund. * **This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard.** Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!" Compensation Range: $87K

jobs.title: Design Engineer
jobs.description: **About Hotplate** ================== Hotplate exists to enable anyone to start and scale a local food business without a brick and mortar. The traditional brick and mortar restaurant model is broken: it requires six figures in upfront capital and comes with high operating costs. Within their first year, 2/3 of all restaurants and bakeries close. The next wave of food entrepreneurship is emerging. These chefs and bakers run businesses from home, commissary kitchens, or mobile pop\-ups. They generate hype and buzz on Instagram and run almost entirely on pre\-orders. The result is 50\-80% profit margins, over 10x the traditional 5% margin of a brick and mortar. But today’s e\-commerce tools weren’t built for this way of selling food. Without Hotplate, chefs and bakers hack together DMs, Google Forms, Square, and Shopify. They spend more time managing logistics than growing their business. We've supported 7,000 businesses generating $100M\+ in sales, many of whom are the top pop ups in the country recognized by the New York Times, James Beard, Infatuation, Eater, etc., and we're just getting started. By building the foundational tool for this new model, we have the opportunity to fundamentally change the food industry for the better: increasing the diversity and accessibility of food by making it possible for anyone to start a food business. **The role** ============ As Hotplate's first design engineer, you'll own how Hotplate looks, feels and works for thousands of chefs and millions of customers. We have a design system and reusable components, but building a clean UI for most projects, and taking the time to think it through, is still one of the biggest slowdowns in shipping features. You'll: * Upgrade the design of what we've already built * Keep it consistent as the product grows * Design and build the UI for entirely new parts of Hotplate as we ship them * Be a thought partner for engineers on what the UI for their features should look like * Co\-develop visual rewrites with Ben, our CEO * Encode our patterns into AI tooling so the design system scales to every project automatically We're also hiring a designer. Until they join, you'll be the go to person for engineers on UI. Once they're here, you'll work alongside them and own the quality of UI implementation across the product. This role is based in San Francisco, and we are 5 days a week in\-person. We move fast. **What you will need to be successful** ======================================= * You're equally comfortable in Figma and your code editor * You have strong frontend skills: TypeScript, React, Tailwind, animation * You have an eye for design details, care deeply about craft, and sweat every word and interaction * You've shipped polished products and know what it takes to get from 90% to 100%, down to pixel perfect execution and smooth interactions * You prototype ideas in hours, not days * You think in systems and build reusable, maintainable UI components * You're excited about AI and want to help define new interaction paradigms * You use AI design and coding tools every day, and keep testing new ones to see what's worth bringing into how Hotplate designs and builds * 2 to 3 years minimum across product design and frontend engineering **Our philosophy of design** ============================ Every engineer at Hotplate owns their features end to end, so great design can't live with just one person. Part of this role is making a clean UI the easy default for everyone. We believe the little details are what make a product feel great. **Useful first.** Solve real problems for chefs and their customers. Then make it feel effortless. **Own all of it.** Shape the feature, design it, ship it. Product, design, code, copy, support, whatever it needs. **Know the tradeoffs.** Understand the chef, the customer, the code and the business before picking a solution. **Build for every chef.** A first time home baker and a chef doing thousands of orders should both feel at home. Keep the advanced stuff there when people need it, not in their way. **Small and excellent.** Scope small enough to do it well. Push back when craft, speed or trust is at risk. **Make the team better.** Kind, direct, low ego. Share work early. When you give the same feedback twice, fix it at the source. This is a great job for someone obsessive about UX and UI. Ben, our CEO, is kept up at night by small interactions he doesn't have the time to act on. If you're obsessive in the same way and always thinking about how to improve them, you'll be very happy here. **Our team** ============ We are a lean, mission driven team. We exist to enable the next million chefs and bakers to scale local food businesses outside the brick \& mortar model. We operate with high ownership, laser focus on the impact we have for our chefs and bakers, and commitment to take on projects that push us out of our comfort zones. We’re a tight knit crew. We jam with a daily shared playlist, often hang for team lunch and happy hours, and always have snacks on the table (made by the team or a Hotplate Chef). We love working in a place where we all have a connection, and think it helps us work better as a team. **This role probably isn't for you if** ======================================= * **You'd rather hand off mockups than ship them.** Here design and code are often the same job. If it isn't in prod, it isn't done. * **You need a design team around you.** You'll be our first design engineer, and for now the only one. * **You want big, splashy redesigns.** Most of the work is sweating the small interactions chefs and their customers touch every day. * **You stop at 90%.** We care about the last 10%: loading, empty and error states, edge cases, and the details most people skip. * **You want close, day to day mentorship.** You'll work closely with Ben early on, but you should want to own UX decisions on your own within your first couple of months. Those are all fine ways to work. They just aren't how Hotplate works. **Benefits** ============ * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and dependents * 401(k) retirement plan * Unlimited PTO (that people actually take) * Monthly budget to spend on Hotplate *Hotplate is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.* Compensation Range: $180K \- $220K

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer
jobs.description: Description We are seeking a Forward Deployed Software Engineer to build technology solutions that help public health programs operate more effectively. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who enjoys working directly with users, understanding complex operational problems, and turning them into reliable software that delivers measurable value. As an embedded member of a cross\-functional team, you will partner with program staff, technical assistance providers, product teams, engineers, and client stakeholders. You will help uncover needs, shape solutions, build and test them with users, and take successful capabilities into production. The role combines full\-stack software engineering, workflow automation, data integration, and applied AI in an environment where requirements evolve as teams learn. You will be successful if you are equally comfortable writing production code, talking with users, working through ambiguity, and making pragmatic technical decisions. **Responsibilities** ==================== **Discover and define:** Work directly with program teams, client stakeholders, and end users to understand operational challenges, identify opportunities for technology, and translate loosely defined problems into practical technical solutions. **Prototype and build:** Design and build across the full stack, including user experiences, application services, APIs, relational data models, integrations, workflows, dashboards, and reporting. Move quickly from problem definition to working prototypes and iterate with real user feedback. **Apply AI where it adds value:** Build AI\-assisted capabilities such as summarization, structured extraction, classification, and workflow support. Preserve appropriate human review and account for reliability, privacy, data governance, and responsible use. **Deploy and improve:** Move successful capabilities into reliable production environments with maintainability, security, error handling, traceability, testing, and operational support in mind. Observe usage, diagnose issues, and improve solutions based on feedback. **Scale what works:** Turn lessons from program\-specific implementations into reusable platform capabilities, technical patterns, and components. Surface gaps between platform capabilities and real\-world needs and feed those insights back to product and engineering teams. **Communicate clearly:** Explain technical options, feasibility, tradeoffs, and constraints to technical and non\-technical audiences. Support demonstrations, walkthroughs, and hands\-on sessions with users and stakeholders. **Qualifications** ================== **Required** * 3 years of professional software engineering experience, including meaningful full\-stack development experience. **Additional Qualifications** * Strong programming skills and experience building modern web applications with JavaScript/TypeScript or comparable technologies. * Experience with relational databases, APIs, external services, and production software delivery. * Ability to work directly with users and stakeholders to understand problems and translate them into technical solutions. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts and tradeoffs to non\-technical audiences. * Demonstrated ability to deliver iteratively when requirements are incomplete or changing. * Experience with version control, code review, testing, and collaborative software development practices. **Preferred** * Client\-facing, embedded, consulting, or Forward Deployed Engineering experience. * Experience integrating LLM capabilities into applications, including summarization, structured extraction, classification, evaluation, or AI\-enabled workflows. * Experience building multi\-step workflows, stateful applications, or human\-in\-the\-loop processes. * Experience with case management, workflow, grant management, or program management systems. * Cloud\-native development, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, or production operations experience. * Experience with government technology environments, sensitive data, data governance, privacy, or responsible AI. * Interest or experience in health, public health, rural health, or public\-sector program delivery. * Professional use of AI\-assisted software engineering tools. **How You’ll Work and What Success Looks Like** =============================================== This role sits at the intersection of engineering, users, and real\-world operations. You will not simply receive a backlog of fully defined requirements. You will work with stakeholders to understand what they are trying to accomplish, determine the right technical approach, and move from idea to working software. Some problems will require traditional engineering; others may benefit from workflow automation, data integration, or AI. In your first six months, success means developing a strong understanding of the program and its users, building trusted workin ities that address meaningful operational needs. Over your first year, you will help turn lessons from individual implementations into reusable capabilities and engineering patterns that make future delivery faster and more consistent. **Technology environment:** JavaScript/TypeScript\-based front\-end development, server\-side application development, relational databases, RESTful APIs, cloud services, workflow and state management, LLM\-enabled application patterns, version control, CI/CD, and automated testing. Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn new technologies matter more than matching every tool in the stack. **Working at ICF** ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting\-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future. We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer. Together, our employees are empowered to share their expertise and collaborate with others to achieve personal and professional goals. For more information, please read our EEO policy. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. **Work Authorization and Sponsorship** All candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for new H\-1B visa sponsorship by ICF. Candidates who currently hold valid work authorization may be considered for a change of employer petition, subject to company policy and applicable immigration requirements. **Reasonable Accommodations** Reasonable Accommodations are available, including, but not limited to, for disabled veterans, individuals with disabilities, and individuals with sincerely held religious beliefs, in all phases of the application and employment process. To request an accommodation, please email Candidateaccommodation@icf.com and we will be happy to assist. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations. Read more about workplace discrimination rights or our benefit offerings which are included in the Transparency in (Benefits) Coverage Act. **Bot and Third\-Party Applications** Please note that this application must be submitted directly by the applicant for consideration. Failure to do so may result in the application being excluded for consideration. Applicants needing an accommodation for disability or religious purposes in connection with the application process should contact Candidateaccommodation@icf.com for assistance. **Candidate AI Usage Policy** At ICF, we are committed to ensuring a fair interview process for all candidates based on their own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools to generate or assist with responses during interviews (whether in\-person or virtual) is not permitted. This policy is in place to maintain the integrity and authenticity of the interview process. However, we understand that some candidates may require accommodation that involves the use of AI. If such an accommodation is needed, candidates are instructed to contact us in advance at candidateaccommodation@icf.com. We are dedicated to providing the necessary support to ensure that all candidates have an equal opportunity to succeed. **Pay Range** There are multiple factors that are considered in determining final pay for a position, including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, certifications and competencies that align to the specified role, geographic location, education and certifications as well as contract provisions regarding labor categories that are specific to the position. jobs.title: Software Engineer And Prototype Developer
jobs.description: **About the Role** We are seeking a versatile and proactive Software Engineer to support and help lead software architecture development for a multi‑component prototype system integrating autonomy, sensing, command‑and‑control, and electromechanical subsystems. You will join a highly cross‑functional engineering team composed of mechanical, aerospace, explosives, and electrical engineers with embedded systems experience, and you’ll collaborate closely with this team but you *will* be the person who sets the tone for professional software practices and execution. This role is ideal for someone who is confident offering industry‑best software practices, comfortable guiding a team with gaps in modern software architecture, and excited to help build a first‑generation system. Your software will touch nearly every part of this system: autonomy behaviors, sensor gateways, launcher subsystems, mission control interfaces, and overall system integration. We are hiring for this specific role but have many other related opportunities at the company. While this role supports an immediate need on the project, IS4S offers a wide range of long‑term career opportunities across our expanding portfolio, and we are hiring with the intent to grow your career well beyond this project. **Key Responsibilities** * **Lead and help define the software architecture** across prototype subsystems, including autonomy hubs, sensors, launcher subsystem interfaces, mission planning tools, and command‑and‑control links. * **Develop and maintain software\-to\-hardware interfaces** spanning electromechanical systems, sensor gateways, launcher mechanisms, and obstacle‑box modules. * **Generate and contribute to system requirements, software requirements, and interface definitions.** * Draft and refine requirements for software components in alignment with the System Requirements Document (SRD), subsystem SRDs, and evolving program needs. * Create, update, and review ICDs (Interface Control Documents) that describe mechanical, electrical, and software interfaces across subsystems. * Support requirement traceability and help integrate software into the prototype system for test demonstration events. * **Support communications, data\-handling, and RF**‑**degraded**‑**environment behaviors**, including TAK/NGC2 plugins and mission‑status pathways. * **Collaborate across disciplines** to ensure seamless integration with autonomy, sensors, launcher mechanics, explosives/fuzing systems, and mission control software. * **Guide the team in modern software practices** — architecture patterns, interfaces, version control, documentation, testing, and scalability. * **Participate in prototype development, integration events, and testing**, including launcher subsystem demonstrations, autonomy hub evaluations, and obstacle\-block field tests. **Required Skills \& Experience** * 1–5 years experience as a software engineer. * Strong proficiency in systems‑level languages (C/C\+\+ preferred) or mission‑integration languages (Python, etc.). * Experience interfacing software with embedded or electromechanical hardware. * Understanding of networking, communications, or distributed system architecture. * Ability to create formal technical documentation — requirements, ICDs, design notes, interface definitions. * Strong communication skills and willingness to provide direction and teach industry‑standard practices. **Preferred Skills** * Background in computer engineering, robotics, autonomy, aerospace systems, or embedded systems. * Experience with TAK/NGC2, RF‑degraded comms concepts, sensor fusion, or C2 integration. * Exposure to MOSA architectures, DoD systems, or fuzing/arming constraints.

jobs.title: Cloud Software Development Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Details:** ================ **Job Description:** -------------------- The world is transforming \- and so is Intel. Intel is a company of bold and curious inventors and problem solvers who create some of the most astounding technology advancements and experiences in the world. With a legacy of relentless innovation and a commitment to bring smart, connected devices to every person on Earth, our diverse and brilliant teams are continually searching for tomorrow's technology and revel in the challenge that changing the world for the better brings. We work every single day to design and manufacture silicon products that empower people's digital lives. Come join us and do something wonderful. **The Role and Impact** As a Cloud Software Development Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, validating, and optimizing software to enable Intel hardware features and enhance cloud deployment models. You will focus on practical, hands\-on software engineering tasks such as debugging, optimizing full\-stack solutions, and collaborating to ensure Intel technologies deliver exceptional value in cloud environments. Your contributions will directly impact the success of Intel's products in cutting\-edge cloud, hybrid cloud, and on\-premises settings. **Business group** The Data Center Group (DCG) is at the forefront of driving innovation and delivering transformative solutions for data\-centric businesses. Focused on enabling cloud computing, AI, and data analytics, the group designs advanced technologies that fuel Intel's leadership in the data center industry. By joining DCG, you will contribute to groundbreaking work that powers the future of cloud infrastructure and accelerates technological advancements worldwide. **Key Responsibilities** * Develop, optimize, and debug software to enable Intel hardware features and enhance cloud/hybrid cloud/on\-prem deployment models. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand partner software stacks and optimize full\-stack solutions (firmware, drivers, OS, middleware, SDKs, frameworks, algorithms, and applications). * Drive the development and validation of reference platform software to improve customer designs and ensure maximum utilization of Intel products within the cloud. * Contribute to the creation and optimization of software for specific technology domains such as data services (ingestion, database, analytics), AI/ML, and open\-source development projects. * Identify and resolve technical challenges to ensure high\-quality, scalable, and performance\-driven solutions. * Feature enablement, end\-to\-end software validation, and debug for next\-generation HW\-SW systems * Triage complex software, networking, and platform issues across validation, deployment, and production environments. **Qualifications:** ------------------- You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. Experience listed below would be obtained through a combination of your degree, research and or relevant previous job and or internship experiences. **Minimum Qualifications** : * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field, with 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in software development and optimization OR a Master's degree with 2\+ years of hands\-on experience. * 3\+ years of experience working in a software product development team * 3\+ years of working experience developing system software for Linux OS * Strong programming skills in C/C\+\+. * Hands on Git and GitHub experience. * Familiarity with cloud computing platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) and their associated development tools. * Understanding of software optimization techniques and debugging tools. **Preferred Qualifications:*** Golang/Python/Bash/Shell scripting experience is a plus. * Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams. * Experience with container orchestration tools like Kubernetes or Docker. * Knowledge of AI/ML frameworks and data analytics technologies. * Eagerness to learn, adapt, and grow in a fast\-paced, innovative environment. * An understanding of graphics fundamentals, experience with Linux, or Windows based operating systems and a strong knowledge of system architecture is vital to success in this role. Experience with one or more of the following is a plus: * Modern C\+\+ (C\+\+17/C\+\+20\) * Python * CMake * Docker or Kubernetes We invite you to seize this opportunity to make an impact in the world of cloud computing while working alongside inspiring colleagues who are passionate about transforming the industry. **Job Type:** ------------- Experienced Hire **Shift:** ---------- Shift 1 (United States of America) **Primary Location:** --------------------- US, Oregon, Hillsboro **Additional Locations:** ------------------------- **Posting Statement:** ---------------------- All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local law, regulation, or ordinance. **Position of Trust** --------------------- N/A **Benefits** ------------ We offer a total compensation package that ranks among the best in the industry. jobs.title: Simulation Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Simulation Software Developer** **Houston Texas** **About Intuitive Machines** Intuitive Machines is an innovative and cutting\-edge space company making cislunar space accessible to both public and private customers. Our mission is to further science and exploration, communications, and economic progress from the Earth to the Moon and beyond. With the first commercial lunar landing in history, multiple NASA lunar missions in development, and additional private missions on our manifest, we pride ourselves in supporting our customers and the nation in paving the way to return humans to the surface of the Moon. Our world\-class team includes experts in all aspects of spacecraft subsystems design, development, and test, on\-orbit operations, and safety. **About the role:** The ideal candidate for the role of Simulation and Modeling Software Developer will be encouraged to take initiative in developing, maintaining, and improving simulation models, tools, and infrastructure. The position is multidisciplinary in nature as the simulation supports a number of internal and external customers which requires regular collaboration with other subsystem engineers for model development and technical support for simulation environments (HWIL simulations, FDIR testing, operations training, etc). **Responsibilities:** * Design, implement, test, and “own” environmental, vehicle and I/O simulation models * Collaborate with vehicle software, GNC, and other subsystem engineers and subject matter experts in creating high\-fidelity environment, sensor, effector, and interface models * Create and execute simulation model verification tests * Faster\-than\-real\-time and real\-time spacecraft simulation development and maintenance * Hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HWIL) simulation development and testing * Support Fault, Detection, Isolation, and Recovery (FDIR) testing through fault modeling * Write model unit tests and coordinate high\-level testing of implemented models * Develop and maintain Software Quality Assurance (SQA) tools * Provide simulation support to flight software, ground software, and operations teams **Requirements:** * BS or MS in Aerospace Engineering, Physics, or related field with 5\+ years of experience preferred * C, C\+\+, and Python programming experience * 6\-degrees\-of\-freedom simulation development experience * Experience in one or more areas including spacecraft dynamics, thermal modeling, power modeling, RF comm modeling, sensor modeling (IMUs, star trackers, LIDAR, etc), GNC software integration * Experience with Agile software development tools and processes * Experience with Atlassian tools, Git version control, Gitlab, Docker, and Linux is preferred * Experience with the following is a plus: + High Level Architecture (HLA) + Core Flight Software **US EEO Statement** Intuitive Machines is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

The department is committed to hiring candidates who share our core values of delivering an exceptional customer service experience, encouraging open communication, embracing change, practicing ethical behavior, and embracing diversity. **We are looking for someone who:** * Demonstrates a proven track record of delivering successful outcomes on both day\-to\-day tasks and larger end\-to\-end projects and initiatives * Brings expertise in designing, developing, code testing, and troubleshooting full stack applications * Has in\-depth experience with .NET Framework, ASP.NET, ASP.NET Core MVC, SQL, SSIS, SSRS, and APIs * Ensures accuracy, security, and high standards across all aspects of development * Maintains a positive attitude, adapts easily, collaborates effectively, and works well with others * Takes initiative, works independently, and consistently achieves results * Approaches challenges with enthusiasm and a desire for continuous learning * Thinks creatively and offers jobs.description: James Hardie is the industry leader in exterior home and outdoor living solutions, with a portfolio that includes fiber cement, fiber gypsum, composite and PVC decking and railing products. Our family of trusted brands includes Hardie®, TimberTech®, AZEK® Exteriors, Versatex®, fermacell®, and StruXure®. With over 8,000 employees and our U.S. operating entities headquartered in Chicago, we boast 31 operating sites, 6 recycling facilities, and 6 research and development centers globally. Powered by a dynamic workforce, we’re united by our purpose of Building a Better Future for All™ through sustainable innovation, a Zero Harm culture, and a commitment to empowering our people and communities. For more information, visit www.jameshardie.com. **Summary** ----------- The Senior AI Solution Engineer serves as a business\-aligned technical advisor and coach to citizen developers. Aligned to designated business functions, this role enables business teams to design, build, deploy, and support their own Generative AI and Predictive AI solutions. The engineer brings hands\-on AI engineering expertise to ask the right questions, review designs, guide technical decisions, and help teams navigate data access, model selection, secure and cost\-effective architecture, software development lifecycle (SDLC) requirements, and governance and oversight requirements. Success is measured by the capability and independence of business builders and the quality of business\-owned solutions—not by the volume of solutions personally developed. The role reports directly to the VP of Cybersecurity, AI and Data and partners with our AI Champions and IT teams to support the business. **What You’ll Do:** ------------------- * Coach business builders from problem framing and design through deployment and ongoing support while keeping solution ownership within the business. * Build business teams’ AI development capability through guided working sessions, design and code reviews, reusable examples, and knowledge sharing. * Design or enable APIs, connectors, enterprise knowledge sources, authentication, permissions, and understand RAG pipelines, while supporting engagement of needed business SMEs for appropriate reviews. * Help teams satisfy security, privacy, architecture, environment, testing, release, and lifecycle requirements; escalate design risks to the appropriate authorities. * Help business owners establish support ownership, documentation, monitoring, cost controls, troubleshooting practices, and escalation paths so their teams can operate and maintain solutions after launch. * Coach builders through technical blockers and production issues by helping them diagnose causes and engage the right support teams, while reinforcing business ownership rather than becoming the default developer or support owner. **What You’ll Bring:** ---------------------- * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field preferred. * 6\-10 years of experience in software development, data science and other adjacent technical skills * Experience building, deploying, and supporting production AI solutions highly preferred. * Understanding and experience with the following: + Power Platform and Copilot Studio + LLM\-based systems, RAG pipelines, or generative AI applications, together with an understanding of predictive AI approaches; ability to guide model and tool selection and evaluate suitability for a business task. + Understanding of enterprise data sources / data lakes, data access controls, data connections (APIs, MCPs, etc.) + Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP, and data lake architecture (Fabric, Snowflake, Databricks), semantic models * Demonstrated ability to coach and mentor people with varied technical backgrounds, facilitate working sessions and design reviews, and build others’ capability and confidence rather than simply deliver solutions on their behalf. * Strong consultative problem\-solving and communication skills **What You’ll Receive:** ------------------------ As of the date of this posting, a good faith estimate of the current pay scale for this position is $110,000 to $150,000\. jobs.title: Web Developer
jobs.description: **Position Summary** Japan Society is seeking a creative, technically skilled, and collaborative Web Developer to manage, maintain, and enhance its website and digital platforms. This individual will be responsible for the day\-to\-day operation of Japan Society's WordPress website, developing features, improving existing functionality, and working with departments to support their digital needs. The Web Developer will collaborate with Film, Performing Arts, Education, the Language Center, Marketing, and other departments to develop engaging web content, improve website layouts, and recommend features that enhance the visitor experience. The position will also play an important role in ongoing website development and modernization projects, collaborating with external design agencies and internal stakeholders to translate designs and wireframes into functional, responsive web pages. The ideal candidate combines strong technical development skills with creativity, an understanding of user experience, and the ability to communicate effectively with nontechnical staff. **Key Responsibilities** **Website Development \& Maintenance*** Manage and maintain Japan Society's WordPress website, ensuring functionality, reliability, security, and performance. * Develop, modify, and maintain website pages, templates, themes, plugins, and custom functionality. * Write and troubleshoot HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, and PHP code. * Identify and resolve website issues, broken functionality, and plugin conflicts. * Improve existing website architecture and eliminate outdated or unnecessary code. * Maintain website development, staging, and production environments. * Use Git and established development workflows to manage code changes, test updates, and coordinate deployments to production. * Perform functional, cross\-browser, and responsive design testing to ensure website compatibility across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices. * Implement website security best practices, including plugin updates, vulnerability management, and access controls, in coordination with IT. * Monitor website performance, troubleshoot issues, and assist with backup and disaster recovery procedures. * Document website architecture, custom code, integrations, configurations, and development procedures to ensure long\-term maintainability. * Coordinate development projects and technical priorities with other internal developers and external vendors as needed. **Website Design \& User Experience*** Collaborate with departments to identify opportunities to improve website layouts, navigation, functionality, and user experience. * Translate wireframes, Figma designs, and visual mockups into functional, responsive web pages and reusable components. * Assist with UI/UX design and recommend improvements that enhance the visitor experience. * Ensure website accessibility and compliance with established web standards. * Work with external design agencies during website development and modernization projects. **Department Collaboration \& Digital Content*** Work directly with departments to understand their website needs, communicate technical requirements, and recommend appropriate solutions. * Coordinate website updates for exhibitions, film screenings, performances, educational programs, and special events. * Collaborate with Marketing's social media and graphic design staff to maintain consistent branding and presentation. * Assist departments with website content management, formatting, and publishing. * Provide technical guidance and training to staff on website functionality and content updates. * Help establish and maintain efficient workflows for submitting, reviewing, and publishing website content. **Video Streaming \& Digital Media*** Integrate live and prerecorded video content using platforms such as YouTube, Vimeo, and other streaming services. * Work with departments to develop web pages for virtual events, streaming programs, and digital archives. * Assist with implementing access\-controlled or paid streaming content. * Ensure video content displays properly across devices and browsers. * Collaborate with IT and program departments to support digital event initiatives. **Website Integrations \& Development Projects*** Maintain and improve integrations with third\-party platforms, including ticketing, CRM, membership, donations, and email marketing systems. * Work with APIs and web services to support website functionality. * Implement and maintain website analytics, SEO tools, and tracking integrations to support Marketing and departmental reporting. * Plan and participate in ongoing website development, improvements, and modernization projects. * Coordinate website content migrations, including reviewing existing content structures and outdated functionality. * Evaluate and recommend technologies, plugins, and development tools. * Work with external vendors and consultants when specialized development assistance is required. **Qualificatio rience. **Required Skills \& Experience:*** 3\+ years of professional website development experience. * Strong experience developing and maintaining WordPress websites. * Proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and PHP. * Experience with WordPress themes, templates, plugins, and custom functionality. * Working knowledge of MySQL or MariaDB and WordPress database structures. * Ability to translate wireframes and design mockups into responsive websites. * Familiarity with UI/UX design principles. * Experience with website troubleshooting, performance optimization, and security. * Familiarity with Git or other version control systems. * Understanding of APIs and third\-party website integrations. * Strong organizational, communication, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and collaborate across departments. * Ability to explain technical concepts to nontechnical staff. **Preferred Skills \& Experience:*** Working knowledge of React and modern front\-end development practices. * Experience with Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, or similar design tools. * Experience with WordPress Gutenberg blocks and Advanced Custom Fields. * Familiarity with video streaming platforms and embedded media. * Experience integrating ticketing, membership, or CRM systems. * Knowledge of website accessibility standards (WCAG). * Experience with SEO and website analytics. * Familiarity with managed WordPress hosting platforms, CDN services, and website security tools. * Experience working with nonprofit organizations, museums, or cultural institutions. * Experience developing multilingual websites. * Ability to speak, read, and write Japanese is a plus. **Work Authorization** Candidates must possess valid U.S. work authorization, as Japan Society cannot offer visa sponsorship for this role. Additionally, applicants must be able to work on\-site at Japan Society’s headquarters in Midtown Manhattan. **Compensation, Schedule, \& Total Rewards** This is a full\-time, exempt position based at Japan Society’s Midtown Manhattan headquarters with an annual salary range of $80,000 \- $85,000, commensurate with experience. Japan Society operates on a hybrid schedule requiring in\-office presence Tuesday through Thursday (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM), with remote flexibility on Mondays and Fridays. Japan Society offers an exceptional, highly subsidized benefits package valued at approximately 35% of an employee’s annual compensation designed to deliver comprehensive health protection, long\-term financial planning, and sustainable work\-life balance:* **Comprehensive Health Benefits:** Premium medical insurance, backed by an employer\-funded Health Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA) that directly covers out\-of\-pocket medical copays and prescription costs, optional pre\-tax Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA), and employer\-paid dental and vision coverage. * **Retirement Planning:** Following six months of service, employees are eligible for an employer contribution of up to 10% of base salary, fully funded by Japan Society with no employee match required. Staff may also elect to make pre\-tax contributions to an optional Supplemental Retirement Annuity (SRA). * **Disability:** 100% employer\-sponsored short\-term disability, long\-term disability, and basic life insurance. * **Pre\-Tax Commuter Benefit:** Transit and parking flexible spending accounts to reduce daily commuting expenses. * **Paid Holidays:** A robust time\-off package including 15 vacation days, 10 sick days, 11 paid holidays, and paid Summer Fridays. **Application Instructions** Please submit a resume with your portfolio showcasing previous website development projects, including a brief description of your contributions to each. Due to the volume of submissions, only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted directly. Please refrain from direct inquiries or LinkedIn messages regarding this position. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled.

jobs.title: AI Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: Jarrod Smart Construction (JSC) and Smart Commercial Construction (SCC) are building an AI capability that starts with their own information and repeatable work. The business decides what to automate and what success looks like. This role turns those requirements into working technology. You will connect our systems and data, build and maintain AI agents and the MCP connections they depend on, and make sure the result is secure and usable. You will work for both companies, so you need to be comfortable serving two teams with different platforms and a shared Microsoft 365 environment. **What****you****will****do** ============================= * Meet with each team to understand the process, the information it needs, and who reviews the output, then translate that into technical requirements and a build plan. * Build and maintain AI agents and automations for repeatable work such as proposals and estimates, selections tracking, schedule and daily\-log summaries, change orders, and billing and closeout. * Design, build, and maintain MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and connectors that let agents securely read from and, where approved, write to our systems: Microsoft 365, Ressio, JobTread, and Adaptive. * Integrate systems and data using APIs, exports, and workflow tools where MCP is not available, so agents work from accurate, current information. * Configure and administer Microsoft 365 Copilot, including permissions, data access, and separation between the two companies inside the shared tenant. * Organize and document our domain of knowledge: where key information lives, how clean it is, and how an agent can reach it safely. * Implement the governance the business sets: approved tools, access and privacy controls, human\-review steps in each workflow, usage and cost visibility, and a clear way to shut a workflow off. * Train staff on the tools you deliver, and keep documentation, prompts, and how\-to guides current. * Evaluate new AI tools and MCP\-enabled integrations and recommend what to adopt, wait on, or skip. **Required****qualifications** ============================== * 2 to 3 years of experience building automations, integrations, or AI\-enabled workflows in a business setting. * Hands\-on experience building or using MCP servers or comparable tool\-calling and agent integrations, and a solid understanding of how agents connect to business systems. * Experience with Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, Power Automate) and with Copilot or a comparable AI assistant. * Comfort with APIs, webhooks, and data connectors, and scripting skill in Python or JavaScript (or Power Platform). * Practical experience with large language models: prompting, building agents, and knowing their failure modes, such as made\-up answers and data leakage. * Sound judgment on security, privacy, and permissions when systems and people overlap, especially two companies in one tenant. * Clear communicator who can gather requirements from non\-technical people and explain technical work in plain language. **Preferred** ============= * Experience in construction, design\-build, or another project\-based business. * Familiarity with construction or accounting platforms (JobTread, Ressio, Adaptive or similar). * Experience with Microsoft Power Platform, Azure, or similar low\-code and cloud tooling. * Background in analytics, data cleanup, or business systems administration. **Our****systems** ================== Microsoft 365 and Copilot (shared by both companies), Ressio (JSC), CoConstruct moving to JobTread (SCC), and Adaptive for accounts payable (both). **You****will****do****well****here****if****you** ================================================== * Start small, ship, then watch how it performs and grow it, rather than chase the biggest project. * Keep humans at the helm and treat AI like a smart intern: give it context, review everything, and have a person sign off. * Enjoy learning how the business actually runs and building what the teams need. **What****we****offer** ======================= We offer a good work environment with room to grow, competitive pay, paid holidays, paid time off, and a 401k with company match! In addition, we offer Health Insurance, Dental, Vision, Life/Accidental Death and Dismemberment, Short Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Accident, and Critical Illness. *Compensation**and**details**will**be**discussed**with**candidates.* \#hc273721

Experience with SECS/GEM and equipment integration is preferred. Knowledge of manufacturing systems such as RMS, SPC, or FDC is preferred. Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills. Self\-motivated and able to work independently in a cross\-functional engineering environment. * Pay range listed in this job posting is an estimate only, and is not necessarily reflective of actual compensation that may be earned, nor a promise of pay for any specific employee future or past. Offers made are always dependent upon actual experience, education and other factors. We bring to the market devices designed to benefit our customers by meeting their product specific needs. Our mission is to bring value to our customers, shareholders and employees. AOS differentiates itself by integrating its Discrete and IC semiconductor process technology, product design, and advanced packaging know\-how to develop high performance power management solutions. AOS's portfolio of products targets high\-volume applications, including but not limited to portable computers, flat panel TVs, LED lighting, smart phones, battery packs, consumer and industrial motor controls and power supplies for TVs, computers, servers and telecommunications equipment. jobs.title: Kaspar Companies: AI Engineer
jobs.description: Job Type Full\-time Description *Do you enjoy leading problem\-solving efforts to ensure systems run smoothly and securely?* *Are you passionate about aligning technology with business strategy?* *Does working for a family\-centric company with deep roots appeal to you?* *Do the values of stewardship, versatility, and family resonate strongly with you?* *Do you find the improvement of people’s lives through stewardship of God\-given resources inspiring?* **Then, Kaspar Companies is right for you!** **AI Engineer Job Summary** Kaspar Companies is seeking a full\-time AI Engineer to lead and develop our AI\-driven initiatives. Based in Shiner, TX, this role is responsible for training AI models, building, deploying, and implementing AI solutions, and enhancing manufacturing processes through innovative technologies. This position requires a tech\-savvy individual with a blend of AI workflow experience, problem\-solving capabilities, and a collaborative mindset. **AI Engineer Responsibilities** * Design, build, and deploy AI\-powered tools that solve specific operational problems across Kaspar subsidiaries, from scoping through rollout and support. * Integrate AI systems with company data sources and platforms, including Syteline ERP, Microsoft 365, and internal applications, so tools work against live business data rather than static inputs. * Automate manual, repetitive workflows such as reporting, data consolidation, monitoring, and vendor or customer follow\-up. * Develop prompts, agent workflows, and system instructions, then test and refine them against real scenarios until outputs are accurate, consistent, and reliable enough to trust in production. * Translate between operational needs and technical capability, and set honest expectations about what AI can and cannot do for a given process. * Write statements of work and project plans, then deliver against them. * Create documentation, job aids, and reference material that let teams operate and troubleshoot solutions without depending on the AI team for every question. * Track usage and adoption, follow up with teams that have stalled, and capture wins so they spread across subsidiaries. * Monitor deployed solutions for accuracy, uptime, cost, and business impact; diagnose failures and improve them. * Apply data security, access, and acceptable\-use standards to every AI tool touching company or customer information. * Evaluate new models, platforms, and capabilities as they emerge, and recommend where they fit. * All other duties as assigned by management. **AI Engineer Skills and Competencies** **Required** * Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability, with a bias toward shipping something usable and improving it rather than waiting for a perfect solution. * Hands\-on comfort with data: spreadsheets, queries, APIs, and structured data from business systems. * Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical work to operators, plant leadership, and executives in language each group uses. * Ability to manage multiple projects across subsidiaries with limited direction. * Genuine curiosity about how work gets done on the floor and in the office, and willingness to go see it firsthand. **Preferred** * Experience with LLM platforms, prompt engineering, agent frameworks, or MCP\-based integrations. * Scripting or development experience (Python, JavaScript, SQL, Power Platform, or similar). * Familiarity with ERP systems, ideally Syteline. * Background in lean or continuous improvement, or experience working alongside a CI function. **AI Engineer Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related disciplines. * IT experience in business process transformation preferred. * Intermediate knowledge of manufacturing operations. Ability to manage multiple initiatives in a dynamic environment **AI Engineer Work Environment** Typical office setting with occasional facility visits. May require on\-call support during emergencies or updates. **AI Engineer Benefits** * Health Insurance * Vision Insurance * Dental Insurance * 401k * Paid Time Off * Profit Sharing * Counseling

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Kikoff: The Fintech Powering Financial Security at Scale** Kikoff is a profitable, pre\-IPO fintech company on a mission to empower everyone to achieve financial security. With record revenue growth in 2025 and a unicorn valuation, we've built a suite of products that help millions of people build credit, access liquidity, and save money. We're scaling fast. Join us if you want to build something meaningful and help millions of people move forward financially. **Why Kikoff:** This is a consumer fintech startup, and you will be working with serial entrepreneurs who have built strong consumer brands and innovative products. We value extreme ownership, clear communication, a strong sense of craftsmanship, and the desire to create lasting work and work relationships. Yes, you can build an exciting business AND have real\-life real\-customer impact. **About the role** ================== Kikoff builds and operates financial products used by millions of people. Our engineers own the customer experience and the systems behind it, including onboarding, payments, subscriptions, and credit reporting. As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll lead complex projects from shaping the opportunity through launch and own the systems you deploy. You'll work with product, design, marketing, and data to identify solutions, decide what and how to build, and measure and demonstrate the impact. You'll make architecture decisions within your projects, coordinate work cross functionally, and resolve tradeoffs between delivery speed, reliability, security, and long\-term maintenance. This is a hands\-on role. You'll own the implementation and review the code, investigate production failures, and improve systems that customers already depend on. You'll use AI agents to ship high quality solutions across the stack and move work forward in parallel, with responsibility for the design, correctness, and production behavior of what you ship. **What you'll own** =================== * Define projects around customer and business outcomes. Use customer feedback and data to challenge assumptions, establish the expected impact, and choose a scope the team can deliver. * Lead delivery across multiple contributors and services. Turn ambiguous requirements into a technical approach and a sequence of releases, anticipate dependencies, and unblock work when plans change. * Design and implement complete customer flows. Own the decisions connecting user experience, APIs, data models, and external integrations, including retries, partial failures, and recovery. * Own your systems in production. Establish tests, monitoring, safe rollouts, and rollback plans. Respond to incidents, protect customers' credit, money, and data, and address the causes of recurring failures. * Be accountable for results after launch. Measure customer adoption, retention, reliability, or delivery speed against the project's goals, and drive changes when results fall short. * Improve the team's technical judgment and delivery. Review designs and code, coach engineers through difficult decisions, and simplify brittle systems and recurring manual work. **What you bring** ================== * Sustained ownership of production software. You've led complex projects, operated what you built, handled failures, and improved the system afterward. You can explain your decisions, the results, and what you'd do differently. * Strong coding and system design skills. You have depth in at least one area and can work across the stack. You can trace behavior through unfamiliar code, reason about data and failure modes, and judge whether an implementation is correct and maintainable. * Product and business judgment. You make reversible product and design decisions independently to keep work moving, and know when to involve product, design, or data partners. You use customer evidence and business results to test your assumptions and adjust your decisions. * Experience delivering substantial engineering work with AI agents. You can break down a problem, direct implementation, review the resulting code, and verify behavior across the affected system. * Experience leading work with multiple contributors and dependencies. You make progress through ambiguity, surface risks early, and keep engineering and cross\-functional partners aligned. * Clear, candid, kind communication. You explain technical tradeoffs, give useful feedback, and help teammates develop their judgment. **How you'll be supported** =========================== * You'll work with brilliant, passionate people across the business who share their knowledge and constructively challenge your thinking. * Mentorship is available as you deepen your expertise and take on broader responsibilities. * Training in financial systems, rules, and regulations to help you empathize with our customers and their journey. * You'll have access to the latest frontier models and AI development tools, and teammates to experiment and learn with. You may have built a company, led projects inside a larger organization, or moved between technical leadership and hands\-on engineering. We value demonstrated ownership and impact across those backgrounds. Prior fintech experience is useful, but not required. **Our stack** ============= Our stack includes Ruby on Rails, React, Flutter, and AWS. We expect strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to become effective in unfamiliar systems. Prior experience with every framework is not required. If this sounds like work you'd enjoy, we'd like to hear what you've built. Base Range $244,000 \- $292,000 USD **A note on applying:** We know great candidates sometimes hold back if they don’t meet every qualification listed. If you’re excited about this role and believe you can do the work, we encourage you to apply. We’re looking for capability and trajectory, not a perfect checklist match. Equal Employment Opportunity Statement Kikoff Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to complying with all federal, state, and local laws providing equal employment opportunities and considers qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class. .

jobs.title: Senior FPGA Engineer — VETi Platform
jobs.description: Kodiak Sciences (Nasdaq: KOD) is advancing vision science by integrating retinal biology, optics, artificial intelligence, medical imaging, and next\-generation wearable technologies. Our VETi™ — Visual Engagement Technology and Imager — platform is an AI\-enabled wearable system combining advanced LiDAR, Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT), optically pumped magnetometer (OPM) brain sensors, embedded computing, machine learning, and AR/VR technologies. VETi is being developed for applications in retina care, brain imaging, digital health, identity security, cognitive science, and broader AI\-enabled vision technologies. We are looking for a Senior FPGA Engineer to build the real\-time processing foundation for Kodiak’s VETi platform, from early prototypes through production\-ready hardware. This role is well suited for an engineer with strong digital design and RTL fundamentals who enjoys high\-throughput signal processing and is excited to build FPGA systems for advanced medical imaging and wearable technologies. We are interested in strong FPGA engineers who are curious about medical imaging and motivated to work on advanced wearable technologies. **Responsibilities** * Own the architecture, RTL design, verification, and validation of FPGA designs for wearable imaging and sensing systems — from prototype through production. * Implement real\-time signal\- and image\-processing pipelines for OCT, LiDAR, and OPM sensor data, including FFT, filtering, resampling, and data reduction. * Accelerate AI inference and compute\-intensive algorithms on FPGA and adaptive SoC platforms, working closely with machine learning and software teams. * Design high\-speed data paths and sensor interfaces connecting data converters, memory, processors, and host systems. * Optimize designs for low power, size, and heat in battery\-powered wearables. * Develop precisely timed control and synchronization logic for MEMS scanners, lasers, motors, and closed\-loop motion systems. * Bring up designs on new hardware and debug timing, interface, and system\-level issues using ILA, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers. * Collaborate with electrical, optics, mechanical, firmware, software, and systems engineering teams. **Education \& Qualifications** * B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of professional FPGA design experience developing complex, high\-performance systems. * Strong RTL design experience in Verilog/SystemVerilog or VHDL, including simulation, synthesis, place\-and\-route, and timing closure on AMD/Xilinx (Vivado) or Intel/Altera (Quartus) platforms. * Solid understanding of synchronous design, clocking, resets, clock\-domain crossing (CDC), and timing constraints. * Experience writing self\-checking testbenches and scripting in Python and Tcl for verification and build automation. * Experience implementing DSP algorithms in hardware — fixed\-point arithmetic, FFTs, digital filters, and high\-throughput streaming architectures. * Experience with high\-speed interfaces (ADC/DAC, JESD204B/C, LVDS, PCIe, DDR, multi\-gigabit transceivers) and sensor interfaces (I2C, SPI, MIPI). * Hands\-on lab experience bringing up and debugging FPGA designs on custom hardware. **Additional Experience That Would Be Valuable** * Experience with adaptive SoC platforms (Zynq UltraScale\+, Versal, Agilex SoC), including embedded C/C\+\+, Linux, and hardware/software co\-design. * Experience with FPGA\-based AI/ML inference (Vitis AI, hls4ml, HLS, or custom accelerators). * Experience with MATLAB modeling and automated FPGA builds with continuous integration (CI). * Experience with advanced verification methodologies (UVM, cocotb, or formal verification). * Experience with low\-power FPGA design techniques (clock gating, power\-aware architecture, power estimation) and tools such as Lattice Radiant. * Experience with OCT, LiDAR, imaging sensors, or biomedical instrumentation. * Familiarity with regulated medical\-device development (IEC 60601, ISO 13485, FDA), or willingness to learn.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Join Komatsu and Be Part of Something Big!** **Job Overview** ---------------- The Senior IT Data \& Solutions Engineer plays a pivotal role in enabling enterprise\-wide data and reporting capabilities across Komatsu. This role focuses on designing, building, and supporting data\-centric solutions that span multiple business domains, including (but not limited to) Digital Transformation (DX), ERP, Customer Experience, Aftermarket, Finance, and Operations. The successful candidate will leverage Komatsu’s enterprise data platforms—primarily Palantir Foundry for data management and transformation, and Power BI for analytics and visualization—to drive business insights, operational efficiency, and strategic decision\-making. This role requires a strong technical foundation, business acumen, and a collaborative mindset to enable cross\-functional data initiatives that align with organizational priorities, while ensuring scalability, performance, and data governance compliance. **Key Job Responsibilities** ---------------------------- * Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines, integrations, and transformation workflows leveraging Palantir technologies and other enterprise tools. * Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate requirements into actionable data solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes. * Implement best practices in data management, governance, and security, ensuring integrity and compliance across the enterprise landscape. * Optimize performance of data platforms through tuning, automation, and continuous improvement of Palantir and Power BI environments. * Provide advanced data modeling and analytical solutions that enable predictive insights and AI/ML use cases. * Troubleshoot and resolve issues across Palantir\-based data systems, maintaining high system reliability and availability. * Partner with business analysts, data scientists, and functional teams to ensure data accessibility, quality, and usability across business domains. **Qualifications/Requirements** ------------------------------- * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field. * 5\+ years experience in data engineering, BI development, or data platform management (preferably Palantir Foundry, Power BI, Azure). * Strong understanding of ETL processes, data modeling, and performance optimization techniques. * Hands\-on experience with data governance, metadata management, and data security principles. * Familiarity with machine learning models, APIs, and automation frameworks is a plus. * Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and in cross\-functional teams. * Individual contributor working with Komatsu teams and vendor partners to deliver enterprise data capabilities. * Collaborates with business analysts, data scientists, and application teams to ensure data consistency and scalability. * Contributes to data architecture and design reviews, aligning with enterprise standards and long\-term strategy. * Continuously researches and adopts emerging tools and technologies in BI, data engineering, and AI domains. **Additional Information** -------------------------- **Hiring Range** At Komatsu, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. This role pays $145,000\. The actual offer will consider a wide range of factors, including experience and location. **Company Benefits** Komatsu provides an extensive and robust employee benefits package that is designed to enhance the well\-being of our employees and family members. We embrace a positive and empowering employee experience with a culture that prides itself on a diverse and inclusive environment. * Health benefits: Medical, dental, vision, HSA, wellness programs, etc. * 401k and/or employee savings programs * Employee time off (vacation and designated holidays) * Employee and family assistance programs * Disability benefits * Life insurance * Employee learning and development programs **Diversity \& Inclusion Commitment** At Komatsu, we come from diverse backgrounds, with unique perspectives, experiences and contributions. We believe that our people are part of our shared purpose. Connected by our core values of ambition, perseverance, collaboration and authenticity, we are committed to continually advancing in our support of diversity and inclusion. United, we are on a journey towards a sustainable future that creates value together. **Company Information** Komatsu develops and supplies technologies, equipment and services for the construction, mining, forklift, industrial and forestry markets. Headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, Komatsu employs more than 64,000 people worldwide, operating in more than 140 countries. For more than a century, the company has been creating value for its customers through manufacturing and technology innovation, partnering with others to empower a sustainable future where people, business and the planet thrive together. Since the company’s founding in 1921, Komatsu has been committed to supporting individuals and communities through job training, skills development and giving back. As a Komatsu employee, you will be encouraged to grow alongside our global company, contributing to a more sustainable future for all. If you are looking for a company that values your talent and potential, join Komatsu to be a part of something big and help advance modern society. Learn more at www.komatsu.com. **EEO Statement** Komatsu is an Equal Opportunity Workplace and an Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.
