jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: **What is Krevera?** Krevera is a fast growing startup with serious market traction bringing the latest AI driven quality analytics to the plastics manufacturing industry with the goal of reducing scrap, downtime, and labor costs in American factories. We build flexible AI\-powered vision systems that are deployed in factories across the country. Our deep\-learning pipelines detect anomalies, diagnose root causes, and feed insights back to injection\-molding machines and robotics so that quality issues are fixed automatically. We have revenue, clients, and are scaling rapidly. We are looking for new engineers to join our company as we grow into 2027\. If you are looking to jump into a fast paced environment with strong mentorship, Krevera is the place to be. **Why Krevera?** ● **Collaborative, fun, innovative culture:** Enjoy a startup environment where teamwork and creativity thrive, whether brainstorming ideas, playing occasional video games over lunch, or taking company walks. ● **Real impact:** Your work will directly shape our technology, culture, and growth from day one. ● **Front\-row seat to AI in manufacturing:** Help define a market that’s just beginning to explode. ● **Momentum:** We have 100\+ systems in our fleet across the US, scaling is the biggest challenge now! **About the Role** As a Full Stack Software Engineer, you will help expand our online platform and deliver new features from start to finish working across our stack. The products you will be working on allow our clients to interact with near real\-time manufacturing data coming out of our AI analysis pipeline from our deployed systems in the field. As an early addition to the team, your technical talent will influence the quality and structure of our stack, directly providing value to customers. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** ● Develop features from scratch by following the full software development cycle from taking initial requirements before development, to gathering feedback post\-deployment ● Be proficient with git and best development practices ● Have a growth mindset and be open to learning new technologies in other areas of our product development ● Ask questions about and improve our current codebase A qualified candidate for this role will have a bachelor’s degree in computer science or similar with at least 2 years of experience. **Required skills include** ● Experience with Vue3 (and Typescript) ● Experience with Python and the major libraries we use: FastApi \+ Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, and Pytest ● Experience with SQL databases and distributed query engines (such as Trino) ● Experience with Linux Operating Systems ● Experience with AWS ● Experience with Docker and/or Kubernetes ● Excellent communication skills (written, verbal, and in a codebase) ● Comfortable working around our office dogs **Desired skills include** ● Experience with the Agile framework, and Jira specifically ● Experience with Rust and/or C\+\+ ● Experience in architecting distributed systems We are looking for someone who is excited to learn and work in a startup environment. This role is on\-site in our Waltham office, but we are flexible when circumstances arise that might necessitate occasionally working from home. Join us if you are excited about joining a growing team and expanding your technical skills. **Logistics** ● **Location:** On\-site, Waltham, MA. ● **Compensation:** Competitive salary \+ meaningful equity. ● **Benefits:** Health insurance, dental, vision, and 401(k). ● **Start date:** ASAP – we’re moving fast. Pay: From $110,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Education: * Bachelor's (Required) Experience: * Python: 2 years (Preferred) * SQL: 2 years (Preferred) * Linux: 2 years (Preferred) * AWS: 2 years (Preferred) Ability to Commute: * Waltham, MA 02452 (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: **TOKENIZATION FULL STACK DEVELOPER** **Company:** LCX **Location:** Miami, Florida, USA **Employment** Full\-time **ABOUT LCX** LCX has launched LCX Liberty, the non\-custodial DeFi product line of LCX. Its products include LCX Liberty DEX, LCX Liberty Chain, an OP Stack Layer 2 for tokenization, and LCX Liberty Explorer. **THE ROLE** Build the products that issue, manage and move tokenized assets on LCX Liberty Chain and other EVM networks. You will work across the whole stack: the smart contracts that define each token, the backend services that run issuance and transfers, and the dashboards issuers and holders use every day. **RESPONSIBILITIES** * Design, build and test smart contracts for token issuance and the full token lifecycle: minting, transfers, transfer restrictions, distributions and redemption. * Ship upgradeable contracts safely, with proxy patterns, timelocked upgrades and written upgrade procedures. * Build the APIs and backend services behind token creation, management and transfers. * Build the frontend apps and dashboards that issuers and token holders use. * Integrate wallets, EVM networks and smart contract interfaces, including OP Stack Layer 2s. * Keep ownership records and transaction history accurate and easy to audit. * Implement secure transaction handling, key management and access control. * Prepare contracts for external audits and fix what they find. * Find and fix performance, reliability and security issues. * Write automated tests, clear documentation and maintainable code. * Work closely with product, engineering and business teams. **Requirements** * 3\+ years of full\-stack or blockchain development. * Strong TypeScript and React, plus backend development in Node.js. * Hands\-on Solidity, tested and deployed with Foundry or Hardhat. * Working knowledge of ERC\-20, ERC\-721 and ERC\-1155\. * Experience with upgradeable contracts (UUPS or transparent proxies). * Experience with viem, wagmi or ethers.js. * APIs, PostgreSQL or another relational database, and cloud infrastructure. * Familiarity with Ethereum, EVM networks and Layer 2s. * An understanding of how tokenization works end to end, from issuance to ownership records. * Strong engineering, testing and problem\-solving habits. **Nice to have** * Experience tokenizing financial or real\-world assets. * Permissioned token standards such as ERC\-3643, with transfer restrictions and allowlists. * Deploying or running OP Stack chains. * Rust. * Contracts that have been through an external audit. **How to Apply** Please include the following with your application: * A one\-minute introduction video of yourself. * A link to your LinkedIn profile. * A link to your X account. * GitHub profile or relevant technical portfolio. Job Type: Full\-time Experience: * Full\-stack development: 3 years (Preferred) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer, Hydrogen (CA)
jobs.description: LTA Research builds and flies next\-generation airships. Our proof\-of\-concept aircraft, Pathfinder 1, is the largest aircraft flying today, and we operate it as a working test platform to push airship technology forward: moving cargo and people to places without roads, runways, or ports, including disaster relief when infrastructure is cut off. Weight matters in every decision we make. This senior role owns mechanical, thermal, and fluid systems from concept through flight test, with a central part in developing the hydrogen propulsion system for our next aircraft. ### **Responsibilities** * Own mechanical, thermal, and fluid systems for flight and ground equipment end\-to\-end, from requirements definition through concept, analysis, detailed design, qualification, and flight test, and mentor junior engineers along the way. * Support the design, build, and qualification of gaseous and liquid hydrogen systems (storage, distribution, conditioning, and venting), including ground test articles and test infrastructure, and contribute to design FMEA and hazard analysis. * Size and verify designs with first\-principles hand calculations, backed by finite element analysis and thermal and fluid simulation where warranted, and correlate analysis against test data. * Produce fabrication\-ready drawings with GD\&T per ASME Y14\.5, select commercial components, and work directly with manufacturing engineers, machine shops, and suppliers on design for manufacturability and assembly. * Define component and subsystem test requirements and work closely with our test engineering team to plan and execute them, staying hands\-on through hardware build, instrumentation, test runs, and data analysis. * Present designs in cross\-departmental reviews and resolve non\-conformances and failures through root cause analysis. * Fully onsite role, with occasional travel between LTA sites and to supplier and test locations. No shift work. ### **Qualifications** * Bachelor of Science in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering with 5\+ years of professional experience in the mechanical or aerospace industries. * Proficiency with SolidWorks (or similar), PDM/PLM tools, GD\&T, and traditional manufacturing processes. * Strong engineering fundamentals in mechanics of materials, thermodynamics, heat transfer, and fluid dynamics, with demonstrated ability to size and verify designs by hand calculation. * Demonstrated experience taking mechanical structures, thermal management systems, and fluid systems from concept through test. * Demonstrated experience designing highly loaded, lightweight structural components (composite or metallic). * Hands\-on R\&D, prototype, or test experience, including hardware build, instrumentation, and data acquisition; able to work in lab, shop, and test settings, including occasional lifting and work around pressurized systems. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Master's degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering. * Experience with hydrogen, cryogenic, or other high\-pressure fluid systems, including hydrogen material compatibility and applicable codes and standards (NFPA 2, CGA). * Experience with system\-level heat integration and thermal optimization, improving how heat is managed and used across interconnected systems. * Experience developing weight\-critical flight hardware, ideally carried through flight test. * Experience with system safety analysis (FMEA, hazard analysis) for pressurized or flight\-critical systems. ### **What We Offer!** * Relocation assistance * Excellent medical, dental, and vision insurance through a PPO plan (100% premium paid for individuals, \~70% for dependents) * Company\-paid life, AD\&D, long\-term disability, and short\-term disability insurances * Parental leave * Generous PTO \+ 10 paid holidays * 401(k) matching up to 6% * Lunch and snacks provided every day, including accommodations for all dietary restrictions * Monthly wellness stipend * Monthly cell phone stipend * Yearly education stipend to obtain certifications or take classes in your field * Fun events, swag, and the occasional airship ride * An opportunity to change the world and work with some of the smartest and the most talented experts from different fields ### **Compliance Requirements** * Criminal background check clearance * Drug test clearance wherever applicable The base salary range for this role is $135,000 \- 160,000, which is determined based on experience, geography, and qualifications. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes a very competitive annual bonus, 401K Match, and other generous benefits. While we believe competitive compensation is a critical aspect of your decision to join us, we do hope you also spend time considering why our mission and culture are right for you. SMS Text Messaging (10DLC Compliance) LTA RESEARCH may communicate with applicants and users via SMS (text messaging) for purposes related to job applications, interview scheduling, and other recruitment updates. By providing your phone number through our application or contact forms, you consent to receive such communications. We do not use SMS for marketing purposes, and we will never sell, rent, or share your phone number with third parties for their promotional use. Message Frequency \& Opt\-Out: Message frequency may vary depending on your application status. Standard message and data rates may apply. You can opt out at any time by replying STOP to any message. For assistance, reply HELP. Consent \& Privacy: Your consent to receive SMS messages is not a condition of employment. All data collected through text messaging is handled accordance with our Privacy Policy and applicable data protection laws, ensuring your personal information is kept secure and confidential. LTA Research \& Exploration welcomes all candidates to apply including those with limited experience. We understand that candidates with a growth mindset and passion for working on the next chapter in aviation advancement can outweigh experience alone. We celebrate diverse origins and journeys and understand their importance in developing new technology. Rooted in our humanitarian mission, we want to serve the entire globe and have a team that represents those we wish to serve. ***Lighter Than Air is an equal opportunity employer.*** *All applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, marital status, veteran status or any other discriminatory factors prohibited by law.* We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Sr AI/Agentic Engineer
jobs.description: Lendistry is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. We consider applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or membership in any other group protected by federal, state, or local law. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at hr@lendistry.com Lendistry does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or staffing firms. To conduct business with Lendistry, a Master Services Agreement (MSA) must be executed and confirmed prior to submitting any information relating to a potential candidate. Without a signed MSA, Lendistry shall not be responsible to any individual or entity for any payment relating to any form of fee or compensation. And, in the event that a resume or candidate is submitted by a recruiter, an employment agency, or a staffing firm without a fully executed MSA, Lendistry has the unrestricted right to pursue and hire any of those candidate(s) without any legal or financial responsibility to the recruiter, agency, and/or firm. **A Day in the Life** The **Senior AI/Agentic Engineer** will deliver the Lendistry AI strategy, partnering closely with underwriting, credit, and product teams to turn real business challenges into AI solutions that ship and hold up in production. This is a hands\-on applied engineering role for an experienced LLM practitioner who owns AI features end to end and helps set technical direction for the team. You'll work directly with the VP of Organizational Intelligence, the AI team lead, and the Senior Staff Engineer, AI – leading agentic workflows, document intelligence, and retrieval systems, mentoring junior engineers, and helping shape the shared AI platform every Lendistry product team relies on. **Lendistry: Who We Are** We’re proud to be the nation’s largest minority\-led, tech\-savvy lender for small businesses and commercial real estate. As a certified Community Development Financial Institution (CDFI) and Community Development Entity (CDE), our mission is all about creating economic opportunities and fueling growth for small business owners and their communities. Join us as we pave the way with innovative financing and financial education! **What You’ll Be Doing** As a Senior AI Engineer, you'll lead delivery across Lendistry's AI products, always starting from a clear understanding of the business problem you're solving: * Document intelligence pipelines that read loan applications, tax returns, and financial statements with full audit trails. * Underwriting copilots that surface risk signals and policy checks in real time for underwriters. * Borrower\-facing conversational AI for applications, decisions, and loan management. * Shared AI platform components – prompt registry, tool\-calling, evaluation, and inference routing – used by every product team. * An evaluation and observability layer that makes AI reliability measurable, not just assumed. **LLM Systems \& Document Intelligence** * Own end\-to\-end LLM features – from the first business conversation through design, deployment, and production operation – across origination, underwriting, servicing, and borrower experience. * Lead agentic workflows and RAG systems: LLMs that plan, call tools, retrieve, and iterate across multi\-step lending tasks with human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * Lead document\-processing pipelines that extract structured data from loan applications and other unstructured financial documents using OCR and LLM\-based extraction. * Build validation, confidence scoring, and audit trails that make AI outputs safe for regulated, high\-stakes lending decisions, and diagnose agentic failure modes before they recur. **Platform, Evaluation \& Reliability** * Help shape the shared AI platform – prompt registry, evaluation harness, and inference routing – and design evaluation and observability (golden sets, LLM\-as\-judge scoring, cost/latency monitoring) that make AI quality measurable. * Treat cost and latency as first\-class engineering constraints through model\-tier routing, caching, and token budgeting. **Technical Leadership \& Collaboration** * Meet regularly with product, credit, underwriting, and platform engineering to understand their challenges, translate * them into reliable AI designs, and explain trade\-offs in plain language. * Partner with the AI team lead and Senior Staff Engineer to ship reliable features, mentor engineers through reviews and pairing, and lead proof\-of\-concept work that validates new use cases quickly. **AI\-Assisted Development Practice** * Use AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or similar) daily as part of the standard development loop, and help lead adoption of emerging agentic tools across Lendistry engineering. * Follow established human\-in\-the\-loop review criteria for when to trust cross multiple steps, and autonomously complete multi\-stage tasks with appropriate safeguards and audit trails. * Hands\-on experience with fine\-tuning and adaptation — LoRA, QLoRA, instruction tuning, or preference tuning — and with rigorous evaluation of model outputs rather than demo\-driven validation. **Engineering \& Platform Skills** ---------------------------------- * Strong LLM tooling fluency, with the judgment to build custom when needed. * Production experience turning unstructured data (documents, forms, scans) into structured, reliable outputs. * Cloud and deployment depth, evaluation discipline to catch LLM\-specific failure modes before production, and experience exposing AI capabilities as reliable internal APIs. **Security \& Regulated\-Industry Awareness** --------------------------------------------- * Working knowledge of LLM security concerns (prompt injection, data exfiltration, output filtering) and discipline around PII and sensitive financial data – redaction, minimization, and keeping it inside Lendistry's trust boundary. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience in fintech, lending, banking, healthcare, or another regulated industry. * Experience fine\-tuning open\-weight models, or with document\-understanding models and OCR tooling. * Background in NLP tasks (NER, classification, semantic similarity), or building shared AI platforms used by multiple product teams. * Experience mentoring engineers and leading design reviews; B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or equivalent experience. **Why You'll Love Working Here:** * Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance * Generous Paid Time Off * Birthday Day Off * 12 Paid Company Holidays * 401(k) Match * FSA and HSA * Paid Life Insurance * Paid Disability Insurance * Pet Insurance * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Professional Development Courses * In Office Provided Snacks and Drinks * Gym Facilities (LA \& Tustin/CEC Offices) * In Office Engagement Activities **Compensation Range** The US base salary range for this full\-time position is **$139,600 \- $180,800** annually. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum base salary for new hires for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by multiple factors like job\-related skills, experience, and state of residence. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range during the interview process. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include any variable compensation elements. **Physical Requirements** This is a stationary position that requires frequent sitting (approximately 95%), repetitive wrist motions, grasping, speaking, listening, close vision, and the ability to adjust focus. It also may require occasional standing, lifting, carrying of 20lbs or less, walking, kneeling, bending/stooping, twisting, pulling/pushing, and reaching above the shoulder. Employees in this position must be physically able to efficiently perform the essential functions of the position. ACKNOWLEDGEMENT B.S.D. jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Robotics Software Engineer** **Location:** Gainesville, FL · On\-site **Type:** Full\-time **PERFECT IT IN SIMULATION. PROVE IT ON THE ROBOT** Skin cancer kills 15,000 Americans a year. Not because it cannot be caught early, but because the imaging technology clinicians have access to was not designed to catch it. Lumijes is building the platform that changes that: a system combining robotics, multi\-spectral photonic imaging, and clinical AI to expose what conventional 2D snapshots leave hidden beneath the surface. Our cobots work inches away from patients and medical staff, so every motion has to be precise, smooth, and safe. We are hiring a Robotics Software Engineer to join our Simulation and Control software team and build and refine the virtual worlds where that motion is designed and tested: the digital twins, kinematics, and trajectory pipelines that get it right before code ever touches physical hardware. Then you will take those models onto the real cobot, tune its motion operations, and make sure it moves exactly the way the simulation said it would. **WHAT YOU'LL BUILD:** You will sit at the center of our sim\-to\-real loop. Your work speeds up our development cycle and decides how confidently we can put a robot next to a patient. * Digital twins: import and configure 3D CAD models into physics simulators, and define joint limits, link properties, and mass properties. * Virtual sensors: model camera, force/torque, and proximity sensors inside simulated environments. * Kinematics and trajectories: implement and test forward and inverse kinematics (FK/IK) and trajectory generation algorithms. * Workspace analysis: identify singularities, reachability constraints, and joint torque limits, and use simulation to find imaging sensor coverage limits or excess angles during motion. * Collision avoidance: develop and evaluate routines that protect patients and equipment. * Automated testing: run rigorous simulation tests to catch edge\-case bugs, and maintain regression suites for robot motion control software. * Sim\-to\-real transfer: move simulation motion models onto the physical cobot, map its full range of motion, and compare real test bed data against virtual metrics until they match. * Imaging collaboration: work with our imaging software team to improve cobot operation in challenging orientations so the imaging head can support every movement it needs. * Documentation: document simulation tests and code modules to support medical device software compliance standards. **WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:** We want engineers who trust the math, test everything, and are not satisfied until the real robot matches the simulation. * B.S. or M.S. in Robotics, Mechatronics, Biomedical Engineering (robotics focus), Mechanical Engineering, or Computer Science. * A solid foundation in C\+\+ and/or Python, with clean code practices. * Practical ROS / ROS 2 experience, whether through academic projects, internships, or your own repositories. * Experience authoring custom BehaviorTree.cpp nodes or using the MoveIt Pro Developer Platform. * Hardware abstraction: configuring jobs.title: Agentic Product Engineer, Studio Platform
jobs.description: **About Mercor** ================ Mercor’s mission is to organize human intelligence for the AI economy. We build the infrastructure that enables frontier AI labs and enterprises to train, evaluate, and improve AI on real\-world professional work. More than five million experts have joined our network, and we pay out over $5 million daily for their knowledge and expertise. We built our training and evaluation infrastructure alongside the world’s leading AI labs. Now, we’re bringing those capabilities to enterprises across industries, enabling them to train, evaluate, and improve AI using their own expertise and standards. Our APEX benchmarks measure how AI performs on economically valuable work, while our enterprise evaluations and post\-training capabilities turn those insights into measurable improvements across real\-world workflows. Our work sits at the intersection of frontier AI, human expertise, and real\-world application. We’re solving problems few companies have encountered, with the opportunity to influence what the world’s most advanced AI systems become capable of doing. We’re looking for people who bring different perspectives, take ownership, exercise sound judgment, and hold themselves to an exceptionally high standard. You’ll have the opportunity to do consequential work alongside talented colleagues who challenge one another, collaborate openly, and share a commitment to excellence. Mercor is profitable and recently raised a $750 million Series D at a $20 billion valuation. We work in person five days a week in San Francisco, New York, and London. **About the Role** ------------------ Frontier models learn to do real work inside RL environments, and those environments get built in Studio. Studio is the product thousands of domain experts use to design, generate and verify RL environments, for the labs behind the models you use every day. We're building the next generation platform for the agentic creation of RL environments, which every leading model is born out of. As a Fullstack Product Engineer on the Studio Platform team, you'll own the Studio user journeys end\-to\-end: the React frontend used daily by thousands of expert contributors and internal Strategic Project Leads, and the backend services powering data pipelines and delivery of outputs to customers. You'll also build and maintain the foundational layer that Mercor depends on to rapidly deploy new data types and task formats across the company. Four distinct stakeholders — AI labs, SPLs, expert contributors, and engineers— rely on what you build. This is a role for someone who cares equally about engineering craft and product impact: shipping scalable, reliable systems and intuitive interfaces that make everyone who touches Studio faster and more effective. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Design how experts and agents work together.** Agents draft the tasks, environments and graders, and experts steer and correct them. Your job is to make steering fast and reviewing easy. * **Build the environment workbench.** Create the agentic framework that experts use to author every environment in Studio. * **Make long agent runs easy to follow.** An expert should be able to understand a three\-hour run in three minutes. * **Turn new environment types into configuration.** When a customer asks for something new, it should ship in a day without an engineer writing code. * **Make quality visible.** Build the agentic QC views that show what failed and why, and let people fix it where they find it. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 5\+ years of fullstack engineering experience building and shipping production software. * You love to live in the product experience. You notice when a flow is one click too long, and you fix it without waiting for a spec. * You’re excellent on the frontend. You know React, TypeScript and Next.js in depth. You’ve built interfaces that create enjoyable visual experiences from complex data. * You go all the way down the stack. You’re comfortable designing the schema, the API and the background job behind the screen you’re building. * You’ve shipped products before. You have about five years of building production software, ideally where you own a product area end to end. * You build with AI. Coding agents are part of how you work, and you care about building the best agentic collaboration experience. * You turn unsolved problems into a plan. You can take a vague problem from a user or partner team, find the first principles issue, and explain the tradeoffs clearly. **Nice\-to\-Haves** ------------------- * Experience building tooling for data labeling, annotation, or human\-in\-the\-loop AI workflows. * Background in design systems, developer\-facing APIs, or internal platform engineering. * Exposure to AI tools, LLM\-powered products, or real\-time data and visualization. * Experience at top\-tier tech companies or fast\-scaling startups. **Why This Role Matters** ------------------------- * Your impact compounds on a massive scale. Experts are paid per task, so a fast experience directly drives the bottom line when the effects are felt across hundreds of thousands of users. * The feedback loop is tight. Features ship daily, and feedback loops are swift and efficient. * You see the frontier early. You watch how the newest models fail before the public does. **Benefits:** ------------- * Generous equity grant vested over 4 years * Health, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) with company match * Unlimited paid vacation and sick days * Parental leave for birthing and non\-birthing parents * Free mental health services * $200 monthly wellness reimbursement * $1\.5K monthly meal stipend * $200 monthly laundry reimbursement * Free Equinox membership * Up to $15K relocation bonus Mercor is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to providing equal opportunity to all employees and applicants. Mercor does not discriminate based on actual or perceived race (including hair texture and protective hairstyles), color, creed, religion, national origin, ethnicity, ancestry, citizenship or immigration status, alienage, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, pregnancy outcomes, childbirth, related medical conditions and lactation), reproductive health decision making (including sexual and reproductive health decisions), gender identity or gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, partnership status, familial status, caregiver status, military service and veteran status (including uniformed service), disability, height, weight, genetic information (including predisposing genetic characteristics), status as a victim of domestic violence, sex offenses, or stalking, arrest or conviction record (as provided by law), lawful off\-duty conduct, credit history (as provided by law), unemployment status, salary history (as provided by law), or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, New York, or local laws and ordinances. Further, Mercor prohibits discrimination, harassment, and retaliation based on any combination of protected characteristics. This Policy applies to all areas of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, compensation, benefits, discipline, termination, and all other privileges, terms, and conditions of employment. This Policy and the law prohibit employment discrimination against any employee or applicant based on any legally protected status. Compensation Range: $160K \- $500K

jobs.title: Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: **ABOUT US** Hey! We’re Molg We’re building robotic systems that make electronics manufacturing circular. We work with hyperscalers and leading electronics manufacturers to automate how hardware is designed, manufactured, disassembled, repaired, reused, and recovered. Using robotics, computational design, and AI, our systems turn today’s e\-waste into resilient, data\-driven supply chains—and change how electronics are made in the first place. **IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:** Join a talented cross\-functional team of software, mechanical, electrical, and robotics engineers to develop and own the firmware that brings Molg’s robotic microfactory systems to life. As a Firmware Engineer, you will: * Design, develop, and maintain firmware for embedded systems across Molg’s robotic platforms — including motor controllers, sensor interfaces, actuators, and custom PCBs. * Own the full firmware development lifecycle: requirements gathering, architecture design, implementation, testing, and deployment to production hardware. * Write robust, real\-time firmware in C/C\+\+ targeting bare\-metal and RTOS\-based environments (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or similar). * Develop and maintain drivers for communication protocols including CAN, SPI, I2C, UART, RS\-485, and Ethernet to support reliable hardware integration. * Collaborate closely with electrical engineers to bring up new hardware, validate schematics, and debug hardware/firmware interactions at the board level. * Build and maintain hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) and software\-in\-the\-loop (SIL) test frameworks to validate firmware behavior in automated CI/CD pipelines. * Partner with robotics and software engineers to define clear firmware/software interfaces and ensure reliable communication between embedded systems and higher\-level control stacks. * Instrument firmware for observability — logging, telemetry, and diagnostics — to support production monitoring and rapid field debugging. * Contribute to firmware architecture decisions as Molg’s system complexity grows, balancing performance, reliability, and maintainability. * Participate in design reviews and bring a hardware\-aware perspective to cross\-functional technical discussions. You’ll have the opportunity to build alongside an incredible team, develop innovative solutions, and grow in a fast\-paced environment that values autonomy and impact. **WHO YOU ARE:** * 5\+ years of professional firmware or embedded systems engineering experience, with a track record of shipping firmware on real hardware. * Expert\-level proficiency in C and C\+\+; experience with Python for tooling, test automation, or scripting is a strong plus. * Deep experience with microcontrollers and microprocessors (STM32, ESP32, NXP, TI, or similar); comfortable working with datasheets and reference manuals as primary sources of truth. * Hands\-on experience with RTOS development — task scheduling, interrupt handling, memory management, and real\-time constraints. * Solid understanding of common embedded communication protocols (CAN, SPI, I2C, UART, Ethernet) and how to debug them with logic analyzers and oscilloscopes. * Comfortable reading schematics and working directly with hardware — you enjoy getting to the root of hardware/software interaction issues. * Experience writing automated firmware tests, ideally in HIL or SIL environments; familiarity with pytest, Robot Framework, or similar testing tools is a plus. * Strong debugging skills — you can navigate a system from application layer down to the register level when needed. * Excellent communicator with a bias toward documentation and clean, maintainable code. * Ability to work in\-person at Molg HQ in Sterling, VA. **WHO WE ARE:** We spend our days building robotic systems, developing complex assembly intelligence software, and designing the next generation of circular products for our customers. Given the importance of working hands\-on with physical systems, the majority of our team is in\-person collaboratively working in our industrial space in Sterling, VA, down the road from the largest data center market in the world. Our facility includes a variety of robots, CNC milling machines, 3D printers, and all the tools needed to build and test our products. It is important to us that anyone on our team that is interested in learning how to use our various pieces of equipment and machinery is taught and can gain the skills and appreciation for making physical things. **THINGS TO KNOW:** * We’re a hands on collaborative team with big ambitions, and there’s a good amount of context\-switching. We expect people to be autonomous and drive their own work to completion. * We are scrappy and looking to build a great sustainable company for years to come. * As a growing company and startup, priorities may shift as customer or business requirements change. We strive to empower individuals with context and decision\-making power to meet this need.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Mytra:** We’re creating an entirely new way to solve the most ubiquitous problem in industry \- moving and storing material. We’re applying robotics and distributed software to create a new class of product for this $1T market. We’re focused on the supply chain industry first. The industry is in a massive bind with the continued growth of e\-commerce, sharp rise in costs, and supply chain disruptions. What has been a “sleepy” industry for decades is now at the epicenter of sustaining the global economy. **About the role** ------------------ The orchestration team builds the backend software that manages all of the work that needs to happen in a Mytra system: what every bot should work on, when, how and in what sequence; in addition to tracking the current state of the system and all of the work requests. We are constantly solving dynamically changing multi\-agent path finding and task allocation problems against a live fleet. We are looking for someone smart, hungry, and genuinely excited by algorithmic and optimization problems, with solid backend fundamentals. This person will help define the behavior of our robotics fleet to make our system as optimized as possible. **Problems we solve:** ---------------------- * Multi\-agent path finding at fleet scale. Collision\-free, time\-feasible trajectories, where every bot's path may intersect and constrain every other's. * Task assignment under precedence constraints. Which bot does what, in what order, when the work has dependencies. * Storage and retrieval strategy. Where a payload should be stored based on a variety of metadata, and what to move out of the way to reach one that's buried. * Continuous replanning. Re\-prioritizing and adapting to new or canceled work without stalling the fleet. * State truth and reconciliation. Mapping where everything is in the physical world in our digital twin; automating recovery when the physical and digital worlds differ; recovery from spills, maintenance zones, network drops, and more unpredictable problems! * Observability. Making a planning cycle legible enough to debug. * WMS integration. Mapping a customer's model of their work onto our system \- and then using that data to optimize their deployment of the Mytra system. **Ideal Candidates** -------------------- * Genuinely like algorithmic and optimization problems. Search, scheduling, routing, constraint solving, graph problems; these are the kind of thing you choose to think about, and you have chased some of them down before. * You've written backend software that other people depended on: a service, an API, something with a database behind it. * You've worked directly with relational databases, particularly SQL or Postgres. * You can own a defined piece of work end to end from general direction rather than daily supervision. * You find answers on your own: you can identify ambiguity, know which questions to ask, and are proactive about getting answers quickly. * You learn fast, and you want to! * You are proficient in Go (or similar backend languages), or can be productive in it quickly. * You are adept at using AI tools to work more efficiently, but are aware of where those tools have shortcomings. You validate their output rather than trusting it inherently. * 2\+ years of production experience. **Nice to have:** ----------------- * Helpful, not required: any exposure to multi\-agent path finding, task allocation, constraint problems, or other search based algorithms; Warehouse automation or AMR fleet management; working with a relational database at scale; experience with NATS or other message pub/sub tools; participated in an on call rotation for a live system with real customers **A Final Note:** ----------------- If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply — even if you don’t check every box. At Mytra, we build bots, but we hire humans. We value thoughtful challengers who communicate with clarity and respect, and we’re lifelong learners committed to getting better every day. We move fast, learn faster, and show up for each other under pressure. The best outcomes come from diverse perspectives working together to build something meaningful and built to last **Benefits Include:** --------------------- * Competitive compensation and equity grants at a high\-growth company backed by top\-tier VCs * Fully subsidized health coverage, including medical (baseline plans), dental, and vision for employees and dependents * 401(k) plans and employer\-subsidized life insurance * Fully subsidized lunch and snacks at HQ—we eat and share stories together at the “long” table * Generous PTO and company\-paid holidays, including one week over the winter break so everyone can recharge together * Voluntary pet insurance, Voluntary Life Insurance, Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity * Fully subsidized tax advisory services and education to help you understand your equity * Commuter benefits, including a up to $150 monthly commuter benefit * Lively, modern combined office and lab space where we rapidly iterate through design, build, and test phases * Fully equipped onsite gym and showers at headquarters **Pay Notice** -------------- Compensation for this position will be set based on the candidate's experience level and location. jobs.description: Procurement Engineer – Advanced Manufacturing **Machine Time Inc. \| Nicholasville, KY** **Employment Type:** Full\-Time \| On\-Site **Schedule:** Day Shift **Compensation:** Competitive, based on experience and technical capabilities Build the Future of Advanced Manufacturing **Advanced technology. Complex challenges. Opportunities to make an impact.** Machine Time is expanding, and we're looking for a Procurement Engineer who wants to grow with us. We're investing in advanced 5\-axis machining technology, expanding our manufacturing capacity, and preparing for our next phase of growth with a larger facility. Our focus is on becoming a leading precision manufacturing partner for the aerospace, space, defense, and other high\-performance industries. As our capabilities grow, we're building the supplier relationships, purchasing systems, and manufacturing processes needed to support increasingly complex projects. **We're looking for someone who understands that great procurement is about more than purchasing parts and materials. It's about finding solutions that make manufacturing possible.** You'll work directly with engineering, operations, quality, production, and suppliers to ensure the materials, components, and outside services needed to manufacture precision parts are available, compliant, and delivered when needed. This is an opportunity to take ownership, solve technical challenges, develop strategic supplier relationships, and help shape the future of our procurement operations. What You'll Be Working On Our team manufactures complex precision components using modern 3\-, 4\-, and 5\-axis CNC technology. As our Procurement Engineer, you'll help connect engineering requirements, supplier capabilities, and production needs. Your responsibilities will include: * Source and procure raw materials, hardware, tooling, components, and outside processing services. * Interpret engineering drawings, material specifications, customer requirements, and manufacturing documentation to determine purchasing requirements. * Identify, evaluate, and develop suppliers capable of supporting complex precision manufacturing. * Request and evaluate supplier quotations, comparing technical capabilities, pricing, lead times, and delivery commitments. * Negotiate pricing, purchasing terms, and delivery schedules while maintaining quality and compliance requirements. * Coordinate outside processing services such as anodizing, plating, heat treating, nondestructive testing, and specialized coatings. * Collaborate with estimating and engineering to obtain accurate material and outside processing costs for customer quotations. * Issue, track, and manage purchase orders to support production schedules and customer commitments. * Monitor supplier performance and proactively address shortages, delays, and delivery risks. * Work with quality personnel to resolve supplier nonconformances, documentation issues, and corrective actions. * Ensure purchased materials and services meet applicable drawing, specification, certification, and traceability requirements. * Support supplier qualification, approval, and ongoing performance evaluation. * Maintain accurate purchasing records, supplier information, and documentation within our digital ERP systems. * Identify opportunities to reduce procurement costs, improve lead times, strengthen supplier relationships, and streamline purchasing processes. * Support continuous improvement initiatives that make our manufacturing operations more efficient and scalable. We believe procurement should be proactive, technically informed, and closely connected to manufacturing—not simply a process of submitting purchase orders. What Success Looks Like **You'll play a direct role in helping Machine Time manufacture challenging parts and deliver on its commitments.** Success in this position means: * Production has the materials and outside services it needs when they're needed. * Suppliers understand our technical requirements and consistently meet expectations. * Material and processing costs are competitive, accurate, and well understood. * Purchasing decisions support quality, traceability, and customer requirements. * Potential supply chain problems are identified and addressed before they affect production. * Supplier relationships become stronger and more capable as the company grows. * Procurement processes become more efficient, reliable, and scalable. We're looking for someone who takes ownership of results, communicates clearly, and enjoys finding solutions to difficult problems. What We're Looking For The ideal candidate combines technical understanding with organization, communication, and commercial judgment. **Minimum Qualifications** * Two or more years of experience in manufacturing procurement, technical purchasing, sourcing, manufacturing engineering, or a related field. * Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and technical documentation. * Working knowledge of  with material certifications, traceability, and counterfeit material prevention. * Experience with technical estimating, manufacturing cost analysis, or RFQ development. * Experience using manufacturing ERP systems and digital procurement workflows. * Familiarity with Paperless Parts or similar manufacturing quoting platforms. * Experience negotiating supplier agreements and developing long\-term purchasing relationships. * Technical degree in engineering, manufacturing, supply chain management, or a related discipline. **A technical degree is valuable, but demonstrated manufacturing knowledge, problem\-solving ability, and relevant experience are equally important.** You don't need to check every preferred qualification to be considered. We're interested in what you can contribute today and how you can grow with our company. What Makes This Opportunity Different? **You'll have the opportunity to influence how an expanding advanced manufacturing company operates.** At Machine Time, procurement works directly with the people responsible for estimating, programming, machining, inspecting, and delivering our products. That means you'll see how your decisions affect the manufacturing process—and have opportunities to improve it. As we expand our equipment, facilities, production capacity, and customer relationships, you'll help develop the supplier network and purchasing systems needed to support that growth. We're looking for someone who wants to do more than maintain an existing process. We want someone who brings ideas, challenges inefficiencies, builds relationships, and helps us become a stronger manufacturing organization. Compensation \& Benefits **Competitive Compensation Based on Experience** Compensation will reflect technical knowledge, manufacturing experience, supplier management capabilities, and the ability to work independently. **Health \& Insurance** * 80% employer\-paid Anthem health insurance premiums. * 100% employer\-paid dental and vision insurance premiums. * Optional employee\-paid short\-term and long\-term disability insurance. * Optional employee\-paid life, accident, cancer, and critical illness insurance. **Paid Time Off \& Holidays** * 40 hours of PTO after completing the introductory probationary period. * 80 hours of annual PTO after one year of service. * 120 hours of annual PTO after five years of service. * Eight paid holidays annually, separate from PTO. **Additional Benefits** * Employee\-funded 401(k) retirement savings plan. * Paid parental leave for eligible employees. * $150 safety footwear credit after the probationary period. * $150 prescription safety glasses credit after the probationary period. * Opportunities for professional development and advancement in manufacturing procurement, supplier management, and operations. *Benefits are subject to eligibility requirements and applicable company policies.* Why Machine Time? **We're building something bigger than a traditional machine shop.** Our vision is to create a manufacturing environment where advanced technology, skilled people, and continuous improvement come together to deliver exceptional results. We're investing in the equipment, facilities, systems, and people needed to support the next generation of precision manufacturing. We want our employees to be part of that progress—not simply watch it happen. Our mission is to **Make Manufacturing Sexy** by challenging outdated perceptions of manufacturing and demonstrating what's possible when talented people have the tools, technology, and opportunities to succeed. If you're looking for an opportunity to apply your technical knowledge, develop supplier relationships, solve challenging problems, and help build a stronger manufacturing organization, **we'd like to hear from you.** **Join Machine Time and help build what's next.** *Machine Time Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.* Pay: $50,000\.00 \- $65,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Health insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description: **Head of Engineering Job Description:** Scope, Impact \& Qualifications Reports to: CEO Level: Executive (CTO\-equivalent scope) Org size: \~25 engineers Time split: 70% Product / 30% Discipline ROLE SUMMARY The Head of Engineering owns the technical outcomes of Maestro's entire product suite while also serving as the top of the engineering discipline ladder: every engineering manager and individual contributor ultimately ladders up to this role. The position deliberately splits attention: 70% product execution, 30% discipline accountability. Product delivery is the immediate, ongoing accountability; discipline work compounds over time and requires protected but smaller blocks of focus so it doesn't get crowded out by delivery pressure. This role sits at the center of Maestro's matrix structure, accountable for craft quality and standards company\-wide, while ensuring embedded engineering talent on each product team is pointed at the right priorities. **SCOPE • Org reach:** all engineering leads across all product lines report into this role (directly or via a lead layer), the senior\-most engineering accountability in the company. • Product surface: full product suite, every active product line's engineering output. • Discipline surface: engineering\-wide standards, tooling, and process, independent of which product team an engineer sits on. THE 70%: PRODUCT ACCOUNTABILITY The Head of Engineering is the single accountable owner for engineering execution across Maestro's product portfolio. **What this looks like day to day:** • Partners with the engineering leads of every product line to ensure their teams are resourced against the right priorities: not just busy, but correctly sequenced. • Accountable for ensuring product strategy and roadmap direction are translated into clear, actionable engineering plans, serving as the connective layer between Product and Delivery leadership and the engineering organization, primarily through engineering leads embedded within product teams. • Accountable for applying technical judgment to turn high\-level strategic priorities into concrete technical execution plans, enabling and guiding engineering leads to scope, sequence, and de\-risk delivery across their product areas. • Identifies where product priorities and engineering capacity are misaligned across teams and resolves the tradeoff, including cross\-team resourcing calls. * Is the escalation point when a product line's engineering execution is off track, and is accountable for getting it back on track. Impact: Every product line ships against strategy, not just against what's easiest to build. Product and Delivery leaders have one accountable engineering partner instead of negotiating separately with each product line's lead. THE 30%: DISCIPLINE ACCOUNTABILITY The Head of Engineering owns what "good engineering" means at Maestro, independent of the product line. **What this looks like day to day:** • Sets and maintains company\-wide engineering standards (code quality, architecture principles, technical debt posture). • Owns cross\-cutting technical initiatives that no single product team should solve independently, e.g. product suite services and universal QA automation. • Defines how AI tooling is used across engineering, including guardrails to ensure AI usage improves output quality and velocity rather than introducing risk or degrading craft. * Identifies and removes friction in how engineering work gets done company\-wide, streamlining processes that slow every team down in the same way. • Is the ultimate accountable owner for engineering management practice (how EMs lead, how performance is evaluated, how the craft is grown) even where day\-to\-day people management is embedded in product teams. Impact: Engineering quality, velocity, and management practice don't fragment by product line. An engineer's experience of "how we build software here" is consistent no matter which team they're on, and the org gets the benefits of scale (shared tooling, shared standards) instead of each team reinventing its own. SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE • Engineers across the organization deliver flawless technical execution that earns long\-term client retention and supports growth. • Product lines are resourced against strategic priority, with tradeoffs made explicitly rather than by default. • Engineering leads across product lines operate with a shared technical bar and shared tooling. • Company\-wide initiatives (QA automation, AI usage standards) ship and get adopted, not just get designed. * Engineering management practice is consistent and healthy across the org, even though EMs are embedded in product teams day to day. QUALIFICATIONS Maestro hires for demonstrated capability, not years\-of\-service checkboxes. The bar below is competency\-based: what someone needs to be able to do, not how long they've been doing it. Required competencies: • Has personally carried end\-to\-end accountability for engineering delivery across more than one product or team simultaneously: not just led a single team, but balanced competing priorities across several. * Can translate ambiguous, high\-level strategy (from product, business, or leadership) into a technical execution plan that engineers can actually build against, without needing someone else to do that translation. • Has designed or materially improved an engineering standard, process, or tooling investment that worked across teams (not a single\-team fix) and can point to the before/after. • Comfortably operates in a matrixed environment, influencing and aligning engineering leads, their teams, and cross\-functional stakeholders without relying on formal authority. • Has hands\-on technical depth sufficient to earn credibility with senior engineers and to personally evaluate technical tradeoffs. This is not a purely managerial role. • Has direct experience managing or mentoring engineering managers, not only individual contributors. • Demonstrates sound judgment on when to standardize company\-wide versus when to let product teams operate with autonomy. Strongly preferred: • Experience operating at this scope inside a company of comparable size (roughly 15 to 50 engineers), where formal process is lighter and judgment calls happen more often than policy lookups. * Direct experience setting a company's approach to AI\-assisted engineering (tooling choices, guardrails, or usage standards) rather than just using AI tools personally. • A track record of building or scaling QA automation, testing strategy, or release process across multiple teams. • Experience partnering directly with Product and Delivery leadership as a peer, not just receiving requirements from them. • Experience leading engineering for always\-on, customer\-facing digital products or live\-service platforms, where availability, release discipline, observability, incident response, and rapid cross\-functional coordination directly affect the end\-user experience and client retention. **What we're explicitly not requiring:** • A specific prior title (VP Engineering, CTO, etc.). We care about scope actually carried, not the title it came with. • A minimum years\-of\-experience threshold. Competency and evidence of impact matter more than tenure. * Deep expertise in every technology in Maestro's stack. Technical judgment and the ability to evaluate tradeoffs matter more than hands\-on fluency in any one language or framework.

jobs.title: Business Engineer

Degree must be completed prior to joining Meta * Must obtain work authorization in country of employment at the time of hire, and maintain ongoing work authorization during employment ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements) * Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies * Experience contributing to open source projects, shared code repositories, and/or personal projects * Experience working on multi\-person code bases including open source or personal projects * Experience with open source contributions (especially as part of larger projects) * Client/partner\-facing and/or experience communicating to an audience * Experience contributing to developer and platform documentation * Experience working in highly collaborative environments * Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews) ### **About Meta:** Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. jobs.title: Enterprise Network Engineer - Orlando, FL
jobs.description: Love Your Mondays again! **Join the Future of Connectivity with Metronet!** Are you ready to launch your career with one of the nation’s fastest\-growing fiber\-optic powerhouses? Welcome to Metronet, where we don’t just build networks; we build communities. **Enterprise Network Engineer** As an **Enterprise Network Engineer**, you will play a key role in designing, implementing, securing, optimizing, and supporting Metronet's enterprise network infrastructure and network security systems. You will help ensure the reliability, scalability, performance, and security of our wired, wireless, WAN, data center, cloud\-connected, and remote\-site environments while supporting critical business operations across the organization. This role is ideal for an experienced network professional who has successfully designed, deployed, and supported enterprise\-scale network and security solutions within medium to large business environments. You will lead network and security initiatives, manage infrastructure upgrades, troubleshoot complex technical challenges, and contribute to the continued modernization of our enterprise technology environment. We're looking for a self\-directed engineer who can take ownership of projects from planning through implementation, work independently with minimal supervision, and bring practical, real\-world experience with enterprise networking technologies. The ideal candidate will have experience supporting large\-scale firewall deployments, data center networking, routing and switching infrastructures, and multi\-site enterprise environments. Success in this role comes from combining strong technical expertise with sound decision\-making, problem\-solving skills, and the ability to drive results in a fast\-paced and evolving environment. **ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:** * Lead the design, deployment, maintenance, and ongoing optimization of enterprise network infrastructure and network security platforms, including routers, switches, firewalls, wireless access points, WAN circuits, VPNs, and related technologies. * Independently manage assigned network engineering projects from planning and design through implementation, documentation, testing, and operational support. * Design and maintain enterprise LAN, WAN, wireless, data center, and cloud\-connected network architectures to support business requirements, remote site connectivity, resiliency, performance, security, and future growth. * Develop, maintain, and evolve network and network security standards, reference architectures, implementation practices, and engineering best practices that support scalability, security, and operational excellence across the enterprise. * Design, implement, review, and maintain network security controls including firewall policies, ACLs, segmentation, VPN access, NAT, secure management access, zero trust\-aligned controls, and access control frameworks. * Serve as an escalation resource for complex network and network security incidents, including routing, switching, wireless, firewall, VPN, DNS, DHCP, WAN, cloud connectivity, performance, availability, and policy\-related issues. * Perform firewall rule reviews, network access reviews, security policy cleanup, and assist with vulnerability remediation efforts related to network infrastructure. * Develop and maintain network and security documentation including diagrams, standards, configurations, procedures, support records, implementation plans, firewall rule documentation, and maintenance window documentation. * Respond to, document, update, and resolve assigned network and security operations tickets in accordance with established service levels, escalation procedures, and change management practices. * Drive network growth initiatives, capacity planning, infrastructure refresh projects, technology standardization efforts, and network security platform modernization across the enterprise. * Lead and collaborate with vendors, service providers, contractors, security teams, and internal stakeholders to successfully deliver network projects, site deployments, migrations, cutovers, and infrastructure upgrades. * Occasional travel to Evansville, IN for team meetings and collaboration events (approximately twice per year). * All other duties as assigned **JOB QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS:** * Bachelor’s degree or better in related field or 4\+ years of related network engineering and network security experience minimum. * Strong experience with NGFW firewalls such as Cisco Firepower, Palo Alto, or FortiGate, including firewall policy management, NAT, VPN, logging, troubleshooting, rule review, and problem resolution. * Experience with enterprise networking technologies and management platforms such as Arista, Juniper, Cisco Nexus, Cisco ISE, Cisco ACI, NDFC, or similar enterprise networking and infrastructure management solutions preferred. * Experience designing, deploying, and supporting enterprise\-scale network infrastructure within medium\-to\-lar SPF, or EIGRP, including route filtering, redistribution, and troubleshooting preferred. * Experience with SD\-WAN technologies, VPN technologies, WAN provider coordination, and remote\-site connectivity preferred. * Experience configuring, deploying, and maintaining Cisco network devices in enterprise LAN, WAN, wireless, security, and data center environments. * Understanding of cloud networking and hybrid network connectivity concepts, including public cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure and related security controls. * Experience with network monitoring, firewall logging, NetFlow, SNMP, Syslog, packet analysis, and performance troubleshooting tools preferred. * Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex network engineering projects, troubleshoot advanced technical issues, and drive solutions with minimal supervision. * Ability to communicate technical and security matters clearly to peers, leadership, vendors, contractors, and non\-technical counterparts. * Good oral and written communication skills with the ability to document technical designs, changes, security decisions, and operational procedures. * Detail\-oriented organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, operational issues, and security\-related requests. * Dependability, adaptability, flexibility, creativity, professional attitude, and the ability to understand complex issues, drive troubleshooting efforts, escalate appropriately when needed. * Willingness to work as a team and independently. * Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. **ADDITIONAL JOB REQUIREMENTS:** * Participate in an on\-call rotation to support network and security incidents outside normal business hours. * Industry\-recognized certifications such as CCNP Enterprise, CCNA, Cisco Security, Palo Alto, Fortinet, AWS Networking, CompTIA Network\+, Security\+, or equivalent preferred. * Experience designing, implementing, securing, and supporting enterprise network infrastructure in a multi\-site environment. Join us and find out what it means to love your career! At **Metronet**, we are committed to delivering cutting\-edge technology combined with exceptional customer care. Our 100% fiber\-optic technology ensures that we provide our customers with some of the fastest internet speeds in the world. As industry leaders in fiber\-to\-the\-premise TV, voice, and internet services, we’re not just focused on expanding our networks—we’re focused on enriching the lives of those we serve. We value our associates because they are the cornerstone of our success. By joining the **Metronet** family, you’re stepping into a rewarding career in technology with a company dedicated to your growth and success. We’re in it to win it, and a key part of our strategy is to strengthen our business\-to\-business technology sales team with talented and hard\-working individuals who aspire to be the next generation of technology leaders. Recognized as one of the Best Places to Work, we offer a competitive total compensation package, including 80% of medical premiums paid by the company, company\-paid disability and life insurance, and a 401(k)\-company match. Plus, enjoy discounted services within our coverage areas and thrive in a locally owned, friendly, and fun atmosphere. Discover more with **Metronet** — a company where your success builds stronger communities, and your future is limitless. **Metro****net** is an equal opportunity employer. We will not discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity, race, gender, religion, age, national origin, color, disability, or veteran status. EOE/Minority/Female/Disabled/Veteran Pay Range: $75,000 \- $95,000/yr. \#LI\-AF1 Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.description: ### **Who we are** The real world is the next frontier, and at Metropolis, we are creating artificial intelligence to make it responsive. We are pioneering the Recognition Economy — a future where mundane repetition disappears and being known unlocks access, comfort, and belonging everywhere you go. From transforming parking into a seamless drive\-in, drive\-out experience for millions of Members to expanding our intelligence layer across retail and hospitality, we are building a world that feels instinctive and magical. In this highly impactful role, you will design, deploy, and own end\-to\-end models that forecast demand, capture price\-demand relationships, and use causal inference and double ML to create actionable pricing strategies. scalable pricing decisions * Architect and productionize scalable demand forecasting models optimized for business goals like visit volume, revenue maximization, and inventory availability * Build and deploy end\-to\-end data pipelines to support large\-scale production usage * Identify data issues including bias, leakage, and labeling inconsistencies, and drive solutions * Design and analyze experiments using A/B testing, switchback, and causal inference to validate pricing strategies * Deploy and monitor machine learning models in production to ensure reliability, scalability, and data quality * Collaborate with product, engineering, and business teams to translate requirements into scalable machine learning solutions * Mentor junior engineers and foster a culture of technical excellence within the machine learning organization ### **What we're looking for** * PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, Applied Mathematics, Industrial Engineering, Operational Research, or a related STEM field with 6\+ years of relevant experience, or MS with 8\+ years experiences with equivalent publications. * Proven experience owning and leading projects from inception to production, successfully deploying models and driving measurable business impact * Solid understanding of causal inference and experimentation, with experience evaluating both short\-term and long\-term effects using A/B testing, DiD, Bandits and uplift modeling * Strong experience in machine learning modeling and statistics, specifically leveraging time series forecasting, probabilistic models, and deep learning models * Experience productionizing and supporting end\-to\-end solutions using forecasting, optimization, and decision\-making algorithms * Hands\-on experience with data pipeline development, including AWS data storage, data transformation, distributed processing with Spark, and workflow orchestration via Airflow. * Experience building agentic AI solutions for pricing is highly desirable. * Proficient programming skills in Python and SQL. Power user of AI coding tools. * Exceptional communication skills with the ability to bridge technical and business domains, influence stakeholders, read academic literature, and formulate concepts using mathematical notation. Ability to explain complex technical topics to non\-technical audiences. **4 Days in Office:** Metropolis values in\-person collaboration to drive innovation, strengthen culture, and enhance the Member experience. Our corporate team members hold to our office\-first model, which requires employees to be on\-site at least four days a week, fostering organic interactions that spark creativity and connection *When you join Metropolis, you'll join a team of world\-class product leaders and engineers, building an ecosystem of technologies at the intersection of parking, mobility, and real estate. Our goal is to build an inclusive culture where everyone has a voice and the best idea wins. You will play a key role in building and maintaining this culture as our organization grows. The anticipated base salary for this position is $220,000\.00 to $260,000\.00 annually. The actual base salary offered is determined by a number of variables, including, as appropriate, the applicant's qualifications for the position, years of relevant experience, distinctive skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location of residence and/or place of employment. Base salary is one component of Metropolis's total compensation package, which may also include access to or eligibility for healthcare benefits, a 401(k) plan, short\-term and long\-term disability coverage, basic life insurance, a lucrative stock option plan, bonus plans and more.* *\#LI\-RR1 \#LI\-Onsite* *Metropolis may utilize an automated employment decision tool (AEDT) to assess or evaluate your candidacy for employment or promotion. Infrastructure Architecture** * Design enterprise\-scale infrastructure environments supporting AI, machine learning, and high\-performance computing workloads. * Develop architecture solutions integrating GPU compute platforms, high\-throughput networking, enterprise storage, and workload orchestration technologies. * Evaluate infrastructure requirements based on application performance, scalability, resource utilization, and operational costs. * Produce technical architecture documentation, infrastructure diagrams, hardware specifications, and implementation plans. * Lead frameworks. * Provide technical leadership and mentoring to infrastructure engineers and architects. * Maintain awareness of emerging AI infrastructure technologies and evolving industry architecture practices. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * 10\+ years of experience in enterprise infrastructure architecture, solutions engineering, technical consulting, or related infrastructure. * Experience with accelerated computing platforms, GPU cluster architecture, and infrastructure sizing. * Advanced understanding of enterprise networking, including high\-speed jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** As AI continues to transform how people discover and interact with information, building scalable, efficient, and reliable AI and Machine Learning infrastructure is more critical than ever. The next generation of intelligent discovery will be powered by advanced machine learning, recommendation systems, agentic workflows, and generative AI working together to deliver personalized, useful, and engaging experiences. The Recommendation \& Agent Platform team at Microsoft Feeds \& AI builds the core AI and ML platforms behind Copilot Discover. Our mission is to empower product teams to rapidly build, train, evaluate, deploy, and scale intelligent discovery experiences that serve millions of users. Our team works across three key platform areas: * Machine Learning Infrastructure – Build scalable, high\-performance infrastructure supporting the end\-to\-end ML lifecycle, including large\-scale distributed training, GPU computing and optimization, efficient model inference and serving, model deployment, evaluation, experimentation, and observability. Develop foundational systems that enable rapid model iteration, efficient resource utilization, and reliable AI operations at scale. * Recommendation Platform – Powers the end\-to\-end recommendation stack, including retrieval, ranking, reranking, experimentation, online serving, and evaluation. Build scalable systems that deliver highly personalized and relevant content experiences to millions of users. * Agentic \& Generative AI Platform – Build scalable, reusable platform capabilities that enable product teams to develop and operate agentic workflows and generative AI experiences. Provide foundational infrastructure for agent orchestration, tool integration, context and memory management, retrieval, grounding, and multimodal content generation and synthesis, enabling rapid innovation and reliable execution at scale. Across these platforms, we embrace AI\-native development practices, leveraging coding agents, automated evaluation, intelligent experimentation, and continuous optimization to accelerate engineering productivity and bring new AI capabilities from ideas to production quickly, efficiently, and reliably. For this **Principal Software Engineer** position, we are particularly looking for an engineer who is passionate about building and advancing our Machine Learning Infrastructure. You will focus on designing and developing scalable, high\-performance ML systems that power large\-scale training, inference, and model serving. You will tackle challenging problems in distributed computing, GPU efficiency, model optimization, and production ML infrastructure, while collaborating closely with teams working on recommendation systems, agentic AI, and generative AI. If you're excited about solving challenging ML infrastructure problems at scale, building foundational AI systems, and contributing to the next generation of intelligent discovery, we'd love to hear from you. **Responsibilities** * Partners with appropriate stakeholders to determine user requirements for one or more complex scenarios. * Provides technical leadership for the identification of
