items. * Holds accountability as a Designated Responsible Individual (DRI), mentoring engineers across products/solutions, working on\-call to monitor system/product/service for degradation, downtime, or interruptions. * Proactively seeks new knowledge and adapts to new trends, technical solutions, and patterns that will improve the availability, reliability, efficiency, observability, and performance of products while also driving consistency in monitoring and operations at scale and shares knowledge with other engineers. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor's jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** Microsoft 365 (M365\) Intelligent Conversation and Communications Cloud (IC3\) is the platform that powers billions of real\-time customer conversations across Teams, Skype, Dynamics, and third\-party solutions (through Azure Communication Services). The platform enables reliable and high\-quality messaging, meeting, and audio/video calling services that work every time, from anywhere, seamlessly across all customer touch points. Conversations on our platforms are made more intelligent in real\-time, empowering best\-in\-class productivity tools for the modern workplace where every call, meeting, or chat will make the next one better. IC3 Policies and settings are critical to drive adoption and revenue of Teams. We grew our global Teams MAU from 50M to 330M since 2020 through addition of over 600 controls spread across 50 policies and 25 settings. Our policy platform is a hyper scale platform serving 75 unique policies resulting in 3 billion runtime resolutions per day. Join a team that’s redefining how cloud\-scale security is built and delivered. At IC3 Security Engineering, we’re creating a future where intelligent systems automatically protect and remediate security risks across hundreds of services. You’ll be part of a mission\-driven team centralizing security operations, empowering service owners, and using AI to transform risk mitigation into a proactive, scalable, and efficient process. In this team, you’ll work with passionate engineers who care deeply about protecting our cloud infrastructure and building smarter, safer systems for the world. As a Senior Software Engineer in the IC3 AEGIS team, you will design and build the AI\-driven platform that powers our centralized security automation and risk remediation. You’ll develop intelligent services that understand complex security requirements, evaluate service posture, and orchestrate automated fixes across IC3\. This opportunity will allow you to accelerate your technical and career growth, gain deep expertise in large\-scale cloud and security systems, and leverage cutting\-edge AI to solve real\-world challenges in security automation. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. **Responsibilities*** Collaborates with appropriate stakeholders to determine user requirements for a scenario. * Drives identification of dependencies and the development of design documents for a product, application, service, or platform. * Creates, implements, optimizes, debugs, refactors, and reuses code to establish and improve performance and maintainability, effectiveness, and return on investment (ROI). * Leverages subject\-matter expertise of product features and partners with appropriate stakeholders (e.g., project managers) to drive a workgroup's project plans, release plans, and work items. * Acts as a Designated Responsible Individual (DRI) and guides other engineers by developing and following the playbook, working on call to monitor system/product/service for degradation, downtime, or interruptions, alerting stakeholders about status and initiates actions to restore system/product/service for simple and complex problems when appropriate. * Proactively seeks new knowledge and adapts to new trends, technical solutions, and patterns that will improve the availability, reliability, efficiency, observability, and performance of products while also driving consistency in monitoring and operations at scale. **Qualifications** ### **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 4\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python + OR equivalent experience. **Other Requirements:** Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: * Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python + OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python + OR equivalent experience. * Proficiency in one or more programming languages (such as C\#, Python, Go, or Java) with experience in building distributed systems or cloud services. * Experience with service\-oriented architecture, microservices, or large\-scale cloud systems (e.g., Azure, AWS, GCP). * Demonstrated understanding of secure coding practices, authentication, authorization, and service security fundamentals. * Experience developing or integrating with AI/ML or automation frameworks to optimize workflows, detect issues, or enable intelligent decision\-making. * Solid problem\-solving and system design skills, with the ability to translate complex security or compliance requirements into practical, automated solutions. * Familiarity with DevSecOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure\-as\-code for managing large\-scale deployments. * Excellent collaboration and communication skills — able to work effectively with cross\-functional partners, influence without authority, and drive alignment across teams. * Growth mindset with a passion for learning new technologies, especially AI\-assisted development and cloud security tooling. * Experience as a Designated Responsible Individual (DRI) or similar operational role, ensuring high service availability and reliability. \#IC3 Platform Software Engineering IC4 \- The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $119,800 \- $234,700 At Milwaukee Tool, we firmly believe that our People and Culture drive our success. Our mission is to provide the tools, technology, and support you need to build software that makes an impact. **Your Role on Our Team** As a Sr Full Stack Software Developer, you will design, build, and support the applications that Supply Chain runs on. You will work across the stack — React front end, Python and API back end — building applications on Databricks that planners, buyers and engineers use every day to make decisions. This is a software engineering role embedded in an analytics team. You will work directly with the business users who depend on what you build, see your work in production quickly, and own it end to end. You will be self\-motivated, pragmatic, and a strong collaborator, comfortable translating a business problem into a working application. **You’ll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:** * Design, build, and maintain full stack applications — React front end, Python and API back end — deployed on Databricks. * Partner directly with business users to understand how they work, and turn that into applications they actually use. * Build and consume APIs that integrate with Oracle, the enterprise data warehouse, and other core systems. * Consume native Databricks services, such as SQL warehouse, Jobs, AI endpoints, Agents, Lakebase (Postgres) * Own applications through their full lifecycle — development, testing, release, hyper care and ongoing support. * Drive engineering standards across the team: code review, version control, CI/CD, testing and traceability. * Build reusable components and shared patterns so each application gets faster to build than the last. * Apply AI\-assisted development tooling effectively, with the judgement to know when generated output is right and when it is not. Working knowledge of SQL and relational data models. * **Other TOOLS we prefer you to have:** * Experience building and deploying applications on modern cloud data platforms (Databricks, Azure, Snowflake, etc.). * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, source control and automated testing. * Experience with containerization and deployment tooling. Familiarity with AI\-assisted development and with integrating AI\-driven capability into applications. * **We provide these great perks and benefits:** * Robust health, dental and vision insurance plans * Generous 401 (K) savings plan * Education assistance * On\-site wellness, fitness center, food, and coffee service * And many more, check out our benefits site HERE . *Milwaukee Tool is an equal opportunity employer.*

Create, update and maintain APQP documentation, including FMEA, Control Plans and process flow diagrams. Follow AIAG APQP procedures and customer\-specific requirements; prepare and submit Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) packages. Ensure manufactured parts meet customer specifications and promptly address nonconformances. Investigate customer concerns, lead corrective actions, develop action plans and complete customer\-specific reporting. Drive continuous improvement in plant scrap, process capability and cost of quality. Maintain and improve the quality management system to comply with applicable standards and customer\-specific requirements. Prepare quality reports and corrective action updates for customers and executive management. Collaborate with other Minth facilities to promote consistent quality systems and read\-across of lessons learned. Perform other duties and special projects as assigned. PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORKING ENVIRONMENT Combination of office\-based work, manufacturing floor activities and customer\-site visits. document processing. * Build data pipelines and dashboards connecting project, equipment, safety, and productivity metrics. * Design AI solutions with human review and accuracy checks before they reach the field. * Work with Learning \& Development and Safety to support training and knowledge tools. **Deployment, Training \& Support** * Roll out new tools to pilot crews first, then expand skills. * Comfortable working directly with field crews and supervisors on active job sites. * Bilingual English/Spanish. * Valid driver's license and ability to travel to job sites across the DFW processing. * Experience with construction or ERP software such as Viewpoint, HCSS, Procore, or similar platforms. * Experience creating dashboards or data visualizations (Power BI, Tableau, or similar). * Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. * Experience building mobile or offline\-capable applications. **What You Get from Working at Moss** * An Automate operational workflows to reduce manual effort across program management, operations, and partner support. * Reliability \& Observability: Own platform uptime, performance, and security in production. Define and monitor SLAs, implement alerting and observability tooling, and drive rapid incident resolution. Documentation \& Collaboration: Produce clear architecture documentation, runbooks, and API references. Working closely with program managers, operations, and technical leads to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. * **What we need to see:** * Education: A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or an equivalent experience. * Cloud Expertise: 8\+ years of hands\-on experience building and operating production infrastructure on AWS. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Graphics Engineer, AI for Experiences
jobs.description: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. NVIDIA is searching for a world\-class engineer in graphics and AI to join our neural graphics product team. We are passionate about applications in generative AI, gaming, augmented reality, user\-generated content, computer vision, and other areas, with the goal of improving visual fidelity, gameplay, or other domains within the gaming and pro\-visualization markets. jobs.title: 2027-2028 Computer Science & Robotics Engineering Teacher
jobs.description: **Start date: August 2027** **Mission** The mission of Neighborhood Charter Schools is to empower every scholar to discover their unique potential and develop the knowledge, character, and courage to shape a better future for themselves, their communities, and the world. Through an exceptional, rigorous, and inclusive K\-12 education, we cultivate scholars who lead with LIGHT, equipping them to think critically, embrace lifelong learning, and lead with purpose. We foster a community where every scholar, including autistic children and scholars with IEPs, belongs, every difference is celebrated, and every learner is empowered to thrive. *Every Learner. Every Pathway. Every Chance to Thrive.* **About Neighborhood Charter Schools** Neighborhood Charter Schools (NCS) is a public charter school network rooted in Harlem and the Bronx, serving students in an intentionally designed, inclusive learning community. NCS is built on a simple but powerful belief: every child deserves to be known, valued, and supported as their full self. Our schools operate as a true neighborhood model, grounded in deep relationships with families and a commitment to belonging for every student. What distinguishes NCS is an inclusive\-by\-design approach. Classrooms, schedules, and supports are intentionally built to serve high\-functioning autistic students, multilingual learners, students with IEPs, and general education students together. Inclusion is not a program or an add\-on—it is the foundation of how our schools function and how students experience learning every day. As NCS expands from a K–8 network to a K–12 system, the launch of its first high school marks a defining moment for the organization. The high school represents an opportunity to extend NCS’s inclusive, neighborhood\-based model through adolescence, creating continuity, care, and high expectations over time. The Founding High School Principal will play a central role in shaping this next chapter and bringing the NCS high school vision to life. To learn more about NCS, please visit https://ncschools.org/ncs\-high\-school/ **The Opportunity** NCS is launching its first high school, serving Harlem and the Bronx and opening in August 2027\. The Founding Computer Science \& Robotics Engineering Teacher builds the school's computing and engineering pathway from the ground up, starting with an introductory course for every 9th grader and growing into AP Computer Science Principles, AP Computer Science A, and hands\-on courses in artificial intelligence and robotics. This teacher ensures every scholar, including those with IEPs and autistic scholars, sees themselves as a technology creator and leaves NCSHS ready for college\-level computing and engineering. **Reporting Structure** This teacher reports to the Assistant Principal of Culture \& Electives (APC) and works closely with the AP of STEM, special education staff, the Light Leader for their grade team, and the Director of College \& Career Readiness (DCCR). Beginning in Year 3, day\-to\-day coaching shifts to the Electives Department Head. **The Founding Role: How It Grows From Year 1 to Year 4** NCSHS opens with 9th grade and adds a grade each year. The computer science program grows with it. * **Year 1 (SY 2027\-28\):** Teach an introductory computer science, AI, or robotics engineering course to all 9th graders. Set up the classroom, devices, robotics equipment, and platforms, and help design the four\-year course sequence. * **Year 2 (SY 2028\-29\):** Add a 10th grade course that builds toward AP readiness (for example, web design or programming foundations). Launch a computer science club or after\-school offering in partnership with the After\-School Coordinator. * **Year 3 (SY 2029\-30\):** Launch AP Computer Science Principles for 11th graders. Use data from Years 1 and 2 to place scholars and build AP supports, in partnership with the AP/Advanced Coursework Lead. * **Year 4 (SY 2030\-31\):** Launch AP Computer Science A and lead a full 9\-12 pathway, including connections to internships, summer programs, and college majors with the DCCR. **What You'll Do** *Duties below reflect the role at full build\-out in Year 4 (SY 2030\-31\).* **Curriculum and instruction** * Teach 6 sections, or 4 sections plus 1\-2 duties, using a rigorous, standards\-aligned curriculum, including AP Computer Science Principles, AP Computer Science A, and/or courses in artificial intelligence and robotics engineering * Build and refine unit plans, projects, and assessments aligned to the NYS Computer Science and Digital Fluency Standards and the College Board AP frameworks * Plan lessons that make computing accessible to every scholar, using accommodations, modifications, and universal design, in partnership with special education staff **Data and scholar achievement** * Design and give assessments that measure mastery, and use the data to adjust instruction and reteach * Own AP pass rates and course mastery for your sections, and keep the gradebook accurate and current * Flag scholars who are struggling academically or behaviorally and bring them to Light Team (MTSS) as needed **Culture and community** * Build a joyful, high\-expectations classroom using NCSHS culture systems and the Code of Conduct, with consistent recognition and consequences * Communicate regularly with families about progress, celebrations, and concerns * Participate in Grade Team meetings, school\-wide events, and NCSHS traditions **Program building and professional growth** * Maintain the classroom, devices, robotics equipment, and software accounts, and partner with Operations on technology needs * Grow scholar interest in computing and engineering through clubs, robotics competitions, and partnerships with organizations and colleges * Take part in weekly coaching, data meetings, and professional development, including summer PD before the school year begins * Other responsibilities as assigned **Who You Are** * A mission\-aligned builder, committed to the NCS inclusive model and energized by launching something new * Bachelor's degree required (Master's preferred); 2\+ years of teaching experience, ideally in an urban public or charter school * Strong command of computer science, artificial intelligence, or robotics engineering content, including programming in Python, Java, or a similar language; experience teaching AP Computer Science or robotics is highly desirable * NYS certification in Computer Science preferred. Candidates holding a CE, CEAS, or Standard Certification in Engineering Technology are encouraged to apply, as are candidates working toward certification * Experience supporting scholars with IEPs and autistic scholars, and a belief that every scholar can master rigorous content * Reflective, data\-driven, and eager for feedback **Compensation** * Competitive salary commensurate with experience, based on the NCS teacher salary schedule, with a range of $76,000\-$136,200 (SY 27\-28\). The starting salary for NYS\-**certified teachers is $82,000\.** * Comprehensive benefits, including medical, vision, and dental insurance, a competitive retirement plan, and parental leave. * Laptop provided KXCsWmu6NF

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff
jobs.description: San Francisco · Full\-time · In\-person · Reports to CTO **Pay range:** $150,000–$210,000 base salary, plus equity. The final offer depends on experience and skills. ### **About Neon Blue** Most product, pricing, and marketing decisions never get tested before the money is spent. Neon Blue builds grounded simulated audiences of a company's customers and market, built from real human studies, so teams can test those decisions first. We're a seed\-stage company in San Francisco, hiring an early engineer. This is a senior generalist individual\-contributor seat. You work across the simulation platform, the customer\-facing product, and the ML infrastructure — GPUs, training, and inference — and you do the work yourself, with high ownership. ### **What you'll own** The engineering that turns research into a product people can use, and that keeps the platform and the models running. * Build the customer\-facing product: choosing an audience, running a study, reading results, and going deeper with interviews — the workflows, interfaces, and product APIs those surfaces need. * Build the simulation platform: running studies, serving simulated people, and making the loop fast and reliable at enterprise scale. * Own ML infrastructure: GPU workloads, training, and inference, so experiments and production runs are reliable and inspectable. * Turn research into production systems without slowing the science down. * Give the research team better tools: job orchestration, evaluation pipelines, data flows, and interfaces they will actually use. * Improve reliability and latency at enterprise scale. * Write the code, review it, and put it in front of users. This is not a manager seat. ### **What you'll do in your first 90 days** * Get fluent in the current product, platform, and training or inference setup, and pick a meaningful slice — a product surface, a study\-run path, or an ML\-infrastructure workflow — that you will own and improve. * Ship a user\-facing improvement to the path someone takes to a first useful result. * Turn research into a dependable production path. * Improve a GPU, training, or inference path so runs are fast and reliable at enterprise scale. * Leave the codebase easier for the next person to extend. ### **You might be a fit if** * You write production\-quality code and have shipped full\-stack or backend systems, and you can work across product surfaces and infrastructure. * You're comfortable owning GPU workloads, training, and inference — or you have a clear path to owning that work, not only calling an API. * You have product judgment: you can tell the difference between a requested feature and the problem underneath it, and you care about the details that make software feel clear and reliable. * You like working next to researchers: you can turn an experiment into a system without requiring them to become platform engineers. * You reason clearly about reliability — latency, cost, failure, and reproducibility — and you debug across the stack. * You move quickly under ambiguity and want to own problems end to end, in person, on a small team, doing the work yourself. ### **Nice to have** * You've built tools or platforms for technical users (researchers, data scientists, or ML engineers). * You've worked on simulation, multi\-agent systems, or data\-heavy evaluation pipelines. * Early\-startup or founding\-engineer experience. * Familiarity with a modern TypeScript/React and API stack, or equivalent depth in a comparable one, alongside Python for ML and infrastructure work. ### **Why join** This is an early engineering seat on the system everything else depends on — product, platform, and ML infrastructure. You'll work in person with the CTO and the research team, write the code yourself, and feel the difference when a study runs well, a prototype becomes a product, or a training job is reliable. ### **In\-person in San Francisco** This is a full\-time role. We work in person in San Francisco. ### **Equal opportunity** Neon Blue is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, and we provide reasonable accommodations in the hiring process on request. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Compensation Range: $150K \- $210K

jobs.description: **Own Every Moment at NetApp** At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud. Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real\-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function. **Senior Site Reliability Engineer (Network \& Security Infrastructure)** ========================================================================= Morrisville, North Carolina, United States **Job category:** Information Technology **Job ID:** 136891\-en\_US **Job Summary** --------------- We are seeking a pragmatic, forward\-thinking Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to help lead the operational evolution of our Global Network and Security Infrastructure. jobs.title: AI Perception Engineer II
jobs.description: **Job Description:** **Location:** United States, Remote **Type:** Full\-time **Travel:** Approximately 10%, including quarterly onsite meetings at a Nextpower California office and visits to solar farms or test sites **Reports to:** Senior Director, Robotics \& Autonomy **About Nextpower** =================== Nextpower is a global leader in intelligent solar tracker and software solutions, optimizing solar power plant performance worldwide. Our Robotics and Autonomy team develops and deploys robotic inspection systems for live and under\-construction solar sites. Construction environments can be busy, crowded, and constantly changing, with active equipment and people requiring careful coordination. Once a site is operating, it may be remote and quiet, with robots working for long periods in open, sun\-exposed conditions and little or no human presence. Our systems combine mobility, perception, embedded computing, autonomy, and cloud intelligence to increase inspection capacity, improve safety, and scale operations. We are seeking an AI Perception Engineer II to build, deploy, and own computer vision and perception software for robotic inspection. You will develop models for object detection, recognition, tracking, classification, segmentation, and fault detection, and own the robot\-side software nodes that run those models in deployed systems. You will also build cloud\-assisted workflows that use APIs to route compute\-intensive analysis to cloud services when appropriate. **Role Overview** ================= This is a hands\-on engineering role focused on building, deploying, testing, and improving AI models and perception software on real systems. You will own perception nodes running on the robot, optimize models for embedded or GPU\-based hardware, and connect robot\-side processing with cloud APIs for additional compute and analysis. When a model identifies a potential fault or uncertainty, you will work with the mission management system to trigger targeted data collection, such as additional images, viewpoints, or sensor measurements, so the system can improve the inspection result. You will work closely with the autonomy and reliability leads and the broader engineering team to deliver a working system and contribute to the inspection roadmap. You will visit test and operating sites to understand inspection conditions, observe how people work, collect representative data, and investigate system behavior. The perception system must perform across very different environments: dynamic construction sites with people, vehicles, and frequent changes, as well as remote, quiet operating sites exposed to sun and dust, where robots may work for long periods without nearby human support. The role combines computer vision and machine learning with strong software engineering and practical robotics integration. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **Computer Vision and Model Development** * Develop, train, and evaluate computer vision models for object detection, recognition, tracking, classification, segmentation, and inspection fault detection. * Prepare datasets, review labels, identify data gaps, and work with inspection specialists to improve training data quality. * Build and maintain repeatable model training and evaluation pipelines, including model and dataset versioning. * Apply probability, statistics, and sound experimental methods to model development and evaluation. **Benchmarking and Testing** * Build benchmarks that measure model performance across fault classes, equipment, sites, and capture conditions. * Analyze false positives, false negatives, and other model errors to identify causes and prioritize improvements. * Test model and software changes as part of the release process. Document results, limitations, and release evidence. **Deployment and Field Validation** * Optimize and deploy models to embedded or GPU\-based hardware, and profile performance on target systems. * Own and maintain perception and inspection software nodes that run on the robot, including their interfaces, performance, health reporting, and integration with the wider system. * Build robot\-to\-cloud workflows that use cloud\-based APIs to route compute\-intensive inference or analysis when appropriate, while accounting for connectivity, latency, bandwidth, and degraded\-operation behavior. * Integrate model results with mission management so detected faults, low\-confidence results, or data gaps can trigger targeted collection of additional images, viewpoints, or sensor measurements. * Develop and evaluate sensor\-fusion approaches using vision, lidar, GPS, IMU, and, where applicable, multispectral data to improve inspection context and fault assessment. * Visit construction and operating sites to observe inspection workflows, collect representative data, and evaluate perception performance in busy, changing environments and remote, sun\-exposed sites. **Software Delivery and Team Execution** * Write mai ability, statistics, benchmarking, and model evaluation. * Experience developing maintainable software, writing automated tests, debugging deployed systems, and testing integrated software or model changes for release. * Experience using Git\-based workflows, including creating pull requests, participating in code reviews, and addressing review feedback. * Experience documenting technical work, breaking it into trackable tasks in Jira or a similar system, communicating progress, and presenting results clearly. * Ability and willingness to test systems on physical robots and travel to test or operating sites * Coachable and collaborative, with the ability to take technical feedback, apply it to your work, and contribute effectively on a fast\-moving engineering team. **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ * Experience using cloud\-based APIs or distributed compute workflows to scale model inference, analysis, or training while coordinating with edge systems. * Experience developing software for mobile robots, including ROS or ROS2 nodes, sensor interfaces, and deployed robot workflows. * Experience with autonomy concepts such as motion planning, localization, and state estimation, and how perception outputs support those capabilities. * Experience with simulation, software\-in\-the\-loop (SIL), hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL), test\-driven development, or other rigorous methods for validating robotics and machine learning systems. * Experience with semi\-supervised learning that combines simulated and real\-world data. * Experience creating or using photorealistic simulation environments and log\-replay systems to generate, reproduce, and evaluate perception scenarios. * Experience building learning pipelines from human demonstrations, observations, or inspection decisions. * Familiarity with experiment tracking and dataset or model management tools, such as MLflow. * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools, such as Cursor, Codex, or similar coding agents, to accelerate implementation, testing, and documentation while independently validating the output and maintaining ownership of code quality. * Experience with solar equipment, industrial inspection, construction, or other visual quality applications. **Join Us** =========== Join a fast\-moving team building technology that will change how solar sites are inspected. Nextpower is an industry leader, and our robotics team is putting capable robots to work in real environments, from active construction sites to remote solar farms. You’ll see your work move from data and models into deployed systems, where better perception can improve inspection quality, expand operating capacity, and help people focus on the hardest decisions. We’re excited to bring on an engineer who is curious, coachable, and eager to keep growing. You’ll have opportunities to deepen your technical skills, take on broader ownership, and contribute to the team’s direction as the work and your capabilities develop. Nextpower is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees At Nextpower, we are driving the global energy transition with an integrated clean energy technology platform that combines intelligent structural, electrical, and digital solutions for utility\-scale power plants. Our comprehensive portfolio enables faster project delivery, higher performance, and greater reliability, helping our customers capture the full value of solar power. Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data\-driven insights, and advanced automation. Together, we’re building the foundation for the world’s next generation of clean energy infrastructure. Nextpower is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. **We are Nextpower** ====================

As a developer, you will train end\-users, provide technical support, successfully collaborate with colleagues to understand the needs of the organization, and develop customized solutions that enhance users’ performance and productivity. A passion for learning new skills is a must in this diverse technology environment. This position is ideal for an individual who enjoys working both independently and as part of a development team. **Do Work That Matters. Build a Career That Lasts.** At Northern Water, a job is more than a position. It’s an opportunity to help manage and protect one of Colorado’s most valuable resources while building a career with an organization known for its stability, strong culture and commitment to public service. Northern Water has been serving Colorado since 1937, and today our work helps provide water to more than 1\.1 million people and approximately 550,000 acres of irrigated farmland across Northeastern Colorado. That responsibility takes a talented team. With nearly 200 employees, Northern Water brings together people working in operations, engineering, construction, maintenance, IT, finance, administration and many other specialties. jobs.title: AI Claims Engineer
jobs.description: **About notch** Notch builds AI for complex, high\-stakes operations. Our platform helps insurance companies move work across customer conversations, documents, and enterprise systems \- with governance, traceability, and human oversight built in. The AI Workforce takes on repeatable tasks, while the AI Workspace gives professionals a connected place to investigate, prepare, and decide. We began inside insurance operations, so we know that real transformation demands more than a great demo: it has to work against actual business rules, real exceptions, and real\-world pressure. Notch has raised $45 million to date, including a $30 million Series A in 2026\. **About the role** This is a new kind of insurance role: part claims expert, part workflow designer, part product partner, and part trusted customer advisor. You won't spend your day adjusting claims or writing production code. You will work with adjusters, claims leaders, and the Notch team to find the work that slows a claim down, design a better approach, and test whether AI can carry it out safely and reliably. You know why the details matter: a police report can contradict the FNOL, a missing photo can stall a decision, and a seemingly simple claim can become a sensitive exception. Your job is to bring that practical judgment into the way our product is built, deployed, and improved. The goal is not just fewer touches \- it is better information and better decisions, with the adjuster in control. **Compensation:** $125,000\-$175,000 base salary \+ plus equity and benefits. **What you'll do** * **Understand the real workflow \-** Work alongside carriers, TPAs, and claims teams to map the journey from FNOL through triage, investigation, documentation, escalation, and resolution. Spot bottlenecks, manual handoffs, and avoidable rework. * **Turn expertise into working AI \-** Translate claims procedures, authority limits, coverage considerations, service standards, and exception rules into clear workflows for Notch's AI Workspace and AI Workforce. * **Design practical use cases \-** Shape experiences such as voice\-based FNOL, document intake and summarization, claim\-file preparation, missing\-information follow\-up, QA review, and next\-best\-action support. * **Test like a claims professional \-** Create realistic scenarios and evaluate outputs against source documents. Challenge missing facts, ambiguous coverage, conflicting evidence, incorrect escalation, and misleading recommendations before customers rely on them. * **Guide customers from pilot to adoption \-** Join discovery sessions, workshops, demos, pilots, and training. Help claims teams understand when to trust automation, when to review it, and where people must retain authority. * **Be the voice of claims inside Notch \-** Partner with Product, Engineering, Solutions, and Customer Success to explain the difficult edge cases and translate customer feedback into product improvements. * **Prove and repeat the value \-** Measure improvements in handling time, file completeness, touches per claim, quality, and policyholder experience. Document patterns and playbooks we can reuse across customers. Requirements: **What you'll bring** * You have worked in claims long enough to know what looks straightforward on a process chart and what actually happens on a busy claims desk. You are ready to improve that work, not just do more of it. * Around 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in P\&C claims adjusting, claims operations, claims quality, or a closely related insurance function. * Strong familiarity with claim intake, documentation, triage, coverage review, escalation, communication, and the controls that make a claim defensible. * The judgment to distinguish a useful AI recommendation from an answer that merely sounds convincing. * Genuine curiosity about AI and software. You do not need to be a developer, but you want to learn how systems behave, how to test them, and how to improve them. * Clear communication with both insurance professionals and technical teams. You can explain an operational issue precisely without drowning people in jargon. * Comfort with ambiguity, customer conversations, and hands\-on iteration; a bias for taking ownership and making a workflow better each time. **The extras we love** * Experience with Guidewire, Duck Creek, or other claims management systems; claims transformation or vendor implementation projects. * Exposure to commercial or specialty claims, bodily injury, complex property losses, SIU referrals, CAT operations, or claims QA/audit. * Experience building process maps, test scenarios, SOPs, no\-code workflows, or internal tools. **Why this role matters** Instead of working one claim at a time, you will help shape how thousands of claims are handled. You will make AI useful to the people who carry the responsibility: reducing administrative work, strengthening the record, and giving adjusters more time for the judgment and empathy no system can replace. **Interested?** We would love to hear how you would improve a workflow you know from the inside.

jobs.title: AI Underwriting Engineer
jobs.description: **About Notch** Notch builds AI for complex, high\-stakes operations. Our platform helps insurance companies move work across customer conversations, documents, and enterprise systems \- with governance, traceability, and human oversight built in. The AI Workforce takes on repeatable tasks, while the AI Workspace gives professionals a connected place to investigate, prepare, and decide. We began inside insurance operations, so we know that real transformation demands more than a great demo: it has to work against actual business rules, real exceptions, and real\-world pressure. Notch has raised $45 million to date, including a $30 million Series A in 2026\. **About the role** This is a new kind of insurance role: part underwriting expert, part workflow designer, part product partner, and part trusted customer advisor. You won't be here to quote or bind risks on Notch's behalf, and you don't need to be a software engineer. You'll partner with underwriters, underwriting leaders, brokers, and our teams to rethink how submissions move from first email to decision\-ready file. You know the difference between information being present and information being usable. An ACORD can disagree with a statement of values, loss runs may omit critical context, and a broker follow\-up can delay an otherwise attractive opportunity. You will turn that practical knowledge into workflows that save time, improve the quality of the file, and keep risk selection and pricing judgment with the underwriter. **Compensation:** $125,000\-$175,000 base salary \+ plus equity and benefits. **What you'll do** * **Understand the underwriting desk \-** Work with carriers, MGAs, and brokers to map submission intake, clearance, appetite triage, document review, broker requests, referral, renewal preparation, and the handoffs between teams and systems. * **Turn expertise into working AI \-** Translate underwriting guidelines, risk appetite, submission requirements, authority rules, and escalation points into understandable processes for Notch's AI Workspace and AI Workforce. * **Design practical use cases \-** Shape AI\-assisted ACORD and SOV extraction, loss\-run analysis, missing\-information detection, broker follow\-up, enrichment, submission comparison, renewal preparation, and decision\-ready case summaries. * **Test like an underwriter \-** Build realistic submission scenarios and validate results against evidence. Look for conflicting exposure data, incomplete schedules, unsupported risk conclusions, inaccurate classifications, and missing source references. * **Guide customers from pilot to adoption \-** Lead domain discussions during discovery, demos, pilots, workshops, and training. Help teams adopt AI in ways that fit underwriting controls instead of bypassing them. * **Be the voice of underwriting inside Notch \-** Partner with Product, Engineering, Solutions, and Customer Success to surface domain\-specific edge cases, prioritize product gaps, and make new capabilities meaningful to end users. * **Prove and repeat the value \-** Track time to a complete submission, underwriter touches, broker response cycles, data quality, and decision readiness. Build playbooks we can apply across lines, carriers, and MGAs. Requirements: **What you'll bring** * You understand underwriting work because you have lived it: the deadlines, the back\-and\-forth, the imperfect data, and the judgment that cannot be reduced to a checklist. You want to improve the system around that judgment. * Around 3\+ years of experience as an underwriter, assistant underwriter, underwriting operations specialist, or in a related carrier, MGA, or brokerage role. * Working knowledge of submissions, ACORD forms, SOVs, loss runs, broker communication, appetite and referral rules, and renewal workflows. * A strong instinct for what makes a file truly decision\-ready, and where a system should stop and ask a human. * Genuine curiosity about AI and software. Coding is not required; comfort learning new tools, testing their outputs, and improving workflows is. * The ability to translate between underwriters, business leaders, and technical teams, with clear and confident written and verbal communication. * An ownership mindset: comfortable tackling ambiguous problems, working with customers, and iterating until the process works in practice. **The extras we love** * Experience in commercial P\&C, specialty or E\&S lines, delegated authority, program business, or complex renewals. * Familiarity with underwriting workbenches, Guidewire, Duck Creek, broker platforms, rating tools, or submission\-management technology. * Experience with workflow design, data validation, no\-code tools, UAT, process improvement, or implementation projects. **Why this role matters** Instead of preparing one submission at a time, you will help build the way underwriting teams operate. Your expertise will make AI more useful, more reliable, and more accountable \- so underwriters have cleaner information, more room for judgment, and better opportunities to write the right business. **Interested?** We would love to hear how you would improve a workflow you know from the inside.

jobs.title: Engineer I or II
jobs.description: **At Obie, we don’t just insure properties — we ensure progress.** With advanced technology, real\-time data, and a vast network of agents and partners, we help real estate investors and landlords get insurance coverage whenever and wherever they need it. Thousands of owners nationwide trust us to be the insurance experts, so they don’t have to be. Joining our team means embracing a fast\-moving environment driven by innovation, collaboration, and constant progress. We learn quickly, iterate often, and celebrate wins together. If you're passionate about driving change and eager to impact the real estate and insurance market, Obie is the place for you. Our Chicago based employees are hybrid, and expected to be in office on Tuesdays and Thursdays. **Brief Summary of Role** Hard work, high standards, real impact. Obie is on a mission to redefine real estate insurance, and we need motivated full\-stack engineers (React, GraphQL, Node.js) to help us build. This isn’t just a coding job—it’s an opportunity to shape our product, our team, and our company from the ground up. The work will be fast, challenging, and deeply rewarding. If you're looking for a place where your code actually matters, read on. **How We Show Up as a Tech Team*** On the Obie Tech Team, we show up **for each other, in the quality of our work, and in the simplicity of our solutions.** * **Make an impact.** We’re growing fast, and this role offers the chance to influence key decisions and take on leadership opportunities. * **Move fast, ship faster.** We deploy multiple times per day and ship features in days, not months. If you love speed and iteration, you’ll thrive here. **What you'll Do*** **Build. Ship. Improve.** Write high\-quality, high\-performance, maintainable code. * **Own your work**—write tests, review code, and keep tech debt in check. * **Architect and develop** applications, databases, and APIs that drive our platform. * **Collaborate across teams** to solve real business challenges. * **Power our partnerships** by building and scaling APIs that turn archaic systems into elegant, real\-time integrations. * **Build dashboards** that our customers and agents rely on daily to make sense of their life and work. * **Automate** workflows so Obie employees can move faster and focus on high\-value work. * Help us go to market with new insurance products and state expansions in record time. **What you'll Bring*** Experience with **React, Node.js, TypeScript, relational databases, testing frameworks, and CICD tools**. * A **bias for action**—strong ability to prioritize, multitask, and deliver. * **Agile mindset**—comfortable with fast iterations and quick pivots. * **Clear, effective communication**, especially in a distributed team environment. * **2\+ years of experience** in software development. * **Degree in CS or related field preferred**—but talent and drive matter more. **This role is not for everyone.** It’s for builders, problem\-solvers, and engineers who want their work to **mean something**. If that’s you, let’s talk. **Interview Process** At Obie, transparency is core to our interview process. We focus on open communication and a positive experience; no trick questions—just honest conversations about your skills and aspirations. To help you prepare, please familiarize yourself with these resources before moving forward:* Our company’s blog to learn more about the market we serve and the information our customers value. * Check out our LinkedIn to see how people interact with our brand and product. * Press and podcast features like Inc. 5000, TechCrunch, Innovate State, Uncontested Investing Podcast, Insurtech Amplified Podcast * Meet us and get to know Obie You'll first talk to Kara on a 30\-minute call for a mutual fit conversation. We’ll talk about your experience, what you’re looking for, and answer any questions about Obie’s team, culture, and product. * Technical Discussion (45 minutes) Next, you’ll meet with one of our **Engineering leaders**, and another member of the team, for a deep dive into your technical skills. Expect a conversation about your experience, approach to problem\-solving, and key technologies. * Take\-Home Coding Challenge You’ll complete a **small application using React and Node.js**. * Live Pairing Session (90 minutes) You’ll walk through your coding challenge with a few engineers and tackle **additional technical concepts** not covered in the take\-home. This is also a chance to see how we work and collaborate. **Moving Forward with Obie** Obie is a leading insurance platform for real estate investors, combining proprietary technology with a modern insurance experience to simplify Home and Landlord insurance. Today, we serve customers nationwide through direct digital experiences, a growing network of insurance agents, and strategic partnerships with lenders, property management platforms, and real estate technology companies. As part of The Baldwin Group, one of the nation's leading insurance distribution platforms and a USA TODAY Top Workplace, we're combining the agility of a fast\-growing technology company with the scale, resources, and career opportunities of a larger organization as we shape the future of investment property insurance. **Obie has you Covered** Being in the insurance industry, we understand the importance of comprehensive benefits for you and your family. These are just some of the benefits and perks we provide:* Comprehensive health, dental, vision and life insurance * Flexible paid time off including 12 week Paid Parental Leave * Retirement savings plan with company match * Monthly stipends to support a healthy lifestyle and learning and development opportunities Obie values transparency and data driven decision making, enabling us to have a consistent and equitable approach to compensation. We are informed by a benchmarking tool which provides real time compensation data allowing us to regularly check our salary ranges against other venture backed companies and startups within our industry. We've provided the full base salary range for this role below, but please note that we typically target the mid point of the salary range to allow room for growth within the role. Your salary is dependent upon many factors, including years of relevant experience, expertise, etc. During your first interview, you can expect to have an open conversation with your recruiter regarding your compensation expectations.* **Note: we’ll only be considering applications that include a video submission** of you walking through your resume and sharing why you’d be a good fit for this role. Please be sure to send your video submission to eng\-hiring@obieinsurance.com. No need to be on camera, a screenshare video will suffice! **The pay range for this role is:** 90,000 \- 150,000 USD per year(United States)
