jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: ### ***About Orderful*** ### **Orderful is reinventing how businesses connect and trade. We modernize EDI \- the backbone of $5T\+ in global commerce \- so companies can click\-to\-trade with any partner fast. We’re Series C and among the fastest\-growing in supply\-chain tech. Our culture is high\-ownership, high\-tempo, and low\-ego; we iterate quickly, care deeply about customers and teammates, and love turning manual operations into products. If that sounds like you, let’s talk.** ### ***Our Core Company Values*** ### **As a team, we're guided by four core values. They impact what we are building, while helping us stay true to ourselves and accountable to each other.** * Our Customers Win * Learn, Iterate, Grow * Build a Great Community * We Show that We Care **About the role** As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll own the design, delivery, and reliability of core parts of the platform that lets companies trade with their retailers, suppliers, and logistics partners through one modern API. Our customers run mission\-critical orders, shipments, and invoices through Orderful, and we’re building toward a future where most new trading partnerships go live at the click of a button. You’ll combine deep engineering fundamentals with the judgment to direct AI coding agents, review their output rigorously, and stay fully accountable for what reaches customers. This is a high\-impact role on a small, senior team, and you’ll help shape how modern software gets built at Orderful. **What you’ll do** * Lead the technical design of major platform initiatives, and write designs that weigh performance, reliability, and the business case from the start. * Turn ambiguous problems into clear specs that AI coding agents can build from, then test and review their work with a high bar. * Own quality as speed increases, from testing and evaluation to diagnosing the hardest bugs in production. * Decide where AI adds value, where deterministic software is the better choice, and where human judgment still matters. * Work with Product, and talk with customers regularly, to understand the problem before you build. * Mentor other engineers, and share what you learn about new models, agents, and workflows so the whole team gets better. **What we’re looking for** * 5\+ years building and running production backend systems, with a record of leading the design of complex systems. * Strong experience with TypeScript and Node.js, APIs, distributed systems, event\-driven architectures, and relational and non\-relational databases. * An AI\-first way of working, with real experience planning, building, and reviewing code at an accelerated pace with tools like Claude Code or Cursor. * A track record of shipping rapidly and owning what you ship, including reliability and on\-call. * Comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to figure out what needs to happen without waiting for a plan. * Clear writing and opinions held with good reasoning, plus a collaborative, low\-ego attitude. **Bonus points** * Experience at a high\-growth startup or a company like Stripe, Shopify, Ramp, or Plaid, or experience building integrations, partner APIs, or AI agent evaluation systems. * Experience with EDI, supply chain, logistics, or commerce platforms. ### ***Why work at Orderful?*** * **Flexibility \& Balance:** Unlimited PTO, a full week off for the holidays, remote work options, and schedules that fit your life. * **Wellness \& Support:** Health, dental, vision, and life insurance, an EAP for when life gets tricky, weekly yoga, and paid parental leave. * **Growth \& Connection:** Take on meaningful projects, plan for your future with a 401(k), and build relationships at our twice\-yearly company\-wide offsites. * **Financial Upside:** Competitive pay and stock options that let you share in the company’s success. ### ***At Orderful, building a great community is at the heart of everything we do. We’re looking for team members who lead with empathy and bring a champion mentality to the challenges our industry faces.*** ### ***We believe the best work happens when people show up as their authentic selves and play to their unique strengths. By taking calculated risks and learning together, we’re building the infrastructure that keeps the global economy moving. If you’re ready to grow with a team that stays curious and stays bold, we’d love for you to join us.***

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: The Senior Data Engineer plays a pivotal role within our expanding Data and AI team. This person helps build and scale our next\-generation data platform, starting with our modernization initiative; transitioning from legacy ingestion processes embedded in C\# .NET code to a scalable, cloud\-native architecture on AWS and expanding into our Databricks analytical data platform for advanced processing and analytics. This is a highly impactful, hands\-on role responsible for designing and implementing AI\-assisted data pipelines and distributed systems that power data product, analytics, data science, and operational use cases. Starting base pay for this role is between $117,000 and $146,000\. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as transferable skills, work experience, business needs, training, location, and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role will be eligible for a bonus as well as competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits, wellness reimbursement, life insurance, and a 401(k) with company match. We offer vacation and sick leave benefits (under a flexible time off policy in most states). Responsibilities: * Designs and implements scalable data\-ingestion pipelines using AWS services (e.g., S3, Lambda, API Gateway, Glue, Step Functions, Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Agent Core) and Azure DevOps * Builds APIs and file upload mechanisms for client data ingestion * Develops data mapping and transformation workflows for loading into SQL Server client databases * Contributes to the design and implementation of a data Lakehouse architecture leveraging Databricks * Enables seamless data flow from the SaaS platform to the analytical platform * Optimizes ETL/ELT processes for performance and reliability * Collaborates with analytics teams to ensure data availability and quality for reporting and machine learning use cases * Provides operational support for existing ingestion processes integrated into C\# .NET code and UI * Troubleshoots and resolves data pipeline issues across environments * Works closely with Software Engineers, Architects, and Product teams to align data solutions with business needs * Implements best practices for data governance, security, and compliance in a multi\-tenant environment * Documents architecture, workflows, and operational procedures Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field required * 7\+ years in Data Engineering or related role * Strong experience with AWS services for data engineering (S3, Lambda, Glue, Step Functions, API Gateway) * Proficiency in Python and/or C\# .NET for data processing and integration * Hands\-on experience with SQL Server and relational database concepts * Familiarity with Databricks, Spark, and Lakehouse architectures * Knowledge of ETL/ELT design patterns and data modeling * Experience building APIs and file\-based ingestion solutions * Exposure to multi\-tenant SaaS environments is a plus * Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills * Ability to work collaboratively in a cross\-functional team * Excellent communication and documentation skills Preferred Qualifications: * Experience with CI/CD pipelines for data workflows * Knowledge of data governance and security best practices in cloud environments * Familiarity with modern data integration tools and frameworks * Exposure to machine learning pipelines and real\-time data processing Benefits: * Medical and Dental coverage available for employees, dependents, domestic partners, and spouses * Paid Time Off – Flexible options plus 10 paid company holidays where available\*\* * All full\-time positions are hybrid, with many eligible to be completely remote * Fully Paid by Origami Risk – Vision insurance, Short \& Long\-Term Disability Insurance, and Basic Life Insurance * Generous family leave options—including adoption and foster care placements * Pre\-Tax Savings Accounts – Flexible Spending Account, Health Savings Account, Commuter Benefits, Dependent Care Savings Account * Retirement Savings – 401(k) with company match up to 4% * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – Confidential \& Free support offered to colleagues facing personal or work\-related complications * Education Assistance Program – to help colleagues pursue industry/role\-specific certifications * Wellness Benefits – reimbursement program to invest in healthy habits as well as support better colleague productivity and stress management * Additional coverages available – Pet Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, and Voluntary Life \& AD\&D coverage *\*\*Flexible PTO not available in California or the UK* Who We Are: Origami Risk delivers single\-platform SaaS solutions that help organizations best navigate the complexities of risk, insurance, compliance, and safety management. Founded by industry veterans who recognized the need for risk management technology that was more configurable, intuitive, and scalable, Origami continues to add to its innovative product offerings for managing both insurable and uninsurable risk; facilitating compliance; improving safety; and helping insurers, MGAs, TPAs, and brokers provide enhanced services that drive results. A singular focus on client success underlies Origami’s approach to developing, implementing, and supporting our award\-winning software solutions. *Origami Risk is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We thrive and benefit from diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and equitable environment for all employees. We do not discriminate against any individual based upon race, religion, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, color, sex, national origin, age, marital status, military or veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.* ***Caution****: Be alert to recruiting scams. We have received reports of individuals impersonating Origami Risk recruiters to deceive candidates into disclosing personal information. These impostors use fake Origami Risk domain names and email addresses. Please double\-check that any email address from an Origami Risk recruiter ends with* *origamirisk.com* *or* *talent.icims.com**. And to confirm the legitimacy of any recruiting communication, feel free to email* *transparencycheck@origamirisk.com**.*

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: At Orion, we're building the intelligent infrastructure that powers modern financial advisory, unifying planning, investing, and client engagement for thousands of advisors and millions of investor accounts. We're looking for a Senior AI Engineer who ships, not just experiments. This is a hands\-on, product\-facing role. You'll own the end\-to\-end delivery of AI\-powered features, from architecture to production — working alongside product managers, designers, and engineers to move fast and build things that matter. **Technical Skills:** * Hands\-on experience building and optimizing RAG systems and agentic workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or Haystack. * Experience designing agentic pipelines and loop architectures, including multi\-step reasoning, tool use, and autonomous retrieval systems * Working knowledge of at least one vector database (Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, or similar) including indexing and query optimization * Experience building and maintaining data preprocessing, chunking, and vectorization pipelines * Ability to evaluate and select LLMs (GPT\-4o, Claude, LLaMA, Mistral, etc.) based on cost, latency, and real\-world performance * AWS infrastructure experience with infrastructure\-as\-code tooling (Terraform) * Strong API design and service development skills. * Strong experience developing enterprise applications using **C\# and .NET**, with the ability to integrate AI/ML solutions into existing business systems. * Experience designing and maintaining **data pipelines and data architectures** that support AI, analytics, and machine learning workloads. * Ability to build scalable, production\-ready AI solutions while leveraging strong software engineering fundamentals across the Microsoft technology stack. **Responsibilities:** * Own AI features end\-to\-end: design, build, and ship to production * Architect and maintain RAG and agentic pipelines across internal and external data sources * Integrate LLMs and generative AI into products and workflows * Apply prompt engineering, fine\-tuning, and custom embeddings to optimize performance in a financial services context * Instrument and monitor AI features in production: quality, latency, regressions, and user impact * Manage cloud infrastructure on AWS using Terraform to support reliable AI service deployment Most companies say they're serious about AI. At Orion, it's the expectation, built into how every engineer on our team works, at every level, every day. Not a tool you reach for occasionally. Not a line on your resume. A force multiplier embedded in the craft. Our CTO put it plainly: AI is not a trend to get ahead of. It is embedded at every level, expected of every engineer, every day. We measure by the leverage we create. At Orion, we build the technology that powers independent financial advisors — the professionals who help everyday people plan for retirement, protect their families, and build financial security. Our platform touches billions in assets under management, which means the software we ship must be fast, reliable, and always getting better. We're not a startup chasing hype. We're a scaled business deliberately building an engineering culture that will take us to the next level — and we're doing it now. Here's what people who've been here a while tend to say: they noticed the informality first and missed the intensity until it caught up with them. Both are real. Nobody is going to make you feel small for not knowing something. And we move fast, care deeply about outcomes, and hold each other to a high standard. The team works hard for each other, which means showing up and contributing at pace isn't just a performance expectation — it's a form of respect. You will own everything you commit. Full stop. Whether you wrote it line by line or shaped it with AI assistance, the standard is the same: you understand it, you can defend it, and it ships with your name on it. AI accelerates execution. It does not replace system design, architectural thinking, or the judgment required to build software that holds up under real load. We operate in fintech, which adds an important layer: client data is sacred and compliance guardrails are non\-negotiable. The engineers who cut corners here are not the engineers who last here. You are not threatened by change — you cause it. You ask "why not?" before you default to the familiar. You experiment, share what you learn, and close gaps fast. You are already using AI tools in your daily workflow. Not as a curiosity. As a practice. \#LI\-AP1 \#LI\-Onsite \#LI\-Hybrid **Recommended Skills:** Artificial Intelligence (AI), Data Processing, Large Language Models (LLMs), Modeling Languages, Software Development, Standard ML (Programming Language)**Salary Range:** $140,935\.00 \- $226,905\.00 The pay listed in this posting indicates the estimated pay at the time of this posting; however, may vary depending on geographic location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition, Orion offers a competitive benefits package which includes health, dental, vision, and disability coverage on day one, 401(k) plan with employer match, paid parental leave, pet benefits including pawternity leave and pet insurance, student loan repayment and more. **About Us** At Orion, we achieve our best work when we support one another, staying personally accountable to each other and the clients we serve. We create a welcoming environment where everyone is respected, valued, and heard. Our commitment to **create raving** **fans** ensures we consistently exceed client expectations. Thinking differently is in our DNA—we **innovate always**, push boundaries, and reject the status quo to deliver transformative outcomes. Together, we **support one another** and **see it through** to success, driving our collective achievements and those of our clients.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, AI
jobs.description: Drug development shouldn’t be guesswork, not when patients are waiting. Pathos is building a next\-generation biotech with AI at the core. Not as a feature, but as the operating system for how medicines get developed. We believe most drugs don't fail because the science was wrong. They fail because they were tested in the wrong patients, with the wrong assumptions, in trials that couldn't answer the real question: who benefits, and why? Pathos exists to change that. We're building the largest foundation model in oncology and pairing it with proprietary AI systems, deep oncology expertise, and 200\+ petabytes of multimodal data linked to patient outcomes, so we can make development decisions with more precision, much earlier. This is not theoretical. We’re well\-capitalized and have the leadership to build a generational company. We invest in and advance our own clinical\-stage programs, using our AI platform to sharpen trial design, patient selection and biomarker strategy. So therapies reach the patients most likely to benefit, sooner. **How We Build** Pathos does not operate like a traditional biotech. There is no middle management. There are no layers of approval. The company is designed, from the ground up, around small teams of 2–4 subject matter experts who each command hundreds of AI agents to do the work that used to require dozens of people. Everyone builds. Everyone ships. Every function at Pathos — from clinical execution to asset selection to the foundation model itself — runs on this model. Our product velocity delivers meaningful outcomes in hours instead of weeks. This is not a future aspiration. It is how we operate today. The people who thrive here are operators: deep experts who can specify what needs to happen, orchestrate AI agents to execute at scale, and make high\-judgment calls that compound over time. If you have spent your career building and shipping AI systems at scale, this is the environment where that experience becomes a superpower. **About the role** ------------------ **Applications will be reviewed continuously, with priority consideration for submissions received by December 7, 2026\.** You will play a major role in advancing the foundation model and building the agentic systems behind Foundry, the AI platform that informs every drug decision at Pathos, and make them continually improve over time from real\-world feedback. You will own how we train and adapt frontier open\-weight models specifically for drug development. You will leverage 200\+ petabytes of multimodal, multi\-scale oncology data spanning over 8 million patient records linked to longitudinal outcomes, alongside live data streams from clinical trial sites. Supported by a dedicated large\-scale GPU cluster and our internal wet lab for experimental validation, your models will directly inform design and execution of clinical trials. You will operate within a lean, high\-velocity team where every builder maintains end\-to\-end ownership over key platform capabilities. If you want to build the intelligence behind how new medicines are developed, and prove rigorously that it gets better, this is the place to do your career’s best work. **What You’ll Build** --------------------- * Advance mid\- and post\-training of our oncology foundation model across SFT and RL, including reward design and verifiers for scientific and clinical tasks whose correctness is hard to check automatically. * Run and debug training at scale, addressing instability, divergence and reward hacking. * Build the harness for scientific and clinical workflows: memory, context management, orchestration and tools, plus methods that optimize the harness automatically and evolve it together with the underlying model. * Design evaluations for open\-ended, long\-horizon scientific, clinical and operational tasks, calibrate them against expert judgment, investigate where they fail, and use them to decide what ships. * Build pipelines that generate, filter and curate training and evaluation data, with safeguards for quality, provenance and contamination. * Turn expert feedback, wet\-lab results and real\-time signals from clinical trial sites into improvements to models, harness and evaluations, so the platform learns from experience with very high sample efficiency. * Work directly with oncologists, biologists and the clinical team to translate drug development needs into tractable ML problems, and publish in top ML and scientific venues. **Who You Are** --------------- We’re looking for researchers and engineers who have gotten models or agents working at scale, care as much about the drugs as about the models, and want their work to reach patients. You take ambiguous problems through experiments to results people can use. We’re hiring across levels, from exceptional early\-career talent to experienced researchers. **Must\-haves** * Deep, hands\-on expertise in at least one of the following, which we value equally: * + Mid\- or post\-training at scale, such as SFT, RL, reward modeling or preference optimization, with direct ownership of training runs and results. + Evaluation, data and agent harness design, such as evaluation and feedback design for scientific, clinical and operational tasks, synthetic data pipelines, or harness optimization spanning memory, context management, orchestration and tools. * Rigorous scientific judgment, including when ground truth is limited, delayed or disputed. * Strong engineering skills in Python, with production\-quality code. * Clear communication of evidence, limitations and uncertainty. * Willingness to learn biology and drug development, and work closely with domain experts. Publications, research software and deployed systems are all valid evidence. Publications are welcome but not required. ### **Bonus** * You’ve built self\-improving agentic systems, for example through self\-play, synthetic data generation, self\-training on past trajectories or test\-time learning, or systems that automate ML research. * You’ve built AI systems for real\-world scientific workflows, such as agents that generate hypotheses and design, run and analyze experiments using lab or clinical data. * You’ve built RL environments or task suites for training agents on realistic, long\-horizon tasks. * You’ve modeled multimodal biomedical data, such as genomics, transcriptomics, pathology and radiology images, clinical notes and EHRs, ideally combining several modalities in one model. * You’ve worked on uncertainty estimation, calibration or causal inference, especially where model outputs inform high\-stakes decisions. * You’ve built or scaled infrastructure for efficient training and inference, such as distributed training, custom kernels (CUDA or Triton) or high\-throughput serving. * You’ve shipped ML systems that real users rely on, then monitored them in production and improved them from user feedback. * You have a background in oncology, drug development or clinical research, or a track record of working closely with clinicians and biologists. * You’ve worked with patient\-level or clinical trial data under privacy and regulatory constraints, such as HIPAA. None of these are required. We value depth in one area over breadth across all of them. **Location** ------------ The preferred location for this position is in our New York City HQ, though exceptional remote candidates will also be considered. **Compensation** ---------------- We are hiring across levels. The anticipated salary range is $220,000 to $350,000 plus equity, and we have flexibility for exceptional candidates.

jobs.title: Senior Software Applications Engineer (AI/ML)
jobs.description: Overview: **Role Summary** We are seeking a **Senior Software Applications Engineer(AI/ML)** to join our team, focusing on the development of cutting\-edge machine learning and artificial intelligence solutions for the semiconductor industry. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in creating robust and scalable software, with a strong background in data analysis, machine learning, and containerization technologies. Responsibilities: * **Design and Implement ML/AI Algorithms:** Help develop and implement advanced machine learning and AI\-based algorithms for the automatic classification of defects in semiconductor inspection tools. * **Data Analysis:** Analyze large volumes of defect data to identify critical patterns, trends, and anomalies, using this analysis to inform model development. * **Training and Model Development:** Train, validate, and deploy defect classification models, ensuring they meet strict performance and accuracy requirements. * **System Optimization:** Continuously improves the accuracy, efficiency, and reliability of the defect classification system through iterative development and optimization. Qualifications:* + **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related technical field. + **Machine Learning Expertise:** Proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch specifically for computer vision tasks (CNNs, Transformers). + **Semiconductor Knowledge:** Familiarity with semiconductor manufacturing processes or inspection metrology is highly preferred. + **Data Proficiency:** Experience handling large datasets and using tools like Pandas, NumPy and SQL for data preprocessing and feature engineering. + **Problem Solving:** Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate complex manufacturing defects into actionable data models, data ingestion, analysis, and visualization. **Preferred Skills*** + Experience with Mismatched Data or Active Learning techniques to handle rare defect types. + Knowledge of ML Ops tools (ML Flow, zen Flow etc.) for model deployment and monitoring in a production environment. + Excellent communication skills to collaborate with cross\-functional hardware and software teams. Pay Range: CAD $120,000\.00 \- CAD $160,000\.00 /Yr.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Mid-level)
jobs.description: At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the world's leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting\-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency. By “Connecting Convenience” across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real\-time market intelligence via mobile applications, such as GasBuddy. We’re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth. #### **The Opportunity** Are you a C\# engineer who enjoys building reliable, high\-performance software and is excited about the possibilities of AI? We’re looking for a Software Engineer II – AI \& C\# to join our team and help build and enhance PDI’s market\-leading POS and back\-office solutions. This role is a great opportunity for an experienced software engineer who has strong C\#/.NET fundamentals and wants to expand their hands\-on experience with artificial intelligence. You do not need prior production AI experience. We’re looking for solid engineering skills, curiosity, and a desire to learn. You’ll work as part of an agile engineering team designing, developing, testing, and supporting enterprise software while helping introduce practical AI capabilities into our products. You’ll collaborate closely with engineers, architects, product owners, UX, QA, SRE, and operations to deliver scalable solutions that solve real business problems. ### **What You'll Do** * Build C\#/.NET applications: Design, develop, test, and maintain features across our POS and back\-office applications, including APIs, services, and SQL\-backed data layers. * Bring AI into our products: Help integrate capabilities such as LLM\-powered assistants, intelligent search, and AI\-driven reporting and insights into existing platforms. * Develop your AI expertise: Gain practical experience working with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), helping move successful prototypes into production. * Support AI quality and safety: Develop test cases, evaluate AI outputs, and help identify accuracy, privacy, security, and payment\-data considerations before solutions reach customers. * Use AI to engineer smarter: Leverage AI coding assistants responsibly to improve development productivity and code quality while sharing effective practices with the broader team. * Collaborate across teams: Partner with Product, UX, Architecture, QA, SRE, and Operations to translate retail and fuel workflows into scalable, maintainable technical solutions. * Own your work: Take features from design through development, testing, deployment, and production support. * Mentor others: Support junior engineers through code reviews, pairing, troubleshooting, and knowledge sharing.Contribute to the Agile team: Participate in Scrum ceremonies, planning, estimation, and continuous improvement efforts. * Keep learning: Stay current with evolving development frameworks, cloud technologies, and AI tools and apply what you learn to real customer problems. ### **What We're Looking For** * 3\+ years of software development experience in a software product development environment. * Strong hands\-on experience with C\# and .NET, including ASP.NET Core and Web APIs. * Working knowledge of SQL, preferably SQL Server. * Exposure to AI/ML concepts through professional experience, coursework, certifications, or personal projects. * Some experience experimenting with technologies such as Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, or other LLM APIs, prompt engineering, or generative AI tools. Production AI experience is not required. * Experience with Git, Postman, Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar development tools. * Understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile development practices. * Familiarity with at least one public cloud platform such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.Comfortable working in both Windows and Linux environments, including PowerShell and bash. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with an ability to work through complex technical challenges. * Strong written and verbal communication skills and a willingness to collaborate, mentor, and share knowledge. * A self\-motivated, curious mindset with the ability to learn new technologies quickly and deliver in a fast\-paced environment. ### **Nice to Have** Experience in any of the following is a plus, but not required: * Angular or other modern JavaScript frameworks * Python * Delphi * Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) * Embeddings and vector databases * AI evaluation or testing frameworks * Retail or convenience\-store technology * Point\-of\-sale (POS) systems * Payments, EMV, or PCI environments * Forecourt/fuel systems * Wholesale or logistics technologies This is an opportunity to build on your existing software engineering experience while developing skills in one of the fastest\-moving areas of technology. You’ll have the chance to experiment with AI, learn from experienced engineers and architects, and turn new ideas into features that solve real problems for PDI customers. You don’t need to come in as an AI expert. Bring your C\#/.NET expertise, engineering mindset, and curiosity. We’ll give you the opportunity to grow the rest. PDI is committed to offering a well\-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career. This includes a competitive salary, market\-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work\-life balance with ample time off \[time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements. Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Our global culture fosters diversity, inclusion, and values authenticity, trust, curiosity, and diversity of thought, ensuring a supportive environment for all. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Help integrate capabilities such as LLM\-powered assistants, intelligent search, and AI\-driven reporting and insights into existing platforms. * Develop your AI expertise: Gain practical experience working with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), helping move successful prototypes into production. * Support AI quality and safety: Develop test cases, evaluate AI outputs, and help identify accuracy, privacy, security, and payment\-data considerations before solutions reach customers. * Use AI to engineer smarter: Leverage AI coding assistants responsibly to improve development productivity and code quality while sharing effective practices with the broader team. * Collaborate across teams: Partner with Product, UX, Architecture, QA, SRE, and Operations to translate retail and fuel workflows into scalable, maintainable technical solutions. * Own your work: Take features from design through development, testing, deployment, and production support. * Mentor others: Support junior engineers through code reviews, pairing, troubleshooting, and knowledge sharing.Contribute to the Agile team: Participate in Scrum ceremonies, planning, estimation, and continuous improvement efforts. * Keep learning: Stay current with evolving development frameworks, cloud technologies, and AI tools and apply what you learn to real customer problems. ### **What We're Looking For** * 3\+ years of software development experience in a software product development environment. * Strong hands\-on experience with C\# and .NET, including ASP.NET Core and Web APIs. * Working knowledge of SQL, preferably SQL Server. * Exposure to AI/ML concepts through professional experience, coursework, certifications, or personal projects. * Some experience experimenting with technologies such as Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, or other LLM APIs, prompt engineering, or generative AI tools. Production AI experience is not required. * Experience with Git, Postman, Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar development tools. * Understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile development practices. * Familiarity with at least one public cloud platform such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.Comfortable working in both Windows and Linux environments, including PowerShell and bash. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with an ability to work through complex technical challenges. * Strong written and verbal communication skills and a willingness to collaborate, mentor, and share knowledge. * A self\-motivated, curious mindset with the ability to learn new technologies quickly and deliver in a fast\-paced environment. ### **Nice to Have** Experience in any of the following is a plus, but not required: * Angular or other modern JavaScript frameworks * Python * Delphi * Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) * Embeddings and vector databases * AI evaluation or testing frameworks * Retail or convenience\-store technology * Point\-of\-sale (POS) systems * Payments, EMV, or PCI environments * Forecourt/fuel systems * Wholesale or logistics technologies This is an opportunity to build on your existing software engineering experience while developing skills in one of the fastest\-moving areas of technology. You’ll have the chance to experiment with AI, learn from experienced engineers and architects, and turn new ideas into features that solve real problems for PDI customers. You don’t need to come in as an AI expert. Bring your C\#/.NET expertise, engineering mindset, and curiosity. We’ll give you the opportunity to grow the rest. PDI is committed to offering a well\-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career. This includes a competitive salary, market\-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work\-life balance with ample time off \[time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements. Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Our global culture fosters diversity, inclusion, and values authenticity, trust, curiosity, and diversity of thought, ensuring a supportive environment for all. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Executive Vice President, Software Engineering
jobs.description: PENNYMAC: Pennymac (NYSE: PFSI) is a specialty financial services firm with a comprehensive mortgage platform and integrated business focused on the production and servicing of U.S. mortgage loans and the management of investments related to the U.S. mortgage market. At Pennymac, our people are the foundation of our success and at the heart of our dynamic work culture. Together, we work towards a unified goal of helping millions of Americans achieve aspirations of homeownership through the complete mortgage journey. A Typical Day: Pennymac is seeking an innovative Executive Vice President of Software Engineering to direct the vision, architecture, and execution of our enterprise software platform. Reporting directly to the Managing Director of Application Development, you will lead high\-performing engineering teams to build secure, scalable, cloud\-native applications. In this role, you will align business goals with technical execution, advance our cloud and serverless strategy, and integrate AI tools across the development lifecycle to multiply developer productivity and accelerate delivery. You will set engineering standards, establish modern design patterns, and mentor technical leaders to cultivate a culture of quality, accountability, and continuous improvement. ### **Responsibilities:** * Define and execute engineering roadmap to support business growth and operational goals. * Align engineering initiatives across cross\-functional teams to deliver secure, reliable, and high\-quality software. * Act as a strategic bridge between technical and product teams, translating complex business requirements into robust, high\-performance engineering solutions. * Guide technology decisions, evaluating new frameworks, tools, and platforms to keep our tech stack modern and effective. * Integrate AI\-assisted coding tools, automated testing, and agentic workflows into daily development practices to multiply team productivity and output. * Identify operational bottlenecks in the software development lifecycle and implement AI\-driven solution options to reduce delivery cycle times. * Establish clear metrics and guardrails for safe, effective AI tool adoption across all engineering teams. * Partner with tech leads and system architects to design scalable, reusable, and maintainable enterprise applications. * Direct cloud\-focused development efforts, prioritizing serverless architectures, microservices, and robust cloud security standards. * Set coding guidelines, design patterns, and testing protocols to enforce high software quality and stability in production. * Manage and scale multiple Scrum teams, fostering a collaborative, accountable, and transparent work environment. * Hire, retain, and develop engineering talent, providing targeted mentorship for tech leads, architects, and senior engineers. * Promote an Agile culture grounded in continuous learning, constructive feedback, and active knowledge sharing. What You’ll Bring: **Requirements:*** MBA or equivalent degree preferred in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. * 10\+ years of experience in leading and managing large software engineering teams with a focus on the financial industry (strong preference for mortgage) * Proven track record of measuring and accelerating engineering throughput, cycle times, and operational efficiency through modern automation and tooling. * Proven track record of successful, tight\-knit cross\-functional collaboration to drive product strategy and deliver high\-value enterprise applications from conception to launch. * Strong business acumen with the ability to effectively negotiate and balance product feature requests against engineering best practices, technical debt, and platform security. * Practical experience implementing AI\-assisted development tools (such as Cursor, Copilot or other LLM\-based coding agents) to optimize engineering workflows and boost developer productivity. * Ability to define security, compliance, and quality guardrails for integrating AI tools into enterprise software engineering lifecycles. * Strong technical skills in Python and Node. * Deep and thorough understanding of modern JavaScript and Typescript tech stack. * Deep understanding of Agile and Scrum principles. * Track record of success building products powered by serverless technologies as well as development and delivery experience (preferably using AWS Lambda, AWS API Gateway, AWS EventBridge). * Depth in NoSQL and SQL fundamentals. * Good working knowledge of cloud based security practices and technologies (preferably AWS services such as AWS Cognito, AWS Secrets Manager, AWS GuardDuty). * Experience in cross functional matrix team environment and with DevOps infrastructure\-as\-code experience. * Well\-developed communication and interpersonal skills, connecting directly and effectively with cross\-functional stakeholders at various levels. * A strong ability to coach and mentor technical leads, architects and senior level engineers, helping them develop their skills and advance their careers. * Experience championing design and development of complex, robust, and highly scalable production services and applications using modern frameworks, tools, and systems. * A passion for learning, continuous improvement, sharing, and working in a team environment. Why You Should Join: As one of the top mortgage lenders in the country, Pennymac has helped over 4 million lifetime homeowners achieve and sustain their aspirations of home. Our vision is to be the most trusted partner for home. Together, 4,000 Pennymac team members across the country are guided by our core values: to be Accountable, Reliable and Ethical in all that we do. Pennymac is committed to conducting a business that makes positive contributions and promotes long\-term sustainable growth and to fostering an equitable and inclusive environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected and supported. **Benefits That Bring It Home:** Whether you're looking for flexible benefits for today, setting up short\-term goals for tomorrow, or planning for long\-term success and retirement, Pennymac's benefits have you covered. Some key benefits include:* Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision * Paid Time Off Programs including vacation, holidays, illness, and parental leave * Wellness Programs, Employee Recognition Programs, and onsite gyms and cafe style dining (select locations) * Retirement benefits, life insurance, 401k match, and tuition reimbursement * Philanthropy Programs including matching gifts, volunteer grants, charitable grants and corporate sponsorships To learn more about our benefits visit: https://pennymacnews.page.link/benefits **Compensation:** Individual salary may vary based on multiple factors including specific role, geographic location / market data, and skills and experience as defined below:* Lower in range \- Building skills and experience in the role * Mid\-range \- Experience and skills align with proficiency in the role * Higher in range \- Experience and skills add value above typical requirements of the role Some roles may be eligible for performance\-based compensation and/or stock\-based incentives awarded to employees based on company and individual performance. Salary: $180,000 \- $383,000 Work Model: OFFICE

jobs.title: Software Engineer Principal - Java/Angular/Spring
jobs.description: **Job Profile****Position Overview** ===================== At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As a Software Engineer Principal within PNC's Asset Management Group organization, you will be based in Pittsburgh, PA; Philadelphia, PA; Cleveland, OH; Dallas, TX; Birmingham, AL; Denver, CO; or Phoenix, AZ. What We're Looking For We're seeking a Principal Software Engineer who brings a strong blend of modern application development, architecture, and engineering excellence. The ideal candidate has experience building scalable enterprise solutions, driving modernization efforts, and delivering business\-critical applications within a fast\-paced environment. Modern Application Development \& Architecture * Strong experience designing, developing, and supporting enterprise applications using Java. * Proven ability to build scalable, resilient microservices and API\-driven solutions. * Experience leading or contributing to application modernization initiatives, including migrations from legacy technologies to modern open\-source and enterprise\-supported platforms. * Deep understanding of software design patterns, performance tuning, security best practices, and application architecture. Front\-End Development \& User Experience * Hands\-on experience developing modern web applications using Angular. * Ability to create responsive, intuitive user experiences that integrate seamlessly with backend services. * Experience with component\-based architectures, state management, and front\-end modernization initiatives. * Passion for building user\-centric solutions that balance functionality, performance, and usability. Event\-Driven Architecture \& Enterprise Integration * Experience working with Kafka to support messaging, event streaming, and large\-scale enterprise integrations. * Strong understanding of distributed systems, asynchronous processing, and high\-volume transaction environments. * Ability to design and support event\-driven architectures that enhance scalability, reliability, and system performance. * Experience collaborating with enterprise integration and shared\-services teams. DevOps, CI/CD \& Platform Engineering * Experience building and supporting CI/CD pipelines, with a preference for Jenkins\-based deployment environments. * Understanding of DevOps principles, automation, monitoring, and cloud\-native development practices. * Ability to improve deployment efficiency, operational stability, and application reliability through automation and engineering best practices. * Experience supporting production environments and driving continuous improvement initiatives. PNC is an in\-office company that fosters a supportive culture where employees can thrive and achieve balance. We encourage candidates to connect with their recruiter and hiring manager to understand workplace expectations and ensure the role aligns with their goals. PNC will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in STEM OPT for this position.**Job Description** =================== * Aligns business strategy with software solutions. * Proposes, designs \& codes software solutions to address complex business needs. Oversees technical and procedural documentation required. * Leads complex problem solving. * Provides technical guidance and support to colleagues and solution development. * Displays an innovative approach to apply modern principles, methodologies and tools to advance business initiatives and capabilities. PNC Employees take pride in our reputation and to continue building upon that we expect our employees to be: * **Customer Focused** \- Knowledgeable of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and able to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions. * **Managing Risk** \- Assessing and effectively managing all of the risks associated with their business objectives and activities to ensure they adhere to and support PNC's Enterprise Risk Management Framework. **Qualifications** ================== Successful candidates must demonstrate appropriate knowledge, skills, and abilities for a role. Listed below are skills, competencies, work experience, education, and required certifications/licensures needed to be successful in this position. **Preferred Skills** -------------------- Agile Methodology, Computer Programming, Data Structures, DevOps, Distributed Systems, Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP), Software Development, Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Software Engineering, System Designs**Competencies** ---------------- Application Design, Architecture, Packaged Application Integratio Work Experience** ------------------- Roles at this level typically require a university / college degree, with 5\+ years of industry\-relevant experience. Specific certifications are often required. In lieu of a degree, a comparable combination of education, job specific certification(s), and experience (including military service) may be considered.**Education** ------------- Bachelors**Certifications** ------------------ No Required Certification(s)**Licenses** ------------ No Required License(s)**Language Assessments** ------------------------ No Required or Preferred Language Assessments**Pay Transparency** ==================== Base Salary: $91,000\.00 – $185,900\.00 Salaries may vary based on geographic location, market data and on individual skills, experience, and education. This role is incentive eligible with the payment based upon company, business and/or individual performance.**Application Window** ====================== Generally, this opening is expected to be posted for two business days from 11/16/2026, although it may be longer with business discretion.**Benefits** ============ PNC offers a comprehensive range of benefits to help meet your needs now and in the future. Depending on your eligibility, options for full\-time employees include: medical/prescription drug coverage (with a Health Savings Account feature), dental and vision options; employee and spouse/child life insurance; short and long\-term disability protection; 401(k) with PNC match, pension and stock purchase plans; dependent care reimbursement account; back\-up child/elder care; adoption, surrogacy, and doula reimbursement; educational assistance, including select programs fully paid; a robust wellness program with financial incentives. In addition, PNC generally provides the following paid time off, depending on your eligibility: maternity and/or parental leave; up to 11 paid holidays each year; 9 occasional absence days each year, unless otherwise required by law; between 15 to 25 vacation days each year, depending on career level; and years of service. To learn more about these and other programs, including benefits for full time and part\-time employees, visit pncthrive.com. **Disability Accommodations Statement** ======================================= If an accommodation is required to participate in the application process, please contact us via email at AccommodationRequest@pnc.com. Please include “accommodation request” in the subject line title and be sure to include your name, the job ID, and your preferred method of contact in the body of the email. Emails not related to accommodation requests will not receive responses. Applicants may also call 877\-968\-7762 and say "Workday" for accommodation assistance. All information provided will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations. At PNC we foster an inclusive and accessible workplace. We provide reasonable accommodations to employment applicants and qualified individuals with a disability who need an accommodation to perform the essential functions of their positions. **Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO)** ====================================== PNC provides equal employment opportunity to qualified persons regardless of race, color, sex, religion, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, or other categories protected by law. This position is subject to the requirements of Section 19 of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act (FDIA) and, for any registered role, the Secure and Fair Enforcement for Mortgage Licensing Act of 2008 (SAFE Act) and/or the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA), which prohibit the hiring of individuals with certain criminal history. **California Residents** ======================== Refer to the California Consumer Privacy Act Privacy Notice to gain understanding of how PNC may use or disclose your personal information in our hiring practices.

jobs.title: Electrical & Integration (E&I) Engineer
jobs.description: Proconex is the exclusive Emerson Impact Partner for Emerson Automation Solutions in the Mid\-Atlantic region. We provide a full portfolio of Process Automation Control Systems, Valves and Control Devices, and related technologies and services to a range of customers—in the Life Sciences, Chemical, Power, Refining, Oil \& Gas, Food \& Beverage, Paper, Metals, and other industries, as well as commercial enterprises and campus facilities. With three strategically located offices, Proconex maintains a deep dedication to its 200\+ employees, a sharp focus on safety and quality, and the drive to deliver. **Job Title** Electrical and Integration (E\&I) Engineer **Job Overview** The E\&I Engineer supports the electrical, networking, integration, design, and testing of Distributed Control System (DCS) and Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) based control systems, primarily on Emerson Process Management platforms with a focus on DeltaV. As part of an internal project team, this role works with cross\-functional groups to integrate equipment and processes for life sciences, energy, and chemical clients throughout the mid\-Atlantic region. Day\-to\-day work spans hardware and electrical design, system staging and testing, construction and site support, and sales support. The position requires the capacity to read engineering documents, effective communication with customers and project teams, and a professional approach to project status, schedule, and budget reporting. **Key Responsibilities** * Design and review automation and control system integration hardware, electrical designs, wireless designs, bus technology designs, specifications, architectures, and Bill of Materials (BOM). * Procure, track, set up, fabricate, stage, test, and ship system hardware and control enclosures. * Develop, review, and execute E\&I Factory Acceptance Test (EIFAT) protocols. * Assist in developing and documenting construction packages, with growth toward managing this activity with minimal to no supervision. * Assist with installation, commissioning, and startup activities, with growth toward managing this activity with minimal to no supervision. * Review requests for proposal and identify and estimate proposal scope and schedules for E\&I activities. * Read and interpret engineering documents, including Functional Specifications, Design Specifications, Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P\&IDs), and engineering guidelines. * Interact with Project Management and customers in a professional manner and communicate project status, schedule, and budget versus cost. * Participate in the maintenance and development of department standards and automation design tool libraries. * Follow all office and customer site safety policies and procedures. This role requires lifting up to 50 pounds and travel up to 25% to customer sites throughout the mid\-Atlantic region for installation, commissioning, startup, and site support activities. **Basic Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Electro\-Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Control Engineering, or equivalent experience. * 3\+ years of experience reading and interpreting engineering documents, including Functional Specifications, Design Specifications, and P\&IDs. * 3\+ years of experience working directly with customers and cross\-functional project teams. * 2\+ years of experience in control system design and implementation, including P\&IDs. * 2\+ years of experience designing or reviewing control system hardware, electrical designs, and specifications. * 2\+ years of experience supporting installation, commissioning, or startup of control systems. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or similarly regulated industries. * Experience with Emerson Process Management control platforms and/or Allen\-Bradley platforms and interfaces. * Experience with communication protocols such as Serial, Ethernet, and Modbus. * Experience with AutoCAD platform. * Experience reading and modifying control logic, including physical layer input/output (I/O) details and continuous configuration (control modules). * Experience with industrial wireless and bus technologies (AS\-i, Profibus, Foundation Fieldbus, DeviceNet). We are proud to be an employee\-owned organization. Through our ESOP, every team member shares in the growth and success of the company, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and long\-term rewards. Proconex offers a standout culture, fantastic work environment, and has very competitive benefits to include premium medical, 401K match, tuition reimbursement, and other unique incentives. When receiving e\-mails from a Proconex or Valspec recruiter, you will only receive e\-mails from addresses ending in @proconexdirect.com, @proconex.net or @valspec.net. Any other domains are impersonations and should be ignored. Candidates must be legally eligible to work in the United States without company sponsorship. Also, we are not interested in working on a corp\-to\-corp basis with other companies at this time. Any third\-party unsolicited resume submission(s) will immediately become the property of Proconex. Proconex will not pay any fee to a submitting employment agency, person, or entity unless a signed agreement is established. Proconex is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status or any other protected class. We are committed to providing a professional environment free of any discrimination or harassment, and we are proud to be a Drug\-Free Workplace.

jobs.title: Senior AI Software Engineer
jobs.description: Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business. Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible. **Senior AI Software Engineer** PTC’s software is used to design, build and service many of the world’s most complex products, from aircraft and cars to medical devices and industrial equipment. We’re bringing AI into that portfolio, and we’re looking for engineers who want to build AI that holds up in demanding, real\-world environments. As a Senior AI Software Engineer, you will build these systems and take them from prototype to production. You will work in a small, fast\-moving squad, with engineers, product managers and designers, shipping agentic features that real customers use. **Key Responsibilities** * Build AI agents and the services around them, using LLMs, retrieval and agentic workflows, and connect them to PTC's products, data and APIs. * Make agents production grade: state that survives restarts, long running work that pauses for human input and resumes, tool permissions scoped to each user, and defenses against prompt injection. * Develop the APIs, tools and integrations, including MCP servers, that let agents act on enterprise systems safely. * Build eval suites and automated tests that catch regressions as models, prompts and data change, and use them as release gates. * Instrument services with metrics, monitoring and tracing for quality, latency and cost, and use that data to improve the system in production. * Ship continuously and own what you ship, from design through deployment, including participating in an on\-call rotation for the services your team runs. Raise the bar for the team through code review, design discussions and mentoring, working with security, architecture and engineering colleagues across PTC's global organization. * **Qualifications** * 5\+ years of software engineering, including building and running distributed services or SaaS applications. * Experience shipping at least one LLM\-based feature (an agent, a RAG system or an AI workflow) to production users, not just prototypes. * Strong skills in at least one of Python, Java, TypeScript or C\+\+. * Solid fundamentals: software design, APIs, data structures, automated testing and modern development practices. * Experience with cloud\-native development on Azure, AWS or GCP: containers, Kubernetes and CI/CD. * Experience integrating AI models with application logic, enterprise data and external tools. * Sound judgment on technical trade\-offs, and ownership of features from design through production support. * Clear communication and experience working with distributed teams * A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent experience. **Nice to have** * Experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph or LangChain, and with MCP. * Experience with vector search, embeddings and retrieval pipelines over enterprise knowledge. * Experience with AI evaluation frameworks, LLMOps and observability tools (for example Datadog). Experience in enterprise software, CAD, PLM (product lifecycle management), ALM (application lifecycle management), SLM (service lifecycle management), industrial software or a related domain. * **This position is not eligible for employment\-based immigration sponsorship. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without requiring current or future sponsorship from PTC.** PTC carefully considers a wide variety of factors when determining compensation. The anticipated annual salary range for this position is between $153,000 \- 200,000\. The salary range reflects a good\-faith estimate of compensation at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on a candidate's skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Additionally, candidates may be eligible for a performance\-based bonus. Employees also have the opportunity to become a PTC shareholder through our employee share purchase program (ESPP), which allows for the purchase of discounted PTC stock. Certain roles may also be eligible for participation in our equity programs. Employees may be eligible for medical, dental and vision insurance, paid time off and sick leave, tuition reimbursement, 401(k) contributions and employer match, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability coverage and, if you are an office\-assigned employee, a generous commuter subsidy. All total rewards and benefits programs are subject to applicable plan eligibility and other terms and conditions. For more information about PTC’s comprehensive benefits, please visit our Careers Page. Applications will be accepted on an on\-going basis. \#LI\-CS1 This position is not eligible for employment\-based immigration sponsorship. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without requiring current or future sponsorship from PTC. At PTC, we believe in the power of diverse ideas and perspectives. As a global company that values and respects all identities, cultures, and perspectives, we strive to create an inclusive PTC for ALL through an environment where everyone feels like they belong and are empowered to bring their true, authentic selves to work. Proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and hire without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, ethnicity, ancestry, marital status, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. For more information about PTC’s comprehensive benefits and our AI usage, please visit our Careers Page (https://www.ptc.com/en/careers/united\-states\-careers). Applications will be accepted on an on\-going basis until the opportunity is filled. PTC endeavors to make ptc.com/careers accessible to all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact PTC's Talent Acquisition team at TalentAcquisition@ptc.com. This contact information is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications. Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting\-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you. If you share our passion for problem\-solving through innovation, you’ll likely become just as passionate about the PTC experience as we are. Are you ready to explore your next career move with us? We respect the privacy rights of individuals and are committed to handling Personal Information responsibly and in accordance with all applicable privacy and data protection laws.
