jobs.description: Job description: **Scope Of The Project** The purpose of this engagement is to obtain a qualified SharePoint Online Administrator to plan, design, administer, modernize, and optimize SCDMV’s SharePoint Online sites, flows, and configuration. The SharePoint Online Administrator will merge SharePoint Online technical capabilities with SCDMV business goals and objectives to produce a platform for the agency to further its mission of delivering exceptional customer service and promoting effective and efficient business processes, professional employees, innovative technology, and strategic partnerships. **Daily Duties** The SharePoint Online Administrator will report to the Server Team Manager within the Server Team. The SharePoint Online Administrator will work with Server Team members, Business Unit Directors, Managers, and their staff. The SharePoint Online Administrator will provide both front\-end support to all end users and collaborate with business units to enhance functionality, governance, user experience, advanced permissions, and operational efficiency. This includes designing and developing intranet solutions, including custom layouts, workflows, and automation. Strong UI/UX design skills and the ability to create user\-friendly, accessible interfaces are needed. This role delivers modern, scalable solutions using SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365 tools, collaborating with cross\-functional teams to automate business processes, ensure secure and accessible systems, and enhance the SCDMV SharePoint Online tenant as new features become available and other features are deprecated. Ultimately, the contractor will become a champion of the capabilities of SharePoint Online, advance SCDMV’s understanding of what can be achieved by utilizing SharePoint Online and increase functionality and usage. **Responsibilities** * Design, administer, and maintain the functionality of sites, subsites, and links. * Use best practices within Entra ID architecture to design, administer, and managesecurity groups, advanced settings, and permissions in SharePoint Online, includingsite permissions for streamlining owner, member, and visitor roles. * Perform site and content permission audits as defined by the agency. * Work with site owners to increase the functionality of departmental SharePointOnline sites and subsites. * Manage site layout structure, content, workflows, and automation. SCDMV Programmer – Project Lead \- M365 SharePoint Online Engineer * Provide SharePoint Online support to end users. * Provide functionality training to the training department and end users. * Review and monitor usage reports. * Clean up sites and remove unused sites. * Create and maintain detailed documentation of SharePoint Online services andsettings. * Create and maintain detailed documentation of SharePoint Online configurationand architecture. * Provide updates to the Project Team. * Stay abreast of the Microsoft platform and functionality roadmap to keep the agencycurrent. * Manage site quotas and file size limits. * Work collaboratively to conceptualize and integrate other Microsoft 365applications into SharePoint Online. * Plan, organize, review, and implement associated project milestones throughcompletion. * Create architecture diagrams and technology navigation maps. * Configure and manage site collections, hubs, libraries, lists, and permissions. * Implement and maintain governance standards, taxonomy, metadata, and contentmanagement policies. * Manage the environment lifecycle, including provisioning, archival, anddecommissioning of sites. **Position Details** * •Hybrid – 3 Days in Office and 2 Days Remote. Potential for fully remote **after** training and acclimation.•First Round of Virtual Interviews and Second Round of Onsite Interviews•Candidates must currently reside in SC, NC, or GA AND be willing to **relocate at least 5 days prior to the start date** at their own expense. **Fingerprinting must be completed during the onboarding process in South Carolina.** **Required Skills** * 5\+ Years of Experience with development support for SharePoint Online (Office365\), Microsoft 365 hybrid infrastructure, the Microsoft Windows platform,advanced permissions, and Entra ID. SCDMV Programmer – Project Lead \- M365 SharePoint Online Engineer * 5\+ Years of Experience with front\-end design, user interface, and user experience. * 5\+ Years of Experience with implementing SharePoint roadmap enhancements and changes and developing technical runbooks. * 5\+ Years of Experience with creating and maintaining workflow and Power Automate configurations. * Understanding of Microsoft SharePoint Online best practices and technical documentation. **Preferred Skills** * Experience with data governance, data governance frameworks, data policy, and policy documentation. * Advanced knowledge of business processes. * Strong understanding of PowerShell. **Additional Skills** * Excellent verbal and written communication skills for business and technical audiences at all levels of the organization. * Ability to stay abreast of the Microsoft development lifecycle management process. **Preferred Certifications** Microsoft Power Platform certifications; Microsoft 365 certifications. **Required Education** Bachelor’s degree in technical or business field. Years of experience may substitute for formal education. Pay: $80\.00 \- $90\.00 per hour Application Question(s): * 7\+ Years of Experience with development support for SharePoint Online (Office365\), Microsoft 365 hybrid infrastructure, the Microsoft Windows platform,advanced permissions, and Entra ID. * 5\+ Years of Experience with front\-end design, user interface, and user experience. * 5\+ Years of Experience with implementing SharePoint roadmap enhancements and changes and developing technical runbooks. * 5\+ Years of Experience with creating and maintaining workflow and Power Automate configurations. * Strong understanding of PowerShell. * Bachelor’s degree in technical or business field. Years of experience may substitute for formal education. * Microsoft Power Platform certifications or Microsoft 365 certifications. * Only US Citizens, GC's or EAD (Video Validation of GC and EAD required) * Candidates from NC,SC or GA only Work Location: Hybrid remote in Blythewood, SC 29016

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Back End
jobs.description: Paradigm is a software company transforming the way that the residential, construction \& building product industries operate across the globe. We are looking for a **Senior Software Engineer – Back End** to be part of revolutionizing these industries. We are building the future with modern software engineering, agent\-assisted systems, and mobile\-first experiences. We are powered by our parent company, Builders FirstSource (NYSE: BLDR). Our Software Engineering Team builds and supports cloud\-based applications in the Azure ecosystem. The InfoThinks team develops intelligent applications and services that combine modern backend engineering with AI capabilities to help users access, understand, and act on complex business and product information. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer – Back End with strong Python and API development experience and a practical understanding of AI application architecture. This engineer will build and maintain APIs and services that integrate large language models, enterprise data sources, search and retrieval systems, and other AI capabilities into production applications. **What You Will Do:** * Design, develop, enhance, and maintain backend APIs and services using Python, with an emphasis on scalable, maintainable, production\-quality systems. * Develop AI\-enabled backend services using LangChain and related technologies that orchestrate large language models, enterprise data, search/retrieval systems, and external APIs, while maintaining appropriate abstractions between the application and underlying models, providers, and data platforms. * Design and implement retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) workflows, including retrieval, context construction, prompt orchestration, and response generation. * Implement observability, logging, error handling, testing, and performance monitoring for both API operations and AI workflows, with appropriate consideration for security, scalability, data privacy, and responsible use of AI. * Evaluate and improve AI application behavior, including response quality, retrieval quality, latency, reliability, token consumption, and cost. * Investigate production issues and implement and test fixes across APIs, AI integrations, retrieval components, and supporting services. * Participate in peer code reviews, contribute to engineering standards and technical documentation, and recommend improvements to development processes and engineering tools. * Collaborate closely with front\-end engineers, Product Owners, QA, data engineers, UX, and other engineering teams to translate product requirements into robust backend solutions, working independently on complex problems while collaborating on architecture and implementation decisions. **What You Need to Succeed:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience. * 4\+ years of professional software development experience, with significant experience developing backend applications, APIs, or distributed services. * Strong hands\-on development experience with Python and modern Python application development practices. * Experience designing and implementing REST APIs and backend services, with a strong understanding of software architecture and object\-oriented and/or functional design principles. * Practical experience with LangChain or comparable frameworks for developing LLM\-powered applications and integrating APIs and applications with LLM providers and AI services. * Strong understanding of large language models and generative AI concepts, including prompts, tokens, context windows, embeddings, and model limitations, and of Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures and how retrieval, context generation, and LLM responses relate. * Experience or working knowledge of semantic search, vector search, and retrieval strategies, and of common AI application patterns such as tool/function calling, structured outputs, agents, and multi\-step AI workflows. * Experience designing reliable production systems with appropriate authentication, authorization, error handling, logging, automated testing, and observability. * Strong problem\-solving skills, including troubleshooting complex issues that span application code, APIs, AI models, retrieval systems, and data sources, and evaluating when new AI technologies are appropriate for production use. * Proven teamwork, collaboration, and communication skills, and the ability to stay dependable and organized while adapting to changing requirements and priorities in an agile environment. **Beneficial Skills and Knowledge:** * Experience with Azure AI services, Azure OpenAI, or similar managed AI platforms. * Experience with Databricks and integrating Databricks APIs or data services into applications. * Experience with vector databases or vector\-enabled search platforms. * Experience with containerized applications and cloud deployment using Docker and Azure. * Familiarity with FastAPI or similar Python API frameworks. **Ready to Join? Apply now at** **www.myparadigm.com/careers** Individual compensation packages are based on various factors unique to each candidate, including skill set, experience, qualifications, and other job\-related reasons. Our US based senior\-level pay generally is hired within a range of $95,000\-139,000/annually for this role. The salary does not reflect total compensation, which includes base salary and benefits. These compensation levels are subject to an annual review. Compensation Range: $95K \- $139K

platforms. * Experience developing reusable component libraries or design systems. **Ready to Join? jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer, Systems Integration
jobs.description: ### **Build the Path Forward** At Path Robotics, we're building the future of embodied intelligence. Our AI\-driven systems enable robots to adapt, learn, and perform in the real world, closing the skilled labor gap and transforming industries. We go beyond traditional methods, combining perception, reasoning, and control to deliver field\-ready AI that is risk\-aware, reliable, and continuously improving through real\-world use. Big, hard problems are our everyday work, and our team of intelligent, humble, and driven people make the impossible possible together. We're seeking Robotics Software Engineers who thrive on making big, complex systems work together in the real world. We currently have **experienced and senior** openings on the team. Our robots combine industrial hardware, real\-time C\+\+ control, ROS, cloud services, and the latest machine learning research. This team ties all of it into one reliable product and scales it from a few cells to dozens of systems running in production on customer factory floors. You'll write the drivers, ROS nodes, deployment tooling, and telemetry that make that possible. You'll be hands\-on with the robots, bringing systems up, debugging them, and working with factory technicians to keep them running. ### **What You'll Do** **Experienced:** * **Write drivers for robotic and industrial hardware.** Build and maintain the drivers that connect our software to robot controllers, sensors, cameras, PLCs, and other industrial equipment, behind clean, reliable interfaces. * **Ship software to the fleet.** Package software in Docker, and build and improve the deployment, configuration, and update tooling that gets it onto dozens of robots reliably. * **Get research onto the robot.** Help integrate and deploy new machine learning models and features from our research teams onto real robotic hardware. * **Bring up and support systems on the factory floor.** Install, test, and troubleshoot systems with factory technicians, including networking and connectivity issues, and turn what you learn into fixes in the code. * **Write solid, tested code.** Contribute unit and integration tests, participate in code reviews, and help keep CI/CD healthy. **Senior:** * **Connect the full stack.** Own the integration layer across modern C\+\+, Python, ROS 1/2, Docker, AWS, web services, and industrial robot controllers, so that new capabilities reach the robot cleanly and reliably. * **Get research into production.** Partner with our machine learning and research teams to package, deploy, and run new learning\-based models on real robotic hardware. * **Scale from a handful of cells to a fleet.** Build the deployment, configuration, and update infrastructure that takes development and demonstration systems to dozens of robots in production. * **Architect large systems.** Organize and design how large numbers of robotic hardware and software components fit together: interfaces, ownership boundaries, versioning, and deployment. * **Build consensus across teams.** Work with hardware, controls, perception, ML, cloud, and field operations teams to understand their needs, propose integration solutions, and bring stakeholders to agreement. * **Mentor engineers.** Provide technical leadership and help experienced engineers grow their system design skills. ### **Who You Are** * A Bachelor's in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 3\+ years (Experienced) / 6\+ years (Senior) building software in modern C\+\+ (Python a strong plus), with hands\-on work on robots or other physical hardware. * Experience with ROS 2\. * Familiarity with ROS, DDS, gRPC, and other communications middleware. * Comfortable with multithreading, concurrency, and debugging systems\-level behavior on real hardware. * Fluent developing and operating software on Linux, with Git. * You enjoy hands\-on work and are willing to spend time on the factory floor with the robots. * **Senior:** A track record of shipping and supporting industrial robotic systems in production. Experience writing drivers or hardware interfaces, deploying containerized software with Docker on AWS or similar platforms, and handling telemetry, remote management, networking, and security for deployed systems. Experience designing large systems of robotics hardware and software, and comfort leading cross\-team technical discussions to a decision. ### **Why You'll Love Working Here** * Daily free lunch to keep you fueled and connected with the team * Flexible PTO so you can take the time you need, when you need it * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage * 6 weeks fully paid parental leave, plus an additional 6–8 weeks for birthing parents (12–14 weeks total) * 401(k) retirement plan through Empower * Generous employee referral bonuses—help us grow our team! ### **Who We Are** At Path Robotics we love coming to work to solve interesting and tough challenges but also because our ideas are welcomed and valued. We encourage unique thinking and are dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application process or any part of the hiring process, please contact HR@path\-robotics.com. We are committed to providing equal access and will work with qualified individuals to ensure a fair and accessible hiring experience. We will respond to your request within 48 hours.

jobs.title: ML Infra Engineer, Compute
jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- Physical Intelligence is bringing general\-purpose AI into the physical world. We are a group of engineers, scientists, roboticists, and company builders developing foundation models and learning algorithms to power the robots of today and the physically\-actuated devices of the future. **The Team** ------------ The ML Infrastructure team supports and accelerates PI’s core modeling efforts by building the systems that make large\-scale training reliable, reproducible, and fast. You will work closely with ML Infra (training systems), data platform, and research teams to ensure compute scheduling is never the bottleneck. **About the Role** ------------------ Physical Intelligence builds general\-purpose AI for the physical world. Training our models requires orchestrating thousands of accelerators across a heterogeneous fleet of GPU and TPU clusters — spanning different hardware generations, cloud providers, and cluster topologies. Today, researchers often need to know which cluster to target, what resources are available, and how to configure their jobs accordingly. That doesn't scale. We need a scheduling and compute layer that makes the right placement decision automatically — routing jobs to the best cluster based on availability, hardware fit, cost, and priority — so researchers can focus entirely on the science. This role owns that problem end\-to\-end: the scheduling systems, the placement logic, the cluster management layer, and the operational tooling that keeps it all running. This is not cloud DevOps. It's not about standing up clusters and walking away. It's a systems role for people who care about intelligent resource allocation, utilization, fault tolerance, and making large\-scale distributed training seamless. **In This Role You Will** ------------------------- * Own Intelligent Job Scheduling and Placement: Design and build multi\-tenant scheduling systems that automatically place training jobs on the best available cluster based on hardware requirements, topology, availability, cost, and priority. Support fair resource sharing across teams and projects with quota management, priority tiers, and preemption policies. Abstract away cluster differences so researchers submit jobs without needing to know where they will land. * Scale Multi\-cluster Orchestration: Build the control plane that manages the job lifecycle across diverse clusters (mixed GPU/TPU, multi\-generation hardware, on\-prem/cloud) and enables seamless job migration, failover, and re\-scheduling. * Optimize Accelerator Utilization and Efficiency: Monitor and optimize GPU/TPU utilization across the entire fleet. Implement priority, preemption, queueing, and fairness policies that balance research velocity with cost efficiency. * Ensure Scaling and Stability: Implement fault detection, automatic recovery, and resilience for long\-running multi\-node training jobs. Manage health checking, node management, and scaling to thousands of accelerators. * Support Inference and Robot Deployment: Extend scheduling and orchestration to inference workloads, including deploying models to edge devices on physical robots. * Enhance Observability and Developer Experience: Build the dashboards, alerting, SLOs, and debugging tools necessary for researchers to understand job status and for the team to ensure high scheduling quality and cluster reliability. **What We Hope You'll Bring** ----------------------------- We’re intentionally flexible on exact background, but strong candidates usually have: * Strong software engineering fundamentals * Experience building or operating job scheduling / resource management systems at scale * Experience with large\-scale compute clusters (GPU and/or TPU) * Familiarity with schedulers and orchestration systems (SLURM, Kubernetes, GKE, K3S, or internal equivalents) * Comfort reasoning about resource allocation, bin\-packing, priority scheduling, and multi\-tenancy * Understanding of how ML training workloads behave — long\-running, multi\-node, sensitive to stragglers, topology\-dependent * A bias toward owning systems end\-to\-end, from design to operation * Enjoy working closely with researchers and unblocking fast\-moving projects **Bonus Points** ---------------- * Experience building multi\-cluster or federated scheduling systems * Experience with TPU infrastructure (GCP TPU slices, Multislice, GKE) * Background in cluster resource managers (Borg, YARN, Mesos, or custom schedulers) * Linux systems engineering, networking, and infrastructure\-as\-code * NCCL/collective communication and topology\-aware placement * Experience with capacity planning and cloud cost optimization at scale * Familiarity with JAX, PyTorch, or similar ML frameworks at the runtime/systems level Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

build solutions for test\-data generation, environment management, mocking, service virtualization, and dependency management. * Partner with software engineers and architects during system design to improve testability, reliability, scalability, and observability. * Implement shift\-left and continuous testing practices across the software development lifecycle. * Define and monitor engineering quality metrics, including automation coverage, defect leakage, flaky\-test rates, execution time, and release quality. * Perform deep debugging and root\-cause analysis of complex failures across application, API, database, and infrastructure layers. * Evaluate and introduce new automation tools, frameworks, and engineering practices, and lead technical design reviews. * Mentor SDETs and software engineers on automation architecture, coding standards, and testing best practices, and drive cross\-team initiatives that improve engineering quality and developer productivity. automation frameworks from the ground up * Hands\-on experience with tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Appium, REST Assured, PyTest, TestNG, JUnit, or equivalent * Strong experience with REST APIs, microservices, and backend or service\-level automation * Experience with SQL\-based database validation and with testing complex distributed and asynchronous systems * Experience skills, along with a solid understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and testing methodologies * Demonstrated ability to influence engineering practices across multiple teams * Excellent communication, technical leadership, and collaboration skills **Preferred:** * Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP, and with Docker and Kubernetes * Experience with performance testing tools such as k6, JMeter, Gatling, or Locust * Knowledge of event\-driven technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ, and experience with contract testing tools such as Pact * Experience with observability platforms such as Datadog, Grafana, or Splunk * Understanding of security testing and application security fundamentals * Experience with large\-scale SaaS, cloud\-native, or enterprise platforms * Experience building internal developer or test productivity tools * Exposure to AI\-assisted test generation or AI\-based quality engineering tools **Pay Range: $193,000 \- $223,000** **WHY QUINCE?** We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case\-by\-case basis. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. *Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds* At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. We run our own AI\-driven red team against our code, contracts, and cloud, gate pull requests before they merge, and set the baselines for how every system is configured. This role owns blockchain security end to end: the smart contracts on EVM chains, Solana, and Stellar that hold and move customer funds, the keys and multisigs that control them, and the backend services that act on what happens on chain. You'll be Rain's blockchain security expert. The calls are yours: what's real, how bad it is, and what has to be fixed before a contract ships or an upgrade goes out. You'll work closely with the leads of our Solana, EVM, and blockchain infrastructure teams, hold the line when it matters, and make the case so they agree, not just comply. **What you’ll do** * Review smart contract changes and upgrades before they ship, across Solidity (EVM), Rust (Solana), and Soroban (Stellar). Find the bug that matters, and often write the fix yourself * Run our contract audits end to end: scope them, work with outside auditors, triage findings from audits, our AI red team, and our bug bounty, set severity, and approve the fixes * Own admin key and role security: multisig and Safe setups, signing ceremonies, role separation, timelocks, and who can upgrade, pause, or move what * Strengthen treasury and fund\-flow protections so no single key, signer, or bad transaction can drain money * Find the blind spots in our on\-chain monitoring: work out what we can't see today, and tell our blockchain detection and response team which detections to build and why * Review how our backend reads and reacts to chain events (indexers, event handlers, signing services), so off\-chain code can't be tricked by on\-chain input * Own the upgrade process so every upgrade is done securely: who deploys, from where, and with what checks. Make sure no contract, chain, or customer program gets left behind on an old version, and prove that what's live matches what was reviewed * Build the tools that make this repeatable: fuzzing and invariant tests, and simulations of upgrades and admin actions before anyone signs them * Lead the technical response when something goes wrong on chain, and own the plan for where blockchain security goes next **You are likely to succeed if you have:** * 4\+ years in smart contract security, protocol security, or security\-minded blockchain engineering * Deep, hands\-on EVM and Solidity, plus real working knowledge of at least one non\-EVM chain (Solana or Stellar/Soroban) * You've found real bugs in contracts that hold real money, through audits, contests, bounties, or your own team's code. You know a scary\-sounding finding from a real one * You've designed or run key management for production contracts: multisigs and Safe, KMS or HSM signing, timelocks, and role\-based access * Fluent with Foundry, fuzzing and invariant testing, transaction simulation, and reading chain state directly * You can read TypeScript backend code well enough to follow how it talks to the chain * You've owned security decisions. You can tell a senior engineer their design needs to change and keep a good working relationship * You'd rather ship a check than write a document, and you use AI tools heavily without trusting them blindly **Bonus attributes:** * Stablecoin, payments, or card issuing background * Public audit reports, audit contest placings, or bug bounty payouts * Hands\-on response to a live on\-chain exploit or key compromise * Formal verification or contract static analysis (Certora, Halmos, Slither, or similar) * Experience building security scanners or LLM\-based review tools **Things that enable a fulfilling, healthy and happy experience at Rain:** **Flexible time off** Unlimited vacation can be daunting, so we require Rainmakers to take 10 days minimum for themselves. **Flexible working** We support a flexible workplace – work from home, come into an office, or both. We want everyone to work in an environment where they're their most confident and productive selves. New Rainmakers receive a stipend to set up a comfortable home workspace. **Easy to access benefits** For US Rainmakers, we cover 95% of your health, dental, and vision plan costs and 90% for your dependents, plus a 100% company\-subsidized life insurance plan. **Retirement goals** Plan for the future with confidence. We offer a 401(k) with a 4% company match. **Equity plan** Every Rainmaker gets an equity option plan so we all benefit from our success. **Health and Wellness** High performance begins from within. Rainmakers receive a monthly stipend to be used for eligible health and wellness spending like gym memberships/fitness classes, massages, acupuncture \- whatever recharges you! **In\-office meals** Rainmakers working from the office enjoy lunch and dinner on us, covered with a DoorDash credit. **Team summits** Summits play an important role at Rain. Time together helps us build relationships and a common destiny. Expect team and company offsites, both domestic and international. Compensation Range: $200K \- $260K

jobs.title: AI Automation Solutions Engineer

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Full Stack Engineer, Java \& Kubernetes Focus** Who We Are Recruitics is the talent acquisition platform for organizations where hiring never stops. The platform unifies predictive labor market intelligence, programmatic reach across every channel candidates trust, and AI\-ready job application workflows to optimize every stage of the pre\-apply journey, from market signal to qualified hire. More than 400 enterprise organizations across healthcare, logistics, retail, and beyond trust Recruitics to reach and convert talent across 100\+ countries. For more information, visit recruitics.com. What We’re Looking For Recruitics is looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer with deep Kubernetes and platform expertise to join our team.You’ll be one of two engineers who own AdaptiveApply. That means the code, the infrastructure, the integrations, and a lot of the decisions. There’s no separate platform team to hand things off to. If you want real ownership of a product that lives with customers, this is it. AdaptiveApply is our newest product: an application layer that sits upstream of the ATS and verifies identity, intent, and qualifications before a candidate ever reaches the employer’s system. We launched with ID.me as our first verification partner, and more partners are on the way. Our tech stack includes React and TypeScript on the frontend; Kotlin and Spring Boot on the backend; Airflow, DBT, Looker, AWS Redshift, DynamoDB, and MongoDB across our data layer; Kubernetes, Helm, and AWS at the heart of our infrastructure; and a rapidly evolving AI/ML layer built on LLM APIs, embeddings, and vector search. We value autonomy and ownership: you'll have the freedom to innovate and the responsibility to implement solutions independently (with plenty of support from your team). What You’ll Do In this role you'll work across the full stack, with Kubernetes and data engineering as recurring throughlines. You will: * Build and run AdaptiveApply end to end: backend services in Kotlin and Spring Boot, event flows on Kafka, and the apply experience candidates actually see. * Deploy your own work. You’ll write the Helm charts, set resource limits and autoscaling, ship through CI/CD, and debug in\-cluster when something breaks. Everything runs on Kubernetes on AWS (EKS). * Integrate verification partners (identity, credentials, assessments) and push clean, verified candidate data into employer ATS platforms. * Take ambiguous problems from customer conversations and turn them into shipped features, working directly with product and go\-to\-market. * Own reliability for what you ship. When a bot submits 500 applications overnight, you’re the one who makes sure the system holds up. * Use AI coding agents as a normal part of how you work, and help shape where AI belongs inside the product. What You’ll Bring We're looking for a well\-rounded engineer who can build complete products and is genuinely strong with Kubernetes and data. The ideal candidate has: * 5\+ years of software engineering with real senior\-level ownership. You’ve designed systems, made the tradeoffs, and lived with the results in production. * Strong Java and JVM experience. Kotlin is our primary backend language, so production Kotlin is a big plus. Spring Boot is expected. * Hands\-on Kafka: topic design, producers and consumers, and handling failures and replays in event\-driven systems. * Production Kubernetes experience deploying and operating your own workloads, not just consuming a platform someone else built. Helm, ingress, autoscaling, RBAC, secrets, and debugging a failing pod should all feel familiar. EKS and Terraform are a plus. * High agency. You don’t wait for a perfectly scoped ticket. You find the problem, propose a path, ship it, and tell people what you did. * Fluency with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar). * Clear communication with non\-engineers. You’ll work closely with product, sales, and sometimes customers. You May Also Have * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field is preferred, but equivalent practical experience is absolutely welcome. * React/TypeScript for when a feature needs frontend work * ATS integrations (Workday, Greenhouse, iCIMS) or HR tech experience * Identity verification, fraud detection, or bot mitigation work * Data pipelines (Airflow, DBT, Redshift) Why Join Us At Recruitics, you’ll have the opportunity to help us make hiring better for everyone. Help us connect intelligence, talent acquisition, and candidate conversion to help companies find the people their business needs more efficiently, while continuously evolving with how talent discovers work and how hiring gets done. You’ll be joining a creative and collaborative environment where your work will directly impact our clients’ success and you will have opportunities for career growth, professional development, and continuous learning. What We Offer * Competitive salaries with growth incentives * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance * \#AnywhereAugust \- We support remote work experiences to expand perspectives and personal growth * 15 Vacation Days, 5 Flex Days, 5 Sick Days, and remote work options year\-round * Fully paid parental leave for both parents * Summer Fridays from Memorial Day to Labor Day * Winter Recess between Christmas and New Years * Commuter and Parking Benefits through Wage Works * Eligible to contribute to your 401(K) Retirement Plan after six (6\) months of employment. * Employee Assistance Programs to support your day to day Location Remote based out of the United States Compensation * Comp Range: $140K \- $200K \+ 10% Yearly Bonus Equal Opportunity And Accessible Workplace Recruitics is an equal\-opportunity employer. We value a culture of inclusion and diversity within our workforce and are committed to maintaining a workplace free from prohibited employment conduct, including discrimination or harassment based on race, color, national origin, sex, age, religion, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, domestic partner status, civil partnership, status as a covered veteran, status in the Uniformed Services of the United States, citizenship and any other characteristic protected by State and Federal law. We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible process for all individuals. If you require any accommodations during the application or interview process due to a disability, please let us know. We will work with you to ensure your needs are met in a timely and respectful manner. Applicants must be at least 18 years old to apply. At Recruitics, protecting our talent community—candidates, clients, and partners—is always a top priority. As you navigate your application journey, please keep these tips in mind to stay safe: * We'll never ask you to pay for anything. That includes applications, interviews, background checks, or equipment. * We only communicate via official email addresses ending in @recruitics.com — never from Gmail or suspicious lookalikes. * We do not request personal financial information such as bank details, credit card numbers, or wire transfers. * If something feels off or doesn’t seem right, pause and contact us directly at careers@recruitics.com. We’re thrilled you’re interested in working with us. Just make sure it’s really us you’re talking to. Stay sharp and stay safe!

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: ***Posting Type*** Hybrid/Remote ***Job Overview*** Who We Are Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI‑powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high‑stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial. The world’s largest law firms, corporations and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we’re deeply committed to expanding access to technology for academic institutions through Relativity Academic and supporting pro bono legal work through Justice for Change What We Do About AI and Data Science at Relativity Over the past two years, billions of documents have benefited from Relativity AI, and we are just beginning. We use AI to improve every user experience, product, matter, and investigation—helping users find the truth faster and act on data with confidence. At the same time, Relativity’s scale creates rich opportunities for data exploration, and our market reach helps turn insights into impact quickly. Our infrastructure makes data available for analysis while keeping it secure and protected, and we continue to invest in modern data\-pipeline and data\-lake technology. We prioritize algorithm excellence to deliver a robust, trusted experience. We are building a world\-class toolset to solve complex challenges quickly. We apply AI across discovery to improve case management and product operations. Our team values curiosity, experimentation, and continuous learning. We test boldly, learn quickly, and improve every day. If you’re looking for a data\-rich, AI\-driven environment with large\-scale challenges and room to innovate, you’ll feel at home on Relativity’s AI team. Join us to help shape the culture, practices, and technical vision for machine learning at Relativity. What You’ll Do As a Senior AI Engineer at Relativity, you will design and build the AI/ML platforms and processes that support applied science and product engineering teams. You will focus on standardizing GenAI workflows and model management, ensuring scalability, security, and reliability. This role requires close collaboration across teams to enable impactful machine learning solutions that improve user experiences and product performance. If you're eager to tackle technical challenges and drive innovation in ML Ops, this position is for you. ***Job Description and Requirements*** **Responsibilities** * **Technical Leadership.** Work with a team of engineers from a technical perspective, focused on data science enablement, automation, and model management. * **Solution Design.** Design AI/ML solutions with the appropriate delivery timelines, extensibility, performance, and scale. * **Planning.** Plan larger data science and machine learning efforts in conjunction with data scientists and product managers, minimizing risks and maximizing opportunities. * **Security \& Compliance.** Collaborate with Relativity's security team to ensure robust data protection and compliance. * **Cross\-Team Collaboration.** Collaborate with product managers, data engineers, and data scientists focused on innovation and new product development. * **ML Ops.** Design, communicate, and deploy our machine learning operations processes and platforms (i.e., ML Ops). * **Prototyping.** Prototype new machine learning technologies to find opportunities to reduce costs, gain efficiencies, unlock insights, or facilitate new product development. * **Hands\-On Contribution.** Contribute towards project work and model technical acumen via hands\-on contributions, coaching, code review, and system design review. * **Communication.** Communicate across the broader AI team, keeping the team aware of AI platform innovation, learning opportunities, and future areas of innovation. * **Deployment \& Monitoring.** Deploy and monitor highly available data science solutions via CI/CD with health and performance metrics. What We’re Looking For **Required** * **4\+ years** of experience engineering software systems. * **2\+ years** of industry experience in machine learning\-focused roles and big data environments. * Fluent in **C\#, Python, or Java** . * **3\+ years** of experience with **Docker** . * **2\+ years** of experience creating resources on **AWS, Azure, or GCP** using infrastructure as code (e.g., AWS CloudFormation, AWS CDK, Terraform, CDKTF, Pulumi, etc.). * Experience with **Prefect, Airflow** , or an analogous workflow tool. * Experience with **Helm and Kubernetes** . * Ability and desire to mentor teammates in the use of applied data science and data processing technologies. * Prior experience owning and maintaining a major system within a business from a technical and architecture perspective. * Experience maintaining and monitoring deployed data science solutions for performance and algorithmic health. **Preferred** * Advanced degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or Artificial Intelligence. * Experience with Azure cloud environment and Azure's big data infrastructure, data processing, and data science toolset. * Experience building or deploying models using frameworks such as **TensorFlow, Keras, or PyTorch** . * Demonstrated deep experience in a particular area of data science (computer vision, NLP, etc.). * Experience with **MLflow** or **Kubeflow** . * Experience in a DevOps, infrastructure, or site reliability team or function. * Experience deploying solutions in big data processing frameworks such as Apache Spark, Hadoop, EMR, and Kafka. * Experience tuning data processing engines such as Spark to optimize costs, resource consumption, and execution times. Why We Could Be A Great Fit * **Impactful Mission:** ***Organize Data, Discover the Truth and Act on It*** \- Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading law firms managing high\-stakes matters on our platform. * **Growth Path:** Engineers gain exposure across the stack, from distributed systems to AI\-enabled workflows, accelerating career growth. * **Engineering Culture:** Continuous delivery, strong observability, and end\-to\-end ownership. * **Inclusive Environment:** Diverse backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger. * **Community Impact:** Volunteer opportunities and company\-sponsored charitable programs. * **Compensation \& Benefits:** Competitive salary, health and retirement programs, wellness resources, discretionary time off (DTO), parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers, two annual company breaks, home office stipend, and an equity program. **Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.** This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long\-term incentives. The expected salary range for this role is between following values: $143,000 and $215,000 The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position. **Required Skills:** Algorithms, Big Data, Cloud Computing, Computer Vision, Data Science, Deep Learning, Natural Language, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Project Management, Software Engineering

jobs.title: Flight Software Engineer II
jobs.description: At Relativity Space, we're building rockets to serve today's needs and tomorrow's breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that's just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known. Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven't been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you're in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you'll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we're writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it's early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us. **About the Team:** The Vehicle Software team develops the safety\-critical software that runs on Terran R. The work spans a distributed, real\-time control system operating under extreme conditions like Mach 5 atmospheric flight, with a deployment pace that allows you to see your code run on rocket engines daily. The team is building new system architecture from the ground up and just as importantly, testing, releasing, and deploying it. You don't need an aerospace background: what matters is experience with high\-reliability software for complex systems. This is a rare opportunity to shape the foundation of Terran R's software stack while directly influencing performance, reliability, and flight success. **About the Role:** Aerospace experience isn't required. We value driven engineers with strong computer science fundamental who collaborate well to solve meaningful problems. As a Flight Software Engineer II, you will be a technical leader within the team with a high level of autonomy tackling core flight software products that directly impact the Terran R program and be responsible for setting standards and best practices for the team along with mentoring junior engineers. Architect and deliver core flight software with a strong focus on meeting system and performance requirements such as latency, allowed jitter, and control frequency. Work closely with GNC engineers to integrate complex algorithms for vehicle ascent and re\-entry, descent and landing. Work closely with Embedded Software Engineers and Avionics to integrate vehicle sensor data such as GPS, IMU, Radar, and to control vehicle equipment such as valves, thrust vector controls, and landing grid fins. Develop telemetry system that prioritizes, filters, stores and forwards, and encodes/decodes telemetry to RF format, and routes that data through ground stations and to data centers. Support the development and integration of testing infrastructure such as HITL (Hardware\-In\-The\-Loop) and HOOTL (Hardware\-Out\-Of\-The\-Loop) and physics and fluid sims. Focus on maximizing the team's velocity by defining processes, best practices, integrating modern tools and technologies, and mentoring junior engineers. **About You:** * An undergraduate or graduate degree in a relevant engineering discipline (Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering) * 2\+ years experience of production development experience * Experience delivering production\-level and high reliability software * Expert in Rust, C\+\+, and/or other system languages, as well as algorithms and data structures * Expert in Linux Operating System concepts such as memory management, CPU shielding, scheduling, etc * Expert in networking concepts such as TCP/IP, UDP * Experience with software development processes including: source control, bug tracking, and CI/CD **Nice to haves but not required:** * Experience with systems\-level programming like synchronization primitives, memory management, etc. * Experience with different inter\-process communication methods * Experience with message passing protocol such as flatbuffer or protobuf **We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. jobs.title: Cyber Security Engineer II
jobs.description: A career at Resilience is more than just a job – it’s an opportunity to change the future. Resilience is a technology\-focused biomanufacturing company that’s changing the way medicine is made. We’re building a sustainable network of high\-tech, end\-to\-end manufacturing solutions to better withstand disruptive events, serve scientific discovery, and reach those in need. The role hunts for threats, root\-causes what the SOC escalates, and engineers and hardens security controls across endpoint, identity, network, on\-premises infrastructure and cloud. The role pairs threat hunting and detection engineering with proactive control hardening and vulnerability management, working primarily in KQL and XQL across Defender XDR and Cortex XDR. It reports to the Cyber Security Lead, oversees the technical work of the managed SOC partner, and influences infrastructure, network, cloud and site IT teams on security decisions in a regulated pharmaceutical manufacturing environment. **Job Responsibilities** ======================== **Threat Detection \& Response** * Conduct triage and root\-cause analysis on escalations from the SOC, including endpoint, identity, email and cloud alerts, correlating identity, endpoint, network and directory data to attribute activity to a person, a device and a network path. * Shape the threat hunting program: recommend hunt priorities based on threat intelligence and business risk, and lead proactive threat hunting across endpoint, identity, network and cloud telemetry using KQL and XQL, and convert confirmed hunts into durable detections. * Build custom detections and tune existing analytics so that what reaches people is worth their time; own detection quality, setting detection and escalation standards for the managed SOC partner and reviewing its performance against them. * Design and operate AI\-assisted investigation workflows that enrich, correlate and draft verdicts, with human approval gates on any containment action; measure their precision against analyst outcomes and set the standard for when AI\-generated analysis, including the managed SOC partner’s, is accepted. * Investigate suspected compromise using working forensic knowledge of attacker techniques such as credential theft, Kerberoasting and pass\-the\-hash: how each appears in telemetry, how to hunt for it and how to harden against it. * Lead the technical response to confirmed security incidents, coordinating infrastructure, cloud, site IT and vendor teams, and brief security leadership on impact, root cause and recommended actions. **Security Engineering \& Hardening** * Implement and verify hardening for on\-premises infrastructure, including Active Directory domain controllers and core network services such as DNS and DHCP, and confirm the applied state rather than the intended configuration. * Configure and review security controls for AWS and Azure workloads with the cloud and infrastructure teams, including identity, logging and exposure of internet\-facing services. * Administer and extend the security tooling already in place, including Zscaler, Keeper PAM and Okta, to get more protection from what is deployed before proposing new tools. * Understand complexity with securing organizations AI and automation platforms; help define authorization boundaries for agents and data connectors, enforce least\-privilege service identities, ensure agent actions are logged and attributable, and review new AI integrations for prompt\-injection, credential\-exposure and privilege escalation risk. * Plan security engineering projects, determining the resources and timelines needed to meet goals in coordination with infrastructure, cloud and site IT teams, and recommend new controls or tools to security leadership. * Coach and mentor security engineers and analysts, and contribute to technical standards for investigations, detections and hardening work. **Vulnerability \& Patch Management** * Own the vulnerability management program end to end through tools such as Rapid7, Plerion, and Defender for Endpoints: maintain scan and agent coverage against the asset inventory, keep authenticated scanning healthy, and treat an unscanned asset as a finding in its own right. * Prioritize findings by real exposure rather than raw severity score: exploitability, internet reachability, asset criticality and compensating controls, so that remediation effort lands where it reduces risk. * Drive remediation to closure with infrastructure, cloud and application owners: assign ownership, track against agreed timelines, verify closure by rescan rather than by ticket status, and escalate blocked items. * Bring external find m and harden against them. * Experience securing infrastructure, including network segmentation, firewall rule review and the configuration of networking components. * Solid working knowledge of AWS and Azure security. * Hands\-on experience applying large\-language\-model or agentic tooling to security operations, such as investigation enrichment, detection authoring or remediation automation, with demonstrated judgment that AI output is a hypothesis to be verified against live data, not a conclusion. * Experience running a vulnerability management program: scan coverage, risk\-based prioritization, influence technical and business stakeholders, including vendors and managed service partners, across multiple areas of the business, and to explain complex security risk to non\-technical leaders. * jobs.title: Sr. Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Our data is at the core of our mission, and the Data Platform team is the central nervous system for petabytes of data from our connected vehicles, manufacturing lines, and supply chain. As a Senior Data Platform Engineer, you will own and scale the infrastructure that data engineers, analysts, data scientists, and AI builders rely on every day. You will manage our Databricks environments as code, enforce enterprise governance, and write the software that automates our platform, working across Sales, Commercial, People and HR, Facilities, Finance, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing. We think of the platform as a product: our customers are the engineers and analysts who build on it. You will treat the platform as software, building the observability, self\-service access, cloud automation, and abstractions that help get the R2 into the hands of consumers across the US and make our data ready for AI. You will also play a critical role in controlling cost and keeping our architecture flexible enough to use alternative compute engines when it makes sense. This role will be located in Atlanta, GA and report to our Sr. Director* Build strong partnerships with data engineers, software engineers, security, cloud infrastructure, and business partners who depend on the platform. Deliver projects end to end within the roadmap and architecture set by Staff engineers. * Manage our Databricks environments as code at petabyte scale across multiple AWS accounts, with Terraform modules for workspaces, Unity Catalog metastores, cluster policies, and AWS networking/identity (VPC, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, IAM roles, KMS). * Build observability for the platform and the data on it: monitoring, alerting, lineage, data quality, and dashboards for reliability, performance, and cost. * Build self\-service capabilities that let engineers and analysts request access, create environments, and deploy pipelines safely, with automation for workspace lifecycle, onboarding, and access audits. * Automate cloud and Databricks configuration with infrastructure as code, Databricks Asset Bundles, and CI/CD (such as GitHub Actions or GitLab CI) following GitOps workflows and multi\-tier deployments (dev, staging, prod) with zero\-downtime updates. * Build abstractions, Go/Python libraries, CLI tools, and templates that make secure, tested, cost\-aware patterns the easy path. Treat the platform strictly as a software product. * Own the reliability and security of your components: meet SLOs, respond to incidents, find the root cause, and improve systems so issues do not repeat. * Own platform cost: alert on Databricks System Tables to track DBU consumption, enforce cluster policies, right\-size compute, tune Spark and Delta workloads, and work with data teams to root out inefficient workloads. Provide the cost data that feeds chargeback models. * Implement governance and security with Unity Catalog: row and column level security, ABAC, automated lineage, identity provider sync, and secret rotation. * Keep our data open: use open formats (Delta Lake, with UniForm and Apache Iceberg interoperability) to preserve long\-term flexibility, and recommend where open architecture is more sustainable. * Use AI models and agents to increase your productivity and help the business use data * 8\+ years in software engineering, data infrastructure, platform engineering or SRE * Databricks in depth: 3\+ years managing production environments through Terraform and the APIs and SDKs, not the UI, with deep knowledge of Unity Catalog, System Tables, compute policies, and Asset Bundles. * Apache Spark internals and tuning, and the tradeoffs between batch, microbatch, and streaming at multi\-petabyte scale. * Strong AWS experience: IAM, S3, KMS, VPC peering, subnets, security groups, and cost management. * Terraform (preferred), Databricks Asset Bundles, CI/CD, GitOps, containers (Docker, Kubernetes), and zero\-downtime infrastructure updates across multi\-tier environments (dev, staging, prod), tested and reviewed like any other code. * Observability and governance: metrics, logs, alerting, SLOs, RBAC and ABAC, lineage, auditing, encryption, and secret management. * Open table formats and distributed data systems such as Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Kafka, and columnar stores. * Experience building internal developer tools, APIs, or CLIs, and applying agile methods to create transparency and prioritization. * A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field, or equivalent experience. A higher degree is a plus. * Experience with data transform

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone. **Why User Behavior?** ====================== As a Senior Software Engineer on the User Behavior ML Platform, you will build the data and serving foundation behind Roblox's user\-level safety understanding, so that every safety system can see who a user is, not just what a single piece of content looks like. You will own the core ML platform for a new capability at Roblox: a safety user feature store, user embeddings, and risk scores that power personalized consequences, proactive detection, and early education. You will feel a deep sense of responsibility building systems that directly affect millions of users, especially minors, on one of the world's largest platforms. Your work will reduce harm, improve fairness, and help ensure Roblox remains a place where creativity and community can thrive safely. **You will:** ------------- * Build the Safety User Feature Store: Design and operate the pipelines that turn violations, reports, appeals, filter activity, and engagement signals into reliable, well\-documented user features for training and serving. * Serve User Embeddings and Risk Scores: Take user embeddings and risk models from offline training to production, including low\-latency online lookup and similar\-user search for detection teams. * Build jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description: Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us! Job Description As a Senior Embedded Software Engineer in Rockwell Automation, you will be part of a new product development team with a focus on design, development, and test of embedded software and features for programmable logic controllers (PLCs). You will also contribute to the overall product requirements, process, and tools. You will have a strong background in software development and exhibit the ability to flex between product software design, development, and test activities. Given tightly coupled hardware and software in our products, previous embedded software experience is preferred. You will report to Team Lead, Embedded Software and will work Hybrid in Mayfield Heights office, OH. ### **Primary Responsibilities:** * Design, and develop embedded software for Programmable Logic Controllers * Build and maintain automated tests in support of new and existing product features * Work in a variety of hardware and software environments, ranging from commercial off\-the\-shelf to custom System on Chip architectures, and from general purpose to embedded real\-time operating systems * Use modern continuous integration and development tools, and promote continuous improvement of tools and practices across the global development organization * Demonstrate a strong understanding of object\-oriented programming concepts, C\+\+ and Python are preferred * Operate across the entire software development life cycle: requirements management, design, implementation, test, release, and maintenance * Work on an Agile development team within a larger Scaled Agile Framework organization, participating in short term (sprint), medium term (program increment) and long term (product roadmap) planning * Mentor less experienced personnel, and encourage knowledge sharing and learning among the development community ### **The Essentials \- You Will Have:** * Bachelor's Degree or Equivalent Years of Relevant Work Experience * Legal authorization to work in the US is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. ### **The Preferred \- You Might Also Have:** * Typically requires minimum of 5 years of related experience. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or equivalent knowledge in the application of software engineering principles, theories, concepts, and techniques * 5\+ years of software engineering experience with demonstrated professional development in software design and implementation * Understand and apply knowledge of object\-oriented analysis, design, and programming techniques * Experience developing software and automated tests and tools in object\-oriented languages such as C\+\+ or Python * Experience with automation frameworks and tools development * Experience in requirements decomposition and test traceability * Experience in using open source tools like Git and Jenkins * Knowledge of unit testing using tools like GTest, CppUnit, etc. * Experience with continuous integration environments, automated test, and acceptance testing * Experience working in an Agile development setting and Agile project tools * Experience working with industrial protocols, especially Common Industrial Protocol (CIP) * Experience developing software and test to safety and security standards such as IEC 61508 or IEC 62443 * Advanced courses or degree in engineering, computer science, or controls ### **What We Offer:** * Health Insurance including Medical, Dental and Vision * 401k * Paid Time off * Parental and Caregiver Leave * Flexible Work Schedule where you will work with your manager to enjoy a work schedule that can be flexible with your personal life. * To learn more about our benefits package, please visit at perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Discovery
jobs.description: **Who we are:** At Rover, pets and their people are at the heart of everything we do. We connect pet parents with trusted pet care across the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Australia. Headquartered in Seattle and Barcelona, we’re a values driven, fast\-growing tech company focused on building safe and personalized experiences tailored to the needs of each unique pet. We’re investing in AI as a business accelerator and provide every team member access to AI tools in service of creating better experiences for our community. We are proud to be recognized as a great place to work, having been named among the 100 Best Companies to Work For in Seattle Business Magazine and Washington’s Best Workplaces in the Puget Sound Business Journal. At Rover we’re committed to creating an accessible, inclusive, and welcoming community, which starts with our employees. Want to make an impact? Join our pack and come work (and play!) with us. **Meet the Discovery team** Discovery owns how pet parents find Rover in the first place: SEO, answer\-engine visibility, and the landing page engine behind our city, service and brand pages. When someone searches for pet care in their neighborhood, our work decides whether Rover shows up and whether the page they land on helps them book. We're a cross\-functional team of full\-stack and WordPress engineers in Seattle and Barcelona, working with product, design, marketing and data science. Right now we're expanding our landing pages into new brands and locales, so the problems run across services, content and international markets. If you want to own a major acquisition channel and measure your impact in real traffic and bookings, we'd love to hear from you. ### **We're looking for someone who** * Takes large, ambiguous problems and turns them into a technical plan the team can execute, writing the design docs and making the tradeoffs explicit. * Leads projects end to end, from scoping through shipping and measuring the result in production, and brings other engineers along by delegating work and reviewing it. * Works across team boundaries, partnering with other teams on shared services such as search, geo routing and content systems. * Uses AI tools to move fast on well\-defined work, so time is spent on the harder judgment calls. * Sets a high bar for code quality through clear, well\-tested code and thoughtful reviews. * Owns their team's production health: monitoring, alerting, and responding when something breaks. * Mentors less experienced engineers and helps them grow. * Shows Rover's core values, acts with integrity, and helps build a diverse, equitable and inclusive team. ### **Your qualifications** * 5\+ years of professional software development experience. * Solid full\-stack experience: you've shipped production features end to end, across backend services (ideally Python and Django) and a modern frontend (ideally React and TypeScript). Other stacks are welcome if you've done real work on both sides. * Experience building and scaling customer\-facing web applications, including frontend performance and server\-side rendering. * A track record of leading technical projects that involved more than one engineer. * Solid relational database and schema design skills. * An observability mindset: you instrument services with logging, metrics, tracing and alerts, and you care how a system behaves after deploy. * Strong testing habits: automated unit and integration tests are part of how you ship. * AI\-native development: coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor or similar) are part of how you work every day. You hand them well\-scoped tasks, review what they produce as carefully as a teammate's PR, and know when to write the code yourself. A note on qualifications: great candidates don't always match every requirement. If you're excited about this role but don't meet every item, we still encourage you to apply.### **Nice to have** * SEO experience: technical SEO, structured data, site performance, or search\-engine and answer\-engine visibility. * Experience with internationalization and multi\-locale sites. * Experience with edge caching on platforms like Cloudflare Workers, including cache key design, warming, invalidation, and safely caching pages that vary by language, experiment, or user state. * Experience with content platforms or headless CMS setups, such as WordPress. * Distributed systems patterns: async task queues (Celery, RabbitMQ), caching (Memcached, Redis), event\-driven architectures. * Pushing AI\-assisted development further: custom workflows, automating repetitive work, going beyond code completion. ### **Compensation:** * In the greater Seattle area the first\-year salary range is $140,761\-$169,903\. Additionally, Rover offers benefits to full\-time employees. * The cash compensation offered for this role will be dependent on the candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, and abilities as demonstrated in the interview and hiring process. At Rover, we’re driven by seeing our people succeed and grow, while doing our jobs better than ever before. We believe the best business outcomes come from a diverse set of perspectives and we’re committed to promoting an inclusive, inventive, and fun environment with amazing employees. We welcome and encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply. Rover is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, military or veteran status, sex, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital or partnership status, genetic predisposition, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. We are committed to work with you to look for reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. \_
