jobs.title: Contract Full-Stack Developer – Short-Term Project
jobs.description: Contract Full\-Stack Developer – Code Cleanup \& Maintenance (Short\-Term Project) **Company:** Synergy Insurance Affiliates (SIA) **Job Type:** Contract / Temporary **Experience Level:** Mid\-to\-Senior **Project Duration:** Short\-term engagement (approximately a few weeks) **Job Overview** Synergy Insurance Affiliates is seeking an experienced Mid\-to\-Senior Full\-Stack Developer for a short\-term contract project focused on code cleanup, optimization of code quality, and improving the maintainability of an existing production platform. Our internal platform is a live system used daily by our agents to manage offices, customers, policies, and dialer/lead workflows. This engagement is strictly focused on improving the quality and maintainability of the existing codebase. This is not a platform rebuild, redesign, or new feature development project. All existing functionality and system behavior must remain unchanged. We are looking for a detail\-oriented developer who can work carefully within an established codebase, follow existing development processes, and communicate effectively with our current development team. Key Responsibilities * Review and evaluate the existing codebase to identify opportunities for cleanup and improved maintainability. * Remove unnecessary console.log statements, debug logs, and commented\-out experimental or debugging code. * Identify and remove unused code, imports, and other unnecessary elements. * Replace loosely defined any types with stricter, more appropriate TypeScript types wherever it is safe to do so. * Develop and implement tests that document and verify the platform's current behavior. * Ensure all cleanup work preserves existing functionality without introducing unintended changes. * Identify potential bugs, inconsistencies, or areas of concern and communicate findings to the existing developer before taking action. * Document any areas intentionally left unchanged, including the reasoning behind those decisions. **Technical Requirements** Candidates should have experience working with production applications and familiarity with the following technologies: **Frontend** * React 18 * Vite * Apollo Client * TanStack Query **Backend** * NestJS microservices * Apollo Federation GraphQL Gateway * REST APIs alongside GraphQL **Database** * MongoDB Atlas **Infrastructure – Familiarity Only** General awareness of the following AWS services and infrastructure is beneficial. No infrastructure modifications are required as part of this engagement. * AWS Region: us\-east\-2 * Amazon Cognito * Amazon ECS/ECR * AWS Lambda * Amazon SQS * AWS Amplify * Traefik Development Workflow \& Expectations To maintain the stability and integrity of our live production platform, all development work must follow our established review and approval process. * All work must be completed on dedicated feature branches. * Every pull request will be personally reviewed by our existing developer. * No changes may be merged into the main branch without explicit approval. * All proposed modifications must remain within the agreed\-upon scope of code cleanup and maintenance. * Any potential bugs or concerns must be communicated and reviewed before changes are made. Project Deliverables Upon completion of the engagement, the developer will be expected to provide: * A cleaned\-up codebase with unnecessary console.log statements and commented\-out debugging code removed. * Removal of unused code and imports. * Replacement of any types with stricter TypeScript types where appropriate and safe. * Tests verifying that existing platform functionality and behavior remain unchanged. * A brief written summary identifying any areas intentionally left untouched, along with the reasoning behind those decisions. Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is a mid\-to\-senior full\-stack developer who has experience maintaining and improving established production applications. We are particularly interested in someone who: * Has strong attention to detail and takes a careful, methodical approach to code maintenance. * Is comfortable navigating and working within an existing, complex codebase. * Understands the importance of preserving functionality in a live production environment. * Can distinguish between necessary code cleanup and changes that would affect product behavior. * Respects established development processes, code review requirements, and project boundaries. * Communicates clearly and proactively when encountering potential issues or decisions requiring additional input. * Can work independently while collaborating effectively with an existing developer. About the Opportunity This is a **short\-term contract opportunity** intended for an experienced developer who can efficiently improve code quality and maintainability without disrupting a live production system. The project has a clearly defined scope, an established technical environment, and an existing developer responsible for reviewing and approving all changes. Pay: From $40\.00 per hour Expected hours: 24\.0 – 40\.0 per week Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Systems Integration & Automation Engineer (IT & AI)
jobs.description: *Des Moines, IA (100% On\-Site) \| Pay: $75,000 – $90,000 / year \+ Benefits* **If your idea of a great tech job is sitting in an ivory tower writing code while a separate team handles the messy reality of physical infrastructure, keep scrolling. You’d hate it here.** We are a growing, $10M\+ multi\-entity blue\-collar business that runs on real\-world execution. In a business our size, you don't get to live in just one narrow lane. You are the technical utility player. That means you will reset a password, provision a new workstation, and fix a dropped router \- *and* you will use that same day to build automated data pipelines, connect APIs, and deploy internal AI tools. You manage the guts, and you build the future. **What You’ll Actually Be Doing** **1\. Managing the Guts: IT Infrastructure \& Support (40%)** * Yes, you own the fundamentals. When an employee forgets their password, a branch router drops offline, or a new hire needs a workstation imaged, you are the one who fixes it. * You administer and secure our cloud environments (Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace) across multiple legal entities, manage user permissions, and configure DNS/email deliverability (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) so our comms don't break. * You keep the digital house running smoothly so our field crews and back\-office teams can work without friction. **2\. Building the Future: Automations \& Integrations (40%)** * You live in tools like n8n, Make, Zapier, and custom webhooks. When data needs to move between our ERP, CRM, and accounting software, you build the pipeline so nobody has to type it twice. * You look at manual, repetitive administrative tasks across our regional branches and think, *"I can automate that by Friday."* Then you build it, test it, and deploy it. **3\. Pushing the Frontier: Practical AI Tools (20%)** * You experiment with LLMs, prompt engineering, and document parsers to build smart internal tools—like automated estimate parsers, scheduling assistants, and internal knowledge bases tied directly to company data. **Who You Actually Are** * **A True Utility Player:** You don't think basic IT tasks are "below you." You understand that keeping the network stable and building advanced automations are two sides of the same coin. * **A Pragmatic Builder:** You have a trail of messy, brilliant side projects, automations, or small\-business tech setups where you forced disparate software tools to work together. * **Zero Corporate Ego:** You measure your success by how much friction you remove from our team's day—whether that means fixing a printer, unblocking an email queue, or deploying a custom integration. * **Plainspoken:** You can explain technical setups to field crews and operations managers without hiding behind IT jargon or corporate red tape. **Why Join Us?** * **Total Ownership:** You aren't a cog in a massive help\-desk queue. You own the entire technical stack from end to end. * **Zero Bureaucracy:** No IT committees, no change boards, no red tape. If you fix a broken process or build a better workflow on Tuesday, it goes live on Wednesday. * **Real\-World Impact:** Your work directly protects our operations and gives our team their sanity back. Sound like the kind of utility role where you can actually stretch your legs? Drop your portfolio, your projects, or your resume and show us what you've built. We move fast on people who get it.

jobs.title: Staff R&D Product Engineer - Software Engineer
jobs.description: At TE Connectivity, we help build the technologies that keep the world connected. As a global leader in connectivity and sensor solutions, we partner with customers across industries to develop innovative products that power transportation, industrial, medical, energy, aerospace, and data infrastructure applications. The Digital Data Networks department is seeking an experienced Staff R\&D Product Engineer to lead the development of embedded software, firmware, applications, and data platforms for next\-generation intelligent power products. This role is responsible for designing and delivering software solutions that bring advanced monitoring, diagnostics, analytics, and device management capabilities to active power products used in AI, hyperscale data center, industrial, and other high\-power applications. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in embedded software and firmware development with strong knowledge of sensing technologies, power systems, data analytics, and connected device architectures. This individual will collaborate across multidisciplinary teams to transform product telemetry into actionable intelligence while enabling differentiated intelligent power solutions for customers worldwide. **Role and Responsibilities** ----------------------------- **Embedded Software \& Active Device Development** * Design, develop, test, and maintain embedded software and firmware for microcontrollers, sensor ICs, and intelligent power devices. * Develop device drivers, bootloaders, hardware abstraction layers (HALs), and real\-time applications using bare\-metal and RTOS architectures. * Create tools and processes for device configuration, calibration, diagnostics, firmware updates, and secure lifecycle management. * Lead software architecture, communication interface implementation, code reviews, and technical mentoring to deliver reliable and scalable solutions. **Sensing, Monitoring \& Diagnostics** * Develop real\-time monitoring algorithms for electrical, thermal, and electromagnetic measurements in power products. * Implement signal processing, calibration, fault detection, event logging, alarm handling, and diagnostic capabilities. * Partner with cross\-functional engineering teams to define sensing architectures and measurement requirements. * Develop predictive monitoring solutions that improve reliability while balancing cost, manufacturability, and system constraints. **Data Management \& Analytics** * Design and develop data acquisition systems, databases, APIs, dashboards, and analytics platforms for product telemetry. * Establish data models, traceability frameworks, retention strategies, and data quality standards across development and production environments. * Create analytics solutions for performance trending, failure analysis, predictive maintenance, and continuous product improvement. * Integrate monitoring platforms with edge, cloud, manufacturing, and enterprise systems while ensuring cybersecurity and data integrity. **Test, Validation \& Product Development** * Develop automated test and data acquisition software supporting product validation, characterization, and manufacturing testing. * Integrate software with laboratory and manufacturing equipment, including power analyzers, oscilloscopes, electronic loads, and thermal chambers. * Execute software verification and validation activities including unit, integration, regression, hardware\-in\-the\-loop, and system testing. * Support product development from concept through production launch by troubleshooting jobs.description: **TOWN OF SOUTHINGTON** **Job Description:** **ASSISTANT TOWN ENGINEER** ================================================ Department(s): Engineering Reports To: Town Engineer Employment Status: Full\-Time; 35 hours, 8:30am – 4:30pm Salary: $108,083 \- $118,427 Union: UPSEU Local 424\-Unit 11 Summary: Step into a high\-impact, senior\-level role driving complex civil engineering projects and managing a full\-service municipal engineering office. In this dynamic position, you will rely on your expert judgment to solve infrastructure challenges while leading and mentoring a multidisciplinary team of engineers, surveyors, inspectors, and administrative staff. Essential Job Functions:* Supervises, coordinates and participates in the administration, survey, design and construction of a variety of public works projects within the Town’s Right of Way and on Town property. * Supervises the preparation of specifications, estimates and proposals. * Consults with private engineers, developers, attorneys, and others relative to public infrastructure and private development projects. * Gives advice on engineering problems and acts as a technical resource, providing solution recommendations and alternatives. * Reviews design proposals, estimates and bids for accuracy and compliance with Town and State standards. * Schedules work, makes changes in assignments and staffing as deemed necessary to meet deadlines or accomplish objectives. * Reviews applications, excavation, and sewer permits. * Reviews and responds to resident complaints * Keeps records and prepares reports. * Acts as Town Engineer in his or her absence. * Prepares and applies for federal and state grants. * Performs related work as required. * Presents engineering proposals to interested groups and organizations. * Manages public communication activities regarding Engineering Division projects, including but not limited to, the development of webpage content, public notifications and public information sessions. * Develops meeting agendas and minutes as required * Investigates and assigns work related to public complaints * Ability to attend meetings outside of standard operating hours * Attends Planning \& Zoning meetings. Also attends Wetlands, Public Works, Apple Harvest Festival, and Sewer Committee as needed. * Performs inspections as required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:* Thorough knowledge of the principles and practices of civil engineering as applied to the construction, planning and design of a variety of public works projects. * Considerable knowledge of applicable codes, ordinances * Considerable knowledge of regulations and standards governing public works engineering. * Knowledge of effective principles and techniques of supervision and office management. * Ability to apply approved engineering methods and standards to the design and construction of a variety of public works projects. * Ability to perform technical research work and to recommend solutions on difficult engineering problems. * Ability to supervise professional and non\-professional staff. * Ability to plan and organize engineering activities. * Ability to present ideas clearly, orally and in writing. * Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with others. * Ability to draft and design using Carlson Civil3D with AutoCAD * Knowledge of GIS (ESRI and ArcGIS Online) * Proficiency in MS Office, and Google Suite Work Environment: Work is performed primarily in a standard business office setting; however, field site visits and inspections are required. Following initial training, one day of hybrid work per week may be permitted. Work performance and deliverables are subject to administrative review by the Town Engineer through regular conferences and examination of reports and studies. The office environment presents standard risks requiring customary safety precautions, such as maintaining safe work practices with equipment, preventing trips and falls, and adhering to fire regulations. Outdoor field work involves site inspections with exposure to varying temperatures, seasonal weather conditions, and active construction sites. Duties require significant walking and/or standing, some of which may be on uneven ground. Routinely conducts site inspections outdoors requiring mobility to inspect sites which may include walking through fields, woods, river areas, and construction sites. May require the use of protective clothing or gear. May work in confined or restricted areas. May occasionally involve incidental exposure or physical harm. Must be able to reach/bend/push/pull/lift objects weighing up to 15 pounds. Must be mobile and able to perform moderately difficult manipulative skills such as writing, using a keyboard and/or calculator with accuracy. Able to sit and stand for prolonged periods of time. Able to perform tasks with eye\-hand coordination. Must be able to see objects closely as in reading and preparing documents or reports. Able to read plans, review drafts, maps or diagrams and read from a computer monitor. Ability to see objects far away as in driving. Ability to differentiate colors as in architectural plans. Able to hear normal sounds with some background noise and to communicate orally in the English language with other Town employees, architects, developers and the public face to face, one to one settings or using a telephone. May have interactions with agitated individuals. Must be able to concentrate on fine details with some interruption. Needs to attend to task/function for more than 60 minutes at a time. Able to understand and relate to specific ideas, generally several at a time and to understand and relate to the theories behind several related concepts. Able to remember multiple tasks/assignments given to self and others over a long period of time. May be exposed to dust and electro\-magnetic radiation as in computer screens. Minimum Qualifications: Graduation from college with a bachelor’s degree in civil engineering or related engineering science, and five (5\) years of progressively responsible experience in the practice of civil engineering; or an equivalent combination of education and training. An employee in this classification must possess a valid drivers’ license in good standing with the State of Connecticut. Registered as an Engineer\-In\-Training or a Professional Civil Engineer in the State of Connecticut. The Town reserves the right to limit the number of applicants invited to any phase of the selection process. BENEFITS Include CT Municipal Employees Retirement System (CTMERS) Pension Plan, generous time off (personal days, vacation, accrued sick leave, including 12 full days \& 2 half day holidays) \& insurance package (medical, dental, vision care, prescription and life). * Competitive salary * Health, dental, and vision insurance * Pension plan * Paid time off * Professional development opportunities \*(Note: Benefits may vary based on union contract and employment status.)\* TERMS OF EMPLOYMENT \& EVALUATIONS * Terms of Employment: In accordance with the collective bargaining agreement between the Town of Southington and the United Public Service Employees Union (UPSEU), Local 424\-Unit 11\. * Evaluations: Performance to be evaluated annually by the Town Engineer Open until filled The Town of Southington is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE). The information contained in this job description is for compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (A.D.A.) and is not an exhaustive list of duties performed.

jobs.title: Quality Engineer, Change Management
jobs.description: The Quality Engineer, Change Management will be the quality owner of Twist Bioscience's change control process, ensuring that changes to products, processes, raw materials, equipment, software, labeling, and documentation are assessed, implemented, and verified in a controlled, risk\-based manner throughout the product life cycle. As the primary QA reviewer and approver for change controls across multiple product platforms, you will partner with Operations, R\&D, Engineering, Supply Chain, Software, and Regulatory Affairs to evaluate impact, define implementation and validation requirements, and ensure compliance with 21 CFR 820 (QMSR), ISO 13485, EU IVDR, and other applicable international and local regulatory requirements. **What You'll Be Doing** *Own change control end to end* * Serve as QA owner and approver for product, process, raw material, equipment, facility, software, labeling, and document changes in the electronic QMS, from initiation through effectiveness verification and closure. * Classify changes by significance using established tiering criteria, matching the level of review, approval, and documentation to the risk. * Define implementation plans covering verification and validation, training, document updates, inventory and work\-in\-process disposition, and effective dates. * Verify objective evidence before implementation and closure, and confirm effectiveness checks are defined and executed where required. *Assess impact and risk* * Lead cross\-functional impact assessments covering product performance, specifications, validation status, risk management files, labeling, regulatory filings, suppliers, and customers. * Lead or contribute to risk assessments (e.g., pFMEA, 5x5 risk assessments) that support change rationale and risk\-based decisions. * Determine validation and revalidation requirements for process, equipment, test method, and software changes, including computerized systems and software releases. * Review verification and validation protocols and reports tied to changes, and identify gaps against internal quality requirements. * Ensure design changes follow design control requirements, and that design history files, risk management files, and device master records / medical device files are updated. *Drive cross\-functional decisions* * Facilitate change review board meetings: build agendas, present changes, document decisions, and track actions to completion. * Coach change initiators and owners to write complete, well\-justified change records. * Identify changes subject to customer notification requirements and quality agreements; prepare notifications and track customer acknowledgment. * Partner with Document Control on controlled document revisions. * Support CAPA, nonconformance, and complaint investigations where actions are implemented through change control. * Provide quality support as new product introductions and transfers move into change control. *Measure and stay audit\-ready* * Track and report change control metrics (cycle time, aging, on\-time closure, backlog, post\-implementation issues) for Quality Data Reviews and Management Review. * Keep change records audit\-ready and act as the change management subject matter expert during internal, customer, notified body, and regulatory audits. **What You'll Bring to the Team** *Required* * Bachelor's degree in a scientific or engineering discipline and 3\+ years in quality engineering, quality assurance, or change control in a regulated medical device, IVD, or biotech manufacturing environment, or equivalent experience. * Hands\-on experience owning, reviewing, or approving change controls, including impact assessment, validation determination, and implementation verification. * Working knowledge of ISO 13485, 21 CFR 820 (QMSR), EU IVDR, ISO 14971, and cGMP, including design change and significant change concepts. * Experience with electronic quality management systems. * Understanding of process, equipment, test method, and software validation (e.g., IQ/OQ/PQ, computer system validation). * Experience with supplier change management and customer change notification. * Strong facilitation and influencing skills, with the ability to drive cross\-functional decisions without direct authority. * Organized and detail\-oriented, able to manage a high volume of concurrent changes and prioritize well. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain change rationale and risk to technical and non\-technical audiences. * Ability to work across functions and levels in a global organization. * Ability to travel up to 10%. *Preferred* * MasterControl experience. * ASQ certification (e.g., CQE, CQA). * Experience in NGS, synthetic biology, molecular diagnostics, or pharmaceutical manufacturing. **About Twist Bioscience** Twist Bioscience synthesizes genes from scratch, known as "writing" DNA. Just as children learn to both read and write, the next phase of development for the genomics revolution is the ability to write DNA. At Twist Bioscience, we work in service of people who are changing the world for the better. In fields such as health care, agriculture, industrial chemicals and data storage, our unique silicon\-based DNA Synthesis Platform provides precision at a scale that is otherwise unavailable to our customers. Twist Bioscience Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Twist Bioscience Corporation provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic characteristics, or any other category protected by law.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Backend, Factory Software
jobs.description: **What to Expect** Tesla uniquely builds foundational Super Intelligence that moves beyond pixels and through the physical world. Making that happen at scale means running factories at a speed and consistency traditional manufacturing has never been able to pull off. Factory Software is the digital nervous system holding this operation together \- their code manages inventory across automated warehouses, orchestrates every step of assembly across thousands of real\-time station controllers, and tracks every bolt \& build along the way. Beyond keeping lines moving, they build the foundation that keeps them healthy; the team leverages data pipelines, computer vision, maintenance systems, and SI agents to catch defects early, troubleshoot issues, and stand up new lines faster. Because a single outage can stop production cold, you'll be designing fault\-tolerant, low\-latency backend systems that scale as our factories evolve. Without Factory Software, Cybercabs and Optimus wouldn't make it out the door with the precision and reliability our world demands.The role is open to any Gigafactory site (Fremont, Austin, Reno, Buffalo). **What You'll Do*** Own end\-to\-end backend development of production\-critical services, taking features from stakeholder requirements and system architecture through testing, deployment, and production support * Architect event\-driven systems and high\-throughput ingestion pipelines using Kafka, Redis, WebSockets, and IoT streams to process live telemetry and computer vision data from factory equipment, automated warehouses, and thousands of station controllers * Design, scale \& optimize data platforms and storage architecture across ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Elasticsearch, and MongoDB, owning schema design, partitioning, replication, and query performance to maintain an immutable source of truth for every build * Build \& maintain low\-latency APIs and data access layers (REST, gRPC, GraphQL, SDKs, and materialized views) that integrate seamlessly with manufacturing hardware, maintenance workflows, ERP systems, and downstream analytical or SI workloads * Develop, evaluate \& ship production SI agents and LLM\-based automation workflows by building tool definitions, retrieval harnesses, guardrails, and automated eval graders to eliminate manual processes and help engineers troubleshoot issues on the floor * Deploy \& operate fault\-tolerant services on Kubernetes with full CI/CD ownership, capacity planning, and deep observability (logging, metrics, tracing, query latency, and ingestion lag), including participating in an on\-call rotation no more than once every two months * Partner directly with cross\-functional teams across Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Controls, Supply Chain, Material Flow, and Quality to scope real\-world bottlenecks and rapidly iterate on solutions as our Gigafactories evolve * Uphold high engineering standards and drive platform adoption through mentorship, code reviews, design docs, internal tooling, and evaluating upstream ecosystem advancements to keep our systems simple, reliable, and ahead of production scale **What You'll Bring*** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience * Proficiency in at least one modern backend or systems language such as Go, Rust, C\+\+, or Python, with the ability to pick up new languages quickly * Strong understanding of distributed systems fundamentals, API design, networking, security, fault tolerance, and backpressure under live traffic * Solid database experience across relational, columnar, and NoSQL stores (such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, and MongoDB), including schema design, indexing, query optimization, and cluster troubleshooting * Experience building event\-driven architectures and low\-latency streaming pipelines using technologies like Kafka, Kinesis, or Redis Streams is a plus * Proficiency in cloud\-native deployment and rigorous engineering practices, including Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, observability (metrics, logging, tracing), code reviews, and technical design documentation is a plus * Experience building computer vision or agentic SI workflows, including RAG pipelines, tool\-use harnesses, prompt engineering, and automated evaluation using frameworks like LangGraph or Google ADK is a plus * High\-autonomy communicator with the curiosity to uncover authoritative data sources and lead technical initiatives end to end alongside cross\-functional engineering and operations teams #### **Benefits** Along with competitive pay, as a full\-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire: * Medical plans \> plan options with $0 payroll deduction * Family\-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits * Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution * Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High\-Deductible medical plan with HSA * Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) * 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits * Company paid Basic Life, AD\&D * Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period) * Employee Assistance Program * Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays * Back\-up childcare and parenting support resources * Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft \& legal services, and pet insurance jobs.title: AVP Data Engineering – Business Insurance Ontology & Knowledge Graph
jobs.description: **Job Details** --------------- Location: Boston, MA Category: Data Engineering Employment Type: Full time, Remote Job Ref: R2627817\-180 AVP Data Engineering \- GE05AE We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future. The **AVP Data Engineering – Business Insurance Ontology \& Knowledge Graph** is an executive\-facing leadership role accountable for defining, building, and driving enterprise adoption of the Business Insurance ontology, semantic layer, and knowledge graph. This leader establishes the governed business meaning, context, and relationships that power trusted analytics, AI, agentic experiences, and decision automation across Small Business, Middle \& Large Business, and Global Specialty. Operating at the intersection of commercial P\&C insurance, business semantics, data architecture, graph engineering, and AI enablement, the role translates complex insurance domain knowledge—submissions, quotes, accounts, policies, coverages, exposures, risks, claims, producers, and portfolio performance—into production\-ready semantic assets consumable by people, data products, LLMs, and agents. The AVP serves as the senior technical and domain authority for semantic and AI\-ready data in Business Insurance, leads and leverage team of ontologists, graph modelers, semantic and AI data engineers, and business data analysts, and partners directly with the heads of Small Business, Middle \& Large Business, and Global Specialty to align the ontology roadmap to growth, underwriting profitability, operational efficiency, and innovation outcomes. **Must be eligible to work in the US without company sponsorship.** Primary Job Responsibilities Executive Leadership \& Stakeholder Engagement * Serve as the primary data and semantic advisor to the heads of Small Business, Middle \& Large Business, and Global Specialty, translating ontology and knowledge graph capabilities into business outcomes, investment cases, and decisions. * Present strategy, roadmap, execution progress, value realized, risks, and decision asks to executive leadership, steering committees, and ELT forums in clear, plain business language. * Build executive sponsorship and drive adoption of a shared Business Insurance vocabulary across underwriting, distribution, product, claims, actuarial, finance, and operations. * Influence enterprise technology, data, platform, and AI strategy in partnership with Technology, Enterprise Architecture, Data \& AI COE, and Applied AI teams. * Negotiate priorities, resolve semantic and ownership conflicts across lines of business, and broker alignment on enterprise definitions. * Act as an external and internal thought leader on ontology, knowledge graphs, agentic analytics, and AI\-native data engineering in insurance. Ontology Strategy, Build \& Adoption * Own the vision, strategy, and multi\-year roadmap for the Business Insurance ontology, semantic layer, context graph, and knowledge graph. * Lead the design and execution of an enterprise\-scale semantic layer that standardizes business meaning and enables trusted analytics, AI, and agentic use cases. * Define and operationalize ontologies modeling core commercial insurance concepts and relationships: customers, business profiles, accounts, submissions, quotes, policies, coverages, products, exposures, risks and locations, claims, producers, and portfolio performance. * Establish canonical vocabularies, metric definitions, business rules, and taxonomies that standardize meaning across structured and unstructured data sources and across all three markets. * Define and enforce standards and reusable patterns for ontology modeling, graph modeling, semantic interoperability, versioning, and ontology reuse across delivery teams. * Drive adoption by embedding semantic models into data products, analytics, AI pipelines, APIs, and activation layers; measure and report adoption and business value. * Move capabilities from strategy to pilot to scaled enterprise production, prioritizing high\-value use cases such as submission triage, risk appetite, clearance, pricing and underwriting insights, portfolio management, and cross\-sell. AI \& Data Engineering * Enable semantic\-first AI and agentic analytics, ensuring LLMs and agents consume governed business context, metrics, rules, and relationships. * Lead implementation of AI data pipelines integrating structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data (e.g., submissions, loss runs, schedules, broker correspondence) to support AI and agentic solutions. * Operationalize ontologies through knowledge graphs, metadata services, data APIs, vector stores, RAG pipelines, and production data platforms in partnership with AI Data Architects and Engineers. * Design and oversee scalable real\-time and batch dat nderwriting approach, account complexity, and data needs. * Familiarity with core insurance concepts and measures: exposures and rating bases (payroll, sales, TIV, vehicles), class codes (NAICS/SIC), insured locations, account rounding, hit/quote/bind ratios, written and earned premium, loss ratio, combined ratio, retention, and rate change. * Familiarity with industry data standards and reference models such as ACORD, ISO, and NCCI. Skills \& Experience Leadership \& Communication * Exceptional executive presence with proven ability to communicate complex technical concepts simply and persuasively to C\-suite, line\-of\-business heads, and board\-level audiences. * Strong executive influence, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills; track record of building cross\-functional coalitions and driving enterprise\-wide adoption without direct authority. * Proven ability to frame investment cases, value metrics, and decisions for senior leadership. * Ability to lead in a lean, agile, fast\-paced environment using Scaled Agile principles. Semantic, Ontology \& Knowledge Graph * Deep expertise in semantic layer architecture, ontology modeling, graph modeling, and knowledge graph design at enterprise scale. * Hands\-on mastery of RDF, OWL 2, RDFS, SKOS, SHACL, SPARQL, and W3C semantic web standards; familiarity with labeled property graphs and query languages such as Cypher or GQL. * Experience designing and operating enterprise knowledge graphs on platforms such as Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, Stardog, or Spanner Graph. * Experience integrating knowledge graphs with LLMs, RAG and GraphRAG pipelines, vector stores, and agentic frameworks. * Strong understanding of context\-aware data engineering, canonical modeling, semantic interoperability, and AI consumption patterns, including embeddings, grounding, reasoning, and explainability. Data \& AI Engineering * Mastery of data engineering and architecture, including lakehouses, data integration, data domains, data products, data APIs, real\-time streaming, and conversational BI. * Experience implementing scalable AI\-driven data systems supporting agentic solutions (e.g., AWS Lambda, S3, EC2, LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, A2A). * Technical expertise in LLMs, prompt engineering, LLM optimization, RAG architectures, and vector databases (e.g., Vertex AI, Postgres, OpenSearch, Pinecone). * Hands\-on experience with multi\-cloud environments across AWS, GCP, and Snowflake. * Strong grounding in data governance, metadata management, lineage, data quality, privacy, and security. Education, Experience, Certifications and Licenses * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 12\+ years in data engineering, data architecture, and large\-scale data ecosystems, including 8\+ years of hands\-on semantic, ontology, or knowledge graph work. * 7\+ years in senior leadership roles managing complex data and AI portfolios, with direct engagement with executive and line\-of\-business leadership. * 5\+ years in commercial Property \& Casualty insurance; experience across Small Business, Middle Market, or Specialty strongly preferred. * Industry designations such as CPCU, AINS, or AU are a plus. **Compensation** The listed annualized base pay range is primarily based on analysis of similar positions in the external market. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Platform AI Tooling
jobs.description: San Jose Regular R\&D Job ID: A140436 to this job Responsibilities About the Team The Data Platform team at the TikTok USDS Joint Venture runs the large\-scale data processing systems that support TikTok in the United States. Our scope includes: \- Big data infrastructure and developer platforms, including data ingestion, ETL, data warehouses, compute engines, storage, batch processing, and streaming. \- Reliable, timely production of high\-quality data for multiple business domains. \- End\-to\-end SLA governance, production operations, incident response, and disaster recovery. \- Resource efficiency, workload isolation, platform security, and regulatory compliance. We operate hundreds of thousands of batch pipelines and thousands of streaming pipelines and work closely with business, infrastructure, security, and central platform teams to deliver reliable data products at scale. Our long\-term goal is a more autonomous data platform with better visibility, smarter decision\-making, and safe self\-healing. We are not building AI demos. We build production systems that solve real operational problems, stay within strict compliance boundaries, and improve reliability and engineering efficiency in measurable ways. We are looking for an (AI) software engineer to join the Data Platform team as an individual contributor (IC). In this role, you will build production\-grade AI systems, tools, and workflows that automate the operation of large\-scale data pipelines. You will work across software engineering, distributed data systems, site reliability engineering, and applied AI. Your systems will process millions of machine\-generated events, including alerts, failures, metrics, logs, pipeline state, dependencies, and infrastructure signals. They will help engineers detect risks, diagnose failures, run root\-cause analysis, and take the right action safely. Some workflows will run continuously and autonomously. Others will involve engineers through clear review, approval, and escalation steps. You will also help turn today’s individual usage of AI agents into a coherent engineering platform with reusable capabilities, shared entry points, rigorous evaluation, and a compliant production release process to push a broader team wide and company wide productivity for their big data needs. This is an applied engineering role. Success requires more than wiring an LLM to a set of APIs. You will need to understand operational problems deeply, design dependable distributed systems, put safe production controls in place, and measure whether AI improves outcomes. Responsibilities \- Build and operate always\-on AI systems that turn machine\-generated events — alerts, failures, metrics, logs, pipeline state, and SLA signals — into traceable diagnoses, decisions, and actions. \- Turn ad hoc agent prompts, local settings, conversational skills, and operational knowledge into reusable production tools with shared entry points, so engineers can troubleshoot and root\-cause issues across components faster. \- Make production AI trustworthy and dependable: least\-privilege access, isolation, approvals, audit trails, safe failure handling, rollback, and human oversight where judgment is required. \- Own quality and release end to end, including evaluation, incident replay and regression testing, canary rollout, monitoring, and continuous improvement of production capabilities. \- Deliver measurable outcomes — reduced manual toil, faster incident recovery, fewer repeat incidents, and stronger SLA attainment across the data platform. What Success Looks Like \- Reduce repetitive manual intervention in data platform operations. \- Detect operational risks before they become business\-visible incidents. \- Shorten incident triage, diagnosis, mitigation, and recovery time. \- Improve the consistency and depth of root\-cause analysis. \- Turn operational knowledge into reusable, continuously improving automation. \- Provide a common, trusted AI\-assisted operating experience to a broad set of engineers. \- Expand automation safely without weakening human accountability, production reliability, or compliance. \- Show measurable value through technical quality, sustained adoption, and better operational outcomes. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications \- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. \- Experience building and operating production software systems or distributed services. \- Strong programming proficiency in one or more languages such as Java, C\+\+, Go, Python, or Rust. \- Solid understanding of distributed systems, including concurrency, state management, fault tolerance, consistency, retries, idempotency, and observability. \- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience working across cross\-functional engineering teams. Preferred Qualifications \- Experience with production engineering or SRE practices, including monitoring, incident  al leave, short\-term and long\-term disability coverage, life insurance, wellbeing benefits, among others. jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description: Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions is seeking a hands\-on Lead Software Engineer to drive end\-to\-end solution delivery for major retail platforms, and to make AI\-augmented engineering the way our teams build. In this role, you will own hands\-on implementation (feature development, technical design, code reviews), engagement leadership (client\-facing technical lead, trade\-off decisions, mentoring), and operational ownership (delivery sign\-off, post\-release support) of high\-impact solutions, translating business requirements into working software you help build. You will also be the engineering authority on how AI is used across the delivery lifecycle: designing agentic workflows, setting guardrails, measuring impact, and bringing the team along. You will drive Dual\-Track Agile processes, using AI to compress the Discovery Track (rapid prototyping and feasibility validation) and to raise quality, traceability, and measurable outcomes in the Delivery Track. The ideal candidate is a senior software engineer who codes daily and treats AI agents as a core part of their toolchain. You have moved beyond personal use of AI assistants to building repeatable, governed, measurable AI workflows that other engineers adopt, from analysis and design to testing, documentation, and code generation, while bringing the technical leadership to drive client engagements forward. You will mentor teams, make critical technical trade\-offs, and take full accountability for delivery sign\-off and post\-release support. This role requires strong retail platform domain knowledge (POS systems, store operations), cloud\-native development experience, and deep fluency with generative and agentic AI tools to accelerate delivery while preserving code quality and architectural integrity. You will have the judgment to know when AI output can be trusted and when it cannot, and you will be a key driver of engineering excellence, ensuring solutions are both innovative and operationally robust. **Key Responsibilities** * Design and operate AI/agentic workflows across the software lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, prototyping, code generation, test\-case creation, specification drafting, code review, documentation, and automated validation, and use them in your own daily development. * Define team standards for AI\-assisted development: prompt and context practices, reusable agent skills and instructions, repository conventions, and review expectations for AI\-generated code. * Establish guardrails for responsible AI use, including IP and licensing, secrets and data handling, security review of generated code, and client contractual constraints, and ensure ethical compliance across the team. * Build evaluation and validation around AI output (automated tests, specification conformance, static analysis, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints) so that speed gains do not erode quality. * Define and report metrics on AI impact, such as cycle time, review turnaround, defect escape rate, test coverage, rework, and cost per outcome, and use them to decide where AI helps and where it does not. * Evaluate, pilot, and recommend AI tools, models, and integrations (IDE assistants, CLI agents, MCP servers, internal automation), considering cost, security, and vendor risk. * Build internal tooling and automation on LLM APIs where it removes recurring toil, such as PR summarization, test generation, release notes, and defect triage. * Own end\-to\-end solution delivery across Discovery and Delivery Tracks, personally building validated prototypes, contributing to formal designs, decomposing work into deliverables, and shipping accepted technical implementations. * Drive the Discovery Track under Dual\-Track Agile by writing AI\-accelerated working prototypes and demoing solutions to validate feasibility and align stakeholders before full implementation. * Translate discovery outcomes into delivery backlog items and partner with implementation teams to ensure design intent, code quality standards, and non\-functional requirements are preserved throughout delivery. * Contribute to technical design across products and integrations: produce ADRs, OpenAPI interface contracts, data models, sequencing diagrams, migration/rollback plans, and traceability matrices that serve as implementation inputs for both engineers and AI agents, partnering with architects on broader governance. * Serve as the primary technical lead in client engagements: facilitate workshops, present technical solutions, make trade\-off decisions, drive approvals, and explain AI\-assisted delivery credibly to client stakeholders. * Personally implement critical components and complex features in modern retail platform stacks, set the bar for code quality through your own work, and review and approve deliverables from implementation teams, including AI\-generated changes. * Apply and reinforce engineering standards, reusable integration patterns, and non\-functional requirements ( n enterprise or client\-facing setting. * Experience building internal developer tooling or MCP servers that integrate AI with Jira, GitLab, Jenkins, or Confluence. * Expertise in formal or machine\-readable specifications (OpenAPI, UML\+OCL, TLA\+, or equivalent) to guide implementation and enable automated validation of AI output. * Experience leading Dual\-Track Agile processes, managing both Discovery and Delivery Tracks, and translating discovery outcomes into actionable backlog items. * Strong retail platform domain knowledge (POS systems, store operations) is highly desirable. * Certifications such as Azure Developer Associate, Azure Solutions Architect, or equivalent cloud credentials. * Strong understanding of advanced security best practices and compliance requirements in enterprise systems. * Experience contributing to platform strategy, reusable assets, and API\-first designs. **About Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions** Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions is a dynamic billion\-dollar global company based in Research Triangle Park, NC, providing retail store solutions to your favorite brands. Have you ever been in a hurry and made use of the self\-checkout at Lowe's Foods, earned fuel rewards at Kroger, or just paid for purchases at retailers such as Walmart, Michaels, Carrefour, The Gap, Calvin Klein, Boots, Cencosud, BJ's, or Costco? These are just a few examples of our in\-store solutions and impressive customer base that made us the world's installed market share leader. The nature of retail is changing quickly, so if you share our 'Together Commerce' vision of a seamless two\-way, participatory shopping experience, let's get together to drive the new economy. Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions, Inc. offers a competitive salary and generous benefits package including the following: * Bonus: Eligible for up to 8% performance\-based bonus (individual and company performance) * Group health coverage (medical, dental, \& vision) * Employee Assistance Programs * Pre\-tax spending accounts * 401(k) plan (with company match) * Company provided life insurance * Pet Insurance * Employee discounts * Generous paid holiday schedule, paid vacation \& sick/personal days **Compensation:** Base Salary Range: $140,000\-$165,000 The above annual salary range is a general guideline. Multiple factors are taken into consideration to arrive at the final annual salary to be offered to the selected candidate. Factors include, but are not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate's work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations. Discretionary Bonus Plan: Eligible for up to 8% annual performance\-based bonus (individual and company performance) **EEO:** Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer that evaluates qualified applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, religious creed, disability, marital status, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, national origin, race, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression and sexual orientation or any other protected factor. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Individuals who need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process should email benefits@toshibagcs.com to request an accommodation **DIVERSITY, EQUITY \& INCLUSION:** We at Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions firmly believe that our people are an integral part to the success of our customers. Furthermore, we're committed to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion for all our people as highlighted by our 5 Core Principles (Create Outreach, Foster Belonging, Unleash Opportunity, Diverse Cultural Engagement and Culture of Transparency). We're passionate about our customers the retail industry and becoming a more responsible company as we help create a brighter future.

jobs.title: Senior Director Software Engineering, Applied AI
jobs.description: **Who Are We?** Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance\-based cash incentive awards. **Salary Range** $157,500\.00 \- $259,900\.00**Target Openings** 1**What Is the Opportunity?** As a member of Enterprise AI Products \& Emerging Tech, you'll be joining a strategic and collaborative team that is passionate about transforming our business and technology capabilities and paving the way for best\-in\-class technology, data and analytics. Travelers is seeking a Senior Director, Applied AI to join Enterprise AI Products \& Emerging Tech as we grow and transform our Technology landscape. Individual will lead and manage teams of AI\-native engineers who deliver production AI solutions with and for Lines of Business. Individual will also plan and execute at a strategic level, lead and influence outcomes across multiple teams and business partners, lead the design, development and implementation of significantly complex, unscoped AI solutions that extend beyond the confines of a team, and establish AI\-native engineering best practices and standards.**What Will You Do?** * Lead teams of AI\-native engineers and emerging leaders while role modeling Travelers' leadership behaviors. * Lead Applied AI engagements, from sustained strategic initiatives requiring deep discovery and architecture ownership to rapid field engagements embedded with Lines of Business that validate feasibility through working prototypes. * Partner with Line of Business leaders to identify, prioritize and shape high\-value AI use cases, taking business problems directly to a scoped written intent with clear production intent, and align work with business and engineering priorities to realize meaningful impact. * Set direction for when to apply non\-deterministic, AI\-enabled design patterns versus traditional deterministic approaches, based on risk tolerance. * Establish AI\-native engineering practices across teams, including spec and plan workflows, autonomy matched to risk, guardrails, evaluation before changes ship, and accountability standards so engineers own AI\-assisted output as the accountable author. * Drive a systems thinking approach and efficiencies across the delivery lifecycle, using emerging tools and practices to optimize flow of value and remove systemic impediments. * Provide strategic direction into overall quality needs and expand automation, including testing, proactive alerting, and resiliency/reliability, and ensure operational resilience through vulnerability management, monitoring, disaster recovery and incident response. * Build AI\-native capabilities across multiple teams, assess skill gaps, drive an AI learning strategy, and set the learning example for others. * Build collaborative relationships with key leaders and peers across the organization (i.e. Team Leaders, CoEs) to ensure the best use of overall resources, and present recommendations that influence executive decisions on AI investment and technology direction. * Develop a robust talent and leadership pipeline, providing technical leadership, mentorship, feedback and unique development opportunities to each team member. * Perform other duties as assigned. Ideal Candidate Competencies * Eight years of related work experience plus four years of team leadership experience. * AI\-Native Engineering \- Experience establishing AI\-native practices at an organizational level, including spec\-and\-plan workflows, context engineering, deterministic guardrails, evaluation suites that gate changes, living convention files and skills that encode policy, and parallel work streams sized to what one person can review. * Delivery \- Advanced delivery skills including the ability to take AI solutions into production with evaluation, monitoring and human review, assess engineering strategies across an organization, and ensure the quality, production readiness and continued health of systems that meet nonfunctional requirements. * Domain Expertise \- Demonstrated track record of applied AI and machine learning expertise, combining traditional ML with LLM\-based approaches, consulting on business priorities, and t p. Required Skills and Experience * Proficiency in Python, with experience in additional languages such as JavaScript, TypeScript, or Java. * Hands\-on experience across front\-end, mid\-tier, back\-end and systems layers, with enough depth to review and challenge designs. * Hands\-on experience with AWS and/or Azure cloud services, containerization and orchestration including Kubernetes, RESTful APIs and microservices, and CI/CD tooling such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions. * Production experience leading the design and delivery of agentic workflows, LLM integrations, or AI\-powered automations, including evaluation, monitoring and human review of AI outputs. * Hands\-on experience using AI coding agents and agentic development tools as the accountable author, with complete ownership of outputs. * Applied machine learning experience including model selection, fine\-tuning, and evaluation in production environments. Preferred Skills and Experience * Experience with Terraform, MongoDB or comparable NoSQL data stores, and Temporal or comparable workflow orchestration tools. * Experience with LLM evaluation methods, including designing evaluation datasets and measuring model performance in production. * Experience with prompt engineering, context engineering, or RAG architectures. * Exposure to MCP server configurations or multi\-agent frameworks. * Experience with ML observability, drift detection, observability tooling or distributed tracing in production environments. * Familiarity with zero\-trust security principles or secure\-by\-design development practices in enterprise AI systems. **What is a Must Have?** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, related STEM field, or its equivalent in education and/or work experience. * 7 additional years of software engineering experience. * 2 years of technical leadership experience. **What Is in It for You?** * **Health Insurance**: Employees and their eligible family members – including spouses, domestic partners, and children – are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment. * **Retirement:** Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar\-for\-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers. * **Paid Time Off:** Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays. * **Wellness Program:** The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs. * **Volunteer Encouragement:** We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice. **Employment Practices** Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions. If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you. Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting. To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life\-at\-travelers/benefits/.

We enhance business productivity by enabling our clients to outsource their HR function to one strategic partner and allowing them to focus on operating and growing their core businesses. Our full\-service HR solutions include features such as payroll processing, human capital consulting, employment law compliance and employee benefits, including health insurance, retirement plans and workers’ compensation insurance. TriNet has a nationwide presence and an experienced executive team. Our stock is publicly traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol TNET. If you’re passionate about innovation and making an impact on the large SMB market, come join us as we power our clients’ business success with extraordinary HR. **Don't meet every single requirement? TriNet always strives to hire the most qualified candidate for a particular role, ensuring we deliver outstanding results for our small and medium\-size customers. So, if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every single qualification in the job description, nobody’s perfect – and we encourage you to apply. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.** **A Brief Overview** The Senior Software Engineer is responsible for the design, development, testing and release of our organization's web and mobile applications. jobs.title: Software Engineer (L2)
jobs.description: **Who we are** At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences. Our dedication to remote\-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands. . **Hiring and how we work** We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! Also, while we are a remote\-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad\-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off\-sites or customer meetings. . **See yourself at Twilio** Join the team as Twilio's next Software Engineer for Stytch, where you'll shape the next generation of identity products. **About the job** This position is needed to help build and scale Stytch’s core product as we bring Stytch capabilities to Twilio’s full customer base, delivering secure, developer\-first identity experiences. Join the Stytch team at Twilio to shape the next generation of identity products. You’ll build backend systems that power authentication, authorization, and emerging agentic and non\-human identity use cases. jobs.title: Sr. Staff Machine Learning Engineer - AV Labs
jobs.description: **About the Role** Uber is launching AV Labs to accelerate the autonomous technology ecosystem. We're building out a high\-velocity team of multi\-disciplinary experts to turn real\-world operations into high\-quality data for our autonomous partners. This team is focused on the hardest problem in AV today: unlocking real\-world, long\-tail driving data. Autonomy is now a data race—and Uber has an edge: We collect rare, real\-world driving data at a scale and capital efficiency no one else can match. As a Senior Staff ML Engineer, you will be at the forefront of Physical AI, building advanced autonomy algorithms and models to add rich semantics to our massive driving data. You will set the technical direction for developing state\-of\-the\-art machine learning that enables better data mining, deep scene understanding, and causal modeling of ego vehicle behavior. You aren't just solving known problems; you are architecting the intelligence behind our L4 data and evaluation engine. You will collaborate with engineers across big data, compute, and cloud engineering to build platforms that harness scale and real\-world complexity to reimagine how the world moves. **What the Candidate Will Do** * **Advanced Semantic Modeling:** Architect and build the cutting\-edge autonomy algorithms and foundation models necessary to extract high\-fidelity semantic meaning from complex urban edge cases, directly enriching our L4 data lake. * **Scene Understanding \& Behavioral Causality:** Lead the hands\-on development of multi\-modal perception and prediction models. You will pioneer algorithms to extract and model the causality behind ego vehicle behaviors from logged data, understanding the 'why' behind driving decisions in complex scenarios. * **Data Engine Taxonomy:** Translate complex algorithmic outputs into a comprehensive, highly structured taxonomy for our autonomous database. Your work will directly create the ultimate data mining engine, empowering partners to query and extract precise, long\-tail edge cases. * **L4 Evaluation Architecture:** Design and deploy the robust, large\-scale ML pipelines that form the core of our L4 evaluation engine, relentlessly optimizing models to process massive streams of upstream sensor data efficiently. * **Technical Leadership \& Execution:** Serve as a domain expert and hands\-on technical lead. You will drive the architecture and execution of critical ML systems, mentor Staff and Senior engineers, and establish a culture of rigorous experimentation and engineering excellence. **Basic Qualifications** * 8\+ years of working experience in the ML, Robotics, or Autonomous Systems industry. * Proven track record of architecting and delivering complex, large\-scale ML systems from conception to production. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields. * Expert\-level proficiency in Python, C\+\+, and Linux environments. * Deep, hands\-on expertise in modern AI/ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow). **Preferred Qualifications** * PhD degree in Robotics, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, or a closely related field. * Extensive experience optimizing large\-scale models and algorithms for massive offline datasets and distributed compute clusters. * Deep understanding of autonomous system architectures, sensor data pipelines, and offline evaluation simulation (as opposed to embedded on\-car execution). * Hands\-on experience building, training, and scaling "Foundation Models" for physical world interaction, multi\-modal scene representation, or causal behavior modeling. * Recognized technical contributions in the field (e.g., strong publication record, relevant patents, or significant open\-source contributions). For Sunnyvale, CA\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $267,000 per year \- USD $297,000 per year. You will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award \& other types of comp. All full\-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits. **Ready to Ride?** This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you. You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits. Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.description: **Scientific Software Programmer, ASC** --------------------------------------- ### **Institute for Sustainability, Energy, and Environment** *This position may be eligible for a hybrid or remote work arrangement dependent with unit operational needs.* *This position is eligible for sponsorship for work authorization, except for sponsorship of a new H1B petition that would incur the $100,000 fee.* The University of Illinois Urbana–Champaign is a public land\-grant research university in Illinois in the twin cities of Champaign and Urbana. It is the flagship institution of the University of Illinois system and was founded in 1867\. The university serves the people of Illinois through a shared commitment to excellence in teaching, research, public engagement, economic development and health care. Faculty, staff and students share their knowledge, expertise and resources with residents in every corner of the state through public service and outreach programs. #### **Job Summary** Responsible for the development, testing, maintenance, deployment, and computational application of ecosystem modeling software and research computing workflows at the Agroecosystem Sustainability Center (ASC). The position works closely with ASC scientists to support large\-scale process\-based model simulations and other computational research activities, while ensuring the reliability, reproducibility, and scalability of scientific software and computational workflows. The position will serve as a key technical contributor and support point for research computing operations, including HPC workflow management, computational resource and storage monitoring, coordination with institutional HPC support teams, scientific data stewardship, troubleshooting, and technical onboarding. The role requires a combination of scientific software engineering, high\-performance computing, scientific collaboration, and practical operational support. #### **Duties \& Responsibilities** * Ecosystem modeling software development, testing, release, and maintenance: + Develop, maintain, test, and release process\-based ecosystem modeling software, with primary responsibility for ecosystem modeling software quality and version lifecycle. This includes regression testing, benchmark testing, debugging, version control, release validation, documentation, and maintaining reproducible software configurations across model versions. * Large\-scale ecosystem modeling and scientific collaboration: + Work closely with scientists to prepare, execute, troubleshoot, and analyze large\-scale ecosystem modeling simulations. + Translate scientific requirements into reliable computational workflows, support model applications across sites and regions, and help scientists diagnose model behavior, input\-data issues, and simulation failures. * High\-performance computing and computational workflow development: + Develop and maintain efficient computational pipelines for large\-scale ecosystem simulations across institutional high\-performance computing (HPC) platforms. + Optimize job submission and workflow execution, automate repetitive computational tasks, and improve the scalability, reliability, and reproducibility of scientific computing workflows. * Research computing operations and HPC resource coordination: + Monitor computational allocations, storage usage, and resource availability for ASC research projects. + Coordinate with institutional HPC support teams on service requests, job scheduling issues, compute reservations, priority requests, storage constraints, and other operational issues affecting time\-sensitive research workloads. * Scientific data management and research data stewardship: + Maintain and organize shared scientific datasets and computational data resources used by ASC modeling activities.
