jobs.title: Principal Forward Deployed AI Engineer
jobs.description: ### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife. **What you’ll be doing...** As a Principal Forward Deployed AI Engineer within Verizon’s Data Analytics team, you will embed directly into the frontline of Verizon’s core Business Units to solve our most critical, ambiguous, and high\-stakes operational challenges. Operating with total technical ownership, you will architect, build, and deploy production\-grade agentic systems, enterprise RAG engines, full\-stack microservices, and decision systems into live operations. You are a technical anchor: you pair deep systems craftsmanship with a product mindset, cutting through operational ambiguity to design production architectures, implement custom orchestration layers (via LangGraph, Temporal, or custom state machines), and enforce context management strategies that scale into enterprise assets. Beyond shipping point solutions, you will run workloads reliably on Domino, Airflow, and Kubernetes, abstracting bespoke code into reusable SDKs, shared libraries, and architectural playbooks that scale company\-wide. Key Responsibilities include: * **End\-to\-End Architectural Blueprinting:** Defining the full\-stack architecture for embedded AI initiatives, including multi\-agent orchestration, state machines, latency/cost budgets, security boundaries, and enterprise back\-end integrations. * **Agentic Orchestration Engineering, Workflow Automation and Governance:** Architect stateful agent workflows complying with established agentic governance rules, using tools like LangGraph, Temporal, or event\-driven state machines, establishing strict protocols for tool calling, execution sandboxing, and deterministic fallback logic. * **Context \& Retrieval Systems:** Designing production RAG infrastructure incorporating hybrid search, re\-ranking algorithms, metadata filtering, and semantic caching, directly informing and scaling Verizon’s context architecture. * **Runtime \& Cloud Deployment:** Deploying production agent services and scheduled workflows to target runtimes (e.g., Domino Data Lab, Apache Airflow, Kubernetes microservices, and serverless compute across AWS, GCP, or Azure). * **Evaluation Harness Design:** Architecting offline and online evaluation frameworks (e.g., LLM\-as\-a\-judge, synthetic test generation, human\-in\-the\-loop review queues, live A/B rollouts) to measure model drift, context hallucination rates, and task completion metrics. * **Platform Codification \& IP Creation:** Generalizing custom domain deployments into reusable internal SDKs, API primitives, and modular UI components; mentor engineers across the organization and draft technical documentation for Verizon patent disclosures. * **Strategic Discovery \& Scoping:** Embed alongside BU leadership to map intricate operational processes, cut through organizational noise, and isolate the highest\-leverage intervention points where applied AI delivers measurable uplift. * **Executive Translation:** Serving as the technical authority in the room with BU Vice Presidents and Managing Directors, demystifying algorithmic behaviors, failure modes, and performance trade\-offs. **What we’re looking for...** You’ll need to have: * Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. * Six or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training. * Extensive hands\-on experience leveraging frontier LLMs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini) and agentic developer frameworks (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) to build scalable solutions and achieve core business milestones. * Experience with containerized deployments (Docker), API design, and cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure). * Advanced full\-stack programming mastery in Python, SQL, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript stacks. * Demonstrated ability to independently scope ambiguous technical initiatives and present architectural designs to senior executive stakeholders. * Demonstrated ability to interface directly with enterprise stakeholders, translate ambiguous business requirements into technical architectures, and lead project delivery end\-to\-end. Even better if you have: * Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics, or a related technical field. * Experience building and scaling centralized context platforms or enterprise search engines similar to Verizon's internal enterprise context layer platforms. * Proven track record implementing both offline evaluation benchmarks and online evaluation/observability pipelines (latency, token costs, hallucination tracking, eval\-driven development). * Proven experience deploying containerized services and data workflows across enterprise platforms such as Domino Data Lab, Apache Airflow, Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), and hyperscaler cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure). * Proven track record designing offline/online eval harnesses, guardrail frameworks, and observability systems (latency, token optimization, tracing). * Prior forward\-deployed engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting experience in top\-tier technology firms or hyperscalers. * Record of turning one\-off operational builds into enterprise\-wide shared libraries, with associated technical publications or filed patents. * Domain knowledge in telecommunications, network capacity optimization, capital planning, or large\-scale customer care operations. * Deep expertise in retrieval and context architectures: designing production RAG pipelines, vector databases (e.g., pgvector, Milvus, Pinecone), hybrid search (dense \+ sparse/lexical), and dynamic context management. If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above. ### **Where you’ll be working** In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. ### **Benefits and Compensation** Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD\&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home \& auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award\-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part\-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job\-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part\-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours. The salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full\-time schedule is: $120,500\.00 \- $231,000\.00\. The salary range for the Colorado location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full\-time schedule is: $120,500\.00 \- $231,000\.00\. The salary range for the Illinois location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full\-time schedule is: $132,500\.00 \- $231,000\.00\.

deterministic and verifiable * Use AI\-assisted development tools every day, including code generation, prompt engineering, and agentic frameworks, and help your squad use them well * Enhance and interfaces other engineers and squads can reuse, and pay down technical debt that slows the team * Apply the principle "fix the process, don't automate the broken one," and push back when automation would only speed up a flawed workflow * Review code with direct, specific feedback, lead design reviews, and mentor early career engineers * Work with product managers and business stakeholders on requirements, and support production operations in your area * Model our core values: We Before Me, Positive Energy, Knowledge Explorer, and Own It **What We're Looking For** * Strong grasp of data experience building with LLM APIs, agentic frameworks, or workflow orchestration tools * Daily use of AI\-assisted development tools, with specific opinions about where they help and where they fail in production code * Working knowledge of what makes AI systems hard to run: non\-determinism, evaluation, prompt and context design, latency, cost, and safety * A track record of taking ambiguous problems, framing them, and delivering working solutions with limited direction * Sound judgment on trade\-offs between speed, quality, cost, and risk, and the ability to explain them to practical challenges, such as numerical stability and problems with no feasible solution * Hands\-on experience integrating and tuning a commercial or open\-source optimization solver, such as Gurobi * Experience with optimization problems that involve whole\-number or yes/no decisions (integer programming), such as minimum trade sizes or limits on the number of trades * Solid numerical linear algebra skills, including working with covariance matrices supplied as optimizer inputs and handling near\-singular or non\-positive semidefinite matrices * Familiarity with portfolio construction, rebalancing, tracking error, and tax\-lot accounting, including using factor risk models as optimizer inputs **What Will Help You Stand Out** * Agentic or LLM\-powered systems you have run in production, and how you evaluated and monitored them * Experience at an asset manager, wealth platform, broker\-dealer, or fintech, especially on portfolio, rebalancing, or trading systems * Engineering standards or shared platforms you built that other teams adopted * A system you can walk us through in detail: what you designed, what broke, what you changed, and what you would do differently **Education and Experience** * B.S. in Computer Science, Mathematics, Operations Research, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. An M.S. or other graduate degree is a plus. * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of production systems * We weigh demonstrated AI tool fluency, technical leadership, and adaptability more heavily than years of experience *Vestmark is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)
jobs.description: **WISEcode is building the world's food intelligence infrastructure** Most people have no real way to know what is in their food or what it does to them. The information is scattered, inconsistent, and written to sell rather than to inform. WISEcode exists to change that: to give people a source they can actually trust, and the freedom to decide for themselves once they have it. Getting there takes a system that turns fragmented food data into answers that hold up: consistent, explainable, and the same whether they reach a parent scanning a label, a brand seeking verification, a regulator, or an AI model answering a question about food. That system is what we are building, and it is why the work compounds instead of resetting with every new product. At its center is our Food Intelligence Corpus: NFP\+™, our foods, ingredients, nutrients, scores and codes, the algorithms behind them, our ingredient ontology, our market intelligence, and everything derived from them. It grows every day, and much of its value rests on one fact: no one else has it. ###### **Why this role matters** Our data, our codes and the methods behind them are what customers, partners and AI systems come to us for. Protecting them is the most important part of this job. We are looking for a leader who has defended a valuable data asset against sophisticated, well\-funded adversaries. WISEcode is also AI\-native. AI writes most of our code, builds our dashboards and analyses, and runs inside our products, and our customers and partners reach us through AI apps and agents. Our principle: **the corpus never goes to the AI; the AI comes to the corpus**, through capabilities we control, where every input and output defines exactly what can cross. Customers, partners and AI systems receive answers from WISEcode, never the corpus. Your job is to keep that true at full speed. This is also a management job. You run the organization that builds and operates our platform (cloud infrastructure, DevOps and IT) and you are accountable for how it performs. You set the priorities, hold people to their commitments, and control what changes, who has access, and what it costs. Nothing important lives in one person's head, and nothing reaches production without review. The President and the CEO should always know where things stand without having to ask. We are looking for someone who takes real command of an organization, not someone who advises it from the side.###### **The role** You own the security, privacy and resilience of everything WISEcode builds and holds, with one priority above the rest: protecting the corpus, our source code and our methods from theft, leakage, scraping, tampering and attack. You report to the President and the shape of the program is yours to define. You also lead our small cloud infrastructure, DevOps and IT team, which builds and runs our AWS platform as infrastructure as code, our deployment pipelines and our corporate IT. You manage them day to day and keep the President and the CEO fully informed. You are a CISO first and an engineer at heart. You came up as a software engineer and still carry the depth of a principal engineer: deep in several areas, broad across all of them. You review far more code than you write, and you know good code when you see it. From time to time you step into engineering to build a feature or a security building block end to end as a model of secure practice, then step out, leaving a pattern that stays healthy after you have gone. That keeps you close to the product; security leadership always comes first.###### **How fast we move** Speed is the floor here, at every level. Nobody gets to be slow because they are senior. AI has collapsed the time it takes to build, not the time a decision has to stay right: build fast, decide durably.* Security work that used to take quarters takes weeks or days here. You ship real protections in your first weeks, not a strategy deck in your first quarter. * You save your deliberation for one\-way doors; everything else you decide, ship and improve. * You know where a shortcut is safe and where it is not, and you never trade the protection of our data for speed. * Progress is shown, not reported: a working control, a closed path, a measured improvement. ###### **What you will do** **Protect the corpus, our code and our methods*** Know where every part of the corpus lives and every path by which it could leave: products, APIs, AI tools, dashboards, exports, backups, laptops, vendors and people. Close the paths that should not exist and instrument the ones that must. * Protect our source code, algorithms, AI instructions (prompts) and tool designs with the same care as the data. A leaked method is as damaging as a leaked table. * Build the means to establish where our data came from wherever it appears. * Defend against well\-funded and state\-backed adversaries: economic espionage, targeted phishing, insider recruitment and supply\-chain compromise, working with f knowledge, architecture as well as security, enough to direct and challenge a senior cloud architect; infrastructure as code and CI/CD; OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect and SAML. * Experience managing infrastructure, DevOps or IT engineers, senior ones and contractors included, and controlling cloud and AI spend as a security concern. * Led a company through SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001 with external auditors, and know US privacy law, including CCPA/CPRA and state consumer health data laws. * Led serious security incidents with Legal, communications, executives and customers. * The backbone to say no to anyone, at any level, when our data is at stake, and the communication skills to be thanked for it. * A record of protections shipped in weeks, not quarters, and still sound years later; AI\-native practice you can show live, not claim; urgency, pragmatism and comfort moving between strategy and hands\-on work. ###### **Nice to have** * Defending against state\-backed actors or economic espionage, including work with federal law enforcement. * Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers or other systems that let outside AI models call into a platform. * Data provenance for a proprietary data asset, and masked or synthetic development data realistic enough to build against. * AI security frameworks: NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications. * Government or research customers: NIST 800\-53, NIST 800\-171, FedRAMP. * Consumer health, wellness, nutrition or food technology. * Remote\-first companies and contractor networks across countries. * CISSP, CISM, CCSP, OSCP or CIPP/US. ###### **How we work** Our values are Respect, Curiosity, Disruption, Honesty and Tenacity. Our leadership principles are Customer Obsession, Invent \& Simplify, Ownership, Honor Transparency and Truth, GSD (get stuff done) and Deliver Results. In this role, the ones that carry the most weight are **Ownership** (the security of the whole company is yours, including the parts nobody assigned), **GSD and Deliver Results** (ambiguity becomes progress, week after week) and **Honor Transparency and Truth** (hard news early and plainly, including about your own area).###### **Compensation** Competitive base and bonus. Details shared in the hiring process.###### **Benefits** * **Location:** Fully remote * **Unlimited PTO and Paid Holidays:** Unlimited time off and 10 paid holidays * **Financial Wellness:** 401(k) with a 4% company match, immediately vested * **Health Benefits:** Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life, and additional ancillary coverage * + 100% coverage for employees, with 80% covered for dependents + 100% employer paid STD, LTD, Identity Theft, and Life insurance + FSA and HSA plans available. For our HSA: + - $200/mo contributions for Employee plans - $400/mo contributions for Employee \+ Dependent plans ###### **Why WISEcode** We are building the layer that food decisions will run on, for people and for the AI systems they increasingly ask. That is quiet, compounding work: broadening coverage, sharpening precision, and making every output repeatable and defensible. We value transparency, rigor, and respect for the person making the decision, who deserves clear information and the freedom to reach their own conclusion. Come in early enough and you help shape how this system is protected, instead of inheriting a program someone else already designed. *Research shows that some groups hesitate to apply unless they meet every qualification. If you are excited about this role but do not check every box, we encourage you to apply. At WISEcode, we value diverse experiences, transferable skills, and the unique strengths each person brings.**WISEcode is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.*

jobs.title: Research Principal Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: Waters Global Research is seeking an accomplished **Principal Mechanical Engineer** to advance the technologies behind next\-generation analytical and bioanalytical instrumentation. This is a hands\-on, career\-level technical position for an engineer with demonstrated command of mechanical engineering fundamentals, modern design and analytical tools, and the judgment to solve complex problems where the path forward is not yet defined. The engineer will contribute to research spanning liquid chromatography, fluid handling, precision mechanisms, detection, sample preparation and other instrumentation platforms. Working alongside scientists and specialists in electronics, software, optics and other disciplines, the Principal Mechanical Engineer will turn fundamental concepts into modeled, built and experimentally validated technologies that improve instrument sensitivity, reliability and scientific workflows. Success depends on both individual technical excellence and the ability to strengthen engineering decisions across the team—not on direct reports or a requirement to progress into management. Responsibilities: * **Lead complex engineering design and problem solving:** Independently define technical requirements, first\-principles models, design constraints, assumptions and acceptance criteria for challenging research problems; assess alternatives quantitatively and recommend defensible solutions. * **Design precision mechanical and fluidic systems:** Develop mechanisms, assemblies, high\-pressure fluid paths, pumps/valves/interfaces, seals, low\-volume flow paths, sample\-handling hardware and electromechanical systems; address dimensional control, thermal behavior, mechanical loads, material compatibility, reliability and precision assembly. * **Own analysis and engineering models:** Use MATLAB and/or Python to create engineering calculations, parameter studies, numerical models, test\-data analysis and visualizations; apply first\-principles structural, thermal, mechanical and fluidic analysis, supported by suitable simulation when useful, and validate important predictions against measurements. * **Deliver high\-quality CAD and design definitions:** Produce and critically review parametric CAD, assemblies, drawings, tolerances, GD\&T, interface definitions and engineering documentation; resolve tolerance stacks, manufacturability, assembly and serviceability issues. * **Drive hands\-on experimental learning:** Plan and build prototypes and experimental apparatus; specify sensors, instrumentation and data acquisition; design decisive feasibility studies, analyze uncertainty and root causes, and use results to refine concepts and models. * **Influence multidisciplinary system architecture:** Integrate mechanical, fluidic, electrical, optical, thermal, firmware/software and scientific constraints; lead design reviews and interface/trade studies within areas of expertise. * **Reduce technical risk and support technology transfer:** Establish design margins, verification methods, failure modes and performance limits; provide clear technical records that enable reproducibility and eventual transition from Global Research into development. * **Raise engineering capability:** Serve as a trusted technical authority, mentor other engineers, share analytical and experimental methods and challenge assumptions constructively without relying on organizational authority. * **Contribute to new technology and intellectual property:** Identify opportunities for improved instrument performance, usability and scientific workflow; incorporate relevant Voice of the Customer insights and document innovations through reports, presentations and invention disclosures as appropriate. Qualifications: * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline required. A master’s degree or PhD in mechanical engineering, fluid mechanics, applied mechanics, mechatronics, thermal sciences or a related technical field is advantageous. * **Professional experience:** Typically 10\+ years of relevant experience with a bachelor’s degree, 8\+ with a master’s, or 5\+ with a PhD in precision equipment, advanced R\&D, instrumentation or complex hardware development. Equivalent combinations of education and substantial demonstrated technical achievement may be considered, subject to HR policy. * **Principal\-level technical record:** Demonstrated independent ownership of high\-complexity designs or engineering investigations, including problem formulation, analytical tradeoffs, component/system design, prototype testing and sound technical decisions under uncertainty. * **Engineering fundamentals:** Advanced knowledge of at least one core specialty—such as mechanical design, fluid mechanics, thermal management, structures, precision mechanisms or electromechanical systems \- combined with the ability to evaluate interactions across adjacent subsystems. * **Hands\-on capability and commun e engineering simulations when relevant; establish credible assumptions, loads and boundary conditions; interpret sensitivity and limitations; and validate important predictions with physical measurements. Tools may include ANSYS Mechanical, SolidWorks Simulation or equivalents. Engineering judgment matters more than expertise in one solver. * **Experimental software and data acquisition:** Experience with LabVIEW, National Instruments DAQ, MATLAB toolboxes, Python\-based instrument interfaces or comparable acquisition and control environments for automated experiments and test\-data analysis. * **System modeling and engineering workflow:** Familiarity with Simulink, structured design of experiments (DOE), statistical analysis, PLM/PDM workflows and controlled technical documentation. Preferred domain experience* **Fluidics and analytical instrumentation:** High\-pressure liquid systems, chromatography, precision pumps, valves, fittings, seal design, microfluidics, low\-dead\-volume flow paths, bio\-compatible or chemically resistant wetted materials, sample handling or separation technologies. * **Related precision instrumentation:** Mass spectrometry, vacuum hardware, optomechanics, spectroscopy, bioanalytical instrumentation, medical devices, semiconductor equipment, robotics or other complex electromechanical or scientific instruments. * **Research\-to\-development practice:** Early\-stage technical feasibility studies, root\-cause investigations, metrology and reliability planning, supplier/manufacturing collaboration, and transfer of validated prototype architectures into a development organization; experience translating scientific or customer workflow needs into engineering requirements is valued. We know that sometimes the perfect candidate does not exist, and that people can be put off applying for a job if they do not fit all the requirements. If you are excited about working for us and have most of the skills or experience we are looking for, please go ahead and apply. You could be just what we need! We believe strongly in the value of diversity and creating supportive, inclusive environments where our colleagues can succeed. As such, Waters is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. Company Description: Waters Corporation (NYSE:WAT) is a global leader in life sciences and diagnostics, dedicated to accelerating the benefits of pioneering science through analytical technologies, informatics, and service. With a focus on regulated, high\-volume testing environments, our innovative portfolio harnesses deep scientific expertise across chemistry, physics, and biology. We collaborate with customers around the world to advance the release of effective, high\-quality medicines, ensure the safety of food and water, and drive better patient outcomes by detecting diseases earlier, managing routine infections, and combating antibiotic resistance. Through a shared culture of relentless innovation, our passionate team of \~16,000 colleagues turn scientific challenges into breakthroughs that improve lives worldwide. *Diversity and inclusion are fundamental to our core values at Waters Corporation. It benefits our employees, our products, our customers and our community. Waters complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws. Qualified applicants are considered without regard to sex, race, color, ancestry, national origin, citizenship status, religion, age, marital status (including civil unions), military service, veteran status, pregnancy (including childbirth and related medical conditions), genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, legally recognized disability, domestic violence victim status, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Simulator Orchestration
jobs.description: Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self\-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo's fully autonomous ride\-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider\-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15\+ U.S. states. ### **The Challenge** Waymo's simulator is one of the most complex virtual environments ever built. It blends deterministic logic, physical dynamics, and advanced AI to create a realistic training ground for the Waymo Driver. As we expand autonomous driving into new geographies, complex weather conditions, and next\-generation capabilities, our goal is to build a highly adaptable, generic simulator that works across any environment. The Simulator Orchestration team is at the heart of tackling this scaling challenge. Our mission is to deliver simulation solutions that power evaluation and training across a diverse range of challenging requirements. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who is passionate about solving complex evaluation problems with simulation technology and thrives on delivering practical solutions within a vast technical ecosystem. ### **The Role** This is a hybrid role. As a core contributor to the Simulator Orchestration team, you will focus on solving practical simulation challenges by intelligently configuring and orchestrating simulator features. **You will:** * Architect Simulation Solutions: Drive the simulator development of the environments required for new initiatives, such as complex weather setups, new geography expansions (e.g., left\-hand traffic), and adapting the simulator to support next\-generation onboard capabilities. * Design the Orchestration Layer: Design and implement systems that dynamically select and compose simulator features based on the specific environment and context, bringing us closer to a truly universal simulator. * Navigate Complex Systems: Dive deep into a massive C\+\+ codebase of onboard and simulator code. You are willing to get your hands dirty. You will rely on strong code\-reading and debugging skills to trace and resolve complex interactions between different systems, shipping robust, production\-ready code. * Collaborate Across Boundaries: Act as the technical glue between teams. You'll partner closely with partners from Simulator, Eval and Onboard orgs, taking the building blocks they provide and turning them into complete, end\-to\-end simulation solutions. ### **What You Bring** We are looking for a strong generalist software engineer who leans heavily toward practical execution and is comfortable navigating large\-scale, interconnected systems. **You have:** * **Engineering Craftsmanship:** * + 5\+ years of industry experience in software development. + Solid proficiency in C\+\+ (preferred) or Python, with a strong ability to read, navigate, and debug large, existing codebases. + Experience building orchestration, dynamic configuration, or integration layers for large\-scale software systems. * **Practical Problem Solving:** * + A proven track record of delivering working solutions in highly complex, ambiguous technical domains. + A pragmatic approach to engineering. You are willing to find compromises and make the right trade\-offs to achieve the broader goal, avoiding the trap of over\-engineering or getting stuck in "ideal land." * **Collaboration \& Communication:** * + Exceptional communication skills. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, negotiating technical boundaries, and building successful partnerships with upstream and downstream teams. **We prefer:** * Deep passion for solving complex evaluation problems with simulation technology to advance autonomous driving. * Track record in delivering goals via practical solutions. * Background in fields that rely heavily on complex systems integration, such as autonomous vehicles, robotics, simulation, or large backend infrastructure.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, AI-Native Systems
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote, USA **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Research \& Development **Staff Software Engineer, AI\-Native Systems** =============================================== **Location:** Remote (US) **We are** ---------- Virtual care only works if the infrastructure behind it does. Wheel builds that infrastructure: the systems that let telehealth run at scale for the patients, clinicians, and companies that depend on it. We're not bolting AI onto old workflows; we're rebuilding how care gets delivered, with AI in the product and in how we build it. We do this in a live, regulated healthcare environment where getting it right matters. This is the next architecture of virtual care, and we're building it now. **You are** ----------- A staff\-level engineer who has built software in a regulated, high\-stakes domain (ideally health tech; fintech and insurtech count too) and knows what that demands: sensitive data, regulatory constraints, and the cost of getting it wrong. You've designed and shipped AI and agentic systems in production, you know where they break, and you have opinions, held loosely and argued well, about building them safely. You're a builder first, and you've done real work in small, scrappy teams. You still write the hard parts of the code yourself, and you've done it recently. You don't need a platform org, TPMs, or layers of review to move. You operate as a domain owner, not a task owner. You take a problem that isn't well\-formed, define it, tie it to what the business has committed to, and lead a group of engineers to a shipped, measured outcome. Your impact shows up in other people's work: the patterns they reuse and the ambiguity you removed before it cost the team a quarter. You get things done. You have sharp judgment about what actually moves the outcome, you'd rather ship something useful this week than something perfect next quarter, and you know when good enough is good enough (and when, in healthcare, it isn't). And you're good to work with. You're curious, generous with your time, quick to give credit, and you can disagree hard without making it personal. Smart matters here; kind matters just as much. Bonus points if people genuinely enjoy being on a team with you. **The Work** ------------ ### **Technical Leadership \& Direction** * Own the technical direction for a significant AI\-native area of the platform, such as patient and clinician experiences, care delivery, or the AI platform layer other teams build on. * Act as tech lead for a team or cross\-team initiative: break down ambiguous problems, sequence delivery, clear blockers, and keep the team pointed at the outcome rather than the ticket. * Connect day\-to\-day engineering to quarterly commitments and company goals, and make those links visible to the team. * Write and review design docs. Make and document the load\-bearing calls, including "not yet" and "buy, don't build." ### **AI \& Agent Engineering** * Design and build production AI features and agents: retrieval, orchestration, tool calling, guardrails, evaluation, and observability. * Define what "production\-ready" means for AI here (testability, rollback safety, cost ceilings, failure modes, human\-in\-the\-loop boundaries) and hold the bar in review. * Take on the hardest parts of the build yourself. This is a hands\-on role; you are expected to be in the code every day. ### **Healthcare\-Grade Engineering** * Treat privacy, security, and responsible AI use on sensitive health data as hard engineering requirements, and turn compliance constraints into concrete architecture. * Partner with clinical, compliance, and legal stakeholders early, so safety and review are designed in rather than bolted on. * Build for the realities of healthcare: integrations with clinical systems, auditability, and high\-reliability workflows. ### **Cloud\-Native Delivery** * Own full\-stack delivery in TypeScript/Node.js and Python: services, APIs, data jobs, and the interfaces on top. * Own deployment, monitoring, and troubleshooting in production, including on\-call, and improve the operational posture of what you inherit. ### **Measure \& Improve** * Own the evaluation strategy for your area: metrics, test harnesses, and plans for accuracy, latency, safety, and cost. * Instrument systems so their behavior is legible after the fact, not just at demo time. * Kill approaches that aren't working, early and visibly. ### **Stakeholders \& The Org** * Work directly with product, operations, clinical, and business leaders to decide which use cases are worth building. * Explain trade\-offs and risks clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences, up to the executive team. * Mentor engineers through code review, design review, and pairing, and build reusable patterns that raise the bar beyond your own team. **What success looks like** --------------------------- * **First 30 days:* on't. * A record of shipping outcomes, not just output: you can point to what you delivered, why it mattered, and the judgment calls you made to get it out the door. * Recent hands\-on output: in the last two years you've personally built and debugged significant production systems, not only directed others. * Meaningful time at a startup or growth\-stage company where you owned what platform, release, or infrastructure teams would handle elsewhere. * A track record of technical leadership as an IC: owning a domain, leading multi\-engineer efforts to completion, and driving decisions across teams without positional authority. * A collaborative, low\-ego style: you raise the people around you and make hard conversations easier, not harder. * Fluent use of AI development tools as a force multiplier, with judgment about when to trust, verify, or override them. * Strong cloud\-native fundamentals: CI/CD, observability, and running what you build. Fluency with relational data and SQL. * Clear written and verbal communication, including design docs that change minds. This is a remote, cross\-functional role. **Strongly desired** -------------------- * Health tech experience specifically: telehealth, EHR/EMR, digital health, payer/provider, or pharmacy. * Experience with clinical workflows or integrations with clinical systems (EHRs, e\-prescribing, labs, HL7/FHIR). * Model evaluation and guardrail infrastructure: measuring output quality, catching regressions, and keeping AI inside safe bounds. * Patient\-, clinician\-, or customer\-facing AI products shipped to real users. * Experience building platform capabilities consumed by other engineering teams. * Experience as a formal tech lead or mentoring engineers. **What's hard about this role** ------------------------------- *We'd rather you hear it now:* * **Ambiguity is the job.** Problems often arrive half\-formed, and priorities can shift as the business and market change. * **You'll build, not just direct.** There's no large platform org; you'll write code, run what you ship, and take on\-call. * **Healthcare raises the bar.** Clinical safety, privacy, and compliance review are part of shipping, and they take real time. If that sounds energizing rather than draining, we'd love to talk. **How we work** --------------- Remote\-first (US), fast\-moving, with tight loops between engineering, product, clinical, and the business. We're an AI\-forward engineering org: we expect AI in the toolchain and in the product, and we measure outcomes over activity. We handle sensitive healthcare data under strict controls; privacy, security, and responsible AI are engineering requirements, not afterthoughts. We take the work seriously, not ourselves. We're direct and kind, we help each other out, and we have fun doing it. **Salary and Perks** -------------------- Pay Range: $185,725\-$264,500 USD *Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate’s work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations.* As an employee of Wheel, you’ll enjoy our Total Rewards Program to help secure your financial future and preserve your health and well\-being, including: * Medical, Dental and Vision * Ancillary: Life, Short and Long Term Disability * 401K match * Flexible PTO * Parental Leave * Stock options * Additional programs and perks *Wheel is committed to equal employment opportunities for all team members. Every decision we make regarding employment is solely based on merit, competence, and performance. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.* *Research shows that underrepresented groups typically apply only if they meet 100% of the criteria listed. At Wheel, we encourage women, people of color, and LGBTQ\+ job seekers to apply for positions even if they don’t check every box for the role.*

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money. **Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.** Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money. As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money. **For everyone, everywhere.** More about **our mission** and **what we offer**. **Job Description** Wise is building the infrastructure for money with a clear ambition: to become the everyday account people rely on, whether they're managing money at home or across borders. Customers should be able to receive their salary, pay bills, earn on their balances, and move money internationally—all from a single account that is simple \& transparent. As a Software Engineer on the North America Account team, you'll work on products that customers interact with every day. You'll own meaningful problems from discovery through production, improving the reliability and experience of receiving money, expanding access to local account capabilities, evolving our interest offering, and building the platform that powers Wise's everyday account experience in North America. Your work will directly influence customer growth, engagement, trust, retention, and the value customers receive from holding money with Wise. **Qualifications*** Demonstrate proficient knowledge and hands\-on expertise in Java. * Bring a strong product mindset, connecting engineering decisions to customer outcomes such as account adoption, customer engagement, reliability, trust, and long\-term value. * Take end\-to\-end ownership of impactful projects, from understanding customer problems and shaping solutions through implementation, rollout, measurement, and ongoing operational excellence. * Build and evolve highly available backend services using Java, Spring Boot, relational databases, microservices, and well\-designed APIs. * Design resilient distributed systems with thoughtful approaches to asynchronous processing, data consistency, observability, scalability, security, and operational reliability. * Work closely with Product, Design, Operations, Compliance, Treasury, and other engineering teams to deliver solutions that balance customer experience, regulatory requirements, and technical excellence. * Write maintainable, well\-tested software while continuously improving engineering practices, operational tooling, and service health. * Communicate technical concepts clearly to a variety of audiences and contribute to collaborative decision\-making across teams. * Raise the engineering bar by mentoring teammates, providing constructive feedback, reviewing designs and code, and reducing operational and knowledge silos across the team. **Additional Information** For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive. We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences. Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers. If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs. Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

jobs.description: **Principal Marine Geotechnical Engineer** Play an integral role in Worley Consulting’s U.S. Marine Survey \& Geoscience capability, providing technical and project leadership for complex offshore, coastal, and marine infrastructure projects. You will combine deep geotechnical expertise with client leadership to manage risk, shape engineering strategies, and deliver practical solutions for challenging marine environments. **Purpose of the role** As a Principal Marine Geotechnical Engineer, you will lead complex technical scopes across offshore site investigation, Geo\-data interpretation, ground modeling, advanced analysis, and design. You will serve as a trusted technical advisor to clients, lead multidisciplinary project delivery, mentor engineers, and contribute to the continued growth of Worley’s marine geotechnical capability. **Location** Houston, Texas is preferred. Baton Rouge, Louisiana or U.S.\-remote arrangements will be considered. The role requires periodic travel to Houston, client and project locations, and offshore or field assignments as required. **You will be responsible for:** * Provide technical and project leadership for complex marine and offshore geotechnical projects, establishing execution strategies, quality expectations, and technical direction. * Lead offshore geotechnical investigations, including scopes, specifications, laboratory programs, contractor evaluations, mobilization readiness, field technical assurance, QA/QC, and data handover. * Interpret CPT/CPTu, borings and cores, laboratory results, and geophysical and geological data to develop design parameters and integrated 2D and 3D ground models. * Translate ground conditions and geohazards into practical siting, design, constructability, and risk\-reduction strategies. * Perform, review, and provide technical assurance for advanced analyses involving piles, suction caissons and anchors, foundations, pipelines and cables, slope stability, settlement, liquefaction and cyclic response, soil\-structure interaction, and seabed interaction. * Serve as Geotechnical Lead or Project Technical Leader, managing multidisciplinary technical delivery across scope, schedule, budget, quality, risk, and client expectations. * Develop trusted client relationships, presenting technical recommendations, resolving complex project challenges, and identifying opportunities to create additional value. * Lead collaboration with clients, contractors, vessel and survey teams, laboratories, and pipeline, subsea, structural, installation, and geoscience disciplines. * Prepare, review, and approve engineering calculations, interpretive reports, technical memoranda, specifications, recommendations, and other key deliverables. * Apply industry standards, sound engineering judgment, and tools including gINT, OpenGround, PLAXIS, FLAC, GeoStudio, LPILE, APile, UTEXAS4, or comparable platforms. * Mentor engineers and provide technical guidance that strengthens quality, capability, and knowledge transfer across the marine geotechnical team. * Lead and support proposals, scopes, estimates, client presentations, and strategic pursuits while remaining actively engaged in project delivery. **What you’ll bring to the role:** **Required** * Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Geotechnical, Geological, or a closely related engineering discipline. * 15\+ years of progressive geotechnical engineering experience, including substantial marine, offshore, coastal, or closely related infrastructure experience. * Extensive experience planning and leading geotechnical investigations, interpreting Geo\-data, developing design parameters, and delivering advanced geotechnical analyses. * Demonstrated project leadership experience managing multidisciplinary technical delivery, scope, schedule, budget, quality, risk, and client expectations. * Deep knowledge of soil and rock mechanics, offshore foundation engineering, soil\-structure interaction, seabed interaction, and geotechnical risk. * Proven ability to provide independent technical review and assurance for complex geotechnical work. * Strong client leadership skills with demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical issues, influence decisions, and build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders. * Experience leading technical teams, mentoring engineers, and coordinating across multiple disciplines and projects. * Professional Engineer (PE) licensure in an appropriate U.S. jurisdiction. * Willingness to undertake periodic offshore or field assignments and travel as required. **Preferred** * PhD in Geotechnical Engineering or a closely related discipline. * Ability to obtain PE registration in additional U.S. states as project needs require. * Significant experience in the deepwater Gulf, offshore energy, LNG and marine terminals, offshore wind, pipelines, umbilicals, cables, or coastal and marine infrastructure. * Recognized expertise in one or more specialist areas, including offshore foundations and anchors, pipeline\-soil interaction, cyclic soil response, slope stability, seismic and liquefaction engineering, ground improvement, or advanced numerical modeling. * Advanced proficiency with gINT and/or OpenGround and experience with complex CPT/CPTu, borehole, laboratory, and interpreted Geo\-data. * Advanced experience with PLAXIS 2D/3D, FLAC, GeoStudio, LPILE, APile, PYWALL, Slide, Settle3, or comparable tools. * Strong working knowledge of applicable marine and offshore geotechnical codes and standards, including API and DNV frameworks. * Experience leading technical proposals, developing scopes and estimates, delivering client presentations, and supporting strategic business development. * Experience with Python, MATLAB, R, GIS, digital engineering, automation, AI/ML, or advanced data visualization. **Benefits** Feel the energy at Worley with access to a range of benefits including paid time off, holiday pay (usually 8 per year in the US), and eligibility to participate in the medical, life, dental, and vision insurance plans, as well as 401K plan. **Apply today** Bring your marine geotechnical expertise, project leadership, and client\-focused approach to Worley Consulting. Join us to lead challenging offshore and marine projects, develop the next generation of engineers, and help strengthen our U.S. Marine Survey \& Geoscience capability. **About Us** Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI\-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today’s needs and transition to more sustainable solutions. Join us and help drive innovation and sustainability in our projects. **Moving forward together** We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We’re building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard. And we’re not just talking about it; we’re doing it. We’re reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today’s low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change. **\#LI\-NM4**

jobs.title: Senior IT IAM Engineer
jobs.description: **Our mission** --------------- We're making Africa the first cashless continent. In 2017, over half the population in Sub\-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash. We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer\-to\-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast. Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in... **How you'll help us achieve it** --------------------------------- We're looking for a Senior IT IAM Engineer who's excited about solving identity and access problems at a company that's growing fast across many countries. Your goal is to make sure every Wave employee and contractor has the right access to the right tools at the right time: secure, easy to manage as we grow, and easy to prove to auditors. You'll work closely with Security Engineering, who run Wave's production access today and lead our overall identity design. Together, you'll develop a consolidated approach for the whole company, and you'll lead building the corporate side of it. You'll also guide the IT team members who do identity work day to day, and be the person teams turn to on corporate security. Our to\-do list will evolve, but here's some of what you might work on: **Build Wave's workforce identity foundation.** * Map how access works across Wave today, including older tools with their own logins, and helping Security Engineering shape one approach for the whole company. * Roll out and run a single identity platform (SSO, MFA, and automated account management) across our SaaS tools, internal apps, and markets. * Automate access changes when people join Wave, move teams, or leave, driven from our HR system and flowing through Google Workspace to every app. * Help shape the decision to implement an enterprise SaaS solution (such as Okta) and lead the implementation if needed. * Build monitoring so that when provisioning or identity workflows fail, we know quickly and can fix them. **Be Wave's go\-to voice on corporate identity** * Set standards and review designs for the IT team members who do identity work, and help them grow their IAM skills. * Help leaders make access decisions that keep us secure without slowing us down, based on how Wave's teams and tools actually work. **Make access easy to prove** * + Designing access around roles, so people get only what they need and it's always clear who has access to what, why, and since when. + Working with Compliance and Internal Control to understand what they need and, over time, making audits simpler for everyone. **Key details** --------------- * Employees in remote positions at Wave can work remotely from any of our talent hubs (between UTC \-5 and \+3\) with reliable internet access in the US, Canada, United Kingdom, Spain, Kenya, or Ghana. * Wave is a distributed team, and we fund up to three in\-person get\-togethers a year, in line with Wave's travel policy. * Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, we are offering an annual gross salary range of $119,800 \-$174,800 depending on your level and location. * Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country). * 6 months fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance. * Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 30\-40 days per year. * $10,000 annual charitable donation matching. **Requirements** ---------------- * 7\+ years in IT, security, systems, or software engineering, including at least 4 years working hands\-on in identity and access management. * You've led a workforce IAM rollout or major overhaul end to end, ideally in a Google Workspace environment. * Experience with identity platforms in Okta and Google Workspace, and with building integrations using APIs, SAML/OIDC, and SCIM, including automating account changes from an HR system. * Experience configuring user lifecycle management in order to automate employee onboarding, offboarding, and access changes using SCIM and identity workflows. * Experience designing role\-based access and running access reviews in a regulated environment (fintech, banking, or similar). * You use code to automate systems and identity work, and can reason across connected systems to design solutions that hold up. We care more about your ability to engineer solutions than experience with a particular programming language. * Experience implementing MFA, conditional access, least\-privilege access, and identity security policies. * Native or bilingual fluency in written and spoken English. **You might be a good fit if you** ---------------------------------- * Speak French conversationally or higher * Have experience in a multi\-country or fast\-scaling organization, particularly in emerging markets. * Are familiar with Mac, ChromeOS and Android device management and device\-aware access. * Are familiar with Entra ID. * Are a strong communicator that can inspire and lead by influence. * Are great at coordinating across teams and excel at communicating across multiple cultures. * Take ownership for outcomes and do whatever you can to make them close to inevitable. * Always listen with empathy but ruthlessly prioritize based on impact. * Are excited about travel and meeting employees across our African countries of operations, including but not limited to Senegal and Ivory Coast. **Our team** ------------ * We have a rapidly growing in\-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world. * We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most. * We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production. * We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021\. Our world\-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa. * We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue. **How to apply** ---------------- Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role. We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals. Wave is an equal\-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.description: Software EngineeringMountain View, CA **About X, the Moonshot Factory** X is a diverse group of inventors and entrepreneurs who build and launch technologies that aim to improve the lives of millions, even billions, of people. Our goal: 10x impact on the world’s most intractable problems, not just 10% improvement. We approach projects that have the aspiration and riskiness of research with the speed and ambition of a startup. **About the Team:** Our team – Bellwether – operates at the intersection of machine learning, geospatial data, and pressing issues with enterprise customers, governments, and more. We focus on severe weather manifestations of climate change, such as wildfires, and aim to use a wide range of data and analytics to better understand and predict what these events could mean for communities and businesses across the globe. We do this through the detection and classification of the features and patterns of the natural and built worlds, the application of cutting\-edge machine learning, and the redesign of the full geo\-ML workflow. This work extends into development and production\-level work as well, as Bellwether also has a number of products that are live with customers. The result: tools and models that allow a range of industries to better leverage earth observation insights. **About the Role:** We are looking for a **Lead Data Scientist** to build and unify the data infrastructure that powers our model training pipelines for Project Bellwether. In this role, you will lead the effort to construct a comprehensive multimodal data corpus—integrating geospatial, imagery, sensor, and operational feeds—that serves as a strategic moat for pre\- and post\-disaster response and resilience. Your primary focus will be designing automated ingestion pipelines for complex multimodal datasets, establishing rigorous data quality validation frameworks, and managing dataset versioning to support continuous machine learning training loops. You will bridge the gap between operations, remote annotation teams, and machine learning engineers to ensure our disaster\-response models are trained on reliable, high\-fidelity, and well\-structured data. **How you will have 10X impact:** * Architect and build automated ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) and ELT (Extract, Load, Transform) data pipelines to aggregate, clean, and harmonize data from disparate sources, databases, and operational ingestion flows. * Implement DataOps practices, including data quality monitoring, automated schema validation, and anomaly detection to catch corrupt or mislabeled data early. * Standardize and integrate third\-party annotation workflows and remote labeling feeds into unified datasets ready for model training. * Design and maintain dataset versioning and storage systems to allow reproducible machine learning experiments and seamless data retrieval. * Partner with ML engineers and operations teams to turn geospatial, imagery, and sensor metadata into structured training features. * Lead the end\-to\-end development of multimodal machine learning models, driving innovation from research and dataset architecture to production deployment for pre\- and post\-disaster response. * Define product and data strategy around the multimodal data corpus, leveraging proprietary datasets as a strategic moat for AI\-driven disaster resilience tools. * Collaborate with engineering teams to optimize model performance, scalability, and integration into existing product workflows. * Establish best practices for MLOps, including model versioning, automated testing, and performance tracking to ensure reliable and high\-quality deployments. * Help hire and grow the data science function, setting the technical bar and culture as the team scales. * Design, build, and maintain robust data ontologies and taxonomies to systematically organize, categorize, and integrate complex geospatial and multimodal datasets. **What you should have:** * Education: Advanced Degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical field. * Data Engineering \& Architecture: 7\+ years experience building scalable data pipelines, managing relational and non\-relational databases, and unifying fragmented data storage systems. * Modern Python Proficiency: Expertise in Python and data manipulation libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, or SQL). * Data Quality \& DataOps: Practical experience implementing automated data validation, quality control frameworks, and dataset versioning practices. * ML Data Lifecycle Understanding: Hands\-on experience structuring datasets specifically for machine learning workflows, including handling annotations, metadata tracking, and training set curation. **It’d be great if you also had these:** * Pipeline Design \& Ingestion: Construct automated ELT/ETL pipelines to aggregate, clean, and integrate complex geospatial, satellite image, and telemetry streams into unified repositories at scale and large volume. * Quality Governance \& DataOps: Deploy comprehensive data validation systems, schema checks, and anomaly monitoring to ensure machine learning components rely on robust, high\-fidelity information. * Versioning \& Tracking: Maintain structured dataset versioning infrastructure to enable reproducible model testing and efficient retrieval of operational features. * Workflow \& Label Integration: Harmonize external labeling pipelines and annotation feeds into streamlined, model\-ready training assets. * Cross\-Functional Strategy: Partner with software engineers, data scientists, and operational stakeholders to convert complex sensor attributes into targeted features for prediction pipelines. * Geospatial Data: Experience working with geospatial data (good knowledge of data sources and formats), GIS tools, and spatial analytics libraries (e.g., GDAL, GeoPandas, Rasterio, Shapely, Zarr, COGs…). The US base salary range for this full\-time position is $207,000 \- $311,000 \+ bonus \+ benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your location during the hiring process. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, or benefits. **An Equal Opportunity Workplace** ---------------------------------- At X, we don't just accept difference \- we celebrate it, we support it, and we thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, our products and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact us at x\-accommodation\-request@x.team.

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, iOS - Agentic Experience
jobs.description: **About the team** ------------------ The Agentic Experience team sits at the forefront of Zillow's transformation toward an agentic product experience. We are the stewards of the agentic UX framework, the foundation that allows Zillow's agentic AI capabilities to come to life across its surfaces, and we operate at the intersection of product and platform: shipping meaningful agentic experiences today while building the durable infrastructure that enables teams across Zillow to build more, faster, tomorrow. We built and launched the user experience for Zillow AI Mode, now available to every signed\-in Zillow user across web, iOS, and Android, and we own and evolve that core experience every day. We also stay at the forefront of agentic UX: exploring what comes after the conversational interface, including generative, context\-adaptive interfaces that personalize to each person's goals and stage of their real estate journey, and bringing the most promising of those ideas into a product used by millions. **About the role** ------------------ We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer, iOS, to help build and evolve Zillow AI Mode in the Zillow iOS app. You will be a core contributor to the mobile experience of AI Mode, a multimodal, context\-aware agentic experience that is increasingly woven into the rest of the app. Beyond the conversational experience itself, you will help shape the interfaces by which other parts of the Zillow iOS app integrate with AI Mode, so they can hand context to the agent and surface its capabilities in place. And as the team pushes into generative UX, you will have the opportunity to contribute to how we bring frontier interaction patterns into a production app used by millions. This is a hands\-on engineering role on a team that is central to Zillow's AI strategy. Much of what comes next is still being defined, and you will have a real voice in defining it. You Will Get To * Build and ship the iOS experience for Zillow AI Mode (conversational, multimodal, and context\-aware) in Swift and SwiftUI, with a high bar for craft, performance, and reliability in a consumer app at scale. * Design and evolve the integration interfaces that let other surfaces in the Zillow iOS app connect to AI Mode: passing context to the agent and bringing agentic capabilities into the flows where users already are. * Contribute to the team's generative UX frontier, helping prototype, evaluate, and productionize AI\-composed, hyper\-personalized interfaces on iOS. * Partner closely with your web and Android counterparts to keep the AI Mode experience consistent across platforms: aligning on experience decisions, evolving the shared schema and protocol, and learning from how each platform solves the same problems, all while building natively on iOS. * Collaborate with product managers, designers, applied scientists, and ML engineers to turn new agentic skills and model capabilities into shippable, measurable user experiences, and support rapid experimentation with real users. * Champion operational excellence for the iOS experience, from instrumentation and observability to testing strategy and safe, incremental rollout, so we can move fast without compromising quality or user trust. This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions. In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $164,400\.00 \- $262,600\.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $156,200\.00 \- $249,400\.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations. In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside. **Who you are** --------------- * A builder at heart who takes pride in the craft of mobile engineering and has the judgment to balance speed with rigor. * A champion for user experience quality. You care how things look, feel, and perform, and you hold a high bar for what great mobile work is. * A collaborative engineer who works well across platforms and functions (product, design, AI/ML, and peer engineering teams) and drives outcomes through influence rather than authority. * A pragmatic techno s of software engineering experience, the majority of it building native iOS applications in Swift. * Deep proficiency in SwiftUI and UIKit, Swift concurrency, and modern iOS architecture patterns, with experience evolving a large, long\-lived codebase. * Demonstrated experience shipping consumer\-facing iOS products to a large user base, with an appreciation for performance, reliability, accessibility, and user experience quality. * Strong understanding of modern engineering practices: CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and incremental rollout. Desired Skills * Experience building AI\-powered or agentic applications, including familiarity with LLMs, streaming responses, tool/function calling, and multimodal input/output (text, voice, images). * Experience with server\-driven or dynamically composed UI, or other approaches to rendering generative, context\-adaptive interfaces on mobile. * Experience on a cross\-platform team, aligning experience decisions with web and Android counterparts and learning from how other platforms solve similar problems. * Comfort with rapid prototyping and iterative product development in a fast\-moving, research\-adjacent environment. **Get to know us** ------------------ At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most\-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality. How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise. Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list , reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow. jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Software Engineering
jobs.description: **Company Summary** Zoro.com is a leading eCommerce platform offering nearly 12 million tools, parts and supplies for our business customers. Launched in 2011, we brought a B2C\-like experience to the B2B industry, and continue to be at the forefront of digital innovation at the intersection of technology and distribution. We have rapidly grown to over $1 billion in annual revenue and we're just getting started! **Job Summary**: As a Senior Engineering Manager on Growth and Commerce Engineering in the AI org, you'll lead product engineering teams that build and run customer\-facing experiences and the platforms/services that power them. You'll partner with Product and Design to turn customer problems into shipped experiences that measurably move key business outcomes, while keeping critical systems secure, reliable, and compliant.
